## Referência: references/squad/checklists/core-four-checklist.md

# Core Four Lead Acquisition Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Leads - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-CL-001 (Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Generated:** 2026-02-10
> **Agent:** hormozi-leads

---

## Quick Reference: The Core Four Matrix

| | Warm (Know You) | Cold (Strangers) |
|---|-----------------|------------------|
| **1-to-1 (Private)** | #1 Warm Outreach | #3 Cold Outreach |
| **1-to-many (Public)** | #2 Post Content | #4 Paid Ads |

**Core Equation:** More Advertising → More Engaged Leads → More Money

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

### Before Starting Any Core Four Method

- [ ] **Offer/Lead Magnet Ready**
  - [ ] Solves a specific problem for a specific audience
  - [ ] Clear dream outcome defined
  - [ ] Value equation elements documented
  - [ ] Could charge for it (even if giving free)

- [ ] **Tracking System Ready**
  - [ ] CRM or spreadsheet for contacts
  - [ ] Way to track outreach attempts
  - [ ] Way to track responses
  - [ ] Way to track conversions

- [ ] **Resource Assessment Complete**
  - [ ] Hours available per day documented
  - [ ] Budget available documented
  - [ ] More time than money? → Start Warm Outreach / Content
  - [ ] More money than time? → Start Cold Outreach / Paid Ads

---

## #1 Warm Outreach Checklist

### Setup Phase

- [ ] **List Building Complete**
  - [ ] Phone contacts exported
  - [ ] Email contacts exported (ALL accounts)
  - [ ] Facebook friends counted
  - [ ] Instagram followers counted
  - [ ] LinkedIn connections counted
  - [ ] Twitter/X followers counted
  - [ ] Other platforms checked
  - [ ] Total contacts documented: _______

- [ ] **Platform Priority Set**
  - [ ] Platforms ranked by contact count
  - [ ] First platform selected: ____________
  - [ ] Plan to hit all platforms eventually

### Daily Execution (Rule of 100)

- [ ] **Day ___ of 100**
  - [ ] 100 personalized messages sent
  - [ ] Each message includes personal detail
  - [ ] Social profiles checked for recent events
  - [ ] Follow-ups sent (Day 2 & 3 for non-responders)

### Response Handling

- [ ] **A-C-A Framework Applied**
  - [ ] Acknowledged what they said
  - [ ] Complimented (tied to character trait)
  - [ ] Asked question toward offer topic
  - [ ] 3-4 exchanges before making offer

- [ ] **Offer Made Correctly**
  - [ ] Asked "Do you know anyone who..." (not "Do you need...")
  - [ ] Described struggles clearly
  - [ ] Stated dream outcome
  - [ ] Stated time delay
  - [ ] Stated effort/sacrifice avoided
  - [ ] Included social proof (examples)
  - [ ] Used "backup humor" if they said no

### Free Client Phase (First 5)

- [ ] **Free Offer Structure**
  - [ ] Limited to 5 clients
  - [ ] Commitment 1: Use it
  - [ ] Commitment 2: Give feedback
  - [ ] Commitment 3: Leave review if deserved
  - [ ] "Does that sound fair?" asked

- [ ] **Client Tracking**
  - [ ] Free client #1: ____________
  - [ ] Free client #2: ____________
  - [ ] Free client #3: ____________
  - [ ] Free client #4: ____________
  - [ ] Free client #5: ____________

### Transition to Paid

- [ ] **Referrals Started** (trigger to charge)
- [ ] **Price Escalation**
  - [ ] Next 5: 80% off
  - [ ] Next 5: 60% off
  - [ ] Next 5: 40% off
  - [ ] Next 5: 20% off
  - [ ] Full price
  - [ ] Continue increasing 20% every 5

### List Maintenance

- [ ] **Regular Value Delivery**
  - [ ] Email/social content schedule set
  - [ ] 9-word emails sent periodically
  - [ ] Hot leads prioritized from responses

---

## #2 Post Free Content Checklist

### Setup Phase

- [ ] **Platform Strategy Selected**
  - [ ] Depth-first (maximize one, then add)
  - [ ] Breadth-first (add all, then maximize)
  - [ ] First platform selected: ____________

- [ ] **Content Schedule Set**
  - [ ] Minimum: Daily posting
  - [ ] Time commitment: 100 minutes/day
  - [ ] Duration: 100 days minimum

### Content Creation (Unit of Content)

- [ ] **Hook Created**
  - [ ] Topic selected (Past/Present/Trends/Manufactured)
  - [ ] Headline includes 2+ elements:
    - [ ] Recency
    - [ ] Relevance
    - [ ] Celebrity
    - [ ] Proximity
    - [ ] Conflict
    - [ ] Unusual
    - [ ] Ongoing
  - [ ] Format matches platform norms

- [ ] **Retention Built**
  - [ ] Structure selected:
    - [ ] Lists (items with theme)
    - [ ] Steps (actions in order)
    - [ ] Stories (events with lessons)
  - [ ] Curiosity embedded (unanswered questions)

- [ ] **Reward Delivered**
  - [ ] Promise from hook fully satisfied
  - [ ] Audience would want to share
  - [ ] Audience would want more

### Give:Ask Ratio

- [ ] **Ratio Tracked**
  - [ ] Current ratio: ___ give : ___ ask
  - [ ] Minimum target: 3:1
  - [ ] Ideal: Give until they ask

- [ ] **CTA Strategy Selected** (if asking)
  - [ ] Integrated (ads within content)
  - [ ] Intermittent (mostly give, occasional ask)
  - [ ] CTA type: Lead magnet / Direct offer

### Measurement

- [ ] **Weekly Tracking**
  - [ ] Posts published: ___
  - [ ] Engagement rate: ___%
  - [ ] Leads generated: ___

- [ ] **Monthly Tracking**
  - [ ] Audience size start: ___
  - [ ] Audience size end: ___
  - [ ] Growth: ___% MoM
  - [ ] Growth indicates content quality

---

## #3 Cold Outreach Checklist

### Setup Phase

- [ ] **Target List Built**
  - [ ] Ideal customer profile defined
  - [ ] List source selected:
    - [ ] Purchased lists
    - [ ] Scraped data
    - [ ] Industry databases
    - [ ] Conference lists
    - [ ] Association lists
    - [ ] Social media searches
  - [ ] List quality verified
  - [ ] Total contacts: _______

- [ ] **Automation Setup**
  - [ ] Email automation tool ready
  - [ ] SMS automation tool ready (if applicable)
  - [ ] DM automation tool ready (if applicable)
  - [ ] Compliance requirements reviewed

### Message Development

- [ ] **Cold Message Template**
  - [ ] Relevance: Why contacting THEM specifically
  - [ ] Value: What's in it for them
  - [ ] Credibility: Why believe you
  - [ ] CTA: Clear, low-friction next step
  - [ ] Multiple variations created for testing

### Daily Execution (Rule of 100)

- [ ] **Day ___ of 100**
  - [ ] 100+ cold outreaches sent (automated)
  - [ ] Channels used:
    - [ ] Email
    - [ ] Text
    - [ ] DM
    - [ ] Cold call
    - [ ] Flyers
  - [ ] Platform rules followed

### Response Handling

- [ ] **Response Received**
  - [ ] Treated like gold
  - [ ] A-C-A framework applied
  - [ ] Moved to warm outreach process
  - [ ] Tracked in CRM

### Measurement

- [ ] **Weekly Tracking**
  - [ ] Outreaches sent: ___
  - [ ] Responses received: ___
  - [ ] Response rate: ___% (target >5%)
  - [ ] Conversions: ___

---

## #4 Paid Ads Checklist

### Phase 1: Track Money

- [ ] **Tracking Setup Complete**
  - [ ] Platform tracking installed
  - [ ] Conversion events defined
  - [ ] Attribution configured
  - [ ] Dashboard/reporting ready
  - [ ] **DO NOT SPEND UNTIL TRACKING WORKS**

### Phase 2: Lose Money (Test)

- [ ] **Ad Creation**
  - [ ] Ad variations created (minimum 10)
  - [ ] Hook-Retain-Reward structure applied
  - [ ] Best free content considered for ads
  - [ ] Multiple creatives tested

- [ ] **Budget Set**
  - [ ] 30-day customer profit calculated: $___
  - [ ] Test budget per ad: $_____ (2x 30-day profit)
  - [ ] Cutoff if zero leads: $_____ (1x 30-day profit)

- [ ] **Testing**
  - [ ] Ads launched
  - [ ] Performance monitored daily
  - [ ] Losers cut at cutoff
  - [ ] Winners identified

### Phase 3: Print Money (Scale)

- [ ] **Winner Validation**
  - [ ] LTGP calculated: $_____
  - [ ] CAC calculated: $_____
  - [ ] LTGP:CAC ratio: ___:1 (target >3:1)

- [ ] **Scaling Budget**
  - [ ] Desired customers: ___
  - [ ] Base budget: Customers × CAC = $_____
  - [ ] Add 20% buffer: $_____
  - [ ] Daily budget: $_____

- [ ] **Customer-Financed Acquisition**
  - [ ] 30-day revenue per customer: $_____
  - [ ] 30-day delivery cost: $_____
  - [ ] 30-day profit: $_____
  - [ ] CAC: $_____
  - [ ] 30-day profit >= CAC? (Yes = unlimited scale)
  - [ ] If no: Upsells/cross-sells added to achieve

### Diagnostic (If Not Profitable)

- [ ] **CAC vs Industry Average**
  - [ ] Industry average CAC: $_____
  - [ ] Your CAC: $_____
  - [ ] If CAC > 3x industry: Fix ads
  - [ ] If CAC < 3x industry: Fix model (LTGP too low)

---

## More-Better-New Optimization Checklist

### When to Apply
- [ ] Current method has plateaued
- [ ] Returns are diminishing
- [ ] Want to grow faster

### MORE Phase

- [ ] **Volume Check**
  - [ ] Current daily actions: ___
  - [ ] Rule of 100 target: 100
  - [ ] Gap: ___
  - [ ] Action: Increase to 100 before anything else

### BETTER Phase

- [ ] **Constraint Identification**
  - [ ] Funnel steps mapped
  - [ ] Drop-off rates calculated:
    - [ ] Step 1: ___% pass
    - [ ] Step 2: ___% pass
    - [ ] Step 3: ___% pass
  - [ ] Biggest drop-off = constraint: _______

- [ ] **Weekly Testing**
  - [ ] Week of: _______
  - [ ] Test hypothesis: _______
  - [ ] Single variable changed: _______
  - [ ] Results: Win / Lose
  - [ ] Logged in test register: Yes / No

- [ ] **Move to Next Constraint**
  - [ ] Current constraint tested 4 times
  - [ ] Unable to beat current version
  - [ ] Moving to next biggest drop-off

### NEW Phase (Only after MORE+BETTER exhausted)

- [ ] **Priority Order**
  1. [ ] New placements on same platform
  2. [ ] Same approach on new platform
  3. [ ] New Core Four method entirely

- [ ] **Decision Criteria**
  - [ ] Returns from MORE+BETTER < Returns from NEW
  - [ ] Resources available for new channel
  - [ ] Selected: _______

---

## Quality Gates Checklist

### Gate 1: Offer Ready
- [ ] Lead magnet or offer validated
- [ ] Pass before starting any advertising

### Gate 2: Rule of 100
- [ ] 100 daily actions achieved
- [ ] Warning if below threshold

### Gate 3: Response Rates
- [ ] Warm outreach: >15% (warning if lower)
- [ ] Cold outreach: >5% (warning if lower)

### Gate 4: Audience Growth
- [ ] Month-over-month increase
- [ ] Warning if stagnant or declining

### Gate 5: Paid Ads Efficiency
- [ ] LTGP:CAC >= 3:1
- [ ] Block scaling if below

### Gate 6: Testing Cadence
- [ ] One test per week per platform
- [ ] Warning if not testing

---

## Weekly Review Checklist

### Warm Outreach
- [ ] Total outreaches this week: _____
- [ ] Response rate: _____%
- [ ] New free/paid clients: _____
- [ ] Referrals generated: _____

### Content
- [ ] Posts published: _____
- [ ] Audience growth: _____
- [ ] Best performing content: _____
- [ ] Leads from content: _____

### Cold Outreach
- [ ] Outreaches sent: _____
- [ ] Response rate: _____%
- [ ] Conversions: _____

### Paid Ads
- [ ] Spend: $_____
- [ ] Leads: _____
- [ ] Cost per lead: $_____
- [ ] LTGP:CAC: ___:1

### Optimization
- [ ] Test run this week: _____
- [ ] Result: Win/Lose
- [ ] Next week's test: _____

---

## Monthly Review Checklist

### Overall Performance
- [ ] Total leads this month: _____
- [ ] Lead growth vs last month: _____%
- [ ] Total customers acquired: _____
- [ ] Customer acquisition cost: $_____

### Method Performance
- [ ] #1 Warm Outreach efficiency: _____
- [ ] #2 Content audience growth: _____%
- [ ] #3 Cold Outreach response rate: _____%
- [ ] #4 Paid Ads LTGP:CAC: ___:1

### Resource Allocation
- [ ] Hours spent per method: _____
- [ ] Budget spent per method: $_____
- [ ] Best performing method: _____
- [ ] Method to scale: _____

### Next Month's Focus
- [ ] Primary method: _____
- [ ] Secondary method: _____
- [ ] Key tests planned: _____
- [ ] Volume targets: _____

---

## Scripts Quick Reference

### Warm Outreach - The Ask
```
"By the way, do you know anyone who is [struggles]
looking for [dream outcome] in [time delay]?

I'm taking on five case studies for free...
I help them [dream outcome] without [effort/sacrifice].
I even guarantee [dream outcome] or work until they do.

Does anyone you like come to mind?
...Haha, does anyone you hate come to mind?"
```

### Free Offer Acceptance
```
"I'll give everything for free, as long as you promise:
1) Use it
2) Give me feedback
3) Leave a killer review if deserved

Does that sound fair?"
```

### 9-Word Re-engagement
```
"Are you still looking for [4-word desire]?"
```

### Content CTA - Offer
```
"I'm looking for 5 [avatar] to help achieve [outcome] in [time].
You don't need to [effort/sacrifice].
If you don't get [outcome], I'll refund AND work until you do.
DM me / Comment / Reply if interested."
```

---

## Key Metrics Quick Reference

| Metric | Target | Warning |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Warm Response Rate | >20% | <15% |
| Cold Response Rate | >5% | <3% |
| Content Audience Growth | >5%/mo | Stagnant |
| Paid Ads LTGP:CAC | >3:1 | <3:1 |
| Daily Actions (Rule of 100) | 100 | <100 |
| Tests per Week | 1/platform | 0 |

---

## Emergency Quick Actions

### "I have zero leads"
1. Start Warm Outreach TODAY
2. 100 reach outs per day
3. Free offer for first 5
4. Continue for 100 days

### "My paid ads are losing money"
1. Check tracking (is it accurate?)
2. Calculate LTGP:CAC
3. If CAC > 3x industry: Fix ads
4. If CAC normal: Fix model (add upsells)
5. Implement customer-financed acquisition

### "My content isn't growing audience"
1. Review hooks (2+ elements?)
2. Check if reward matches promise
3. Compare format to top performers
4. Increase posting frequency
5. Consider depth-first before breadth

### "I hit a plateau"
1. Are you at 100/day? (MORE)
2. Are you testing weekly? (BETTER)
3. Have you tried new placements? (NEW)
4. Follow priority: MORE → BETTER → NEW

---

**Remember:** "If you're not getting as many leads as you want, you are not doing the core four with enough skill or enough volume."

**Commit to the Rule of 100 and you'll never go hungry again.**

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/customer-journey-checklist.md

# Customer Journey 4-Milestone Checklist

> Checklist de validação para `design-customer-journey.md` (HZ_RET_006)
> Source: $100M Retention Playbook - Step 9 Churn Checklist
> Agent: hormozi-retention

---

## Milestone 1: ACTIVATE

```yaml
milestone_activate:
  definition:
    - [ ] Activation point claramente definido
    - [ ] Métrica específica estabelecida
    - [ ] Target timeline definido (ex: primeiros 30 dias)

  tactics:
    - [ ] Onboarding 100% direcionado ao activation
    - [ ] Quick wins no caminho identificados
    - [ ] Fricções mapeadas e removidas
    - [ ] Celebração definida para quando atinge

  unlockable:
    - [ ] Incentivo por atingir activation definido
    - [ ] Tipo: unlock, bonus, badge, access
    - [ ] Entrega automática ou manual definida
```

---

## Milestone 2: TESTIMONIAL

```yaml
milestone_testimonial:
  timing:
    - [ ] Pedido vem IMEDIATAMENTE após activation
    - [ ] Momento de máxima satisfação identificado
    - [ ] Não esperar = não perder o momento

  capture_method:
    - [ ] Método primário definido (video, written, screenshot)
    - [ ] Método secundário para quem não quer video
    - [ ] Duração esperada (1-2 min video)

  questions_prepared:
    - [ ] "Onde você estava antes?"
    - [ ] "O que mudou?"
    - [ ] "Qual foi o momento decisivo?"
    - [ ] "O que você diria para alguém considerando?"

  template_ready:
    - [ ] Script de pedido documentado
    - [ ] Incentivo por participação definido
    - [ ] Processo de follow-up se não responder
```

---

## Milestone 3: REFER

```yaml
milestone_refer:
  timing:
    - [ ] Pedido vem LOGO APÓS testimonial
    - [ ] Ou após grande resultado/satisfação
    - [ ] Estado emocional positivo = melhor momento

  request:
    - [ ] Script documentado
    - [ ] "Você conhece alguém passando pelo mesmo?"
    - [ ] Naturalidade, não pressão

  facilitation:
    - [ ] Template de mensagem para enviar
    - [ ] Link/código fácil de compartilhar
    - [ ] Sistema de tracking de referrals

  incentives:
    - [ ] Incentivo para referrer definido
    - [ ] Incentivo para referred definido
    - [ ] Double-sided incentive configurado
```

---

## Milestone 4: ASCEND

```yaml
milestone_ascend:
  trigger_events:
    - [ ] Após activation point atingido
    - [ ] Após 3 meses de tenure
    - [ ] Após resultados significativos
    - [ ] Quando expressa nova necessidade

  offers:
    - [ ] Pelo menos 1 ascension offer definida
    - [ ] Pricing documentado
    - [ ] Value add claro

  positioning:
    - [ ] Próximo passo natural, não venda forçada
    - [ ] Conectado a nova necessidade do cliente

  when_not_to:
    - [ ] Não quando frustrados
    - [ ] Não antes de atingir valor na compra atual
    - [ ] Não durante problemas não resolvidos
```

---

## Journey Timeline

```yaml
timeline:
  mapped:
    - [ ] Semana 0-4: ACTIVATE - período definido
    - [ ] Semana 4-8: TESTIMONIAL - período definido
    - [ ] Semana 8-12: REFER - período definido
    - [ ] Mês 3+: ASCEND - triggers definidos

  realistic:
    - [ ] Timeline atingível para maioria dos clientes
    - [ ] Buffer para variação individual
```

---

## Unlockables System

```yaml
unlockables:
  per_milestone:
    - [ ] ACTIVATE: Unlock definido (ex: módulo avançado)
    - [ ] TESTIMONIAL: Unlock definido (ex: badge/certificado)
    - [ ] REFER: Unlock definido (ex: desconto/crédito)
    - [ ] ASCEND: Unlock definido (ex: acesso VIP)

  delivery:
    - [ ] Método de entrega definido (auto vs manual)
    - [ ] Notificação ao cliente configurada
```

---

## Tracking & Metrics

```yaml
metrics:
  per_milestone:
    - [ ] % que atinge ACTIVATE
    - [ ] % que dá TESTIMONIAL
    - [ ] % que faz REFER
    - [ ] % que faz ASCEND

  timing:
    - [ ] Tempo médio para cada milestone
    - [ ] Variação identificada
```

---

## Output Quality

```yaml
output_complete:
  documentation:
    - [ ] 4 milestones definidos com métricas
    - [ ] Scripts para cada pedido (testimonial, referral)
    - [ ] Unlockables documentados
    - [ ] Timeline visual criado

  alignment:
    - [ ] Alinhado com onboarding sequence
    - [ ] Alinhado com engagement scoring
    - [ ] Integrado com CRM/sistema
```

---

*Checklist: customer-journey | Version: 1.0*
*Supports: design-customer-journey.md (HZ_RET_006)*

---

## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical — 4 Milestone Definitions (Activate, Testimonial, Refer, Ascend) | 22 | 3 | 66 |
| Standard — Timeline, Unlockables System, Tracking & Metrics | 14 | 2 | 28 |
| Bonus — Output Quality & Alignment | 7 | 1 | 7 |
| **TOTAL** | **43** | | **101** |

### Thresholds
- **PASS**: >= 81 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 61 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 61 points

### If FAIL
The customer journey has critical gaps in one or more milestones. Prioritize completing the ACTIVATE milestone first (it gates all downstream milestones), then ensure each subsequent milestone has clear triggers, scripts, and unlockables before rolling out.

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/downsell-strategy-checklist.md

# Downsell Strategy Implementation Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Modelos: Seção 4 Ofertas de Downsell - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-CL-001 (SOP Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Generated:** 2026-02-10
> **Agent:** hormozi-models

---

## Pre-Implementation Setup

### 1. Payment Plan Infrastructure
- [ ] **Payment processor configured** - Can store cards and schedule payments
- [ ] **Third-party financing partner** - Application process integrated (optional but recommended)
- [ ] **Layaway terms defined** - Clear policy on payment-before-delivery
- [ ] **Payment calculator built** - Generate split options in real-time
- [ ] **Prepay discount set** - Amount that rewards full payment (e.g., "normally $X, prepay is $Y")
- [ ] **Billing frequency options** - Weekly, biweekly, monthly options mapped
- [ ] **Retry policy established** - Multiple passes on declined cards same day

### 2. Trial Structure Setup
- [ ] **Trial criteria defined** - What customer must do to avoid penalty
- [ ] **Penalty fee structure** - Per-item fees vs single fee
- [ ] **Check-in schedule created** - Mandatory meetings with upsell opportunities
- [ ] **Trial documentation** - Agreement with separate fee clause for initials
- [ ] **Card capture process** - System to securely store cards for future charges
- [ ] **Makeup opportunity policy** - How customers can recover from missed items

### 3. Feature Downsell Menu
- [ ] **Feature list with values** - Ranked from highest to lowest perceived value
- [ ] **Price-feature matrix** - What price for each configuration
- [ ] **Quality tier definitions** - What changes at each tier
- [ ] **Quantity reduction options** - Available package sizes
- [ ] **DIY alternatives** - Products/tools for self-service option
- [ ] **Guarantee removal pricing** - What discount for no guarantee

### 4. Training & Scripts
- [ ] **7-step payment plan script** - Word-for-word flow
- [ ] **Seesaw downselling script** - Simplified version
- [ ] **Trial offer script** - "Start you for free" approach
- [ ] **Integrity script** - Commitment extraction language
- [ ] **Fee explanation script** - Post-card-capture explanation
- [ ] **Desire check questions** - 1-10 scale and follow-up
- [ ] **Feature removal scripts** - For each downsell type

---

## Process Execution Checklist

### Payment Plan Downsell (Process I)

#### Step 1: Prepay Discount
- [ ] Present price WITH interest included as anchor
- [ ] Offer prepay as "discount" not avoiding "fee"
- [ ] Use language: "It's $X, but $Y if you prepay. You save $Z."
- [ ] Wait for response before moving to step 2

#### Step 2: Third-Party Options
- [ ] Offer financing: "Another company pays me, you pay them"
- [ ] Offer credit card: "Do you prefer I decide terms or you decide?"
- [ ] Offer layaway: "Pay before receiving, take your time"
- [ ] If all declined → Step 3

#### Step 3: Half Now, Half Later
- [ ] Ask: "When do you get paid?"
- [ ] Offer: "Half today, half when you get paid?"
- [ ] If declined: "What's the most you can put down today?"
- [ ] Schedule remaining balance to payday
- [ ] If still declined → Step 4

#### Step 4: Desire Check (GATE)
- [ ] Ask: "On a scale of 1-10, how much do you want this?"
- [ ] **If 8-10:** Continue to Step 5
- [ ] **If <8:** Ask "Why not a 10?" then pivot to Feature Downsell
- [ ] Document score in CRM

#### Step 5: Three-Payment Split
- [ ] Offer: "1/3 now, 1/3 next payday, 1/3 following payday"
- [ ] Align with customer's actual pay schedule
- [ ] If declined → Step 6

#### Step 6: Spread Evenly
- [ ] Calculate payments across service duration
- [ ] Example: "16-week program = 16 weekly payments"
- [ ] If declined → Step 7

#### Step 7: Free Trial
- [ ] Transition to Trial Process (Process II)
- [ ] "The sale ends here, at least for now" if trial also declined

---

### Trial with Penalty (Process II)

#### Step 1: Offer Trial Last
- [ ] Only after clear rejection of main offer + payment plans
- [ ] Script: "How about we start you for free? Would that work?"
- [ ] Frame as help, not sales tactic

#### Step 2: Get Card (GATE)
- [ ] Request card immediately: "Let me get your ID and card"
- [ ] If resistance: "It's just how we've always done it"
- [ ] **If no card → End conversation politely**
- [ ] Verify card works with small authorization

#### Step 3: Sell Staying and Paying (GATE)
- [ ] Ask: "If this gets you results, will you stay long-term?"
- [ ] Use integrity script about long-term vs quick fix
- [ ] **Must get verbal commitment before continuing**
- [ ] Document commitment

#### Step 4: Explain Fees (After Card)
- [ ] Explain penalty structure for non-compliance
- [ ] Frame as "keeping you on track"
- [ ] Have customer initial fee clause separately
- [ ] Timing: ALWAYS after card captured, never before

#### Step 5: Schedule Check-Ins
- [ ] Explain each check-in and its purpose
- [ ] Make clear these are mandatory
- [ ] Document that charges apply if missed
- [ ] Schedule all check-ins in calendar immediately

---

### Feature Downsell (Process III)

#### Strategic Removal Order
- [ ] **Remove HIGHEST value features first** - Makes customer see value
- [ ] Show price difference after removal
- [ ] Ask: "How about now?"
- [ ] If they re-upsell to main offer → Close on main

#### Quantity Reduction
- [ ] Product: "Start with 1 month instead of 3?"
- [ ] Service: "Start with 2 sessions instead of 4?"
- [ ] Maintain core value proposition

#### Quality Reduction
- [ ] Time: Specific hours vs anytime
- [ ] Days: Limited days vs any day
- [ ] Speed: Next day vs same day
- [ ] Ratio: Group vs 1-on-1
- [ ] Method: Text vs video call
- [ ] Provider: Team vs owner
- [ ] Format: Recorded vs live
- [ ] DIY vs Done-For-You

#### Feature Removal
- [ ] Remove guarantee (often most effective)
- [ ] Remove specific services (calls, chat, etc.)
- [ ] Remove premium features

#### DIY Alternative
- [ ] Last resort for service rejection
- [ ] Offer tools/products instead of service
- [ ] Products should support same outcome

---

## Quality Control Checklist

### Trust & Integrity Checks
- [ ] **Never offered same thing for less** - Always removed value with price
- [ ] **No in-the-moment discounting** - Used pre-approved terms only
- [ ] **Consistent pricing** - Same rules for everyone
- [ ] **No pressure tactics** - Personalized, not pressured
- [ ] **Trades, not giveaways** - Every give had a get

### Payment Plan Health
- [ ] **Full payment ratio maintained** - Not declining since adding plans
- [ ] **New customers added** - Not cannibalizing full-pay customers
- [ ] **Completion rate tracked** - >70% completing plans
- [ ] **Aligned with pay schedules** - Payments on paydays
- [ ] **Retry policy active** - Multiple passes on declines

### Trial Health
- [ ] **Card on file for all trials** - No exceptions
- [ ] **Commitment documented** - All agreed to stay if results
- [ ] **Fees acknowledged** - Initialed separately
- [ ] **Check-ins scheduled** - All mandatory meetings booked
- [ ] **Compliance tracking active** - Know who's meeting terms

---

## Metrics to Track

### Primary Metrics
| Metric | Target | Current | Status |
|--------|--------|---------|--------|
| Downsell Conversion Rate | >40% | ___ | ⬜ |
| 30-Day Cash Collected | ↑ vs baseline | ___ | ⬜ |
| Full Payment Ratio | Maintain | ___ | ⬜ |
| Trial-to-Paid Conversion | >50% | ___ | ⬜ |

### Process-Specific Metrics
| Process | Metric | Target | Current |
|---------|--------|--------|---------|
| Payment Plans | Completion Rate | >70% | ___ |
| Payment Plans | Steps to Close (avg) | Track | ___ |
| Trials | Penalty Collection Rate | Track | ___ |
| Trials | Check-in Attendance | >80% | ___ |
| Features | Re-Upsell Rate | Track | ___ |
| Features | LTV by Entry Method | Compare | ___ |

### Churn by Billing Frequency
| Frequency | Expected Churn | Actual |
|-----------|----------------|--------|
| Monthly | 10.7% | ___ |
| Quarterly | 5% | ___ |
| Annual | 2% | ___ |

---

## Red Flags & Escalations

### Immediate Escalation Required
- [ ] **Full payment ratio dropping** → Review if plans cannibalizing
- [ ] **Trial completion <50%** → Adjust criteria or support
- [ ] **Payment default rate >30%** → Review capacity assessment
- [ ] **Customer complaints about fees** → Review fee explanation process
- [ ] **Trust concerns raised** → Audit for pure discounting

### Warning Signs to Monitor
- [ ] Desire scores averaging <8 (offer-market fit issue)
- [ ] High step count to close (offer complexity issue)
- [ ] Trial penalties higher than conversions (criteria too hard)
- [ ] Feature downsell not re-upselling (wrong features removed)

---

## Weekly Review Checklist

### Downsell Performance
- [ ] Total rejections this week: ___
- [ ] Total downsell attempts: ___
- [ ] Downsell conversion rate: ___
- [ ] Revenue from downsells: ___

### Process Mix
- [ ] Payment plan downsells: ___
- [ ] Trial enrollments: ___
- [ ] Feature downsells: ___
- [ ] Re-upsells to main offer: ___

### Health Indicators
- [ ] Full payment ratio vs last week: ___
- [ ] Payment plan completion rate: ___
- [ ] Trial compliance rate: ___
- [ ] Average steps to downsell close: ___

---

## The Six Rules Quick Reference

| # | Rule | Check |
|---|------|-------|
| 1 | "No to THIS offer, not ALL offers" | Am I still making offers? |
| 2 | "Downsells are trades" | Did I get something for what I gave? |
| 3 | "Personalize, don't pressure" | Did I find their preferences first? |
| 4 | "Same thing, new ways" | Am I offering differently, not discounting? |
| 5 | "Never just lower price" | Did I remove value with the price reduction? |
| 6 | "Customers talk" | Am I using consistent pricing? |

---

## Anti-Pattern Check

### The Car Salesman Trap
**Story:** Salesman dropped insurance from $5,000 → $400 for the SAME product.
**Result:** Customer said no to ALL offers AND lost trust in the car price.

**Self-Check:**
- [ ] I did NOT offer the same thing for less
- [ ] I offered DIFFERENT things at different prices
- [ ] Customer trust maintained
- [ ] Customer understands value-price relationship

---

## Implementation Sign-Off

| Phase | Owner | Date | Status |
|-------|-------|------|--------|
| Infrastructure Setup | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |
| Script Training | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |
| First Live Downsell | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |
| Week 1 Review | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |
| Process Optimization | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |
| Full Deployment | ___ | ___ | ⬜ |

---

- [x] 11 SOP parts documented
- [x] 8-field step anatomy for each process
- [x] Quality gates defined
- [x] Metrics tracking configured
- [x] Escalation paths established

**Source:** All checklist items derived from $100M Modelos Seção 4, Ofertas de Downsell

# Email Campaign Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Money Models Blueprint: Email/SMS Copy - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-CL-001 (Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10
> **Agent:** hormozi-copy

---

## Pre-Campaign Setup

### List & Segmentation
- [ ] Registration list identified and cleaned
- [ ] Purchase history imported
- [ ] Cart abandonment tracking configured
- [ ] Affiliate list separated
- [ ] Exclusion rules defined:
  - [ ] Purchasers excluded from upsell sequences
  - [ ] Previous affiliates excluded from recruitment
  - [ ] Cart abandoners routed to recovery sequence
- [ ] Merge variables tested ({FNAME}, {{smart_link}}, etc.)
- [ ] Fallback values set for empty fields

### Platform Configuration
- [ ] Email automation platform configured (HubSpot)
- [ ] SMS platform integrated (Twilio/SMSBump)
- [ ] Shopify/E-commerce webhooks active
- [ ] Calendar integration tested
- [ ] Smart link generation verified
- [ ] UTM parameters standardized
- [ ] Tracking pixels installed

### Deliverability Preparation
- [ ] Sender domain authenticated (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
- [ ] IP reputation checked
- [ ] Warm-up plan in place (if new domain)
- [ ] Spam score tested (<5)
- [ ] Unsubscribe process verified
- [ ] CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance verified

---

## Registration Sequence Checklist

### Email b1: Confirmation ("You're registered")
- [ ] Subject: "You're registered. (Save this email)"
- [ ] Opens with congratulations + name
- [ ] "PLEASE SAVE THIS EMAIL" instruction included
- [ ] Event details present:
  - [ ] Platform (YouTube Live)
  - [ ] Date
  - [ ] Time with timezone (PT + ET)
- [ ] Calendar link functional
- [ ] PS about pre-order/shipping
- [ ] Trigger: Immediate on form submit
- [ ] SMS companion sent

### Email b2: VIP Upsell (15 minutes)
- [ ] Subject: "in case you missed this"
- [ ] Confirms already registered
- [ ] VIP benefits listed with checkmarks:
  - [ ] Vegas day entry
  - [ ] Book first + guaranteed
  - [ ] Private VIP livestream
  - [ ] Launch Workshop
- [ ] "Same price" reminder
- [ ] Mystery tease PS ("better than NFT...")
- [ ] CTA to VIP page
- [ ] Trigger: 15 min after registration
- [ ] Exclusion: purchased = true, abandoned = true

### Email b3: VIP Follow-up (24 hours)
- [ ] Subject: "Get your book first + VIP Livestream"
- [ ] "Helps warehouse team" rationale
- [ ] Full VIP benefit list
- [ ] Price clearly stated ($29.99 + SH)
- [ ] "Secret Project" tease
- [ ] Calendar reminder link
- [ ] Trigger: 24h after registration
- [ ] Exclusion: purchased = true

### Email b4: Affiliate Invitation (48 hours)
- [ ] Subject: "Win a day with me (free)"
- [ ] Social proof (32,000 previous affiliates)
- [ ] Prize framing ("benefit you AND them")
- [ ] refer.acq.com link
- [ ] "Just 10 people" accessibility note
- [ ] Behind-the-scenes promise
- [ ] Trigger: 48h after registration
- [ ] Exclusion: previous affiliates

### Email b5: Affiliate Follow-up (72 hours)
- [ ] Subject: "Free Audiobook + Book Launch Event"
- [ ] Specific prize breakdown:
  - [ ] 70 Profit Tactics Audiobook
  - [ ] Chance at Vegas day
  - [ ] Recording of day
- [ ] "Biggest prize" tease
- [ ] Terms & Conditions link
- [ ] Trigger: 72h after registration
- [ ] Exclusion: previous affiliates

---

## Pre-Launch Sequence Checklist

### Email 1: Announcement (45 days)

- [ ] Registration + preorder CTA
- [ ] Money Model definition
- [ ] "Crowning achievement" positioning
- [ ] Mystery project tease PS
- [ ] Full list send + new registrants

### Email 2: Official Invitation (41 days)

- [ ] Mystery giveaway reminder

- [ ] Vegas drawing mention
- [ ] Pre-order link

### Email 3: Value Explanation (35 days)

- [ ] Warehouse team rationale
- [ ] Full VIP benefit list
- [ ] "Get yours first" urgency

### Email 5: Mystery Amplification (19 days)

## Abandoned Cart Sequence Checklist

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/engagement-scoring-checklist.md

# Engagement Scoring System Checklist

> Checklist de implementação para `create-engagement-scoring.md` (HZ_RET_007)
> Source: $100M Retention Playbook - Seção 10
> Agent: hormozi-retention

---

## Data Foundation

```yaml
data_foundation:
  available_metrics:
    - [ ] Login/visit data disponível
    - [ ] Usage/feature adoption data
    - [ ] Content consumption data
    - [ ] Community activity data
    - [ ] Support ticket data

  activation_point:
    - [ ] Activation point definido
    - [ ] Métrica de activation trackável
```

---

## 5 Levels Defined

```yaml
level_definitions:
  level_0_ghost:
    - [ ] Critério: Sem atividade 30+ dias
    - [ ] Threshold específico definido
    - [ ] Risco: Extremamente alto

  level_1_passive:
    - [ ] Critério: Atividade mínima, tendência queda
    - [ ] Threshold específico definido
    - [ ] Risco: Alto

  level_2_active:
    - [ ] Critério: Regular mas não no activation
    - [ ] Threshold específico definido
    - [ ] Risco: Moderado

  level_3_engaged:
    - [ ] Critério: No/acima activation point
    - [ ] Threshold específico definido
    - [ ] Risco: Baixo

  level_4_champion:
    - [ ] Critério: Ativo + refere outros
    - [ ] Threshold específico definido
    - [ ] Risco: Muito baixo
```

---

## Action Protocols

```yaml
protocols:
  ghost_protocol:
    - [ ] Prioridade CRÍTICA definida
    - [ ] Sequência de 14-21 dias documentada
    - [ ] Day 0: Email/SMS pessoal
    - [ ] Day 3: Ligação
    - [ ] Day 7: Oferta especial
    - [ ] Day 14: Last chance
    - [ ] Escalation definido

  passive_protocol:
    - [ ] Framework ACA aplicado
    - [ ] Outreach pessoal (não automático)
    - [ ] Friction discovery process
    - [ ] Incentivo para re-engajar

  active_protocol:
    - [ ] Foco: Guiar ao activation point
    - [ ] Clarificar o que precisa atingir
    - [ ] Remover obstáculos
    - [ ] Progress tracking

  engaged_protocol:
    - [ ] Manter, não quebrar o que funciona
    - [ ] Testimonial request
    - [ ] Referral request
    - [ ] Upsell presentation

  champion_protocol:
    - [ ] VIP access oferecido
    - [ ] Early access a novidades
    - [ ] Co-creation oportunidades
    - [ ] Ambassador program
```

---

## Metrics Framework

```yaml
metrics_tiers:
  tier_1_survival:
    - [ ] Churn rate mensal (por cohort)
    - [ ] Revenue churn rate
    - [ ] LTV (rolling 90 dias)
    - [ ] LTV:CAC ratio

  tier_2_engagement:
    - [ ] Frequência de login/visita
    - [ ] Profundidade de uso de features
    - [ ] Taxa de consumo de conteúdo
    - [ ] Participação em comunidade
    - [ ] Support ticket volume + sentiment
    - [ ] NPS score (trimestral)

  tier_3_predictive:
    - [ ] Tempo desde último login/compra
    - [ ] Tendência do engagement score
    - [ ] Taxa de falha de pagamento
    - [ ] Taxa de resposta a outreach
    - [ ] % conclusão do activation point
```

---

## Scoring Algorithm

```yaml
algorithm:
  factors_defined:
    - [ ] Login frequency (weight assigned)
    - [ ] Activation status (weight assigned)
    - [ ] Feature depth (weight assigned)
    - [ ] Community activity (weight assigned)
    - [ ] Referral behavior (weight assigned)

  thresholds:
    - [ ] Ghost threshold defined (ex: score <10)
    - [ ] Passive threshold defined (ex: 10-30)
    - [ ] Active threshold defined (ex: 31-50)
    - [ ] Engaged threshold defined (ex: 51-75)
    - [ ] Champion threshold defined (ex: >75)

  calculation:
    - [ ] Fórmula documentada
    - [ ] Testada com dados reais
    - [ ] Update frequency definida
```

---

## Alerts & Automation

```yaml
alerts:
  configured:
    - [ ] Alert para Level 0 (Ghost) - imediato
    - [ ] Alert para Level 1 (Passive) - diário
    - [ ] Alert para downgrade de level

  recipients:
    - [ ] Quem recebe cada tipo de alert
    - [ ] Escalation path claro
```

---

## Dashboard & Visualization

```yaml
dashboard:
  created:
    - [ ] Distribuição por level visível
    - [ ] Tendências ao longo do tempo
    - [ ] Alerts ativos
    - [ ] Actions pending

  location:
    - [ ] Dashboard location definido
    - [ ] Acesso configurado para equipe
```

---

## Quality Gate

```yaml
quality_gate:
  system_complete:
    - [ ] 5 níveis claramente definidos
    - [ ] Critérios objetivos para cada nível
    - [ ] Métricas em 3 tiers implementadas
    - [ ] Protocolo de ação para cada nível
    - [ ] Activation point integrado no scoring
    - [ ] Alertas definidos para risco
    - [ ] Dashboard/visualização criada
    - [ ] Owner de cada protocolo atribuído
```

---

*Supports: create-engagement-scoring.md (HZ_RET_007)*

## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical — 5 Level Definitions & Action Protocols | 35 | 3 | 105 |
| Standard — Data Foundation, Scoring Algorithm, Alerts | 20 | 2 | 40 |
| Bonus — Dashboard, Quality Gate, Metrics Framework | 19 | 1 | 19 |
| **TOTAL** | **74** | | **164** |

### Thresholds
- **PASS**: >= 132 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 99 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 99 points

### If FAIL
The engagement scoring system cannot reliably identify at-risk customers. Ensure all 5 levels have objective thresholds and that the Ghost (Level 0) protocol is fully defined as an immediate priority -- undetected ghosts are the largest source of preventable churn.

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/exit-interview-checklist.md

# Exit Interview System Checklist

> Checklist de implementação para `create-exit-interview-system.md` (HZ_RET_005)
> Source: $100M Retention Playbook - Steps 5+7 Churn Checklist
> Agent: hormozi-retention

---

## Pre-System Setup

```yaml
pre_setup:
  onboarding_integration:
    - [ ] Expectativa de exit interview setada no onboarding
    - [ ] Script para setar expectativa documentado
    - [ ] Compromisso social criado ("pode fazer isso por mim?")

  cancellation_trigger:
    - [ ] Trigger de cancelamento definido
    - [ ] Cancelamento NÃO processa imediatamente
    - [ ] Call agendada dentro de 48h automaticamente
```

---

## Interview Process

```yaml
interview_process:
  scheduling:
    - [ ] Método de agendamento definido
    - [ ] Tempo máximo até call (48h)
    - [ ] Reminder 24h antes

  script_documented:
    - [ ] Script de abertura pronto
    - [ ] "Hey, sem pressão. Adoraria ouvir todas as razões..."
    - [ ] Técnicas de escuta documentadas
```

---

## 3 Phases of Interview

```yaml
interview_phases:
  phase_1_listen:
    - [ ] Regras claras: NÃO interromper, NÃO defender
    - [ ] Objetivo: Validar emoções, coletar informação
    - [ ] Duração: Quanto precisar

  phase_2_align:
    - [ ] Script de indignação preparado
    - [ ] "Isso é completamente ridículo. Você está 100% correto."
    - [ ] Criar aliança com cliente

  phase_3_offer:
    - [ ] Pergunta: "Me dá oportunidade de consertar?"
    - [ ] Se SIM: Oferecer save options
    - [ ] Se NÃO: Agradecer feedback, processar com dignidade
```

---

## Save Options

```yaml
save_options:
  option_1_redo:
    - [ ] Critérios de quando usar definidos
    - [ ] Script documentado
    - [ ] "Deixa eu tentar de novo e vou consertar isso"
    - [ ] Ações pós-redo definidas (responsável dedicado, check-ins)

  option_2_upsell:
    - [ ] Critérios de quando usar definidos
    - [ ] Programa superior identificado
    - [ ] Script documentado
    - [ ] "Você deveria estar no programa maior. Culpa minha."
    - [ ] Crédito de pagamentos anteriores

  option_3_pause:
    - [ ] Critérios de quando usar definidos
    - [ ] Termos de pausa definidos
    - [ ] Script documentado
    - [ ] Check-in em 30-60 dias agendado
```

---

## Resell Protocol

```yaml
resell_protocol:
  value_reminder:
    - [ ] Script para relembrar por que ficar ajuda
    - [ ] Progresso do cliente documentado

  loss_aversion:
    - [ ] Lista do que perdem preparada:
      - [ ] URLs personalizadas
      - [ ] Posts/conteúdo criado
      - [ ] Progresso/badges/níveis
      - [ ] Acesso a comunidade
      - [ ] Pricing de founder (se aplicável)
      - [ ] Relacionamentos construídos
```

---

## High-Volume Alternative

```yaml
cancellation_video:
  if_needed:
    - [ ] Critério de "alto volume" definido
    - [ ] Vídeo criado com:
      - [ ] Relembra por que começaram
      - [ ] Revende o valor
      - [ ] Lembra o que arriscam perder
      - [ ] Oferece alternativa (pause/downgrade)
      - [ ] CTA final

    - [ ] Duração: 3-4 minutos max
    - [ ] Posicionado ANTES da confirmação de cancelamento
```

---

## Tracking & Metrics

```yaml
tracking:
  volume_metrics:
    - [ ] Cancellation requests tracked
    - [ ] Interviews scheduled vs completed
    - [ ] Show rate

  outcome_metrics:
    - [ ] Saved with redo
    - [ ] Saved with upsell
    - [ ] Saved with pause
    - [ ] Total save rate

  feedback_metrics:
    - [ ] Top 3 razões de cancelamento
    - [ ] Actionable insights documentados
```

---

## Team Training

```yaml
team_training:
  skills:
    - [ ] Equipe treinada em escuta ativa
    - [ ] Equipe treinada nas 3 fases
    - [ ] Equipe treinada nas save options
    - [ ] Role-play realizado

  documentation:
    - [ ] Feedback log template criado
    - [ ] Processo de escalation definido
```

---

## Expected Impact

```yaml
expected_impact:
  targets_set:
    - [ ] Save rate target: ~50% dos que aparecem
    - [ ] Show rate target: ~50%
    - [ ] Churn reduction: ~25%
    - [ ] LTV increase: ~33%
```

---

*Checklist: exit-interview | Version: 1.0*
*Supports: create-exit-interview-system.md (HZ_RET_005)*

---

## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical — 3 Interview Phases & Save Options | 22 | 3 | 66 |
| Standard — Pre-System Setup, Resell Protocol, Team Training | 17 | 2 | 34 |
| Bonus — High-Volume Alternative, Tracking & Metrics, Expected Impact | 16 | 1 | 16 |
| **TOTAL** | **55** | | **116** |

### Thresholds
- **PASS**: >= 93 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 70 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 70 points

### If FAIL
The exit interview system cannot effectively save cancelling customers. Prioritize documenting the 3-phase interview script (Listen, Align, Offer) and the 3 save options (Redo, Upsell, Pause) -- these are the core mechanics that drive the ~25% churn reduction target.

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/fast-cash-checklist.md

# Fast Cash Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Playbook: Fast Cash - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** HO-CL-001 (Hormozi Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Agent:** hormozi-leads

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

Before launching a Fast Cash Play, verify:

### List Readiness
- [ ] Customer database accessible
- [ ] Existing customers identified and segmented
- [ ] Past customers (in good standing) identified
- [ ] Engaged leads with explicit permission identified
- [ ] Cold leads (no contact 6+ months) EXCLUDED
- [ ] Contact information verified (email, phone)
- [ ] List count calculated for 5-10% target

### Offer Readiness
- [ ] Ultra-premium offer designed
- [ ] 1-3 core components defined
- [ ] 3 bonuses separated and ready to layer
- [ ] Bonus 1 (good) ready for Day 5/Day 2 release
- [ ] Bonus 2 (better) ready for Day 2/6h release
- [ ] Bonus 3 (best - "worth more than entire price") ready for 24h/cart open
- [ ] Price set at 10x-50x current average cart value
- [ ] Quantity cap set at 5-10% of customer base

### Fulfillment Readiness
- [ ] Delivery capacity verified for all potential buyers
- [ ] Schedule blocked for premium service delivery
- [ ] Team briefed on premium expectations
- [ ] "You. Will. Work. More. For. These. Customers" understood

### Materials Readiness
- [ ] All emails written and loaded in CRM
- [ ] All texts written and scheduled
- [ ] CTA consistent across all messages
- [ ] Price indication included where appropriate
- [ ] Deadline (Saturday midnight) set clearly
- [ ] Booking/checkout links tested

### Sales Readiness (Consult Path)
- [ ] Calendar open for consults over 7-day window
- [ ] Sales scripts reviewed
- [ ] Card-on-file charging process ready
- [ ] "I'm in" reply handling process defined

### Tech Readiness (Auto Checkout Path)
- [ ] Checkout page built and tested
- [ ] Payment processing verified
- [ ] Cart open time scheduled
- [ ] Inventory/spot limiting configured

---

## Phase I: Preparation Checklist

### Step 1: Assemble Target List
- [ ] Query CRM for existing customers
- [ ] Query CRM for past customers in good standing
- [ ] Query CRM for engaged leads with permission
- [ ] Exclude leads with no contact in 6+ months
- [ ] Verify contact info for all included
- [ ] Calculate total list size
- [ ] Set quantity cap (5-10% of list or fulfillment limit)

### Step 2: Design Ultra-Premium Offer
**Core Components (pick 1-3):**
- [ ] **Attention**: 1-on-1 or many-on-1 from senior person
- [ ] **Personalization**: Customized/tailored version
- [ ] **Convenience**: 24/7 support, extended hours, exclusive times
- [ ] **Status**: Special perks, badges, recognition
- [ ] **Duration**: 6 months to 1 year commitment
- [ ] **Speed**: Priority, <10 min response promise
- [ ] **Experience**: White glove, concierge, nice dinners
- [ ] **Access**: In-person, retreats, behind the scenes
- [ ] **Network**: Connection with other top customers
- [ ] **Secrets**: Trade secrets, vetted vendors, black book

**Bonus Structure:**
- [ ] Bonus 1 defined and benefits documented
- [ ] Bonus 2 defined and benefits documented
- [ ] Bonus 3 defined (must be worth more than price tag)
- [ ] All bonuses available to all buyers regardless of timing

### Step 3: Set Premium Price
- [ ] Current average cart value identified: $________
- [ ] 10x multiplier = $________
- [ ] 50x multiplier = $________
- [ ] Final price set: $________
- [ ] Price shocks as much as value shocks: VERIFIED

### Step 4: Set Quantity Cap
- [ ] Customer base count: ________
- [ ] 5% of customers: ________
- [ ] 10% of customers: ________
- [ ] Fulfillment capacity: ________
- [ ] Final cap (lowest of above): ________ spots

### Step 5: Choose Selling Method
- [ ] **Consult Path** (7 days) - IF:
  - [ ] High price point
  - [ ] Limited sales staff
  - [ ] Need to spread appointments
- [ ] **Auto Checkout Path** (5 days) - IF:
  - [ ] Very strong brand
  - [ ] Can handle stampede
  - [ ] Low-friction purchase

### Step 6: Prep All Materials
- [ ] All emails written (see templates)
- [ ] All texts written (see schedule)
- [ ] Loaded into CRM/scheduler
- [ ] Send times configured
- [ ] Test messages sent
- [ ] Links verified working

---

## Phase II: Execution - Push to Consult (7 Days)

### Day 7 (Sunday): Primer
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: "Hey [CLIENT NAME] would it be cool if I got you [TO THEIR GOAL] and saved you a ton of money? Give me a thumbs up if that sounds cool. I'm sending you something you're gonna like tomorrow."
- [ ] Responses monitored
- [ ] Hot leads noted

### Day 6 (Monday): Announcement
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "We need to talk" - Core offer, price indication, deadline, CTA to book consult
- [ ] **TEXT AM SENT**: "Hey, sooo I just sent you an email!! Did you get it?"
- [ ] **TEXT PM SENT**: "That email about our special offer has my inbox blowing up. Click >>LINK<< to set a time."
- [ ] Consult bookings tracked
- [ ] Early sales recorded

### Day 5 (Tuesday): Recap + Bonus 1
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "best. deal. ever." - Recap all benefits for people who missed it
- [ ] **BONUS 1 RELEASED**: ________________ (Status type)
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Meme + link
- [ ] Sales count updated: ____/____

### Day 4 (Wednesday): Mid-week Push
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: "This offer won't happen ever again. Click >>LINK<< to talk about how it can help you."
- [ ] Sales velocity assessed
- [ ] IF <50% sold: Consider adding value to offer

### Day 3 (Thursday): Sales Update
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "how to [get dream result] and save money doing it"
- [ ] Include actual numbers: "Over half the spots are gone. [X] people have already..."
- [ ] Remind: first-come-first-serve
- [ ] Sales count updated: ____/____

### Day 2 (Friday): Scarcity + Bonus 2
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: "[CLIENT NAME] We're down to our last couple of spots..."
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "2 spots left + game changer"
- [ ] **BONUS 2 RELEASED**: ________________ (Secrets type)
- [ ] "GAME CHANGER I WAS SAVING UNTIL NOW" messaging used
- [ ] Sales count updated: ____/____

### Day 1 AM (Saturday): Warning + Best Bonus
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "Saving $XXX ends tonight. Don't kick yourself tomorrow."
- [ ] **BONUS 3 RELEASED**: ________________ (Access type - worth more than price)
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Reminder with CTA
- [ ] Deadline reinforced: "expires tonight at 7pm"
- [ ] Sales count updated: ____/____

### Day 1 PM (Saturday): Sold Out
- [ ] **IF SOLD OUT**: Send sold out text
- [ ] **IF NOT SOLD OUT**: Consider final push or accept current sales
- [ ] "The program sold out!" notification sent
- [ ] Final sales recorded: ____/____
- [ ] Waitlist compiled (for back-outs)

### Post-Campaign: Back-Out Handling
- [ ] **IF CUSTOMER BACKS OUT**: Send "one spot left" notification
- [ ] Waitlist contacted first
- [ ] Back-out spot filled
- [ ] "RE: your goals we set" email template used

---

## Phase II: Execution - Push to Auto Checkout (5 Days)

### Day 5: Primer
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Teaser about something big coming
- [ ] Anticipation built

### Day 4: Announcement
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: Core components + price
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Draw attention to email
- [ ] Initial interest gauged

### Day 2: 48h Warning + Bonus 1
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: Cart opens in 48 hours
- [ ] **BONUS 1 RELEASED**: ________________ (Personalization type)
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: "Set an alarm so you don't miss it"
- [ ] "Expect it to sell out in minutes" messaging used
- [ ] First-come-first-serve emphasized

### Day 1: 60 Min Out
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: "Set alarm, have payment method ready"
- [ ] Team ready for cart open
- [ ] Checkout page verified working

### Cart Open: Launch + Best Bonus
- [ ] **CART OPENED** at scheduled time
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: Cart open announcement
- [ ] **BONUS 3 RELEASED**: ________________ (Experience type - immediate benefit)
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Cart open notification
- [ ] Sales monitoring started

### Cart Open + 60 Min: Sales Update
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: "How many sold already. How many left."
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Update
- [ ] Sales count: ____/____

### Cart Open + 6h: Scarcity + Surprise Bonus
- [ ] **EMAIL SENT**: X spots left
- [ ] **SURPRISE BONUS RELEASED**: ________________ (Convenience type)
- [ ] "This should close out the offer" messaging
- [ ] **TEXT SENT**: Final push
- [ ] Sales count: ____/____

### Cart Open + 12h: Sold Out
- [ ] **SOLD OUT NOTIFICATION** sent
- [ ] "Shows the promo was justified"
- [ ] Final sales recorded: ____/____
- [ ] Waitlist compiled

### Next Day: Back-Out Handling
- [ ] **IF CUSTOMER BACKS OUT**: "one spot left" notification
- [ ] Waitlist gets priority
- [ ] Charge card on file if permitted

---

## Phase III: Fulfillment Checklist

### Deliver Premium Service
- [ ] All buyers contacted within 24h of purchase
- [ ] Onboarding scheduled
- [ ] Premium service calendar blocked
- [ ] "You. Will. Work. More. For. These. Customers" mindset activated
- [ ] White-glove experience delivered
- [ ] All promised bonuses provided

### Collect the 4Rs
- [ ] **REVIEWS**: Request reviews from all buyers
- [ ] **RESULTS**: Document customer outcomes
- [ ] **REFERRALS**: Ask for referrals
- [ ] **RESELLS**: Explore additional purchases
- [ ] 4Rs documented for marketing use

---

## Phase IV: Cooldown & Planning Checklist

### Cooldown List
- [ ] Campaign complete notification sent internally
- [ ] Return to regular value-add content
- [ ] No promotional content for 90 days
- [ ] List engagement monitored
- [ ] Cold leads warmup started (for next campaign)

### Set Next Fast Cash Date
- [ ] 90+ days out confirmed
- [ ] Q1 date: ________
- [ ] Q2 date: ________
- [ ] Q3 date: ________
- [ ] Q4 date: ________
- [ ] Calendar blocked for next campaign prep

---

## Quality Gate Verification

| Gate | Check | Status |
|------|-------|--------|
| QG-001 | List warmth (no 6-month cold leads) | [ ] |
| QG-002 | Offer value (10x+ unscalable elements) | [ ] |
| QG-003 | Price premium (10x-50x current) | [ ] |
| QG-004 | Material readiness (all prepped) | [ ] |
| QG-005 | Capacity verified (can fulfill all) | [ ] |
| QG-006 | Cooldown observed (90+ days since last) | [ ] |

---

## KPI Targets

### Campaign Metrics
| Metric | Target | Actual | Status |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Total Revenue | $30,000+ | $________ | [ ] |
| Spots Sold | 100% | ____/____ | [ ] |
| Gross Margin | 90%+ | ___% | [ ] |
| Customer Take Rate | 5-15% | ___% | [ ] |
| Sell-out Velocity | <50% duration | __ days | [ ] |

### 4Rs Collection
| 4R | Target | Actual | Status |
|----|--------|--------|--------|
| Reviews | 75%+ of buyers | ____/____ | [ ] |
| Results | 100% documented | ____/____ | [ ] |
| Referrals | 2+ per buyer | ____/____ | [ ] |
| Resells | 25%+ | ____/____ | [ ] |

---

## Annual Fast Cash Calendar

### Quarterly Performance
| Quarter | Revenue Target | Actual | Spots | Take Rate |
|---------|---------------|--------|-------|-----------|
| Q1 | $30,000+ | $________ | ____/____ | ___% |
| Q2 | $30,000+ | $________ | ____/____ | ___% |
| Q3 | $30,000+ | $________ | ____/____ | ___% |
| Q4 | $30,000+ | $________ | ____/____ | ___% |
| **Annual** | $120,000+ | $________ | ____/____ | ___% |

### Annual Impact
| Metric | Baseline | With Fast Cash | Change |
|--------|----------|----------------|--------|
| Annual Revenue | $________ | $________ | +__% |
| Annual Profit | $________ | $________ | +__% |
| New Customers from Fast Cash | N/A | ________ | N/A |

---

## Troubleshooting Quick Reference

### Not Selling Fast Enough
- [ ] Check open rates (list engagement issue?)
- [ ] Check click rates (offer interest issue?)
- [ ] Check booking/purchase rates (value/price issue?)
- [ ] **ACTION**: Add value to offer before remaining sends
- [ ] **QUOTE**: "Consider adding things to the offer to make it more compelling"

### High Opens, Low Conversions
- [ ] Review offer clarity
- [ ] Review price vs. value presentation
- [ ] Check CTA friction (too many steps?)
- [ ] **ACTION**: Simplify purchase process

### Customer Backing Out
- [ ] Identify reason
- [ ] Improve onboarding/reassurance
- [ ] Send back-out notification to waitlist
- [ ] **ACTION**: Fill spot immediately

### List Fatigue (for future campaigns)
- [ ] Extend cooldown to 6 months
- [ ] Increase value content between campaigns
- [ ] Ensure scarcity was real (don't fake sold-out)
- [ ] **QUOTE**: "If you feel you need to give it longer than twelve weeks to cool off between promotions, run it twice a year instead"

---

| 5 | Tuesday | Email + Text | Recap + Bonus 1 + meme |
| 4 | Wednesday | Text | Mid-week push |
| 3 | Thursday | Email | Sales update with numbers |
| 2 | Friday | Text + Email | Scarcity + Bonus 2 |
| 1 | Saturday AM | Email + Text | Warning + Bonus 3 (best) |
| 1 | Saturday PM | Text | Sold out notification |
| 0 | (If back-out) | Email + Text | One spot left |

---

## Sample Campaign Schedule (Auto Checkout Path)

| Day | Action | Content |
|-----|--------|---------|
| 5 | Text | Primer |
| 4 | Email + Text | Announcement with price |
| 2 | Email + Text | 48h warning + Bonus 1 + "set alarm" |
| 1 | Text | 60 min out - "payment ready" |
| 0 | Email + Text | Cart open + Bonus 3 (immediate benefit) |
| +60min | Email + Text | Sales update |
| +6h | Email + Text | X spots left + surprise bonus |
| +12h | Text | Sold out |
| +1 day | Email + Text | Back-out (if applicable) |

---

## Validation Score

**Fast Cash Campaign Completeness:**

| Preparation | 30 | ___/30 | __% |

**Target: 80%+ for campaign launch readiness**

---

## Key Quotes to Remember

> "Revenue is vanity. Profit is sanity. Cash is reality." - p.1

> "If you get 10% of your customers to pay 10x the price...you double your revenue." - p.5

> "Fast Cash Plays are more like winning lottery tickets you cash in once a quarter." - p.4

> "The only thing that should shock them as much as the price is the value that goes with it." - p.8

> "You. Will. Work. More. For. These. Customers. You will earn that money." - p.8

> "This [best bonus] should be worth more than the entire price tag and should get you to sell out." - p.10

> "Despite Cash Plays only being ~15% of my annual revenue, they were nearly half my profit." - p.6

> "I've found that once a quarter is the sweet spot." - p.15

*"As long as you've got cash, you're still in business."* - Alex Hormozi

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/goated-ads-checklist.md

# GOATed Ads Framework Checklist

> **Source:** GOATed Ads SOP extracted from $100M GOATed Ads Playbook
> **Version:** 2.0.0
> **Date:** 2026-02-10
> **Cross-Reference:** goated-ads-sop.md, ad-angles-sop.md, hooks-sop.md
> **Agent:** hormozi-ads

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

### Before Creating Any Ad

- [ ] Read goated-ads-sop.md completely
- [ ] Understand Ad Assembly process (50 hooks x 3-5 meats x 1-3 CTAs)
- [ ] Friday blocked as dedicated advertising day
- [ ] 3-hour block reserved for production session
- [ ] Testing infrastructure ready (ad platform, pixel, tracking)

### Red Flags - STOP if:

- [ ] Budget <$50/day per ad set (insufficient data)
- [ ] No CAC calculation done
- [ ] No avatar research completed
- [ ] Haven't studied Eugene Schwartz awareness levels
- [ ] Expecting results from <100 conversions

---

## Pre-Requisites Checklist

### Fundamental Math (All Required)

- [ ] CAC maximum calculated: LTGP / 3 = $___
- [ ] Break-even in days defined (target: <30 days)
- [ ] Test budget calculated: 10x expected CPA = $___
- [ ] Minimum margin validated: ___% (must be >30% after ads)
- [ ] Daily minimum per ad set: $50+

### Market Research (All Required)

- [ ] 10 competitors analyzed in Meta Ad Library
- [ ] 5 working angles identified and documented
- [ ] 3 dominant offers in market mapped
- [ ] Market gaps documented
- [ ] Competitor ad frequency noted

### Surgical Avatar (All Required)

- [ ] Pain #1 identified (the one that keeps them awake)
- [ ] Exact language collected (screenshots of comments)
- [ ] Awareness level measured (1-5 scale)
- [ ] Purchasing power validated
- [ ] Demographics documented (age range minimum 10 years)

### Avatar Language Verification

- [ ] Minimum 10 real comments/quotes collected
- [ ] Language audit: 80%+ of copy uses avatar words
- [ ] Pain vocabulary documented
- [ ] Desire vocabulary documented
- [ ] Objection vocabulary documented

---

## Hook Creation Checklist (80% of Effort)

### Pre-Hook Research

- [ ] Review previous winning hooks from past campaigns
- [ ] Pull hooks from organic content (longs, shorts, tweets, emails)
- [ ] Save competitor ads to phone album
- [ ] Identify viral content hooks in niche
- [ ] Check Ad Libraries as last resort

### Awareness Level Distribution

- [ ] Level 5 - Most Aware (Offer): ___ hooks
- [ ] Level 4 - Product-Aware (Proof): ___ hooks
- [ ] Level 3 - Solution-Aware (Promise): ___ hooks
- [ ] Level 2 - Problem-Aware (Pain): ___ hooks
- [ ] Level 1 - Unaware (Curiosity): ___ hooks
- [ ] Total hooks = 50 (minimum)

### Distribution Rule Check

- [ ] Verify NOT 90%+ in "Most Aware" bucket
- [ ] Spread hooks across awareness levels
- [ ] When in doubt, went broader (capture warm + attract cold)

### Hook Quality Checklist (Each Hook)

- [ ] Specific problem mentioned
- [ ] Number in first line (when applicable)
- [ ] Pattern interrupt element present
- [ ] Avatar speaking to avatar
- [ ] Under 3 seconds when spoken

### Level 5 Hooks Created (Offer)

- [ ] Discount/deal hook created
- [ ] New feature/formula hook created
- [ ] Limited time hook created
- [ ] Best-seller hook created
- [ ] Upgrade/improvement hook created

### Level 4 Hooks Created (Proof)

- [ ] Social proof quantity hook created
- [ ] Industry/vertical proof hook created
- [ ] Testimonial teaser hook created
- [ ] Case study hook created
- [ ] Results/ROI hook created

### Level 3 Hooks Created (Promise)

- [ ] Speed/fastest way hook created
- [ ] Result doubling hook created
- [ ] Introducing product hook created
- [ ] Method reveal hook created
- [ ] Outcome promise hook created

### Level 2 Hooks Created (Pain)

- [ ] "Tired of X" hook created
- [ ] Missing elements hook created
- [ ] Better way hook created
- [ ] Problem cost hook created
- [ ] Pain amplification hook created

### Level 1 Hooks Created (Curiosity)

- [ ] Hidden danger hook created
- [ ] Unexpected loss hook created
- [ ] Secret reveal hook created
- [ ] Myth-busting hook created
- [ ] Pattern interrupt curiosity hook created

### Meme/Culture Hooks (Bonus)

- [ ] Niche-specific meme hooks considered
- [ ] Culture-specific references used where appropriate
- [ ] Meme-like content format tested

---

## Meat Creation Checklist (20% of Effort)

### Format Selection

- [ ] 3-5 meats planned for this session
- [ ] Each meat has clear format designation
- [ ] Assets identified for each format

### Demonstration Ads

- [ ] Live use / reaction clip available
- [ ] Unboxing content considered
- [ ] Before/after comparison prepared
- [ ] High production hero ad planned (if budget allows)
- [ ] Service demonstration scripted

### Testimonial Ads

- [ ] UGC content collected
- [ ] Direct to camera testimonials filmed
- [ ] Podcast/interview clips available
- [ ] Raw iPhone style footage included
- [ ] Walk 'n talk rants recorded
- [ ] Group testimonial (multiple people) planned
- [ ] Parade of Proof sequence ready

### Education Ads

- [ ] Explainer video script written
- [ ] How-to listicle content prepared
- [ ] Whiteboard explainer planned
- [ ] High-performing organic content repurposed

### Story Ads

- [ ] Storytelling/narrative script ready
- [ ] Lifestyle footage available
- [ ] Warning and opportunity angle considered
- [ ] Documentary style approach planned
- [ ] Problem-solution structure scripted

### Faceless Ads

- [ ] Screenshot compilations of customer texts
- [ ] Text-only ad variations created
- [ ] Slide show sequences prepared
- [ ] Animations considered
- [ ] Visual effect-based ads planned

### Video Structure Timing

- [ ] 0-3s: Hook (pattern interrupt) confirmed
- [ ] 3-10s: Agitate problem scripted
- [ ] 10-20s: Present solution scripted
- [ ] 20-27s: Social proof included
- [ ] 27-30s: Clear CTA scripted

---

## CTA Creation Checklist (~0% of Effort)

### CTA 1 - Complete Anatomy

- [ ] What to do: action specified
- [ ] How to do it: instruction clear
- [ ] When to do it: urgency element
- [ ] What they get: benefit stated
- [ ] What happens next: next step explained

### CTA 2 - Complete Anatomy

- [ ] What to do: action specified
- [ ] How to do it: instruction clear
- [ ] When to do it: urgency element
- [ ] What they get: benefit stated
- [ ] What happens next: next step explained

### CTA 3 - Complete Anatomy (Optional)

- [ ] What to do: action specified
- [ ] How to do it: instruction clear
- [ ] When to do it: urgency element
- [ ] What they get: benefit stated
- [ ] What happens next: next step explained

### CTA Quality Rules

- [ ] Clear > Clever principle applied
- [ ] S-P-E-L-L it out: Click, Call, Reply, Go, Scan
- [ ] Single action verb used
- [ ] No ambiguity in instruction

### Visual Demonstration

- [ ] Screen showing landing page included
- [ ] Form fill process demonstrated
- [ ] Submit button highlighted
- [ ] Congruence with landing page verified

---

## Ad Assembly Calculation

### Production Math

- [ ] Hooks created: ___ (target: 50)
- [ ] Meats created: ___ (target: 3-5)
- [ ] CTAs created: ___ (target: 1-3)
- [ ] Total combinations: ___ x ___ x ___ = ___
- [ ] Target achieved: 150-750 ads

### Time Tracking

- [ ] Hook creation time: ___ hours (target: 1-2 hours)
- [ ] Meat creation time: ___ hours (target: ~1 hour)
- [ ] CTA creation time: ___ minutes (target: ~5 minutes)
- [ ] Total session time: ___ hours (target: ~3 hours)

---

## Campaign Configuration Checklist

### Campaign Structure

- [ ] CBO (Campaign Budget Optimization) enabled
- [ ] Maximum 3-5 ad sets configured
- [ ] Budget minimum $50/day per ad set
- [ ] Pixel installed correctly
- [ ] All conversion events configured

### Targeting Settings

- [ ] Broad targeting (3-10% of population)
- [ ] NO stacked interests (let algorithm work)
- [ ] Age range: minimum 10-year spread
- [ ] Lookalike 1% from customer list created
- [ ] Exclusions properly set

### Copy Elements

- [ ] Headline: specific result + timeframe
- [ ] Primary text: <125 characters
- [ ] Description: main benefit
- [ ] CTA button: action verb (Garantir, Comecar, Acessar)

### Landing Page Alignment

- [ ] Headline matches ad exactly
- [ ] CTA visible in <3 seconds of scroll
- [ ] Social proof visible above fold
- [ ] Load time <2 seconds
- [ ] Conversion rate baseline: minimum 2%

---

## Day 1 Monitoring Checklist (First 24 Hours)

### KPI Checks

- [ ] CTR measured: ___% (threshold: >1%)
- [ ] CPM measured: $___ (threshold: <$30)
- [ ] CPC measured: $___ (threshold: <$3)
- [ ] Link CTR measured: ___% (threshold: >0.8%)

### Diagnostic Actions

- [ ] If CTR <1%: Hook problem identified
- [ ] If CPM >$30: Creative quality issue flagged
- [ ] If CPC >$3: Relevance problem noted
- [ ] If Link CTR <0.8%: Copy weakness marked

---

## Day 2 Monitoring Checklist

### KPI Checks

- [ ] Frequency measured: ___ (threshold: <2)
- [ ] CPL measured: $___ (threshold: <50% of target)
- [ ] Add to Cart rate: ___% (threshold: >5%)
- [ ] Video Views 3s: ___% (threshold: >30%)

### Diagnostic Actions

- [ ] If Frequency >2: Saturation warning
- [ ] If CPL >50% target: Kill and restart
- [ ] If Add to Cart <5%: Page problem identified
- [ ] If 3s views <30%: Hook weakness confirmed

### Decision Point

- [ ] Continue decision made
- [ ] Kill and restart decision made
- [ ] No ego in decision (data-driven)

---

## Daily Monitoring Checklist (5 Minutes)

- [ ] CPA yesterday vs today compared: $___ to $___
- [ ] Frequency check: ___ (threshold: <5)
- [ ] Comments reviewed and responded
- [ ] Competitors checked
- [ ] Budget utilization: ___% (threshold: >90%)

---

## Red Flags - Immediate Action Checklist

### Kill Signals

- [ ] CPA doubled: PAUSA imediata
- [ ] CTR <0.5%: MATA o ad
- [ ] Frequency >10: REFRESH criativo
- [ ] ROAS <2x for 3 days: ANALISE profunda
- [ ] Relevance score <4: NOVO CRIATIVO

### Troubleshooting: CPM Alto

- [ ] Creative fatigue checked (frequency >7?)
- [ ] Relevance score checked (>6?)
- [ ] Competition spike checked (Q4, Black Friday?)
- [ ] Account penalty checked

### Troubleshooting: CPA Subindo

- [ ] Landing page conversion checked
- [ ] Offer strength evaluated
- [ ] Competitor offers analyzed
- [ ] Algorithm changes considered

### Troubleshooting: CTR Baixo

- [ ] Hook quality reviewed
- [ ] Visual uniqueness assessed
- [ ] Copy resonance tested
- [ ] Market saturation considered

---

## Scale Signals Checklist

### Ready to Scale (All Must Be True)

- [ ] ROAS >3x for 7 consecutive days
- [ ] CPA stable for 500+ conversions
- [ ] Frequency <3 after 14 days
- [ ] CTR maintains >1%

### Scale Methods

- [ ] 20% Rule applied: budget +20% every 48 hours
- [ ] New ad sets: same copy, new audience
- [ ] Surfing: pause Friday, reactivate Monday
- [ ] Day-parting: off overnight if B2B

---

## Weekly Optimization Checklist

### Week 1 Tasks

- [ ] Kill ads with CPA >150% of target
- [ ] Double budget on winners
- [ ] Test 3 new creatives
- [ ] Adjust bid cap if needed

### Week 2 Tasks

- [ ] Create lookalike from buyers
- [ ] Test new copy angle
- [ ] Add retargeting campaigns
- [ ] Implement audience exclusions

### Week 3-4 Tasks

- [ ] Vertical scale (+20%/day)
- [ ] Horizontal scale (new audiences)
- [ ] Test new formats (carousel, collection)
- [ ] Add new geos/demographics

---

## Budget Allocation Checklist

### Weekly Budget Split

- [ ] Total weekly budget: $___
- [ ] 70% to proven campaigns (winners): $___
- [ ] 20% to new tests (exploration): $___
- [ ] 10% to retargeting: $___

---

## Golden Rules Validation

- [ ] Rule 1: NOT scaling without 100 conversions
- [ ] Rule 2: Creative fatigue window respected (10-14 days)
- [ ] Rule 3: Focusing on top 20% performers
- [ ] Rule 4: Tested price before changing everything
- [ ] Rule 5: iOS 30% tracking loss factored in calculations

---

## Session Results Checklist

### Output Validation

- [ ] Hooks created: ___ (target: 50)
- [ ] Meats created: ___ (target: 3-5)
- [ ] CTAs created: ___ (target: 1-3)
- [ ] Total ads assembled: ___ (target: 150-750)
- [ ] Session time: ___ hours (target: ~3 hours)

### Documentation

- [ ] Winners from this week identified
- [ ] Learnings documented for next week
- [ ] Testing log updated
- [ ] Next Friday session scheduled

---

## Quality Gate Checklist

### Gate 1: Pre-Production Complete

- [ ] All math calculations done
- [ ] Market research documented
- [ ] Avatar language collected
- [ ] Testing infrastructure ready

### Gate 2: Production Complete

- [ ] 50+ hooks written
- [ ] 3-5 meats scripted
- [ ] 1-3 CTAs defined
- [ ] Video structure verified

### Gate 3: Campaign Ready

- [ ] All configuration items checked
- [ ] Landing page aligned
- [ ] Tracking verified
- [ ] Budget allocated

### Gate 4: Ready for Scale

- [ ] 7+ days stable performance
- [ ] ROAS >3x achieved
- [ ] 100+ conversions collected
- [ ] Frequency <3 maintained

---

## Final Validation Checklist

### SOP Compliance

- [ ] Ad Assembly process followed (50 x 3-5 x 1-3)
- [ ] Time distribution respected (80% hooks, 20% meat, ~0% CTAs)
- [ ] Awareness levels used for hook distribution
- [ ] All 5 meat formats considered
- [ ] CTA anatomy complete (5 elements)

### Testing Protocol

- [ ] Minimum budget per ad set respected ($50/day)
- [ ] KPI thresholds documented
- [ ] Kill signals defined
- [ ] Scale signals confirmed

### Documentation

- [ ] This checklist completed
- [ ] Metrics recorded
- [ ] Decisions documented
- [ ] Handoff notes written

---

## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical - Pre-Requisites & Math | 18 | 3 | 54 |
| Critical - Hook Production (50+) | 35 | 3 | 105 |
| Standard - Meat & CTA Creation | 32 | 2 | 64 |
| Standard - Campaign Config & Monitoring | 28 | 2 | 56 |
| Bonus - Optimization, Scale, Quality Gates | 32 | 1 | 32 |
| **TOTAL** | **145** | | **311** |

### Thresholds

- **PASS**: >= 249 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 187 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 187 points

### If FAIL

Do not spend ad budget until pre-requisites are complete. Validate CAC math, complete avatar research, and produce the minimum 50 hooks before launching any campaign. Running ads without these foundations wastes budget on unvalidated creative.

---

*Checklist validated: 2026-02-10*
*Source: GOATed Ads SOP v1.0*
*Based on $100M GOATed Ads Playbook + $50M tested*
