## Engagement Scoring Framework

### Niveis Configurados

| Nivel | Nome | Definicao | Acao | Risco |
|-------|------|-----------|------|-------|
| 0 | GHOST | Sem atividade 30+ dias | Campanha de reativacao imediata | Extremamente alto |
| 1 | PASSIVE | Atividade minima, tendencia de queda | Outreach pessoal (ACA), incentivo | Alto |
| 2 | ACTIVE | Regular mas nao no activation point | Guiar para activation point | Moderado |
| 3 | ENGAGED | No ou acima do activation point | Testimonial, referral, upsell | Baixo |
| 4 | CHAMPION | Acima do AP, refere, advoga | VIP treatment, micro-celebrity | Muito baixo |

### Acoes por Nivel Implementadas
- [ ] Nivel 0: Campanha de reativacao imediata
- [ ] Nivel 1: Outreach pessoal (ACA), incentivo para re-engajar
- [ ] Nivel 2: Guiar para activation point, community linking
- [ ] Nivel 3: Manter, pedir testimonial/referral, apresentar upsell
- [ ] Nivel 4: Elevar como micro-celebridade, convidar para VIP

---

## Metricas de Monitoramento

### Tier 1 - Survival (Track Weekly)
- [ ] Churn rate mensal (por cohort)
- [ ] Revenue churn rate (dollar-weighted)
- [ ] LTV (rolling 90-day average)
- [ ] LTV:CAC ratio

### Tier 2 - Engagement (Track Daily/Weekly)
- [ ] Frequencia de login/visita
- [ ] Profundidade de uso de features
- [ ] Taxa de consumo de conteudo
- [ ] Participacao em comunidade
- [ ] Volume e sentiment de tickets de suporte
- [ ] NPS score (trimestral)

### Tier 3 - Predictive (Build Over Time)
- [ ] Tempo desde ultimo login/compra
- [ ] Tendencia do engagement score
- [ ] Taxa de falha de pagamento
- [ ] Taxa de resposta a outreach
- [ ] Percentual de conclusao do activation point

---

## Win-Back Campaigns

### Segmentacao de Clientes Churned

| Segmento | Causa Provavel | Abordagem |
|----------|----------------|-----------|
| <30 dias | Activation failure | "Percebi que falhamos com voce. Veja como e diferente agora." |
| 30-90 dias | Value perception issue | "Muita coisa mudou desde que voce saiu. Veja o que perdeu." |
| 90+ dias | Fatores externos | "Pessoas como voce que voltaram viram X resultados em Y tempo." |

### Sequencia de Win-Back
- [ ] **Dia 1**: Email/text pessoal reconhecendo saida (sem venda)
- [ ] **Dia 3**: Compartilhar success story de alguem na situacao deles
- [ ] **Dia 7**: Oferta especifica para voltar (desconto, bonus, ou waived fee)
- [ ] **Dia 14**: Ultimo outreach com incentivo por tempo limitado
- [ ] **Dia 30**: Adicionar a nurture de longo prazo
- [ ] **A cada 90 dias**: Mostrar resultados de pessoas que assinaram quando eles sairam

---

## Reactivation for Dormant (Still Paying, Not Using)

### Framework: 3-Touch Reactivation
- [ ] **Touch 1 - Acknowledge + Compliment:**
  "Ei, notei que voce nao logou. So queria dizer que seu progresso em [coisa especifica] foi impressionante."
- [ ] **Touch 2 - Value reminder:**
  "Lembrete rapido - acabamos de adicionar [feature/conteudo]. Acho que ajudaria com [objetivo deles]."
- [ ] **Touch 3 - Personal invitation:**
  "Estou organizando [evento/call] na proxima [data]. Adoraria que voce participasse."

### Escalation
- [ ] Se sem resposta apos 3 touches: Ligar (telefone > texto > email)
- [ ] Se ainda sem resposta: Marcar como alto risco de churn

---

## Overwhelm Prevention

### Principio Central
- [ ] Time entende: "Value per second, not seconds of value"
- [ ] Time entende: "Less but better beats more and decent"

### Audit de Deliverables
- [ ] Listar todos os deliverables atuais:
  1. _____________________
  2. _____________________
  3. _____________________
  4. _____________________
  5. _____________________

- [ ] Verificar: >5 deliverables/mes? Potencial overwhelm
- [ ] Core 2-3 coisas identificadas
- [ ] Plano para "fazer menos, mas melhor" documentado

---

## Decision Rules

### Churn
- [ ] DR-001: "Churn > 10% mensal = problema de produto, nao de crescimento"
- [ ] DR-002: "Churn floor < 1% e incomum, pedir confirmacao de dados"
- [ ] DR-003: "Churn ceiling > 25% sugere crise, priorizar fix de produto"

### LTV
- [ ] DR-004: "LTV:CAC < 2:1 = parar de escalar, consertar backend"
- [ ] DR-005: "LTV:CAC 2:1-3:1 = crescimento possivel mas margens finas"
- [ ] DR-006: "LTV:CAC >= 3:1 = pode escalar agressivamente"

### Activation
- [ ] DR-007: "Clientes que nao atingem activation point em 30 dias = alto risco"
- [ ] DR-008: "Activation point completion < 50% = revisar onboarding"

### Pricing
- [ ] DR-009: "Testar precos a cada quarter"
- [ ] DR-010: "2x preco + -20% conversao = FAZER (se +60% receita)"

### Engagement
- [ ] DR-011: "Engagement Level 0-1 por 30+ dias = campanha de reativacao imediata"
- [ ] DR-012: "Usage churn precede billing churn - interceptar quando para de usar"

### Volume
- [ ] DR-013: "Mais deliverables que 5 por mes = verificar potential overwhelm"

---

## Red Flags Imediatos

| Sinal | Status | Acao Requerida |
|-------|--------|----------------|
| Churn > 10% mensal | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | PARAR escala de aquisicao, diagnosticar |
| LTV:CAC < 2:1 | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | PARAR escala, consertar backend |
| Sem onboarding | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | IMPLEMENTAR imediatamente |
| Sem engagement tracking | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | IMPLEMENTAR metricas |
| Adicionando features quando clientes reclamam | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | PARAR, investigar se resposta e delecao |
| Retention investment > 1/5 CAC | [ ] OK [ ] ALERTA | REVISAR se excedido |

---

## Anti-Patterns (NUNCA FAZER)

### Nunca Sugerir
- [ ] "Apenas conseguir mais clientes" como solucao para churn
- [ ] Descontos sem mecanicas de retencao attached
- [ ] Adicionar mais features/conteudo como estrategia de retencao
- [ ] Ignorar os dados e ir com gut feeling
- [ ] Tratar todos os clientes churned igual
- [ ] Pular onboarding para "economizar tempo"
- [ ] Annual pricing sem primeiro consertar o produto

### Sempre Verificar
- [ ] Churn esta sendo calculado corretamente? (so cohort original)
- [ ] Estamos resolvendo o problema certo? (acquisition vs retention vs monetization)
- [ ] Temos activation points identificados?
- [ ] Onboarding esta direcionando para activation points?
- [ ] Estamos rastreando engagement antes de virar churn?
- [ ] Price-value equation esta balanceada?

---

## Quality Gates

### Antes de Implementar
- [ ] QG-001: Dados minimos coletados (churn, ARPU, CAC, tempo medio)
- [ ] QG-002: LTV calculado corretamente
- [ ] QG-003: LTV:CAC ratio conhecido e >= 2:1
- [ ] QG-004: Activation points identificados
- [ ] QG-005: Onboarding de 30 dias desenhado

### Durante Implementacao
- [ ] QG-006: 5 Horsemen em execucao
- [ ] QG-007: Engagement scoring ativo
- [ ] QG-008: Exit interviews acontecendo
- [ ] QG-009: Surveys 2x/ano agendados

### Apos 90 Dias
- [ ] QG-010: Churn reduziu (target: -50%)
- [ ] QG-011: LTV aumentou
- [ ] QG-012: Activation rate > 50%
- [ ] QG-013: Win-back campaigns gerando retornos

---

## Auditoria Trimestral

### Metricas a Revisar
- [ ] Churn mensal (tendencia de 3 meses)
- [ ] LTV (comparado a quarter anterior)
- [ ] LTV:CAC ratio
- [ ] Engajamento medio
- [ ] Taxa de activation
- [ ] Taxa de save em exit interviews

### Gatilhos para Revisao Urgente
- [ ] Churn subiu mais de 2 pontos percentuais
- [ ] LTV:CAC caiu abaixo de 3:1
- [ ] Engajamento medio caindo por 3 meses consecutivos
- [ ] Grande mudanca de produto ou pricing
- [ ] Novos dados de activation point disponiveis

---

## Resultados Esperados

| Metrica | Antes | Depois (6 meses) |
|---------|-------|------------------|
| Churn Mensal | 10% | 3% |
| LTV | 10 meses | 33 meses |
| LTV Multiplier | 1x | 3.3x |

**Beneficios:**
- Cresce todo ano mesmo se vendas ficam iguais
- Negocio compoem (referrals > churn)
- Mais valioso para vender
- Word of mouth positivo
- Equipe motivada por clientes sendo ajudados

---

## Troubleshooting Quick Reference

| Problema | Causa Provavel | Solucao |
|----------|----------------|---------|
| Churn > 10% | Problema de produto | Diagnosticar produto, nao escalar |
| Baixa activation | Onboarding falho | Revisar onboarding para activation point |
| Clientes inativos | Falta de engagement | Implementar reach out 2x/semana |
| Cancelamentos surpresa | Sem tracking | Implementar engagement scoring |
| Churn sobe apos implementacao | Normal (Mes 1) | Manter curso, esperar Mes 2-3 |
| Baixo save rate em exits | Script fraco | Treinar time, usar indignacao |
| Overwhelm complaints | Muitos deliverables | Reduzir para core 2-3 |
| LTV:CAC < 2:1 | Backend quebrado | Parar escala, consertar antes de crescer |

---

## Assinaturas

| Item | Responsavel | Data | Assinatura |
|------|-------------|------|------------|
| Pre-requisitos completos | | | |
| 5 Horsemen implementados | | | |
| 9-Step Checklist implementado | | | |
| Crazy 8 LTV analisado | | | |
| Engagement scoring ativo | | | |
| Win-back campaigns ativas | | | |
| Quality gates passaram | | | |
| Lancamento aprovado | | | |

---


## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical - Pre-Requisites, 5 Horsemen, 9-Step (Steps 1-3), Quality Gates Pre | 55 | 3 | 165 |
| Standard - Crazy 8, Continuity Offers, Engagement Scoring, 9-Step (Steps 4-9) | 60 | 2 | 120 |
| Bonus - Metricas, Win-Back, Reactivation, Decision Rules, Auditoria | 35 | 1 | 35 |
| **TOTAL** | **150** | | **320** |

### Thresholds
- **PASS**: >= 256 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 192 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 192 points

### If FAIL
O sistema de retencao e LTV tem gaps estruturais criticos. Comece pelo health check de Pre-Requisitos (churn <10%, LTV:CAC >=3:1) e implemente os 5 Horsemen em ordem - estes sao a fundacao de todas as outras taticas de retencao.

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/sales-page-checklist.md

# Sales Page Checklist: Os 17 Elementos da Pagina Matadora

> **Source:** Blueprint PV - Os 17 Elementos da Pagina Matadora - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** HO-CL-001 (Hormozi Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Agent:** hormozi-copy

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

Before building the sales page, verify:

### Offer Documentation
- [ ] Product/service clearly defined
- [ ] Pricing finalized
- [ ] Value stack components listed with values
- [ ] Bonuses defined with values
- [ ] Guarantee policy approved

### Avatar Preparation
- [ ] Ideal customer profile documented
- [ ] Pain points identified (top 5)
- [ ] Desired outcomes identified
- [ ] Objections documented (top 5)
- [ ] Demographics for proof matching

### Proof Library
- [ ] Testimonials collected (minimum 3)
- [ ] Case studies available
- [ ] Result metrics documented
- [ ] Credibility elements (credentials, media)
- [ ] Proof organized by demographic

### Technical Setup
- [ ] Page builder ready
- [ ] Analytics tracking configured
- [ ] Heatmap tool installed (Hotjar/Clarity)
- [ ] A/B testing capability ready
- [ ] SSL certificate active

---

## SECTION A: Above the Fold (0-600px)
### Os 3 Segundos Criticos

> **Target Metric:** >40% scroll rate
> **Critical Rule:** These 5 elements decide stay or leave

---

### Element 1: Headline Principal (O Hook Magnetico)

**Value Equation Target:** Dream Outcome (MAXIMIZE)

**Formula Check:**
- [ ] Format: "Como [RESULTADO] em [TIMEFRAME] Sem [DOR #1] ou [DOR #2]"
- [ ] Contains specific result (not vague)
- [ ] Contains timeframe (days, weeks, months)
- [ ] Contains pain avoidance (at least one)

**Quality Check:**
- [ ] NOT feature-focused (e.g., "Curso de X")
- [ ] NOT generic benefit (e.g., "Aprenda X")
- [ ] IS outcome-specific with obstacles addressed

**Example Quality Spectrum:**
| Level | Example |
|-------|---------|
| RUIM | "Curso de Marketing Digital" |
| BOM | "Aprenda Marketing Digital" |
| MATADOR | "Como Conseguir 30 Clientes High-Ticket em 90 Dias Sem Gastar Fortuna em Ads ou Virar Escravo do Instagram" |

**A/B Test Ready:**
- [ ] Pain variant created
- [ ] Desire variant created
- [ ] Both variants follow formula

---

### Element 2: Subheadline (A Promessa Expandida)

**Value Equation Target:** Perceived Likelihood (MAXIMIZE)

**Template Check:**
```
"O [MECANISMO UNICO] usado por [NUMERO] [AVATAR ESPECIFICO]
para [RESULTADO COMPROVADO] - Agora disponivel para [QUALIFICACAO]"
```

**Element Verification:**
- [ ] Unique mechanism named
- [ ] Specific number of users/customers
- [ ] Avatar clearly identified
- [ ] Result stated (matching headline)
- [ ] Qualification included

**Positioning:**
- [ ] Directly below headline
- [ ] Font size: 60% of headline
- [ ] Same visual hierarchy

---

### Element 3: CTA Principal #1 (O Botao Impossivel de Ignorar)

**Value Equation Target:** Effort & Sacrifice (MINIMIZE)

**Technical Specifications:**
- [ ] Color: Minimum 3:1 contrast with background
- [ ] Size: Minimum 200px width (mobile)
- [ ] Position: Prominent, above fold

**Text Quality:**
- [ ] Benefit-oriented (NOT action-oriented)
- [ ] NOT "Comprar Agora" or "Buy Now"
- [ ] States outcome they want

**Quality Spectrum:**
| Level | Example |
|-------|---------|
| RUIM | "Comprar Agora" |
| BOM | "Quero Meu Acesso" |
| MATADOR | "Sim! Quero 30 Clientes em 90 Dias ->" |

**Psychological Hack:**
- [ ] Arrow (->) included in button text
- [ ] CTR boost expected: 12-26%

---

### Element 4: Prova Social Imediata (Trust Badge Instantaneo)

**Value Equation Target:** Perceived Likelihood (MAXIMIZE)

**Format Verification:**
```
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ [NUMBER]+ [USERS] | [SATISFACTION]% | [GUARANTEE/RESULT]
```

**Elements Present:**
- [ ] Star rating (5 stars)
- [ ] User/customer count (real number)
- [ ] Satisfaction percentage
- [ ] Result timeline or guarantee

**Example:**
"⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 2.847+ Alunos | 98% Satisfacao | Resultados em 14 Dias ou Dinheiro de Volta"

**Position:**
- [ ] Below CTA OR integrated in header
- [ ] Visible without scrolling
- [ ] Numbers are REAL and verifiable

---

### Element 5: Urgencia/Escassez Indicator

**Value Equation Target:** Loss Aversion (AMPLIFY)

**Type Selection (choose one):**
- [ ] Countdown Timer: "Oferta Expira em 23:47:32"
- [ ] Limited Spots: "7 de 25 Vagas Restantes"
- [ ] Expiring Bonus: "Bonus de R$2000 Apenas Hoje"

**CRITICAL VERIFICATION:**
- [ ] Scarcity is REAL
- [ ] Mechanism is truthful
- [ ] Not fake countdown that resets
- [ ] Not fake "spots remaining"

**Warning:** False scarcity = long-term trust destruction

---

### Section A Completion Score

| Element | Present | Quality (1-3) |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| 1. Headline | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 2. Subheadline | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 3. CTA #1 | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 4. Social Proof | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 5. Urgency | [ ] | ___/3 |
| **TOTAL** | ___/5 | ___/15 |

**Minimum for Launch:** 4/5 elements, 10/15 quality score

---

## SECTION B: Main Body
### A Jornada de Persuasao

> **Target Metrics:** Time on page >3 min, Scroll depth >70%
> **Critical Rule:** These 9 elements build the logical + emotional case

---

### Element 6: VSL ou Imagem Hero

**Purpose:** Control exposure time to persuasion message

**IF VSL:**
- [ ] Thumbnail has obvious play button
- [ ] Thumbnail has benefit text overlay
- [ ] Duration matches traffic:
  - [ ] Cold traffic: 8-15 minutes
  - [ ] Warm traffic: 15-45 minutes
- [ ] Aspect ratio: 16:9
- [ ] Responsive design
- [ ] Centered on page

**IF Image Hero:**
- [ ] Product/result mockup shown
- [ ] OR "After" transformation photo
- [ ] Caption with benefit included
- [ ] High quality, professional

---

### Element 7: Bullets de Beneficios (Nao Features)

**Value Equation Target:** Dream Outcome (MAXIMIZE)

**Formula for Each Bullet:**
```
✓ [RESULTADO] para que voce possa [BENEFICIO EMOCIONAL]
```

**Quality Check Per Bullet:**
| # | Tangible Result | Emotional Benefit | Formula Correct |
|---|-----------------|-------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 2 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 3 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 4 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 5 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 6 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |
| 7 | [ ] | [ ] | [ ] |

**Quantity Check:**
- [ ] Minimum 5 bullets
- [ ] Maximum 7 bullets
- [ ] NOT features disguised as benefits

**Quality Spectrum:**
| Level | Example |
|-------|---------|
| RUIM | "10 Modulos de Conteudo" |
| BOM | "Aprenda Facebook Ads" |
| MATADOR | "✓ Domine o Pixel do Facebook em 48h para que voce pare de desperdicar 73% do seu budget com publico errado" |

---

### Element 8: Secao "Para Quem E"

**Value Equation Target:** Perceived Likelihood (MAXIMIZE)

**Template:**
```
Este [PRODUTO] e PERFEITO para voce se:
☑️ [SITUACAO ESPECIFICA #1]
☑️ [DOR ESPECIFICA #2]
☑️ [DESEJO ESPECIFICO #3]
```

**Checklist Items (minimum 3):**
- [ ] Item 1: Specific situation
- [ ] Item 2: Specific pain point
- [ ] Item 3: Specific desire
- [ ] Item 4: (Optional)
- [ ] Item 5: (Optional)

**Quality Verification:**
- [ ] Each item resonates with ideal customer
- [ ] Specificity level high (not generic)
- [ ] Reader thinks "this was made for me"

---

### Element 9: Secao "Para Quem NAO E"

**Value Equation Target:** Exclusivity (DESIRE AMPLIFIER)

**Template:**
```
ATENCAO: Isso NAO e para voce se:
❌ [DESQUALIFICADOR #1]
❌ [DESQUALIFICADOR #2]
❌ [DESQUALIFICADOR #3]
```

**Disqualification Items (minimum 2):**
- [ ] Disqualifies "magic pill" seekers
- [ ] Disqualifies insufficient time commitment
- [ ] Disqualifies prerequisites not met
- [ ] (Optional additional disqualifiers)

**Strategic Verification:**
- [ ] Disqualifies problem customers
- [ ] NOT disqualifying paying customers unnecessarily
- [ ] Creates exclusivity feeling for qualified prospects

---

### Element 10: Stack de Valor Visual

**Purpose:** Make price-value gap OBVIOUS

**Structure Template:**
```
COMPONENTE #1 ........................ Valor R$ X.XXX
COMPONENTE #2 ........................ Valor R$ X.XXX
BONUS #1 ............................. Valor R$ XXX
BONUS #2 ............................. Valor R$ XXX
BONUS #3 ............................. Valor R$ X.XXX
                        VALOR TOTAL: R$ XX.XXX
                        SEU INVESTIMENTO: R$ X.XXX
                        VOCE ECONOMIZA: R$ XX.XXX
```

**Components Listed:**
| Component | Value | Defensible |
|-----------|-------|------------|
| Main Component 1 | R$ _____ | [ ] |
| Main Component 2 | R$ _____ | [ ] |
| Bonus 1 | R$ _____ | [ ] |
| Bonus 2 | R$ _____ | [ ] |
| Bonus 3 | R$ _____ | [ ] |

**Visual Elements:**
- [ ] Table or cards format
- [ ] Individual values crossed out
- [ ] Total value prominent
- [ ] Actual price highlighted
- [ ] Savings amount emphasized

**Verification:**
- [ ] All values are defensible if questioned
- [ ] Gap between total and price is substantial
- [ ] Math is correct

---

### Element 11: Comparacao de Preco

**Purpose:** Anchor against expensive alternatives

**Matrix Template:**
```
ALTERNATIVA A (Agencia): R$ X.XXX/mes = R$ XX.XXX/ano
ALTERNATIVA B (Consultor): R$ XX.XXX + XX% resultados
ALTERNATIVA C (Fazer Sozinho): X anos de tentativa e erro

NOSSA SOLUCAO: R$ X.XXX uma vez - Para sempre
```

**Alternatives Listed:**
- [ ] Alternative A (most expensive): _____________
- [ ] Alternative B (different model): _____________
- [ ] Alternative C (DIY cost): _____________
- [ ] Your solution with positioning

**Verification:**
- [ ] Alternatives are real options customers consider
- [ ] Comparisons are fair and accurate
- [ ] Your solution clearly wins on value

---

### Element 12: FAQ das 5 Maiores Objecoes

**Value Equation Target:** Perceived Likelihood (MAXIMIZE)

**The 5 Universal Objections:**

| # | Objection | Answer Present | Ends with Benefit |
|---|-----------|----------------|-------------------|
| 1 | "Funciona para [minha situacao especifica]?" | [ ] | [ ] |
| 2 | "Quanto tempo leva para ver resultados?" | [ ] | [ ] |
| 3 | "E se nao funcionar para mim?" | [ ] | [ ] |
| 4 | "Preciso de [recurso/habilidade] para funcionar?" | [ ] | [ ] |
| 5 | "Como funciona o suporte?" | [ ] | [ ] |

**Format Verification:**
- [ ] Question in bold
- [ ] Answer is direct
- [ ] Each answer ends reinforcing a benefit

**Additional Objections (optional):**
- [ ] Objection 6: _____________
- [ ] Objection 7: _____________

---

### Element 13: Garantia Destacada

**Value Equation Target:** Perceived Likelihood (~100%)

**Killer Template:**
```
GARANTIA TRIPLA DE 30 DIAS
✓ Garantia #1: Resultados em 14 dias ou dinheiro de volta
✓ Garantia #2: Se implementar e nao funcionar, devolvemos 2X
✓ Garantia #3: Pode cancelar por qualquer motivo em 30 dias
```

**Guarantee Elements:**
- [ ] Guarantee #1 (result-based): _____________
- [ ] Guarantee #2 (implementation-based): _____________
- [ ] Guarantee #3 (unconditional): _____________

**Visual Design:**
- [ ] Highlighted box/section
- [ ] Seal or badge icon
- [ ] Contrasting color
- [ ] Stands out from page

**Legal Verification:**
- [ ] All guarantees are legally deliverable
- [ ] Terms are clear
- [ ] Process is documented

---

### Element 14: Sobre o Criador/Empresa

**Purpose:** Transfer personal authority to product

**Essential Elements:**
- [ ] Professional photo
- [ ] 2-3 quantifiable credentials
- [ ] 1 strategic vulnerability
- [ ] Clear mission statement

**Credentials Listed:**
1. Credential: _____________
2. Credential: _____________
3. Credential: _____________

**Vulnerability Included:**
- [ ] Past failure/struggle mentioned
- [ ] Creates relatability
- [ ] Not self-deprecating to point of losing authority

**Script Pattern:**
"Depois de [FAILURE]... descobri [SYSTEM/SOLUTION]... Hoje, apos ajudar [NUMBER]+ [PEOPLE], minha missao e..."

---

### Section B Completion Score

| Element | Present | Quality (1-3) |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| 6. VSL/Hero | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 7. Benefits | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 8. Para Quem E | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 9. Para Quem NAO E | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 10. Value Stack | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 11. Price Compare | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 12. FAQ | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 13. Guarantee | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 14. About | [ ] | ___/3 |
| **TOTAL** | ___/9 | ___/27 |

**Minimum for Launch:** 7/9 elements, 18/27 quality score

---

## SECTION C: Conversion Elements
### Os Multiplicadores Silenciosos

> **Target Metric:** Checkout abandon <25%
> **Critical Rule:** These 3 elements remove final friction

---

### Element 15: Barra de Progresso (Checkout)

**Value Equation Target:** Effort & Sacrifice (MINIMIZE)

**Implementation:**
```
Passo 1: Informacoes Basicas
Passo 2: Pagamento
Passo 3: Confirmacao
```

**Verification:**
- [ ] Progress bar visible during checkout
- [ ] Maximum 3 steps
- [ ] Current step clearly indicated
- [ ] Completion feels achievable

**Expected Impact:** Reduces cart abandonment 18-30%

---

### Element 16: Selos de Seguranca

**Value Equation Target:** Effort & Sacrifice (fear removal)

**Essential Seals:**
- [ ] SSL/Lock icon
- [ ] Card brand logos (Visa, Mastercard, etc.)
- [ ] "Compra Segura" badge
- [ ] Privacy guarantee

**Position Verification:**
- [ ] On checkout page
- [ ] Near main CTAs
- [ ] Visible without scrolling

**Authenticity:**
- [ ] Only display earned certifications
- [ ] SSL actually active
- [ ] Payment processor logos accurate

---

### Element 17: Chat/Suporte Visivel

**Value Equation Target:** Effort & Sacrifice (MINIMIZE)

**Options (choose at least one):**
- [ ] Floating WhatsApp button
- [ ] Integrated chat widget
- [ ] Phone number visible: "Duvidas? (XX) XXXXX-XXXX"

**Proactive Chat Script:**
"Oi! Vi que esta na pagina ha X minutos. Posso tirar alguma duvida sobre o programa?"

**Verification:**
- [ ] Support actually responsive (not fake)
- [ ] Clear contact method
- [ ] Available during business hours minimum
- [ ] Response time acceptable

---

### Section C Completion Score

| Element | Present | Quality (1-3) |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| 15. Progress Bar | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 16. Security Badges | [ ] | ___/3 |
| 17. Chat/Support | [ ] | ___/3 |
| **TOTAL** | ___/3 | ___/9 |

**Minimum for Launch:** 3/3 elements, 6/9 quality score

---

## Quality Gate Verification

| Gate | Metric | Target | Current | Pass |
|------|--------|--------|---------|------|
| QG-001 | Scroll Rate | >40% | ___% | [ ] |
| QG-002 | Conversion (cold) | >3% | ___% | [ ] |
| QG-003 | Checkout Abandon | <25% | ___% | [ ] |
| QG-004 | Elements Complete | 14/17 | ___/17 | [ ] |
| QG-005 | Mobile Score | 90+ | ___ | [ ] |
| QG-006 | Load Time | <3s | ___s | [ ] |

---

## Pre-Launch Final Checklist

### Technical
- [ ] All 17 elements present (or justified omission)
- [ ] Mobile responsive
- [ ] Load time <3 seconds
- [ ] All links working
- [ ] Payment processing tested
- [ ] Thank you page configured

### Tracking
- [ ] Analytics tracking live
- [ ] Heatmap installed
- [ ] Conversion events defined
- [ ] A/B test infrastructure ready

### Support
- [ ] Support channel active
- [ ] Response protocol defined
- [ ] FAQ covers common questions
- [ ] Guarantee process documented

### Content
- [ ] All copy proofread
- [ ] Numbers verified
- [ ] Claims defensible
- [ ] Legal review complete (if applicable)

---

## Total Page Score

| Section | Elements | Score |
|---------|----------|-------|
| A - Above Fold | ___/5 | ___/15 |
| B - Main Body | ___/9 | ___/27 |
| C - Conversion | ___/3 | ___/9 |
| **TOTAL** | ___/17 | ___/51 |

**Launch Thresholds:**
- **Minimum:** 14/17 elements, 34/51 quality score
- **Target:** 17/17 elements, 42/51 quality score
- **Excellent:** 17/17 elements, 48/51+ quality score

---

## Post-Launch Optimization Checklist

### Week 1
- [ ] Review heatmap data
- [ ] Identify scroll drop-off points
- [ ] Check conversion funnel for leaks
- [ ] Monitor support queries for objection patterns

### Week 2
- [ ] Launch first A/B test (headline priority)
- [ ] Analyze checkout abandonment reasons
- [ ] Review chat transcripts for insights
- [ ] Update FAQ based on real questions

### Ongoing
- [ ] Monthly element audit
- [ ] Quarterly full review
- [ ] Continuous A/B testing program
- [ ] Proof library updates

---

## Quick Reference: Golden Rules

### The Meta-Rule
```
"A pagina nao vende. A pagina remove as razoes para NAO comprar."
```

### Show, Don't Tell
```
Para cada claim -> mostre prova
Para cada feature -> mostre beneficio
Para cada objecao -> mostre solucao
```

### Value Equation Attack
```
Section A: Capture attention (Dream Outcome + Urgency)
Section B: Build case (Likelihood + Value)
Section C: Remove friction (Minimize Effort)
```

### Optimization Priority
```
1. If scroll rate <40% -> Fix Section A
2. If conversion <3% -> Audit all 17 elements
3. If checkout abandon >25% -> Focus Section C
```

---

## Troubleshooting Quick Reference

| Problem | Check First | Quick Fix |
|---------|-------------|-----------|
| Low scroll | Headline | A/B test pain vs desire |
| No CTA clicks | Button text | Change to benefit + arrow |
| High bounce | Above fold | Add social proof |
| Low conversion | Value stack | Make gap more obvious |
| Cart abandon | Trust badges | Add security seals |
| Support overload | FAQ | Address real objections |

---

*"Show, don't tell - Para cada claim, mostre prova. Para cada feature, mostre beneficio. Para cada objecao, mostre solucao."* - Blueprint PV

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/scarcity-urgency-checklist.md

# Scarcity & Urgency Implementation Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Offers - Chapters 12 & 13 - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-CL-001 (SOP Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Generated:** 2026-02-10
> **Agent:** hormozi-offers

---

## Pre-Implementation Checklist

### Offer Readiness

- [ ] Core offer delivers real value (passes "Value Equation" test)
- [ ] Offer is already working at baseline (don't add scarcity to broken offer)
- [ ] Target audience is defined and reachable
- [ ] Sales process is documented and functional

### Capacity Analysis

- [ ] True operational capacity is known (not guessed)
- [ ] Current utilization percentage is calculated
- [ ] Weekly/monthly onboarding capacity is mapped
- [ ] Delivery quality at capacity is confirmed

### Infrastructure Ready

- [ ] Calendar system can enforce time windows
- [ ] CRM can track capacity and waitlist
- [ ] Communication channels are configured (email, social, landing pages)
- [ ] Countdown timer tools are available (if using urgency)

### Ethical Commitment

- [ ] Leadership commits to honoring ALL stated limits
- [ ] Team understands "no exceptions" policy for deadlines
- [ ] Sell-out announcement process is defined
- [ ] Waitlist management is planned

---

## Scarcity Type Selection Checklist

### Physical Product Scarcity

> "Ter lançamentos limitados é um método testado e comprovado"

- [ ] Identified release type (flavor, color, design, size)
- [ ] Quantity set BELOW expected demand
- [ ] "Always sell out" principle accepted
- [ ] Sell-out announcement planned
- [ ] Frequency set (monthly optimal)

**Go/No-Go:** Can you honestly limit production and commit to selling out?

### Total Business Limit Scarcity

> "Minha agência atenderá apenas vinte e cinco clientes no total"

- [ ] Maximum client capacity determined
- [ ] Service quality at capacity validated
- [ ] Waitlist system configured
- [ ] Periodic expansion plan (10-20%) outlined
- [ ] "Always leave some demand unmet" accepted

**Go/No-Go:** Can you turn away clients when at capacity?

### Growth Rate Limit Scarcity

> "Aceitamos apenas 5 novos clientes por semana"

- [ ] Weekly/monthly new client capacity determined
- [ ] Openings remaining tracking enabled
- [ ] Sales team trained on scarcity scripts
- [ ] Buffer for uncertainty maintained

**Go/No-Go:** Can you honestly report openings remaining?

### Cohort Limit Scarcity

> "Aceitamos 100 clientes 4 vezes por ano"

- [ ] Cohort size set below expected demand
- [ ] Cohort start dates defined
- [ ] Open/close enrollment process documented
- [ ] Compound tracking initialized

**Go/No-Go:** Can you close enrollment even with demand?

### Premium Access Scarcity (Extreme)

> "Venda uma oferta muito limitada de acesso 1-a-1"

- [ ] Delivery method you don't hate identified
- [ ] Tiny limit set (3-5 typical)
- [ ] Premium price determined
- [ ] Communication plan for availability

**Go/No-Go:** Are you prepared for top 1% of 1% clients?

### Exit Barrier Scarcity

> "Se eles saírem, nunca poderão retornar"

- [ ] Confirmed this is a SMALL group application
- [ ] Policy clearly communicated before enrollment
- [ ] Enforcement mechanism in place
- [ ] Understood this "loses teeth" with larger groups

**Go/No-Go:** Can you enforce the "no return" policy?

---

## Urgency Type Selection Checklist

### Cohort-Based Urgency

> "Quanto menos frequentemente você inicia novos clientes, mais poderoso"

- [ ] Cohort start dates are fixed and real
- [ ] Basic script prepared: "Sign up today = Monday group"
- [ ] Advanced script prepared: "Cancellation slot available"
- [ ] Late-join handling defined (catch-up or runway extension)

**Go/No-Go:** Are your start dates real and enforced?

### Seasonal/Promotional Urgency

> "A promoção real pode ser a mesma, mas nomeá-la algo diferente"

- [ ] Promotion calendar mapped for the year
- [ ] Each promotion has unique name (New Year, Valentine's, Spring, etc.)
- [ ] Landing pages with visible dates ready
- [ ] Ads with deadline copy prepared
- [ ] Local business frequency (monthly) considered if applicable

**Go/No-Go:** Are you committed to ending promotions on stated dates?

### Price/Bonus Urgency

> "Cria medo de perder a promoção, em vez do serviço real"

- [ ] Identified what expires (discount, bonus, installation, workshop)
- [ ] Expiration is honest (you WILL remove after date)
- [ ] Interchangeable elements ready for rotation
- [ ] Script prepared: "Not sure how long we'll run this one"

**Go/No-Go:** Will you actually remove the bonus/discount after deadline?

### Price Increase Urgency

> "Nunca aumente seus preços sem avisar as pessoas"

- [ ] Price increase is ACTUALLY happening
- [ ] Announcement timeline defined
- [ ] Pipeline clearing campaign planned
- [ ] New price is set and locked in

**Go/No-Go:** Is the price increase real and permanent?

### Exploding Opportunity Urgency

> "Cada segundo que alguém atrasa, eles perdem ganhos desproporcionais"

- [ ] Opportunity is genuinely time-sensitive
- [ ] Delay consequences are real and significant
- [ ] Emphasis plan for urgency messaging
- [ ] Evidence of time decay available

**Go/No-Go:** Does waiting actually cost the prospect significantly?

---

## Combined Deployment Checklist

### Stacking Scarcity + Urgency

> "Frequentemente, escassez e urgência são usadas juntas"

- [ ] Both limits can be honestly enforced
- [ ] Combined message is clear, not overwhelming
- [ ] Example ready: "20 spots, enrollment closes Friday"
- [ ] Both tracking systems active

### Sell-Out Announcement Protocol

> "Você também deve deixar todos saberem que esgotou"

- [ ] Announcement template ready
- [ ] Channels for announcement identified (email, social, landing page)
- [ ] Waitlist capture integrated into announcement
- [ ] Next opportunity date estimated and communicated

---

## Communication Checklist

### Scarcity Messaging

- [ ] Capacity percentage visible: "Currently at X% capacity"
- [ ] Spots remaining visible: "Only Y spots left"
- [ ] Waitlist mentioned: "Join waitlist for next opening"
- [ ] Social proof implied: "X people chose to work with us"

### Urgency Messaging

- [ ] Deadline prominently displayed
- [ ] Countdown timer active (if digital)
- [ ] Reminder sequence configured
- [ ] Last-day messaging prepared

### Scripts Ready

#### Scarcity Scripts:
- [ ] Total limit: "We only serve X clients total"
- [ ] Growth rate: "We accept only X new clients per week, Y spots filled"
- [ ] Cohort: "We accept X clients Y times per year, doors open then close"
- [ ] Premium: "I have X spots for direct access at [price]"

#### Urgency Scripts:
- [ ] Cohort deadline: "Sign up today = next group Monday"
- [ ] Seasonal: "Our [Name] Promo ends [Date]"
- [ ] Price/Bonus: "Take advantage of the discount, we change every 4 weeks"
- [ ] Price increase: "Prices going up, get in now!"

---

## Ethical Enforcement Checklist

### Before Launch

- [ ] All limits are real and verifiable
- [ ] Deadline enforcement is committed (no exceptions)
- [ ] Team trained on "no exception" policy
- [ ] Honest scarcity as fallback if needed

### During Campaign

- [ ] Capacity tracking is real-time accurate
- [ ] Deadlines are visibly counting down
- [ ] No fake urgency ("only 2 left!" when unlimited)
- [ ] Customer challenges handled with proof

### At Capacity/Deadline

- [ ] Campaign closed as stated (no extensions)
- [ ] Sell-out announced publicly
- [ ] Late requests redirected to next opportunity
- [ ] Waitlist capturing overflow demand

### After Campaign

- [ ] All claims were honored
- [ ] No credibility damage identified
- [ ] Compound tracking updated
- [ ] Learnings documented for next campaign

---

## Quality Gate Checkpoints

### QG-001: Honesty Gate (BLOCKING)

Before ANY scarcity-urgency deployment:

- [ ] Limit is real and enforceable
- [ ] Deadline is real and will be honored
- [ ] No "fake scarcity" elements

**If failed:** Use honest scarcity or do not deploy

### QG-002: Sell-Out Gate (WARNING)

At end of limited campaign:

- [ ] Campaign sold out (or close to it)

**If failed:** Reduce limit next time

### QG-003: Deadline Enforcement Gate (BLOCKING)

When late request comes in:

- [ ] Deadline was honored (no exceptions)
- [ ] Customer redirected to next opportunity

**If failed:** Escalate - credibility at risk

### QG-004: Announcement Gate (WARNING)

After sell-out:

- [ ] Sell-out was announced publicly

**If failed:** Announce immediately - this is part of the strategy

### QG-005: Credibility Gate (BLOCKING)

Campaign review:

- [ ] No fake scarcity claims made
- [ ] All limits were honored
- [ ] No deadline exceptions granted

**If failed:** Audit and correct before next campaign

### QG-006: Compound Effect Gate (WARNING)

Quarterly review:

- [ ] Effectiveness improving or stable
- [ ] Time-to-sell-out not increasing
- [ ] Waitlist not shrinking

**If failed:** Strategy refresh required

---

## Metrics Tracking Checklist

### Primary Metrics

- [ ] Sell-out rate tracked (target: >80%)
- [ ] Decision speed tracked (target: faster than baseline)
- [ ] Last-day sales percentage tracked (benchmark: 30-60%)

### Secondary Metrics

- [ ] Waitlist conversion rate
- [ ] Price objection frequency
- [ ] Repeat buyer rate post-exposure
- [ ] Time-to-sell-out trend

### Compound Effect Tracking

- [ ] Campaign-over-campaign comparison active
- [ ] Quarterly trend analysis scheduled
- [ ] Improvement/decline patterns monitored

---

## Post-Campaign Review Checklist

### Performance Review

- [ ] Did we sell out? (If no, limit was too high)
- [ ] Did last-day spike occur? (If no, urgency needs work)
- [ ] Were all limits honored? (If no, credibility risk)
- [ ] Was sell-out announced? (If no, missed opportunity)

### Credibility Review

- [ ] Any customer complaints about fake scarcity?
- [ ] Any deadline exceptions granted?
- [ ] Any capacity violations?
- [ ] Public perception intact?

### Compound Effect Review

- [ ] Is sell-out time improving?
- [ ] Is waitlist growing?
- [ ] Are price objections decreasing?
- [ ] Are repeat purchases increasing?

### Optimization Notes

- [ ] What worked well?
- [ ] What needs improvement?
- [ ] Limit adjustments for next time?
- [ ] Urgency messaging refinements?

---

## Quick Reference: Do's and Don'ts

### DO:

- Set limits BELOW expected demand
- ALWAYS sell out (better than oversupply)
- ALWAYS announce sell-outs
- Enforce deadlines without exception
- Use honest scarcity as default
- Track compound effectiveness over time
- Vary marketing more often (especially local businesses)

### DON'T:

- Use fake scarcity or urgency
- Reopen after deadline closes
- Make exceptions for late requests
- Over-order and fail to sell out
- Skip the sell-out announcement
- Use the same fake countdown everyone uses
- Damage credibility for short-term gains

---

## Final Pre-Launch Validation

Before launching any scarcity-urgency campaign, confirm:

1. **Honesty Check:** Every limit and deadline is real and enforceable
2. **Enforcement Commitment:** Team commits to zero exceptions
3. **Announcement Ready:** Sell-out announcement template prepared
4. **Tracking Active:** All metrics and compound tracking initialized
5. **Waitlist Configured:** Overflow demand can be captured
6. **Scripts Ready:** Sales team has all necessary scripts

**Launch Authorization:**
- [ ] All items above confirmed
- [ ] Strategy owner sign-off
- [ ] Campaign can proceed

---

**"A estratégia de escassez mais fácil é a honestidade."**

*When in doubt, use honest scarcity. It always works.*

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/subscription-model-checklist.md

# Subscription Model Checklist
# Source: $100M Money Models - Secao 5: Ofertas de Continuidade
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10
> Agent: hormozi-models

---

## Overview

Este checklist cobre a implementacao completa de ofertas de continuidade baseado no framework de Alex Hormozi. Use em conjunto com:
- `subscription-model-sop.md` - Framework detalhado
- `subscription-model-squad-blueprint.yaml` - Estrutura de automacao
- `retention-sop.md` - Retencao pos-conversao

---

## Pre-Requisitos

### Fundacao do Negocio
- [ ] Valor continuo claramente definido (o que cliente recebe todo mes)
- [ ] Oferta de atracao (trial/desafio) validada e funcionando
- [ ] Sistema de billing recorrente implementado
- [ ] Metricas de churn sendo rastreadas
- [ ] Metas de lucro de 30 dias definidas

### Inventario de Assets
- [ ] Lista completa de assets existentes (cursos, templates, ferramentas)
- [ ] Precos historicos reais documentados para cada asset
- [ ] Calculo do valor total do pacote de bonus
- [ ] Confirmacao: valor do bonus > primeiro pagamento de continuidade
- [ ] Verificacao: todos os bonus sao relacionados a oferta principal

---

## Tipo 1: Oferta de Bonus de Continuidade

### Design do Bonus
- [ ] **Bonus principal** definido com valor percebido > primeiro pagamento
  - Asset: _________________
  - Valor real: $_____________
  - Primeiro pagamento: $_____________
  - Ratio: ______x (deve ser >1x)

- [ ] **Bonus secundarios** listados com valores
  - Bonus 2: _________________ (valor: $______)
  - Bonus 3: _________________ (valor: $______)
  - Bonus 4: _________________ (valor: $______)
  - Valor total empilhado: $_____________

- [ ] **Tipo de bonus** identificado
  - [ ] Mais do mesmo (extensao do que compram)
  - [ ] Complementar (adiciona ao produto principal)
  - [ ] Upgrade (versao superior)
  - [ ] Titulo/Status (Silver, Gold, Diamond)

- [ ] **Cross-bonus** considerado (se aplicavel)
  - [ ] Digital + Fisico (se oferta digital)
  - [ ] Fisico + Digital (se oferta fisica)

### Regras de Bonus Verificadas
- [ ] Precos de bonus sao REAIS (nao inventados)
- [ ] Bonus e RELACIONADO a oferta principal
- [ ] Bonus usa assets EXISTENTES (custo marginal zero preferido)
- [ ] Ancora de valor e CRIVEL para o cliente

### Script de Apresentacao
- [ ] Script criado: Vender BONUS primeiro (nao membership)
- [ ] Script criado: Perguntar "Quer saber como conseguir gratis?"
- [ ] Script criado: Revelar que membership da bonus
- [ ] Script criado: Empilhar bonus com valores individuais
- [ ] Script criado: Oferecer opcao standalone

---

## Tipo 2: Oferta de Desconto de Continuidade

### Pre-Pagamento em Massa
- [ ] Oferta definida: "Compre __ meses, ganhe __ gratis"
  - Recomendado: "Compre 5, ganhe 1" (16% desconto)
  - Target de uptake: 12.5% (1 em 8)
  - Impacto esperado: +50% lucros de 30 dias

- [ ] Oferta de pre-pagamento anual definida (se aplicavel)
  - Desconto: ____%
  - Bonus adicional: _________________

### Descontos Vitalícios
- [ ] Desconto condicional definido (se aplicavel)
  - "Se pagar hoje, desbloqueia desconto vitalicio de $____ para $____/mes"

---

## Tipo 3: Oferta de Taxa Dispensada

### Estrutura da Taxa
- [ ] **Preco mensal** definido: $_____________
- [ ] **Taxa de configuracao** definida: $_____________
  - Range recomendado: 3-5x mensal
  - Sua taxa: ______x mensal
  - [ ] Taxa >= 3x mensal
  - [ ] Taxa <= 5x mensal

- [ ] **Duracao do compromisso** definida: _____ meses
  - [ ] Minimo 12 meses (requerido)

### Opcoes para Cliente
- [ ] **Opcao A** (Mes a Mes) documentada:
  - Taxa: $_____________
  - Primeiro mes: $_____________
  - Total hoje: $_____________
  - Mensalidade: $_____________
  - Cancelamento: A qualquer momento

- [ ] **Opcao B** (Compromisso) documentada:
  - Taxa: Dispensada
  - Compromisso: _____ meses
  - Mensalidade: $_____________
  - Se cancelar antes: Pagar taxa de $_____________

### Documentacao Legal
- [ ] Documento para cliente rubricar criado
- [ ] Linguagem clara sobre taxa se cancelar cedo
- [ ] Processo de cobranca de taxa definido

### Regras Verificadas
- [ ] Taxa desaparece APOS completar compromisso
- [ ] Mecanismo de investigacao se >5% cancelam cedo
- [ ] Servico e de resultado de LONGO PRAZO (SEO, investing, weight loss)

### Tatica Avancada (Opcional)
- [ ] "Taxa para causa odiada" considerada
  - Script criado: "Qual causa voce odeia?"
  - Mecanismo de doacao definido

---

## Pricing Mix

### Definir Objetivo
- [ ] Target de % que escolhe continuidade: _____%

### Calcular Multiplicador
| Target | Multiplicador |
|--------|---------------|
| 50% | 1.33x |
| 60% | 1.66x |
| 70% | 2.00x |
| 80% | 2.33x |
| 90% | 2.66x |

- [ ] **Preco de continuidade**: $_____/mes
- [ ] **Multiplicador escolhido**: _____x
- [ ] **Preco standalone calculado**: $_____ (continuidade x multiplicador)

### Validacao
- [ ] Preco standalone parece "caro" comparado a continuidade
- [ ] Ambos os precos sao criveis no mercado

---

## Posicao no Funil

### Sequencia Correta
- [ ] **Passo 1**: Lead magnet / Oferta de atracao -> Gera dinheiro antecipado
  - Sua oferta: _________________

- [ ] **Passo 2**: Upsell offers -> Mais dinheiro antecipado
  - Seu upsell: _________________

- [ ] **Passo 3**: Downsell offers -> Recupera vendas perdidas
  - Seu downsell: _________________

- [ ] **Passo 4**: OFERTA DE CONTINUIDADE -> Dinheiro hoje + amanha
  - Sua continuidade: _________________

### Verificacao Critica
- [ ] NUNCA oferecer continuidade como unica opcao de entrada
- [ ] SEMPRE ter trial/desafio/lead magnet ANTES de continuidade
- [ ] Continuidade e apresentada APOS cliente ja ter comprado algo

---

## Scripts Completos

### Script 1: Apresentacao de Bonus
- [ ] Step 1: Descrever bonus com entusiasmo (valor alto)
- [ ] Step 2: Pausar para reacao
- [ ] Step 3: "Quer saber como conseguir gratis?"
- [ ] Step 4: "Torne-se membro VIP e recebe gratis. Ou compre por $____"
- [ ] Step 5: "Alem disso, recebe [bonus 2, 3, 4] com valores"

### Script 2: Taxa Dispensada
- [ ] Opcao A: Mes a mes com taxa de $____
- [ ] Opcao B: Compromisso de ____ meses, taxa dispensada
- [ ] "Qual faz mais sentido para voce?"

### Script 3: Prepayment Upsell
- [ ] "Quer economizar ainda mais?"
- [ ] "Pre-pague __ meses, ganhe __ gratis"
- [ ] "Como bonus extra, voce tambem recebe ____"

### Script 4: Taxa para Causa Odiada (Opcional)
- [ ] "Qual causa voce odeia?"
- [ ] "Se cancelar cedo, doo a taxa para eles"

---

## Monitoramento

### Metricas Primarias
- [ ] Tracking configurado: Conversao standalone vs continuidade
  - Target: ____% continuidade
  - Atual: ____%

- [ ] Tracking configurado: Uptake de prepagamento
  - Target: >12.5%
  - Atual: ____%

- [ ] Tracking configurado: Lucros de 30 dias
  - Projecao: $_____
  - Atual: $_____

### Metricas de Alerta
- [ ] Tracking configurado: Cancelamento antes do compromisso
  - Threshold: <5%
  - Atual: ____%
  - [ ] Se >5%: Investigar PRODUTO (nao aumentar taxa)

### Dashboard
- [ ] Visualizacao de mix standalone/continuidade
- [ ] Visualizacao de prepayment uptake
- [ ] Visualizacao de 30-day profit trend
- [ ] Alertas automaticos configurados

---

## Quality Gates

### Antes de Lancar
- [ ] QG-001: Valor do bonus > primeiro pagamento
- [ ] QG-002: Bonus relacionado a oferta principal
- [ ] QG-003: Taxa entre 3-5x mensal (se waived fee)
- [ ] QG-004: Compromisso >= 12 meses (se waived fee)
- [ ] QG-005: Oferta de entrada existe ANTES da continuidade
- [ ] QG-006: Cliente rubrica documentacao (se waived fee)

### Apos Lancar
- [ ] QG-007: Cancelamento precoce <5%
- [ ] QG-008: Conversao dentro de 10% do target
- [ ] QG-009: Prepayment uptake >12.5%

---

## Integracao com Retention SOP

### Handoffs
- [ ] Apos signup de continuidade -> Iniciar onboarding (retention-sop)
- [ ] Apos completar compromisso -> Oferecer annual pricing (retention-sop Step 6)
- [ ] Se cliente quer cancelar -> Exit interview (retention-sop Horseman 5)

### Cross-References Documentados
- [ ] Annual Pricing -> retention-sop Step 6
- [ ] Exit Interviews -> retention-sop Horseman 5
- [ ] Churn Reduction -> retention-sop completo
- [ ] LTV Calculation -> retention-sop Crazy 8

---

## Troubleshooting Quick Reference

| Problema | Causa Provavel | Solucao |
|----------|----------------|---------|
| Muitos escolhem standalone | Multiplicador baixo | Aumentar multiplicador |
| Muitos mes-a-mes (waived fee) | Taxa baixa | Aumentar taxa (3-5x) |
| >5% cancelam antes do compromisso | Produto ruim | Investigar produto, NAO aumentar taxa |
| Baixo uptake de prepayment | Nao oferecendo | Sempre oferecer apos aceitar continuidade |
| Bonus nao ressoa | Nao relacionado | Trocar por bonus relevante |

---

## Auditoria Trimestral

### Revisar
- [ ] Valor do bonus ainda > primeiro pagamento?
- [ ] Precos de bonus ainda criveis?
- [ ] Mix standalone vs continuidade no target?
- [ ] Taxa dispensada no range 3-5x?
- [ ] Oferta de entrada ainda funciona?
- [ ] Prepagamento sendo oferecido?

### Ajustar
- [ ] Multiplicador (se conversao off-target)
- [ ] Bonus package (se nao ressonando)
- [ ] Taxa (se muitos mes-a-mes ou muitos compromissos)
- [ ] Scripts (se equipe nao seguindo)

---

## Assinaturas

| Item | Responsavel | Data | Assinatura |
|------|-------------|------|------------|
| Pre-requisitos completos | | | |
| Ofertas desenhadas | | | |
| Scripts criados | | | |
| Pricing definido | | | |
| Quality gates passaram | | | |
| Lancamento aprovado | | | |

---

## Notas de Implementacao

```
Data: ____________

Tipo de oferta escolhido: [ ] Bonus [ ] Desconto [ ] Taxa Dispensada [ ] Combinacao

Decisoes tomadas:
1. _______________________________________________
2. _______________________________________________
3. _______________________________________________

Proximos passos:
1. _______________________________________________
2. _______________________________________________
3. _______________________________________________

Responsavel: ______________________
Review date: ______________________
```

---

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/upsell-page-checklist.md

# Upsell Page Checklist

> **Source:** BLUEPRINT UPSELL: A ARQUITETURA DA MULTIPLICACAO DE AOV - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** HO-CL-001 (Hormozi Checklist Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Created:** 2026-02-10
> **Agent:** hormozi-copy

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

Before building any upsell page, verify these prerequisites:

### Technical Prerequisites
- [ ] **One-Click Payment Configured** - Token storage from main purchase working
- [ ] **Timer System Ready** - Countdown mechanism with sound capability
- [ ] **Exit Intent Detection Active** - Mouse/back button triggers configured
- [ ] **Video Hosting Ready** - Autoplay and completion tracking enabled
- [ ] **Mobile Responsive Template** - Fixed footer buttons working

### Content Prerequisites
- [ ] **Upsell Offer Defined** - Clear complementary product/service
- [ ] **Pricing Strategy Set** - 30-50% of main product value
- [ ] **Downsell Variant Ready** - 15-25% of main product value
- [ ] **Testimonials Collected** - 2-3 upsell-specific testimonials
- [ ] **VSL Script Written** - 2-4 minute structure complete

---

## SECTION A: O Topo Critico (Above the Fold)

### Element 1: Headline de Continuidade
- [ ] **Maintains "yes" momentum** - Feels like continuation, not new pitch
- [ ] **Validates previous purchase** - Confirms their decision was good
- [ ] **Includes personalization** - Uses customer name if available
- [ ] **Creates anticipation** - Hints at additional value

**Validation Checks:**
- [ ] Does NOT question previous purchase
- [ ] Does NOT create new anxiety
- [ ] Does NOT imply main product is insufficient

**Template Options Used:**
- [ ] "ESPERE! Sua compra foi confirmada, mas..."
- [ ] "[Nome], voce desbloqueou uma oferta exclusiva"
- [ ] "Parabens! Antes de acessar seu [produto], veja isso..."
- [ ] Custom (must pass validation checks)

---

### Element 2: Subheadline de Complementaridade
- [ ] **Positions as multiplier** - Upsell accelerates, doesn't replace
- [ ] **States specific result** - Clear additional outcome
- [ ] **Includes benefit multiplier** - "3x faster" or similar
- [ ] **Contains time limit** - "Oferta valida apenas agora"

**Formula Applied:**
```
"Adicione [RESULTADO ESPECIFICO] ao que voce acabou de comprar
e [BENEFICIO MULTIPLICADOR] - Oferta valida apenas agora"
```

---

### Element 3: Barra de Progresso Psicologica
- [ ] **3 steps visible** - Clear progression
- [ ] **Step 1 has green checkmark** - Reinforces positive decision
- [ ] **Step 2 shows "Voce esta aqui"** - Creates incomplete mission feeling
- [ ] **Step 3 shows final destination** - Area de membros/access

**Visual Structure:**
```
[✓] Passo 1: Programa Principal Garantido
[?] Passo 2: Acelerar Resultados (Voce esta aqui)
[ ] Passo 3: Acessar Area de Membros
```
- [ ] Checkmark verde visible
- [ ] Current step highlighted
- [ ] Incomplete step grayed

---

### Element 4: Timer de Decisao
- [ ] **Duration set** - Maximum 10 minutes (not 24h)
- [ ] **Message displayed** - "Oferta expira quando sair desta pagina"
- [ ] **Sound enabled** - Tique-taque nos ultimos 60 segundos
- [ ] **Expiry behavior** - Redirects to thank you page

**Timer Configuration:**
- [ ] Timer visible above fold
- [ ] Countdown active on page load
- [ ] Sound triggers at 60s remaining
- [ ] Page redirects at 0

---

## SECTION B: O Corpo Persuasivo

### Element 5: Video Upsell Curto
- [ ] **Duration** - 2-4 minutes maximum (NEVER exceed)
- [ ] **Opens with congratulations** - Validates purchase (0-10s)
- [ ] **Reveals gap** - What upsell addresses (10-30s)
- [ ] **Demonstrates result** - Proof of additional value (30-90s)
- [ ] **Quick value stack** - Components listed (90-180s)
- [ ] **Urgent CTA** - Clear action (180-240s)

**Opening Script Matches:**
```
"Parabens! Voce acabou de tomar a melhor decisao para [resultado].
Mas descobri que alunos que tambem pegam [upsell] conseguem
[resultado 3x maior]. Deixe-me mostrar rapidamente..."
```
- [ ] Script follows template
- [ ] Tone is celebratory, not salesy
- [ ] No new anxiety created

---

### Element 6: Grafico "Com vs Sem"
- [ ] **Side-by-side format** - Clear visual comparison
- [ ] **5 comparison points** - Specific benefits listed
- [ ] **Checkmarks/X marks** - Visual yes/no indicators
- [ ] **Velocity multiplier footer** - "1x vs 3-5x" bottom line

**Comparison Points Include:**
- [ ] Time to result
- [ ] Support level
- [ ] Resources/templates included
- [ ] Implementation method
- [ ] Learning curve/roadmap

---

### Element 7: Mini Stack de Valor
- [ ] **Maximum 3 components** - Simplicidade acelera decisao
- [ ] **Each has dollar value** - Clear value assignment
- [ ] **Total calculated** - Sum displayed
- [ ] **Today's price shown** - Significant discount from total
- [ ] **5-10x ratio validated** - Perceived value >= 5x price

**Value Stack Structure:**
```
COMPONENTE PRINCIPAL .............. Valor R$ [X]
BONUS RAPIDO #1 .................. Valor R$ [Y]
BONUS RAPIDO #2 .................. Valor R$ [Z]
                    TOTAL: R$ [X+Y+Z]
                    HOJE APENAS: R$ [price]
```

**Ratio Check:**
- [ ] Total value / Today's price >= 5x (minimum)
- [ ] Total value / Today's price >= 10x (optimal)

---

### Element 8: Prova Social Especifica do Upsell
- [ ] **Quantity** - 2-3 testimonials only
- [ ] **Upsell-specific** - About the upsell, NOT main product
- [ ] **Short format** - Quick to read
- [ ] **Photos included** - Real faces
- [ ] **Specific results** - Quantified outcomes

**Example Format:**
```
"93% dos alunos que pegaram o [Upsell] dizem que
foi a melhor decisao que tomaram..."

[Foto] "O [upsell] cortou meu tempo de implementacao
em 75%. Resultados na primeira semana!" - Nome
```

---

### Element 9: Garantia Empilhada
- [ ] **Original guarantee referenced** - "Sua garantia original CONTINUA VALENDO"
- [ ] **Additional guarantee added** - Extra protection for upsell
- [ ] **Specific outcome promised** - "acelerar resultados em pelo menos 2x"
- [ ] **Clear refund terms** - "devolvemos 100% do valor do upgrade"
- [ ] **Keep everything clause** - "voce fica com tudo"

---

## SECTION C: Elementos de Conversao Rapida

### Element 10: Dois Botoes Apenas
- [ ] **Binary choice** - Only Yes and No options
- [ ] **Yes button** - Verde, Grande, Primary position
- [ ] **No button** - Cinza, Menor, Secondary position
- [ ] **Outcome-focused copy** - Results, not features

**Button Copy:**
- [ ] YES: "SIM! Quero Resultados 3x Mais Rapidos →"
- [ ] NO: "Nao, prefiro ir mais devagar"

**Mobile Specific:**
- [ ] Buttons fixed at bottom of viewport
- [ ] Tap targets appropriately sized
- [ ] Always visible during scroll

---

### Element 11: Micro-Comparacao de Preco
- [ ] **Main price referenced** - "Voce acabou de investir R$ [main]"
- [ ] **Percentage shown** - "menos de 30% extra"
- [ ] **Multiplier stated** - "multiplica resultados por 3"
- [ ] **Metaphor included** - "E como comprar um carro e deixar de pegar o seguro"

---

### Element 12: FAQ Ultra-Especifica
- [ ] **Exactly 3 questions** - No more, no less
- [ ] **Addresses timing objection** - "Preciso disso agora ou posso pegar depois?"
- [ ] **Addresses value objection** - "Isso nao deveria estar incluido?"
- [ ] **Addresses risk objection** - "E se eu me arrepender?"

**Answers Match Templates:**
- [ ] Q1 Answer mentions exclusive pricing
- [ ] Q2 Answer differentiates main vs upsell purpose
- [ ] Q3 Answer references guarantee + extra days

---

### Element 13: Reassurance Bar
- [ ] **Security indicator** - "🔒 Compra Segura"
- [ ] **Same card mention** - "Mesmo cartao ja cadastrado"
- [ ] **Guarantee reference** - "Garantia Total"
- [ ] **Access timing** - "Acesso Imediato"

---

### Element 14: Exit Intent Pop-up Downsell
- [ ] **Trigger configured** - Mouse to X or back button
- [ ] **Headline** - "ULTIMA CHANCE!"
- [ ] **Empathy statement** - "Ok, entendo que R$ [price] pode ser demais agora..."
- [ ] **Payment plan offer** - "3x de R$ [split price]"
- [ ] **Two buttons** - Accept and decline

**Modal Contains:**
```
"ULTIMA CHANCE!
Ok, entendo que R$ 497 pode ser demais agora...
Que tal levar o mesmo upgrade por 3x de R$ 197?"
[SIM, QUERO PARCELADO] [Nao, obrigado]
```

---

## SECTION D: Sequencia de Multiplos Upsells

### Element 15: Logica de Progressao
**Upsell #1 (Complemento Direto):**
- [ ] Pricing: 30-50% of main product value
- [ ] Purpose: Accelerates main result
- [ ] Target conversion: 30%
- [ ] If accepted → Upsell #3
- [ ] If rejected → Upsell #2

**Upsell #2 (Versao Lite):**
- [ ] Pricing: 15-25% of main product value
- [ ] Purpose: Lower barrier entry
- [ ] Target conversion: 20%
- [ ] If accepted → Thank You Page
- [ ] If rejected → Thank You Page

**Upsell #3 (Complemento Premium):**
- [ ] Pricing: 50-100% of main product value
- [ ] Purpose: Maximum value for committed buyers
- [ ] Target conversion: 15% of Upsell #1 buyers
- [ ] If accepted → Thank You Page
- [ ] If rejected → Thank You Page

---

### Element 16: Thank You Page Optimization
- [ ] **Confirmation visual** - All purchases summarized
- [ ] **Proximos passos** - Numbered next steps
- [ ] **Direct link** - Area de membros access
- [ ] **Onboarding video** - 2 minutes max
- [ ] **Referral offer** - "Refer a Friend" with incentive

---

### Element 17: One-Click Upsell Tecnico
- [ ] **Token stored** - From first purchase
- [ ] **Single click processing** - No re-entry of data
- [ ] **Instant confirmation** - <3 second processing
- [ ] **Fallback available** - Manual form if token fails
- [ ] **Tested before launch** - Verified working

**Critical Rule:**
> "Configure o one-click upsell ANTES de criar a pagina.
> A friccao tecnica mata mais upsells que copy ruim."

---

## Performance Validation

### Target Metrics
- [ ] **Upsell #1 Take Rate** - Target: >25%
- [ ] **AOV Multiplier** - Target: 1.8-2.5x main product
- [ ] **Time on Page** - Target: <90 seconds (quick decision)
- [ ] **Exit Intent Conversion** - Target: >10% of triggers
- [ ] **Technical Success Rate** - Target: >99%

### Launch Checklist
- [ ] All 17 elements implemented
- [ ] All section A elements above fold
- [ ] Mobile experience tested
- [ ] One-click payment verified
- [ ] Timer and sound working
- [ ] Exit intent triggering correctly
- [ ] Analytics tracking active
- [ ] A/B testing ready (if applicable)

---

## Quick Reference: What NEVER To Do

### Headlines
- [ ] Never question the purchase ("Tem certeza?")
- [ ] Never create new anxiety ("Voce esta perdendo...")
- [ ] Never imply insufficiency ("O programa sozinho nao e suficiente...")

### Value Stack
- [ ] Never exceed 3 components
- [ ] Never have <5x perceived value ratio

### VSL
- [ ] Never exceed 4 minutes
- [ ] Never skip the congratulations opening

### FAQ
- [ ] Never have more than 3 questions
- [ ] Never have fewer than 3 questions

### Timing
- [ ] Never set timer >10 minutes
- [ ] Never allow page access after timer expires

---

## Troubleshooting Quick Guide

| Symptom | First Check | Likely Cause |
|---------|-------------|--------------|
| Take rate <15% | One-click working? | Technical friction |
| Time on page >120s | VSL length? | Content fatigue |
| Low exit intent conversion | Downsell offer value? | Weak alternative |
| High page abandonment | Headline continuity? | Momentum broken |
| Low VSL completion | First 30 seconds? | Weak hook |

---

## Final Sign-Off

**Page Ready for Launch:**

- [ ] All 17 elements verified
- [ ] All 4 sections complete
- [ ] Psychological foundation applied
- [ ] Technical systems tested
- [ ] Target metrics defined
- [ ] Monitoring in place

**Approved by:** _________________ **Date:** _________________

---

*Checklist Version 1.0.0 - Based on BLUEPRINT UPSELL by Alex Hormozi*



<\!-- Criado com Squad Creator do AIOXPRO por @oalanicolas e @pedrovalerio | 2026-02-10 -->


## Referência: references/squad/checklists/upsell-sequence-checklist.md

# Upsell Sequence Checklist

> Checklist de validação para `create-upsell-sequence.md` (HZ_MOD_002)
> Source: $100M Money Models - Seção 6 (Upsells)
> Agent: hormozi-models

---

## Foundation

```yaml
foundation:
  core_mapped:
    - [ ] Core offer claramente definida
    - [ ] Problemas criados pelo core mapeados
    - [ ] Urgência de cada problema avaliada
```

---

## Type 1: Classic Upsell

```yaml
classic_upsell:
  structure:
    - [ ] "Não pode ter X sem Y" - problema identificado
    - [ ] Solução natural para o problema
    - [ ] Preço definido
    - [ ] Timing definido

  tactics_applied:
    - [ ] Upsells mais lucrativos primeiro
    - [ ] "Você não quer mais nada, quer?" (Não = Sim)
    - [ ] Surprise and delight - dá TODOS bônus
    - [ ] BAMFAM considerado (Book A Meeting From A Meeting)

  script:
    - [ ] Script documentado
    - [ ] Conecta problema → solução
```

---

## Type 2: Menu Upsell

```yaml
menu_upsell:
  4_steps:
    - [ ] UNSELL: O que riscar (não precisam)
    - [ ] PRESCRIBE: O que precisam
    - [ ] A/B: Pergunta sem sim/não
    - [ ] CARD ON FILE: "Usar cartão em arquivo?"

  options:
    - [ ] 2-3 opções definidas
    - [ ] Cada opção com preço e includes
    - [ ] The Economist Play considerado (A, B, A+B)

  scripts:
    - [ ] Unselling script documentado
    - [ ] Prescription script documentado
    - [ ] A/B question documentada
```

---

## Type 3: Anchor Upsell

```yaml
anchor_upsell:
  5_steps:
    - [ ] Âncora definida (5-10x principal)
    - [ ] Âncora é oferta REAL
    - [ ] Rescue question preparada
    - [ ] Oferta principal clara
    - [ ] Pergunta de pagamento

  critical_rule:
    - [ ] Preparado para entregar âncora se aceitarem
    - [ ] Não é oferta falsa

  expected:
    - [ ] % que compra âncora estimado
    - [ ] % que compra principal estimado
```

---

## Type 4: Rollover Upsell

```yaml
rollover_upsell:
  situations:
    - [ ] REENGAJAR clientes antigos (6+ meses)
    - [ ] RESGATAR clientes chateados
    - [ ] ROUBAR de concorrentes
    - [ ] UPSELL clientes atuais

  pricing:
    - [ ] Upsell ≥ 4x crédito
    - [ ] Máximo 25% desconto efetivo
    - [ ] Crédito claramente comunicado

  script:
    - [ ] Script documentado para cada situação
```

---

## 17 Quality Levers (Para Premium)

```yaml
quality_levers:
  considered:
    - [ ] Response time
    - [ ] Availability
    - [ ] Days available
    - [ ] Time per session
    - [ ] Locations
    - [ ] Cancellation policy
    - [ ] Service ratio (1:many vs 1:1)
    - [ ] Communication method
    - [ ] Provider level
    - [ ] Live vs Recorded
    - [ ] Remote vs In-person
    - [ ] DIY/DWY/DFY
    - [ ] Expirations
    - [ ] Personalization
```

---

## Sequence Order

```yaml
sequence:
  defined:
    - [ ] Ordem dos upsells definida
    - [ ] Timing de cada upsell documentado
    - [ ] Transições naturais

  no_overlap:
    - [ ] Upsells não competem entre si
    - [ ] Cada um resolve problema diferente
```

---

## Projected Impact

```yaml
impact:
  calculated:
    - [ ] Current avg order value
    - [ ] Projected avg order value
    - [ ] Multiplier esperado (típico: 2-4x)

  realistic:
    - [ ] Conversões baseadas em benchmarks
    - [ ] Não assume 100% aceitação
```

---

## Scripts Documented

```yaml
scripts:
  complete:
    - [ ] Classic upsell script
    - [ ] Menu unselling script
    - [ ] Menu prescription script
    - [ ] Anchor presentation script
    - [ ] Rollover reengagement script
```

---

## Quality Gate

```yaml
quality_gate:
  minimum:
    - [ ] Pelo menos 2 dos 4 tipos definidos
    - [ ] Cada tipo com script documentado
    - [ ] Timing de apresentação claro
    - [ ] Conversões esperadas realistas
    - [ ] Integrado com core offer
```

---

*Checklist: upsell-sequence | Version: 1.0*
*Supports: create-upsell-sequence.md (HZ_MOD_002)*

---

## Scoring

| Category | Items | Points Each | Max |
|----------|-------|-------------|-----|
| Critical — Foundation Core Mapping, Anchor Real-Offer Rule, Quality Gate Minimums | 13 | 3 | 39 |
| Standard — Classic Upsell, Menu Upsell, Rollover Upsell, Scripts Documented | 22 | 2 | 44 |
| Bonus — 17 Quality Levers, Sequence Order, Projected Impact | 21 | 1 | 21 |
| **TOTAL** | **56** | | **104** |

### Thresholds
- **PASS**: >= 84 points (80%)
- **CONDITIONAL**: >= 63 points (60%)
- **FAIL**: < 63 points

### If FAIL
The upsell sequence cannot reliably increase average order value. Map the core offer's created problems first, then build at least 2 of the 4 upsell types (Classic and Anchor are highest priority) with documented scripts before presenting to customers.

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/upsell-strategy-checklist.md

# Upsell Strategy Checklist

> **Source:** $100M Modelos - Secao 3: Ofertas de Upsell - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Generated:** 2026-02-10
> **Related:** upsell-page-checklist.md (for PAGE validation)
> **Agent:** hormozi-models

---

## Purpose

Validate that your upsell STRATEGY is complete and follows Hormozi's four upsell types framework. Use this checklist BEFORE designing upsell pages.

**Cross-Reference:** For PAGE element validation, see `upsell-page-checklist.md`

---

## Pre-Flight Check

Before designing any upsells, verify:

- [ ] **Core offer is profitable** - You have unit economics calculated
- [ ] **Customer journey mapped** - You understand what happens after purchase
- [ ] **Products/services exist** - You have things to upsell
- [ ] **Fulfillment capacity** - You can deliver on upsell promises
- [ ] **CRM configured** - You can track purchase history
- [ ] **Payment system ready** - Card-on-file capability exists

---

## SECTION A: Problem-Solution Chain Validation

### A.1: Problem Mapping

- [ ] **Core offer problem identified** - "What problem does the main offer solve?"
- [ ] **Revealed problem identified** - "What NEW problem does solving that create?"
- [ ] **Upsell solution exists** - "What product/service solves the new problem?"
- [ ] **Chain documented** - Written problem-solution map exists

**Template Check:**
```
[ ] "You can't have [Core Benefit] without [Upsell Benefit]"
Example: "You can't have a clean car without sealant"
```

### A.2: Chain Continuation

- [ ] **Each upsell reveals another problem** - Chain continues
- [ ] **Chain is 3+ levels deep** - Multiple upsell opportunities
- [ ] **Problems are genuine** - Not manufactured or forced
- [ ] **Solutions are valuable** - Actually help customer

---

## SECTION B: Classic Upsell Validation

### B.1: Structure Check

- [ ] **"X without Y" framework applied** - Core positioning exists
- [ ] **Immediate problem addressed** - Upsell solves next logical problem
- [ ] **Timing is correct** - Presented when problem becomes apparent

### B.2: Profit Ordering

- [ ] **Margins calculated** - Know profit for each upsell
- [ ] **Highest margin first** - Presentation order by profit
- [ ] **All upsells priced** - No guesswork on pricing

### B.3: Techniques Applied

| Technique | Applied | Notes |
|-----------|---------|-------|
| Say No to Say Yes | [ ] | "Voce nao quer mais nada, quer?" |
| Surprise & Delight | [ ] | Give all bonuses even if early yes |
| Hyper-Buyer Detection | [ ] | Life events flagged for increased offers |
| Access Acceleration | [ ] | Fastest possible delivery |
| Bundle & Name | [ ] | Multiple items grouped with outcome name |
| Integration in Delivery | [ ] | Upsells embedded in core product |
| BAMFAM | [ ] | Next meeting scheduled before end |
| Guarantee Upsell | [ ] | Charging for what was free |

### B.4: Scripts Ready

- [ ] **Main pitch script** - "You can't have X without Y"
- [ ] **Say No script** - "Voce nao quer mais nada, quer?"
- [ ] **BAMFAM script** - "Quando funciona melhor - [A] ou [B]?"
- [ ] **Objection handlers** - Common objections addressed

---

## SECTION C: Menu Upsell Validation

### C.1: Four Tactics Present

| Tactic | Present | Validated |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **UNSELL** | [ ] | What they don't need crossed out |
| **PRESCRIBE** | [ ] | What they need with instructions |
| **A/B CHOICE** | [ ] | Two options, both are purchases |
| **CARD ON FILE** | [ ] | Stored payment closing |

### C.2: Unselling Validation

- [ ] **Products to unsell exist** - Things you can cross out
- [ ] **Unselling builds trust** - Genuinely helping, not fake
- [ ] **Unselling script ready** - "Voce nao vai precisar de..."
- [ ] **Staff trained on unselling** - Encouraged to help "beat the system"

### C.3: Prescribing Validation

- [ ] **Integration explanation** - How it works with previous purchase
- [ ] **Usage instructions** - Detailed how-to included
- [ ] **Personalization present** - Tailored to customer situation
- [ ] **Prescription script ready** - "Voce vai querer..."

### C.4: A/B Choice Validation

- [ ] **Two options defined** - Not yes/no, but A or B
- [ ] **Both options are purchases** - Either choice is a sale
- [ ] **Nudge prepared** - "Este e meu favorito"
- [ ] **Categories covered** - Quantity, timing, flavor, color, etc.

**A/B Categories Checklist:**
- [ ] Quantity options ("Uma ou duas?")
- [ ] Timing options ("Amanha ou segunda?")
- [ ] Flavor/type options ("Chocolate ou baunilha?")
- [ ] Size options ("Pequeno ou medio?")
- [ ] Personnel options ("Joao ou Sara?")
- [ ] Delivery options ("Padrao ou expresso?")

### C.5: Card on File Validation

- [ ] **Payment system supports tokens** - Can store cards
- [ ] **Script ready** - "Quer usar o cartao em arquivo?"
- [ ] **First-purchase alternative** - "Qual cartao voce quer usar?"
- [ ] **Sold-out handling** - Payment collected, delivery delayed

---

## SECTION D: Anchor Upsell Validation

### D.1: Pricing Ratio

- [ ] **Anchor price is 5-10x main offer** - Sufficient contrast
- [ ] **Same PRIMARY features** - Core function identical
- [ ] **Different SECONDARY features** - Premium differentiators
- [ ] **Margins preserved** - Both offers profitable

**Ratio Calculator:**
```
Anchor Price: ____________
Main Price: ____________
Ratio: ____________ (must be 5-10x)
[ ] PASS (5x or higher)
[ ] FAIL (increase anchor or reduce main)
```

### D.2: Premium Authenticity

- [ ] **Premium offer is genuine** - You'd be happy to fulfill
- [ ] **Premium has real value** - Not fake or throwaway
- [ ] **Premium can be sold** - Some customers will buy it
- [ ] **Not treating as decoy** - Presented seriously

### D.3: Execution Flow

- [ ] **Step 1: Present Anchor** - Premium shown first
- [ ] **Step 2: Get the Gasp** - Wait for price shock
- [ ] **Step 3: Rescue Script** - "Voce se importa com [feature]?"
- [ ] **Step 4: Main as Bargain** - Present main offer
- [ ] **Step 5: Close with Card** - "Quer usar o cartao em arquivo?"

### D.4: Edge Cases Handled

- [ ] **No gasp = premium sale** - Close the premium if no reaction
- [ ] **Don't gasp yourself** - Ready to fulfill premium
- [ ] **Rescue script natural** - Face-saving, not mocking

---

## SECTION E: Rollover Upsell Validation

### E.1: Candidate Identification

| Candidate Type | Identified | List Ready |
|----------------|------------|------------|
| **Dormant (6+ months)** | [ ] | [ ] |
| **Upset (your customers)** | [ ] | [ ] |
| **Competitor's Upset** | [ ] | [ ] |
| **Current Buyers** | [ ] | [ ] |

### E.2: Credit Calculation

- [ ] **Credit amount defined** - How much to offer
- [ ] **4x ratio validated** - Upsell is 4x credit minimum
- [ ] **Maximum 25% discount** - Credit doesn't exceed limit

**Credit Calculator:**
```
Credit Offered: ____________
Upsell Price: ____________
Ratio: ____________ (must be 4x or higher)
Effective Discount: ____________% (must be 25% or less)
[ ] PASS
[ ] FAIL (reduce credit or increase upsell price)
```

### E.3: Campaign Elements

| Element | Present | Validated |
|---------|---------|-----------|
| Win-back script | [ ] | [ ] |
| Refund-to-rollover script | [ ] | [ ] |
| Competitor theft script | [ ] | [ ] |
| Urgency (one-time offer) | [ ] | [ ] |
| Gift card play (optional) | [ ] | [ ] |

### E.4: Outreach Quality

- [ ] **Personalized** - Not generic blast
- [ ] **Video option** - Personalized videos for high-value
- [ ] **Value-first framing** - "Queria devolver seu dinheiro"
- [ ] **Clear next step** - Easy to accept

### E.5: Win-Back ROI Tracking

- [ ] **Campaign cost tracked** - Time and money invested
- [ ] **Response rate tracked** - % who respond
- [ ] **Conversion rate tracked** - % who accept
- [ ] **Revenue attributed** - $ from campaign

---

## SECTION F: Economist Technique (Optional Advanced)

### F.1: Three-Option Setup

- [ ] **Option A defined** - Cheaper standalone
- [ ] **Option B defined** - Expensive standalone (DECOY)
- [ ] **Option C defined** - Both together, same price as B
- [ ] **Decoy price = Bundle price** - B and C same price

**Example Validation:**
```
Option A (Digital): $______
Option B (Print Only): $______ [DECOY]
Option C (Both): $______

[ ] B price = C price (decoy works)
[ ] Margins preserved on all options
```

---

## SECTION G: Integration & Culture

### G.1: Delivery Integration

- [ ] **Upsells embedded in core delivery** - Natural mentions
- [ ] **Bonus-to-problem flow designed** - Free items create upsell needs
- [ ] **Staff know integration points** - When to mention upsells

### G.2: BAMFAM Culture

- [ ] **Never end without next meeting** - Rule enforced
- [ ] **Calendar integration exists** - Easy to book
- [ ] **Compliance tracked** - Metric monitored
- [ ] **Script available** - Team knows how to do it

### G.3: Staff Training

- [ ] **All four upsell types trained** - Team knows the framework
- [ ] **Scripts memorized** - Can execute naturally
- [ ] **Unselling encouraged** - Culture of helping customers
- [ ] **Premium sales celebrated** - Not afraid of big tickets

---

## SECTION H: Metrics & Tracking

### H.1: Primary Metrics Tracked

| Metric | Tracked | Target | Current |
|--------|---------|--------|---------|
| Average Order Value (AOV) | [ ] | 1.5-2x baseline | ______ |
| Overall Upsell Take Rate | [ ] | >25% | ______% |
| Profit per Customer | [ ] | Increase | $______ |

### H.2: Type-Specific Metrics

| Upsell Type | Metric | Target | Tracked |
|-------------|--------|--------|---------|
| Classic | Conversion | >30% | [ ] |
| Menu | Items per Sale | >1.5 | [ ] |
| Anchor (Premium) | Premium Sales | >5% | [ ] |
| Anchor (Main) | Main Sales | >40% | [ ] |
| Rollover | Reactivation | >15% | [ ] |
| BAMFAM | Compliance | 100% | [ ] |

### H.3: Quality Tracking

- [ ] **Gasp rate for anchors** - Are anchors working?
- [ ] **Gift card redemption** - If using gift card play
- [ ] **Rollover campaign ROI** - Return on win-back
- [ ] **Customer satisfaction** - Not harming experience

---

## SECTION I: Quality Gates Validation

### I.1: Gate Compliance

| Gate | Checked | Pass/Fail |
|------|---------|-----------|
| Problem-Solution Chain Complete | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |
| Profit Ordering Applied | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |
| Anchor Ratio 5-10x | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |
| Rollover Credit Max 25% | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |
| BAMFAM Enforced | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |
| Bundle Value 5-10x Price | [ ] | [ ] Pass [ ] Fail |

### I.2: Failure Resolution

If any gate fails:
- [ ] **Root cause identified** - Know why it failed
- [ ] **Fix implemented** - Corrective action taken
- [ ] **Re-validated** - Gate passed after fix

---

## Final Validation Summary

### Completeness Check

| Section | Complete | Score |
|---------|----------|-------|
| A: Problem-Solution Chain | [ ] | __/4 |
| B: Classic Upsell | [ ] | __/12 |
| C: Menu Upsell | [ ] | __/15 |
| D: Anchor Upsell | [ ] | __/12 |
| E: Rollover Upsell | [ ] | __/14 |
| F: Economist (Optional) | [ ] | __/4 |
| G: Integration & Culture | [ ] | __/8 |
| H: Metrics & Tracking | [ ] | __/10 |
| I: Quality Gates | [ ] | __/7 |

### Readiness Determination

```
Total Score: ______ / 86 (excluding optional Section F)

[ ] READY (>80%): Proceed to upsell page design
[ ] NEEDS WORK (60-80%): Address gaps before proceeding
[ ] NOT READY (<60%): Major strategy work needed
```

### Sign-Off

| Role | Name | Date | Signature |
|------|------|------|-----------|
| Strategy Owner | ____________ | ______ | ________ |
| Revenue Lead | ____________ | ______ | ________ |
| Fulfillment Lead | ____________ | ______ | ________ |

---

## Quick Reference: Key Validation Points

### Must-Have Before Launch

1. **Problem-solution chain documented** - Know what you're solving
2. **Profit ordering applied** - Highest margin first
3. **At least 2 of 4 upsell types ready** - Classic + one other minimum
4. **Scripts for all active types** - No improvisation
5. **BAMFAM enforced** - Culture embedded
6. **Metrics tracked** - Know what's working

### Common Failures to Avoid

1. **Anchor not genuine** - Customers sense fakeness
2. **Rollover credit too high** - Eating margins
3. **No unselling** - Missing trust-building
4. **No BAMFAM** - Leaving money on table
5. **One upsell only** - Missing the 11.6x opportunity

### McDonald's Reminder

```
Hamburger alone: $0.25 profit
With fries: $0.25 + $0.75 = $1.00
With combo: $1.00 + $1.75 = $2.75
With supersize: $2.75 + $1.00 = $3.75

Multiplier: 15x (from $0.25 to $3.75)

"Se o McDonald's nao fizesse upsell de batatas fritas e refrigerante,
nao haveria McDonald's."
```

---

## Next Steps After Passing

1. **Design upsell pages** - Use `upsell-page-sop.md`
2. **Validate pages** - Use `upsell-page-checklist.md`
3. **Build sequences** - Use `upsell-sequence-checklist.md`
4. **Train team** - Scripts and culture
5. **Launch and track** - Metrics dashboard
6. **Optimize** - Iterate based on data

---
