## Referência: references/squad/data/swipefiles/goated-ads-swipefile.yaml

```yaml
# GOATed Ads Playbook - Alex Hormozi
# Extraido de: $100M GOATed Ads Playbook, FRAMEWORK GOATed Ads, Checklist de Ads
# Fonte: Acquisition.com - Copyright 2025

version: "1.0"
source: "GOATed Ads Playbook"
author: "Alex Hormozi"
context: "Sistema para criar 150-750 ads por semana e escalar advertising"

# =============================================================================
# AD ASSEMBLY PROCESS - O Sistema de Montagem de Ads
# =============================================================================
ad_assembly_process:
  overview: |
    Ads sao montados em partes, nao criados de uma vez.
    Resultado: 50 hooks x 3-5 meats x 1-3 CTAs = 150 a 750 ads por semana.
    90% do trabalho esta na preparacao, nao na gravacao.

  time_allocation:
    hooks: "80%"
    meat: "20%"
    ctas: "~0%"

  hook:
    description: "Primeiros 5 segundos - vende a pessoa em prestar atencao"
    quantity_per_session: 50
    importance: "Se ninguem passa pelo hook, nada mais importa"

    sources_for_hooks:
      - name: "Winning Hooks From Previous Ads"
        description: "Top performers do passado que voce reusa"
        priority: 1
      - name: "Winning Hooks From Free Content"
        description: "Hooks de longs, shorts, tweets, emails que performaram"
        priority: 2
      - name: "Winning Hooks From Other Ads"
        description: "Salve ads que voce gosta e copie os hooks"
        priority: 3
      - name: "Winning Hooks From Others Content"
        description: "Content com tons de views no seu espaco"
        priority: 4
      - name: "Platform Ad Libraries"
        description: "Ultimo recurso - dificil saber o que performa"
        priority: 5

    types_verbal:
      - "Labels (Rotulos)"
      - "Questions (Yes/Open)"
      - "Conditionals (Se/Entao)"
      - "Commands (Imperativos)"
      - "Statements (Declaracoes)"
      - "Lists/Steps (Listas/Passos)"
      - "Narratives (Historias)"
      - "Exclamations (Exclamacoes)"

    formula: "Hook Eficaz = Call Out + Value Condition"
    call_out: "Algo que faz o prospect dizer 'isso e para mim'"
    value_condition: "Promessa implicita ou explicita de valor SE consumirem"

  meat:
    description: "Corpo do ad que cumpre a promessa do hook"
    quantity_per_session: "3-5"
    rotation: "Menos frequente porque menos pessoas veem"

    formats:
      demonstration:
        description: "Mostra o produto/servico em acao"
        subtypes:
          - "Live use ou reactions"
          - "Unboxing"
          - "Comparisons (before/after)"
          - "High production hero ads (Dollar Shave Club, Old Spice)"

      testimonial:
        description: "Prova social de clientes/usuarios"
        subtypes:
          - "User-generated content (UGC)"
          - "Direct to camera"
          - "Podcast style"
          - "Professional testimonials"
          - "Raw iPhone style"
          - "Walk n talk rants"
          - "Group testimonials (parade of proof)"
          - "Lifecycle ads"
          - "Man-on-the-street interviews"
          - "Influencer collabs"

      education:
        description: "Ensina algo valioso"
        subtypes:
          - "Explainer videos"
          - "How-to listicles"
          - "Whiteboard explainer"
          - "High performing organic content"

      story:
        description: "Narrativa que conecta emocionalmente"
        subtypes:
          - "Storytelling"
          - "Lifestyle"
          - "Warnings and opportunities"
          - "Documentary style"
          - "Skits"
          - "Brand manifestos"

      faceless:
        description: "Sem pessoa na camera"
        subtypes:
          - "Screenshots of customer comments/texts"
          - "Text only"
          - "Slide shows"
          - "Animations"
          - "Cartoon ads"
          - "Visual effect based ads"

  cta:
    description: "Call To Action - diz exatamente o que fazer"
    quantity_per_session: "1-3"
    principle: "Clear > Clever"

    elements:
      what_to_do: "Take advantage of this great offer by..."
      how_to_do_it: "...tapping the button on the bottom of your screen..."
      when_to_do_it: "...before it expires..."
      what_they_get: "...and you'll get $1000 of free stuff."
      what_happens_next: "...delivered straight to your inbox."

    best_practice: "Show AND tell - demonstre visualmente o proximo passo"

    examples:
      - "Start free on the next page"
      - "Grab your 14-day free trial on the next page"
      - "Get started on the next page free"

    enhancements:
      - "Urgency"
      - "Scarcity"
      - "Guarantees"
      - "Bonuses"

# =============================================================================
# FORMULA 150-750 ADS POR SEMANA
# =============================================================================
scale_formula:
  equation: "50 hooks x 3-5 meats x 1-3 CTAs = 150-750 ads/semana"

  weekly_schedule:
    friday: "Ad creation day"
    steps:
      - "Find your best ads"
      - "Chop them into hook, meat, CTA"
      - "Run through kaleidoscope for 50+ hooks"
      - "Generate 3-5 variations on meat"
      - "Record 1-3 CTAs"

  benefits:
    offense: "Escala advertising consistentemente"
    defense: "Ninguem consegue descobrir seus top performers"

# =============================================================================
# EUGENE SCHWARTZ - 5 LEVELS OF AWARENESS
# =============================================================================
schwartz_5_levels:
  description: |
    Audiencias vao de quente/pequena para fria/grande.
    Quanto melhor o ad, mais alto na piramide ele converte.

  levels:
    - level: 1
      name: "Most Aware"
      description: "Cliente conhece seu produto, so precisa saber a oferta"
      hook_type: "Offer driven"
      example_template: "50% off our best-selling XYZ product for the rest of the month"
      b2c_example: "XFast's new formula: Now with 25% more protein - Same great taste!"
      b2b_example: "DigitalBoost: Now offering social media management at 20% off for new clients"

    - level: 2
      name: "Product Aware"
      description: "Cliente sabe o que voce vende mas nao tem certeza se e certo pra ele"
      hook_type: "Proof driven"
      example_template: "Discover why 10,000 people chose XYZ to solve their [problem] last month"
      b2c_example: "Why 9 out of 10 XFast users reached their goal weight within 3 months"
      b2b_example: "See how DigitalBoost increased ROI by 150% for 5 different industries"

    - level: 3
      name: "Solution Aware"
      description: "Cliente sabe o resultado que quer mas nao sabe que seu produto pode entregar"
      hook_type: "Promise driven"
      example_template: "The fastest way to [achieve desired result] - introducing XYZ"
      b2c_example: "Lose 15 pounds in 30 days with our scientifically proven meal replacement system"
      b2b_example: "Double your online sales in 6 months with our data-driven marketing strategies"

    - level: 4
      name: "Problem Aware"
      description: "Cliente sente que tem um problema mas nao sabe que existe solucao"
      hook_type: "Pain driven"
      example_template: "Tired of [specific problem]? There's a better way"
      b2c_example: "Frustrated with crash diets that don't last? There's a sustainable way to shed pounds"
      b2b_example: "Is your website getting sales? You might be missing these crucial elements"

    - level: 5
      name: "Completely Unaware"
      description: "Cliente nao sabe que tem um problema ou necessidade"
      hook_type: "Curiosity driven"
      example_template: "The hidden danger in your daily routine that's costing you [money/time/health]"
      b2c_example: "The hidden hormonal imbalance that's making 1 in 3 Americans gain weight"
      b2b_example: "The unexpected way your business is losing $1000s each month in untapped revenue"

  pro_tip: |
    Se 90% dos seus hooks estao no bucket 'Most Aware', espalhe para capturar fatias maiores.
    Quando em duvida, va um pouco mais amplo - voce ainda pega a audiencia quente
    e atrai parte da audiencia fria.

  meme_tip: |
    Memes ou conteudo meme-like atraem a maior porcentagem da sua audiencia.
    Um meme relevante para um grupo especifico funciona como mariposa para a chama.

# =============================================================================
# SCALE IT FRAMEWORK
# =============================================================================
scale_framework:
  core_principle: |
    Voce nao saturou o mercado - voce saturou a qualidade do seu ad.
    Quanto melhor o ad, maior a audiencia que ele converte.

  process:
    step_1:
      name: "Find Winners"
      description: "Faca muitas variacoes no inicio"
      detail: "Variacoes apelam para diferentes segmentos do mercado"

    step_2:
      name: "Double Down"
      description: "Alguns ads performam muito melhor que o resto"
      detail: "Quando encontrar, reuse os mesmos hooks para mais winners"

    step_3:
      name: "Kaleidoscope"
      description: "Tome ads vencedores e multiplique"
      detail: "Processo avancado para escalar winners existentes"

  key_insight: |
    Novos clientes entram no mercado todo dia.
    Voce deve a eles servir o ad mais convertedor possivel.
    Nao fique entediado repetindo - sera a primeira vez que eles veem.

  old_spice_example: |
    "Eu nao era comprador de Old Spice. Vi os ads, achei engracados,
    comecei a comprar. E 70% do mercado tambem. Esse e um ad sem limite.
    Bom o suficiente para converter todo mundo."

# =============================================================================
# GOATED ADS CHEAT SHEET
# =============================================================================
cheat_sheet:
  step_1:
    name: "Figure Out Awareness Level"
    levels:
      - "Unaware"
      - "Problem Aware"
      - "Solution Aware"
      - "Product Aware"
      - "Most Aware"

  step_2:
    name: "Write 50 Hooks"
    options:
      - "Divida hooks em buckets por nivel de awareness"
      - "OU foque a maioria mais ampla que seus hooks atuais"
    inspiration_sources:
      - "Seus melhores ads anteriores"
      - "Top ads de outras industrias (ouro aqui)"
      - "Seu melhor short content"
      - "Melhor short content de outros"
      - "Salve ads favoritos para revisar"

  step_3:
    name: "Write 3-5 Meats"
    types:
      demonstration:
        - "Showcasing produto/servico"
        - "Unboxing"
        - "Comparison ads"
        - "Before and afters"
        - "High production hero ads"
      testimonial:
        - "UGC"
        - "Founder direct to camera"
        - "Podcast style"
        - "Professional testimonials"
        - "Raw iPhone style"
        - "Walk n talk rant style"
        - "Group testimonials"
        - "Lifecycle ads"
        - "Man on the street"
        - "Influencer collabs"
      education:
        - "Educational/informational"
        - "Explainer videos"
        - "How-to/tutorial"
        - "Whiteboard explainer"
        - "Listicle videos"
        - "High performing organic"
      story:
        - "Storytelling/narrative"
        - "Lifestyle"
        - "Emotional/sentimental"
        - "Humorous/comedy"
        - "Brand manifesto"
        - "Problem-solution"
      faceless:
        - "Screenshots of comments/texts"
        - "Text only"
        - "Slide shows"
        - "Animations"
        - "Cartoon ads"
        - "Visual effect based"

  step_4:
    name: "Write 1-3 CTAs"
    elements:
      - "What/how to do it"
      - "When to do it"
      - "What they get for doing it"
      - "What happens next (optional)"
      - "Demonstrate visually"

  step_5:
    name: "Find New Winners"
    action: "Repeat steps 1-4 to find another winner"

# =============================================================================
# FRAMEWORK 70-20-10 (Modelo Google)
# =============================================================================
framework_70_20_10:
  origin: "Larry Page e Sergey Brin - provado matematicamente"
  application: "Alocacao de recursos para maximos retornos"

  distribution:
    proven_70:
      percentage: 70
      description: "Core - Proven Winners"
      action: "Reusar top performers"

    adjacent_20:
      percentage: 20
      description: "Emerging - Winner Adjacent"
      action: "Modelar de outros nichos"

    moonshot_10:
      percentage: 10
      description: "Moonshots - Experimentos"
      action: "Ideias completamente novas"

  rule: "Nunca faca 100% novo ou 100% do mesmo - siga 70-20-10"

# =============================================================================
# CHECKLISTS OPERACIONAIS
# =============================================================================
checklists:
  pre_launch:
    matematica_fundamental:
      - "CAC maximo calculado (LTGP / 3)"
      - "Break-even em dias definido (ideal: <30)"
      - "Budget teste = 10x CPA esperado"
      - "Margem minima: 30% apos ads"

    pesquisa_mercado:
      - "10 concorrentes analisados no Facebook Ad Library"
      - "5 angulos que estao funcionando identificados"
      - "3 ofertas dominantes mapeadas"
      - "Gaps obvios no mercado documentados"

    avatar_cirurgico:
      - "Dor #1 identificada (a que tira sono)"
      - "Linguagem exata coletada (prints de comentarios)"
      - "Nivel de sofisticacao medido (1-5)"
      - "Poder de compra validado"

  campaign_structure:
    hierarquia:
      - "CBO ligado (deixa o algoritmo trabalhar)"
      - "3-5 conjuntos de anuncios maximo"
      - "Budget minimo: $50/dia por conjunto"
      - "Pixel instalado e eventos configurados"

    segmentacao_inicial:
      - "Broad targeting (3-10% da populacao)"
      - "SEM interesses empilhados"
      - "Idade: range de 10 anos minimo"
      - "Lookalike 1% da lista de clientes"

  creative:
    hook_3_seconds:
      - "Problema especifico mencionado"
      - "Numero na primeira linha"
      - "Pattern interrupt visual"
      - "Avatar falando com avatar"

    video_structure:
      - "0-3s: Hook"
      - "3-10s: Agitar problema"
      - "10-20s: Apresentar solucao"
      - "20-27s: Prova social"
      - "27-30s: CTA claro"

    copy:
      - "Headline: Resultado especifico + tempo"
      - "Primary text: <125 caracteres"
      - "Descricao: Beneficio principal"
      - "CTA: Verbos de acao (Garantir, Comecar, Acessar)"

  landing_page:
    above_fold:
      - "Headline match com ad (exata)"
      - "CTA em <3 segundos de scroll"
      - "Prova social visivel"
      - "Tempo de carregamento <2s"

    conversion_elements:
      - "VSL ou carta de vendas"
      - "Garantia destacada"
      - "FAQ das 5 maiores objecoes"
      - "Urgencia real (nao fake)"
      - "Checkout em 1 passo"

  metrics_48h:
    day_1:
      - "CTR >1% (menos = hook ruim)"
      - "CPM <$30 (mais = criativo ruim)"
      - "CPC <$3 (mais = relevancia baixa)"
      - "Link CTR >0.8%"

    day_2:
      - "Frequencia <2"
      - "CPL <50% do target"
      - "Add to Cart >5%"
      - "Video Views 3s >30%"

  weekly_optimization:
    week_1:
      - "Matar ads com CPA >150% do target"
      - "Duplicar budget dos vencedores"
      - "Testar 3 novos criativos"
      - "Ajustar bid cap se necessario"

    week_2:
      - "Criar lookalike dos compradores"
      - "Testar novo angulo de copy"
      - "Adicionar retargeting"
      - "Implementar exclusoes de audiencia"

    week_3_4:
      - "Scale vertical (aumentar budget 20%/dia)"
      - "Scale horizontal (novas audiencias)"
      - "Testar novos formatos (carousel, collection)"
      - "Adicionar novos geos/demos"

  scale_signals:
    ready_to_scale:
      - "ROAS >3x por 7 dias seguidos"
      - "CPA estavel por 500+ conversoes"
      - "Frequencia <3 apos 14 dias"
      - "CTR mantem >1%"

    how_to_scale:
      - "Regra 20%: Aumenta budget 20% a cada 48h"
      - "Novos conjuntos: Mesma copy, nova audiencia"
      - "Surfing: Pausa sexta, reativa segunda"
      - "Day-parting: Desliga madrugada se B2B"

  troubleshooting:
    cpm_alto:
      - "Criativo cansou (frequencia >7)"
      - "Relevance score <6"
      - "Competicao aumentou (Q4, Black Friday)"
      - "Conta com penalidade"

    cpa_subindo:
      - "Pagina convertendo menos"
      - "Oferta perdeu forca"
      - "Competidor com oferta melhor"
      - "Mudanca no algoritmo"

    ctr_baixo:
      - "Hook fraco"
      - "Visual generico"
      - "Copy nao ressoa"
      - "Saturacao de mercado"

  daily_5min:
    - "CPA ontem vs hoje"
    - "Frequencia <5"
    - "Comentarios respondidos"
    - "Competidores checados"
    - "Budget utilization >90%"

# =============================================================================
# GOLDEN RULES
# =============================================================================
golden_rules:
  - rule: "Nunca scale sem 100 conversoes"
    number: 1
  - rule: "Creative fatigue = 10-14 dias"
    number: 2
  - rule: "80% do resultado vem de 20% dos ads"
    number: 3
  - rule: "Teste preco antes de mudar tudo"
    number: 4
  - rule: "iOS mata 30% do tracking (calcule isso)"
    number: 5

# =============================================================================
# RED FLAGS IMEDIATOS
# =============================================================================
red_flags:
  - condition: "CPA dobrou"
    action: "PAUSA"
  - condition: "CTR <0.5%"
    action: "MATA"
  - condition: "Frequencia >10"
    action: "REFRESH"
  - condition: "ROAS <2x por 3 dias"
    action: "ANALISE"
  - condition: "Relevance score <4"
    action: "NOVO CRIATIVO"

# =============================================================================
# BUDGET ALLOCATION
# =============================================================================
budget_allocation:
  proven_campaigns: "70%"
  new_tests: "20%"
  retargeting: "10%"

# =============================================================================
# HOOK EXAMPLES (Swipe Copy)
# =============================================================================
hook_examples:
  for_ads:
    - "Local business owners, I have a gift for you"
    - "Real quick question... Can I have your email address?"
    - "Would you pay $1,000 to have the business of your dreams in 30 days?"
    - "You might be wondering why I just caught a banana..."
    - "Read this if you're tired of being broke"
    - "$4,664 per month... That's what Kyle... The LAST person on the leaderboard... was able to build"

  for_content:
    - "You guys want to hear something completely insane"
    - "How to get ahead of 99% of people"
    - "The smartest thing you can do today"
    - "I f&cking guarantee you that..."

  for_email:
    - "SHHHHH It's a SURPRISE!!"
    - "Btw... (I have a favor to ask)"
    - "We made a boo boo"
    - "Your first goodie (for affiliates only)"

# =============================================================================
# KEY INSIGHTS
# =============================================================================
key_insights:
  - insight: "O Hook e 80% do Valor do Marketing"
    detail: "David Ogilvy: depois de escrever o headline, voce gastou 80 centavos do seu dolar"
    action: "Inverta seu tempo - 80% hook, 20% resto"

  - insight: "Grave 10 Hooks Para Cada 1 Ad"
    detail: "Nao e typo - 10 para 1. Encontra o winner 10x mais rapido"
    action: "Pare de gravar 1 e torcer"

  - insight: "Hooks Devem Fazer ELES Se Sentirem Importantes"
    detail: "Dean mudou de ego para empatia e fez milhoes"
    action: "Delete referencias a voce do hook"

  - insight: "Let The Data Do The Teaching"
    detail: "Mesmo seu pior conteudo tem top 10% - analise esses hooks"
    action: "Documente TUDO, analise top/bottom 10%"

  - insight: "Cocktail Party Effect"
    detail: "Seu nome corta qualquer ruido - replique isso"
    action: "Seja especifico no call-out"

  - insight: "Hooks Sao Verbal + Nonverbal"
    detail: "Nao e so texto - e tudo nos primeiros 5 segundos"
    action: "Use visual absurdo + explicacao"

  - insight: "Mude Apenas o Hook e 2-5-10X Resultados"
    detail: "Mesmo produto, preco, oferta - so hook diferente"
    action: "Teste hooks antes de mudar qualquer outra coisa"

# =============================================================================
# CASE STUDIES
# =============================================================================
case_studies:
  larry_king:
    context: "Dean Graziosi gastou fortunas recriando set do Larry King"
    problem: "Conseguiu o REAL Larry King, bomba total"
    intervention: |
      Mudou de: "Tonight, I'm here with multi-millionaire Dean Graziosi..."
      Para: "Have you ever looked in the mirror and thought 'I should be further ahead?'"
    result: "De zero vendas para milhoes de livros"
    lesson: "Ego no hook = morte. Fazer ELES importantes = ouro"

  banana:
    context: "Hormozi precisava de hook novo para Skool Games"

  - name: "The Banana Principle"

  - name: "The Guarantee Hook"

  - name: "The Rumor Hook"

  - text: "The hook dictates the content, and not the other way around"

  - text: "Let the data do the teaching. Most people have no idea anyways."
```

```yaml
# =============================================================================
# OGILVY 40 HOOKS
# =============================================================================
ogilvy_40_hooks:
  metadata:
    source: "40 Melhores Hooks de David Ogilvy - SwipeFile Completo"
    analysis_structure: "Texto, Tipo, Triggers, Numeros, Formula, Resultado, Como Adaptar"

  hooks:
    - id: "OG_001"
      texto: "At 60 miles an hour the loudest noise in this new Rolls-Royce comes from the electric clock"
      tipo: "Statement/Proof"
      triggers: ["Especificidade", "Sinal de Qualidade", "Curiosidade"]
      numeros: "60 miles an hour"
      formula: "[Numero especifico] + [Condicao] + [Prova extrema de qualidade]"
      resultado: "Aumento de 50% nas vendas em 1958 com orcamento de apenas $50,000"
      como_adaptar: "At full capacity, the only sound in our data center is the cooling system"
      melhor_para: ["Produtos premium", "posicionamento de luxo", "superioridade tecnica"]

    - id: "OG_002"
      texto: "The man in the Hathaway shirt"
      tipo: "Statement/Character"
      triggers: ["Misterio", "Identidade", "Story Appeal"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[O homem/mulher que] + [Caracteristica distintiva]"
      resultado: "+160% vendas, estoque esgotado em 1 semana, orcamento $30,000"
      como_adaptar: "The developer who ships on Friday"
      melhor_para: ["Criacao de personagem de marca", "lifestyle branding"]

    - id: "OG_003"
      texto: "How to win friends and influence people"
      tipo: "How-to/Promise"
      triggers: ["Auto-aperfeicoamento", "Poder Social"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Como] + [Resultado desejado 1] + [e] + [Resultado desejado 2]"
      resultado: "Titulo best-seller por decadas"
      como_adaptar: "How to build products and keep users"
      melhor_para: ["Conteudo educacional", "desenvolvimento pessoal"]

    - id: "OG_004"
      texto: "They laughed when I sat down at the piano but when I started to play!"
      tipo: "Story/Transformation"
      triggers: ["Underdog", "Vindicacao", "Reviravolta"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Eles riram quando] + [acao inicial] + [mas quando] + [reviravolta]"
      resultado: "Um dos headlines mais copiados da historia"
      como_adaptar: "They smirked when I opened my laptop, but when I showed the revenue dashboard..."
      melhor_para: ["Produtos de transformacao", "educacao", "superacao"]

    - id: "OG_005"
      texto: "Only Dove is one-quarter moisturizing cream"
      tipo: "Statement/Unique Claim"
      triggers: ["Exclusividade", "Beneficio Tangivel"]
      numeros: "one-quarter"
      formula: "[Apenas X] + [e] + [Proporcao especifica] + [Ingrediente diferenciador]"
      resultado: "Vendas de $2B para $4B em 3 anos"
      como_adaptar: "Our AI uses 40% real human feedback in every decision"
      melhor_para: ["Diferenciacao por ingrediente/componente"]

    - id: "OG_006"
      texto: "How to create advertising that sells"
      tipo: "How-to/Direct"
      triggers: ["Conhecimento Pratico", "ROI"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Como criar] + [X que] + [produz resultado mensuravel]"
      resultado: "Livro referencia no mercado"
      como_adaptar: "How to write code that actually ships"
      melhor_para: ["B2B", "conteudo educacional", "consultoria"]

    - id: "OG_007"
      texto: "The headline is 80 percent of the advertisement"
      tipo: "Statement/Statistic"
      triggers: ["Autoridade", "Priorizacao"]
      numeros: "80 percent"
      formula: "[Elemento X] + [e] + [Percentual] + [do resultado total]"
      resultado: "Citado em milhares de livros de marketing"
      como_adaptar: "The first 3 seconds are 90% of your video's success"
      melhor_para: ["Conteudo educacional", "estabelecer prioridades"]

    - id: "OG_008"
      texto: "Nobody ever reads anything"
      tipo: "Statement/Contrarian"
      triggers: ["Pattern Interrupt", "Verdade Incomoda"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Ninguem nunca] + [Acao esperada]"
      resultado: "Forca o leitor a provar o contrario"
      como_adaptar: "Nobody actually uses all their SaaS features"
      melhor_para: ["Chamar atencao", "quebrar padroes"]

    - id: "OG_009"
      texto: "Do you make these mistakes in English?"
      tipo: "Question/Self-Assessment"
      triggers: ["Medo de Erro", "Auto-aperfeicoamento"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Voce comete] + [estes erros] + [em] + [Area]?"
      resultado: "Um dos anuncios mais bem-sucedidos por correspondencia"
      como_adaptar: "Do you make these mistakes in your code reviews?"
      melhor_para: ["Conteudo educacional", "correcao de problemas"]

    - id: "OG_010"
      texto: "The two most powerful words you can use in a headline"
      tipo: "Statement/Secret"
      triggers: ["Curiosidade", "Poder", "Simplicidade"]
      numeros: "two"
      formula: "[Os X] + [mais poderosos] + [elemento] + [contexto de uso]"
      resultado: "Alta taxa de cliques em conteudo"
      como_adaptar: "The 3 metrics that actually matter to investors"
      melhor_para: ["Conteudo viral", "listicles", "educacional"]

    - id: "OG_011"
      texto: "When you're only No. 2, you try harder"
      tipo: "Statement/Position"
      triggers: ["Underdog", "Esforco", "Honestidade"]
      numeros: "No. 2"
      formula: "[Quando voce e] + [posicao inferior] + [voce] + [vantagem compensatoria]"
      resultado: "Avis passou de prejuizo para lucro"
      como_adaptar: "Because we're bootstrapped, every customer actually matters"
      melhor_para: ["Challenger brands", "diferenciacao por esforco"]

    - id: "OG_012"
      texto: "I don't know who you are. I don't know your work. I don't know your company's product"
      tipo: "Statement/Challenge"
      triggers: ["Confrontacao", "Reality Check"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Eu nao sei] + [Lista de desconhecimentos] + [Implicacao]"
      resultado: "Anuncio B2B mais famoso"
      como_adaptar: "I don't know your stack. I don't know your team size. I don't know your burn rate."
      melhor_para: ["B2B", "vendas complexas", "awareness"]

    - id: "OG_013"
      texto: "If you're going to San Francisco"
      tipo: "Conditional/Location"
      triggers: ["Relevancia", "Timing", "Localizacao"]
      numeros: null
      formula: "[Se voce vai] + [para] + [Local especifico]"
      resultado: "Conexao cultural instantanea"
      como_adaptar: "If you're building with AI in 2025"
      melhor_para: ["Marketing local", "eventos", "turismo"]

    - id: "OG_014"
      texto: "This morning I wrote a $1,000,000 check"
      tipo: "Statement/Achievement"
      triggers: ["Big Numbers", "Historia Pessoal", "Proof"]
      numeros: "$1,000,000"
      formula: "[Momento especifico] + [Eu] + [Acao impressionante com numero grande]"
      resultado: "Alta memorabilidade"
      como_adaptar: "Yesterday we processed 10 million transactions"
      melhor_para: ["Testimonials", "case studies", "authority building"]

    - id: "OG_015"

      - "Don't miss out"
      - "Hurry"
      - "Act fast"
      - "Qualquer linguagem de venda agressiva"

    personalization_by_stage:
      visitou_nao_adicionou: "Foco em clarificar valor"
      adicionou_carrinho: "Foco em remover friccao/duvida"
      engajou_conteudo: "Foco em momento/oportunidade unica"

# =============================================================================
# EVENTO CONVITE HOOKS (Zoom Events)
# =============================================================================
evento_convite_hooks:
  metadata:
    source: "Hooks Convite para Evento - Zoom.md"
    note: "Hooks para convites de eventos online/webinars"

  hooks:
    - id: "EV_001"
      hook: "The rumors are true... Big companies DO have an unfair advantage"
      tipo: "Statement Hook (Confirmation + Twist)"
      triggers: ["Curiosity Gap", "Contradiction"]
      formula: "[The rumors are true... X DO have Y]"

    - id: "EV_002"
      hook: "Quick question: What's your email?"
      tipo: "Question Hook"
      triggers: ["Curiosity Gap", "Pattern Interrupt"]
      formula: "[Quick question: + unexpected ask]"

    - id: "EV_003"
      hook: "You don't need cheaper leads."
      tipo: "Contradiction Hook"
      triggers: ["Contradiction"]
      formula: "[You don't need X. You need Y.]"

    - id: "EV_004"
      hook: "Is it possible to 3x your customer value in 90 days?"
      tipo: "Question Hook"
      triggers: ["Specificity", "Curiosity"]
      numeros: ["3x", "90 days"]
      formula: "[Is it possible to + specific result + specific timeframe?]"

    - id: "EV_005"
      hook: "I went from losing $20 on every customer to making $240 profit"
      tipo: "Story Hook (Transformation)"
      triggers: ["Social Proof", "Specificity"]
      numeros: ["$20", "$240"]
      formula: "[I went from negative X to positive Y]"

    - id: "EV_006"
      hook: "If you're 25 to 55 and own a business"
      tipo: "Statement Hook (Identity)"
      triggers: ["Identity"]
      numeros: ["25 to 55"]
      formula: "[If you're + demographic + situation]"

    - id: "EV_007"
      hook: "If I woke up with a struggling business tomorrow"
      tipo: "Story Hook (Hypothetical)"
      triggers: ["Curiosity Gap"]
      formula: "[If I + hypothetical scenario + what I would do]"

    - id: "EV_008"
      hook: "One of my portfolio companies got a 7.5x increase"
      tipo: "Statement Hook (Result)"
      triggers: ["Social Proof", "Specificity"]
      numeros: ["7.5x"]
      formula: "[Subject + got + specific result]"

    - id: "EV_009"
      hook: "Most businesses work like this:"
      tipo: "Statement Hook (Comparison setup)"
      triggers: ["Curiosity Gap"]
      formula: "[Most X work like this: vs Smart X work like this:]"

    - id: "EV_010"
      hook: "There are two types of business owners:"
      tipo: "Statement Hook (Dichotomy)"
      triggers: ["Identity", "Curiosity"]
      numeros: ["two"]
      formula: "[There are two types of X:]"

  top_formulas:
    rumors_hook:
      estrutura: "The rumors are true... [unexpected truth about X]"
      exemplos:
        - "The rumors are true... Big companies DO have an unfair advantage"
        - "The rumors are true... There IS a million-dollar secret"
      uso_ideal: "Quando quer confirmar uma suspeita do mercado mas com um twist inesperado"

    contradiction_hook:
      estrutura: "You don't need [what everyone thinks]. You need [real solution]."
      exemplos:
        - "You don't need cheaper leads. You need a better money model."
      uso_ideal: "Para quebrar crencas limitantes do mercado"

    transformation_story:
      estrutura: "I went from [bad situation with specific number] to [good situation with specific number]"
      exemplos:
        - "I went from losing $20 on every customer to making $240 profit"
      uso_ideal: "Para demonstrar transformacao possivel com numeros especificos"

    two_types_dichotomy:
      estrutura: "There are two types of [people]: Type 1: [behavior] Type 2: [better behavior]"
      exemplos:
        - "There are two types of business owners:"
        - "In every market, there are two types of businesses:"
      uso_ideal: "Para posicionar o leitor e criar identificacao"

    hypothetical_scenario:
      estrutura: "If I [constraint/situation], here's exactly what I would do"
      exemplos:
        - "If I woke up with a struggling business tomorrow"
        - "If I only had 90 days in a brand new town"
      uso_ideal: "Para demonstrar competencia atraves de cenarios especificos"

# =============================================================================
# FRAMEWORKS
# =============================================================================
frameworks:
  seventy_twenty_ten_rule:
    name: "70-20-10 Innovation Rule"
    source: "Google (Larry Page & Sergey Brin)"
    description: "Resource allocation strategy for maximum returns"
    breakdown:
      seventy_percent_core:
        description: "Hooks already proven in your content or others"
        action: "More of what works"
        result: "Stabilizes advertising, guarantees baseline performance"
        steps:
          - "Create spreadsheet with tabs for each platform"
          - "Columns: name, hook, views, link"
          - "Review best hooks before making content"

      twenty_percent_emerging:
        description: "Winner Adjacent - promising but less proven"
        action: "Model concepts from other niches"
        steps:
          - "Subscribe to software showing outliers by platform"
          - "Search platforms for topics you discuss"
          - "Paste into slide deck with screenshot and repackaging ideas"

      ten_percent_big_ideas:
        description: "Totally new risky experiments"
        action: "Try craziest ideas without fear of failure"
        result: "Source of breakthrough innovations"

  hook_category_distribution:
    source: "Analysis of Hormozi 121 Best Hooks"
    breakdown:
      statements: "35%"
      conditionals: "20%"
      questions: "15%"
      commands: "10%"
      narratives: "10%"
      lists: "5%"
      labels: "3%"
      exclamations: "2%"

  verbal_vs_nonverbal:
    verbal_hooks:
      types:
        - name: "Labels"
          example: "Local business owners, I have a gift for you"
          description: "Words your avatar identifies with"

        - name: "Questions"
          subtypes:
            yes_questions: "Would you pay $1,000 to have the business of your dreams?"
            open_questions: "Which would you rather be?"

        - name: "Conditionals"
          example: "If you're working all the time and your business isn't growing..."
          description: "Scenarios/conditions leading to result"

        - name: "Commands"
          example: "Read this if you're tired of being broke."
          description: "Direct commands telling audience to do something"

        - name: "Statements"
          examples:
            - "The smartest thing you can do today..."
            - "How to get ahead of 99% of people."

        - name: "Lists/Steps"
          example: "28 ways to stay poor"

        - name: "Narratives"
          example: "One day I was in the back and this old lady comes in..."
          description: "Stories and anecdotes"

        - name: "Exclamations"
          example: "Ahhhhh... This is the blueprint to becoming a millionaire"
          description: "Expresses strong emotion"

    nonverbal_hooks:
      description: "Noises or visuals that grab attention"
      examples:
        - "Dropped tray of dishes - signals embarrassing disaster"
        - "Clink of knife against champagne - signals important news"
        - "Catching a banana unexpectedly"
      principle: "Both get everyone's attention, just for different reasons"
      best_practice: "Use verbal and nonverbal hooks together when platform allows"

  dean_graziosi_story:
    context: "Story that forever changed how Hormozi viewed hooks"
    original_failing_hook: "Tonight on Larry King, I'm here with my guest Dean Graziosi he's a multi New York Times best seller, a multi-millionaire, and tonight he's gonna show you how you can have that success too and talk about his book."
    winning_hook: "Have you ever in your adult life looked at yourself in the mirror and thought 'I should be further ahead by now?' If you have, you're not alone. And tonight, my guest Dean Graziosi is going to help you see how you can live to your full potential."
    key_lesson: "It needed to make THEM feel important, not me."
    what_changed: "Only the opening sentences - book name, cover, pages, offer, price, website all stayed the same"
    result: "Went from complete failure to selling millions of books"
    principle: "I spend as much thinking about the first sentence as everything else combined."

# =============================================================================
# CHECKLISTS
# =============================================================================
checklists:
  first_time_through:
    - "Look at top-performing ads or content of other people"
    - "Isolate the hooks"
    - "Write down your favorite 50"
    - "Use all of them in ads and content"

  every_time_after:
    - "Look at top 10% performers (top 5)"
    - "Make 70% of next batch using those top 5 hooks"
    - "Make 20% doing permutations (visuals and words)"
    - "Make 10% completely different hooks (model first time through)"

  good_hooks_contain:
    - "Some way to catch their attention (call out)"
    - "Some implication of value if they consume it"

  variety_creation:
    conditions:
      template: "If you're a [avatar], this video will [benefit]"
      example: "If you're a chiropractor, this video will get you more leads."

    labels:
      template: "[Avatar] I have a gift for you"
      example: "Chiropractors I have a gift for you."

    questions:
      template: "Would you rather [pain] or [solution]?"
      example: "Would you rather struggle to get patients for the rest of your life or fix it in 6 weeks?"

    commands:
      template: "Watch this if you want to [result]"
      example: "Watch this if you want to get more patients."

    statements:
      template: "The top 1% of [avatar] follow these rules..."
      example: "The top 1% of chiropractor clinics follow these rules..."

    lists_or_steps:
      template: "[Number] ways [avatar] [result] without [objection]"
      example: "11 ways Chiropractors get more patients without paid ads"

    stories:
      template: "All of a sudden, [dramatic event]..."
      example: "All of a sudden, my phone starts ringing off the hook..."

  pre_publication_checklist:
    - "Hook para scroll em <0.5s?"
    - "Avatar se identifica imediatamente?"
    - "Numero especifico presente?"
    - "Promessa clara?"
    - "Curiosidade criada?"
    - "Visual chamativo?"
    - "Audio limpo (se video)?"
    - "Diferente do mercado?"
    - "Testado com 5 pessoas?"
    - "Eu clicaria nisso?"

  daily_hooks_checklist:
    - "Revisar top 5 hooks antes de criar conteudo"
    - "Criar minimo 3 variacoes para cada peca"
    - "Documentar TODOS os hooks usados"
    - "Tracking de performance configurado"
    - "Split test ativo em pelo menos 1 canal"

  weekly_optimization_checklist:
    - "Rankear todos os hooks da semana"
    - "Identificar top 10% e bottom 10%"
    - "Atualizar banco de 'Core Winners'"
    - "Pesquisar 5 novos hooks de concorrentes"
    - "Planejar mix 70-20-10 para proxima semana"

# =============================================================================
# HOOK TESTING GUIDELINES
# =============================================================================
hook_testing:
  by_content_type:
    ads:
      hooks_per_content: 10
      note: "Record 10 hooks for every 1 piece of ad content"

    short_content:
      approach: "Every winning tweet on every other platform reused as a short"
      expansion: "Finish short by expanding on the hook"

    long_content:
      hooks_per_content: "3-4"
      review: "Team looks at in post-production to pick best"

    emails:
      approach: "Run active split tests on every campaign"
      documentation: "Document winners in separate file"

  performance_benchmarks:
    ctr:
      ruim: "< 0.5%"
      medio: "0.5-2%"
      bom: "2-5%"
      excelente: "> 5%"

    video_metrics:
      hook_rate: ">35% (Views 3s / Impressions)"
      thumb_stop_ratio: ">2% (Clicks / Impressions)"
      continuation_rate: ">70% (Views 15s / Views 3s)"
      save_rate: ">1% (Saves / Reach)"

  ten_commandments:
    - "Especifico > Generico"
    - "Numero > Sem numero"
    - "Negativo > Positivo (3x mais engagement)"
    - "Pergunta > Afirmacao (em ads)"
    - "Curto > Longo (max 7 palavras)"
    - "Visual > Texto (video sempre)"
    - "Problema > Solucao (agita primeiro)"
    - "Novo > Conhecido (novidade vicia)"
    - "Urgente > Eterno (FOMO vende)"
    - "Simples > Complexo (5a serie)"

# =============================================================================
# AGENT USAGE INSTRUCTIONS
# =============================================================================
agent_usage:
  hormozi_hooks:
    instructions:
      - "Use 70% proven hooks from this swipefile"
      - "Adapt 20% from adjacent niches or formats"
      - "Experiment with 10% completely new concepts"
      - "Always test 10 hooks per ad content piece"
      - "Track and document all performance data"
      - "Eliminate bottom 10%, double down on top 10%"

    selection_criteria:
      cold_audience: ["Questions", "Exclamations", "Pattern Interrupts"]
      warm_audience: ["Conditionals", "Stories", "Social Proof"]
      hot_audience: ["Commands", "Direct Statements", "Offers"]

    adaptation_rules:
      - "Keep psychological structure intact"
      - "Update cultural references for audience"
      - "Preserve primary mental trigger"
      - "Test minimum 3 variations"
      - "Measure against original benchmark"

  hormozi_ads:
    instructions:
      - "Start with proven hooks from ads section"
      - "Test 'The rumors are true...' format first (highest frequency in campaigns)"
      - "Always include specific numbers for credibility"
      - "Create identity dichotomies ('Two types of...', 'Smart vs Dumb')"
      - "Never use jargon in first 15 words"

    high_frequency_patterns:
      - "'The rumors are true...' (6x in single launch)"
      - "'If you're/If I' conditional (8x)"
      - "'Two types of' dichotomy (4x)"
      - "Direct comparisons X vs Y (5x)"
      - "Specific numbers in hook (60% of all hooks)"

  hormozi_copy:
    instructions:
      - "Hook determines content, not reverse"
      - "Spend 80% of effort on first few seconds"
      - "Make THEM feel important, not you"
      - "Use cocktail party effect - call out specifically"
      - "Combine verbal and nonverbal hooks when possible"

    key_formulas:
      transformation: "I went from [negative X] to [positive Y]"
      dichotomy: "There are two types of [X]: [Type 1] vs [Type 2]"
      contradiction: "You don't need [common belief]. You need [real solution]."
      authority_stack: "[Credentials list] + [compressed promise]"
      hypothetical: "If I [constraint/situation], here's exactly what I'd do"
      time_investment: "It took me [X years] to learn this, but I'll teach you in [Y time]"

  remarketing_copy:
    instructions:
      - "Never create new desire - clarify existing interest"
      - "Use soft language for cart abandonment ('reminder', 'clarifying')"
      - "Progress urgency gradually for launches"
      - "Always include specific numbers to reinforce value"
      - "Never use aggressive sales language"

    intensity_progression:
      level_1_soft: "'Quick reminder', 'Just clarifying', 'Worth remembering'"
      level_2_medium: "Statistics, comparisons, success rates"
      level_3_intense: "'Final hours', 'Last chance', 'This is your final call'"

# =============================================================================
# QUOTES AND MANTRAS
# =============================================================================
quotes:
  david_ogilvy:
    - "After you've written your headline, you've spent eighty cents of your advertising dollar."

  dean_graziosi:
    - "You gotta nail the hook or nothing else matters."
    - "I spend as much thinking about the first sentence as everything else combined."
    - "Since then, I've spent as much thinking about the first sentence as everything else combined."

  alex_hormozi:
    - "The hook dictates the content, and not the other way around."
    - "Let the data do the teaching."
    - "If you have ten hours to advertise, focus your first eight hours on the hooks."
    - "No matter how bad your content is, some will be in the top 10%."

mantras:
  operational:
    - "Test 10x more"
    - "Data over opinions"
    - "70-20-10 always"
    - "Hook first, content second"
    - "Make them important"
    - "Document everything"
    - "Top 10% replicate, Bottom 10% eliminate"

  powerful_questions:
    - "What hook would make ME click?"
    - "Is this about them or about me?"
    - "What's my top 10% saying?"
    - "Have I tested 10 variations yet?"
    - "What would Dean change?"
```

```yaml
# $100M Lead Nurture Playbook Swipefile
# Source: Alex Hormozi - Acquisition.com
# Extracted: 2026-02-23

version: "1.0"
source:
  title: "$100M Lead Nurture Playbook"
  author: "Alex Hormozi"
  publisher: "Acquisition.com"
  year: 2025

core_concept:
  principle: "If they do not show, they cannot buy"
  focus: "Maximizing 30-day show rates"
  metrics:
    schedule_rate: "Percentage of engaged leads who schedule appointment"
    show_rate: "Percentage of scheduled leads that show up"
    throughput: "Total percentage of engaged leads that show up"

frameworks:
  four_pillars:
    - name: "Availability"
      description: "Number of open appointment slots you have"
      correlation: "Almost perfect correlation with throughput"
    - name: "Speed"
      description: "How fast you respond to leads"
      stats:
        - "391% increase in conversions when contacted within 60 seconds"
        - "78% of customers buy from company that responds first"
    - name: "Personalization"
      description: "Making communication useful and relevant"
      effect: "More personal = more likely to respond and show"
    - name: "Volume"
      description: "Number of times you reach out before giving up"
      problem: "44% of salespeople stop after first attempt"

strategies:
  pillar_1_availability:
    more_days:
      principle: "Take appointments 7 days per week"
      math: "40% more availability = potential 40% more sales"
    more_hours:
      recommendation: "6am to 6pm PST covers highest US percentage"
      principle: "Be available when customers are available to buy"
    flexible_times:
      recommendation: "4 scheduling options per hour (every 15 minutes)"
      note: "Convenient for lead, not just business"
    multiple_channels:
      options: ["Inbound calls", "Outbound calls", "Self-scheduling online"]

  pillar_2_speed:
    speed_to_first_contact:
      goal: "Contact leads within 5 minutes"
      litmus_test: "If you aren't getting 'man that was fast!' at least once a day, you're too slow"
    speed_to_first_appointment:
      max_scheduling: "3 days out maximum"
      ideal: "Same day, next day, day after"
      reason: "Appointments closer = higher show rates"
    speed_of_response:
      principle: "Respond to messages quickly between scheduling and appointment"
      impact: "Leads often make buying decisions before the sales call"

  pillar_3_personalization:
    communication_method:
      approach: "Start everywhere, continue where they respond"
      channels: ["Text", "Email", "DM", "Phone call"]
    qualify_leads:
      benefit: "Spend time on promising prospects, cancel poor fits"
    best_leads_to_best_closers:
      steps:
        - "Look at best customers' actions and demographics"
        - "Ask those questions in opt-ins and applications"
        - "Score leads (1-5 or red-yellow-green)"
        - "Route best leads to best closers"
    segment_messaging:
      easy: "Research leads before contact - 5 min prep"
      hard: "Set up sequences for each lead category"
    incentives:
      push: "Give gift before appointment (reciprocity)"
      pull: "A/B choice that assumes they'll show"
    proof:
      approach: "Match testimonials to lead demographics"

  pillar_4_volume:
    scheduling_sequence:
      day_1:
        - "Call within 5 min of opt-in"
        - "Double-dial if no answer"
        - "Leave voicemail"
        - "Text immediately after"
        - "Double dial and text 2 more times"
      day_2_3: "Call 2x per day + text after second call"
      day_4_7: "Call and text once per day"
      after_week: "Transition to long-term nurture"
    automated_reminders:
      - "Immediately: confirmation of time, date, caller number"
      - "24 hours before"
      - "12 hours before"
      - "3 hours before"
    manual_reminders:
      - "Night before"
      - "Morning of"
      - "60 minutes before"
    bamfam:
      name: "Book A Meeting From A Meeting"
      rule: "NEVER get off call without scheduling next appointment"

tactics:
  pull_appointments_forward:
    script: |
      Hey, this is [Name] calling from XYZ on a recorded line...
      I saw you booked a time for our X on Monday.
      Just calling to confirm some details.
      [Qualify: WHO they are, WHAT they want, WHAT they're struggling with]
      Good news: I think we can help you out.
      Better news: I have an opening that canceled today at 4pm...
      unless now is a good time?

  hot_handoff:
    script: |
      You're in luck. You're going to speak with one of our top experts.
      He's been in this game for a while and helped [similar people] achieve [thing they want].
      Let me check his calendar... Yep, you're all confirmed.
      I'm going to introduce you via text message.

  gift_card_incentive:
    script: |
      Hey [Name]! I wanted to make sure you're caffeinated for our meeting.
      Check your email - I just sent you a $5 gift card.

  ab_incentive:
    script: |
      Since you're a first-time client, I'm setting aside some free products.
      Would you want face cream or hand lotion?

execution:
  culture_principles:
    - "Be a garbage man - don't judge leads"
    - "Yellows are the new gold - work less qualified leads"
    - "Volume negates luck"
    - "BAMFAM as a way of life"
    - "Every sale is opportunity for free practice"

  tracking:
    rank_by:
      - "Show rate"
      - "Close rate"
      - "Lead-to-close percentage"
    note: "Best closers are typically best setters"

checklist:
  availability:
    - "Schedule appointments 7 days per week"
    - "Schedule as many hours as possible (9am-9pm EST goal)"
    - "Give 4 scheduling options per hour (every 15 min)"
    - "Add automated self-scheduling"
    - "Remove steps from self-scheduling process"
  speed:
    - "Respond to leads in under 5 minutes"
    - "Book appointments same day, next day, or day after"
    - "Pull appointments forward when possible"
    - "Outbound dial all interested leads"
    - "Respond to messages quickly"
  personalization:
    - "Contact everywhere, focus where they respond"
    - "Use applications and demographic info to qualify"
    - "Segment messaging based on lead info"
    - "Send best leads to best closers"
    - "Incentivize showing up (gifts, A/B offers)"
    - "Show proof matching their situation"
  volume:
    - "Double-dial + text 3x first day"
    - "2x second and third day"
    - "1x days 4-7"
    - "Automated reminders: 24h, 12h, 3h out"
    - "Manual reminders: night before, morning of, 60 min prior"
    - "BAMFAM - always book next meeting"

agent_usage:
  pm:
    - "Design lead nurture sequences"
    - "Structure availability policies"
  po:
    - "Define lead qualification criteria"
    - "Prioritize personalization features"
  dev:
    - "Build automated reminder systems"
    - "Implement lead scoring and routing"
  analyst:
    - "Track show rates by sales rep"
    - "Measure conversion at each nurture stage"
```

```yaml
# $100M Lifetime Value Playbook Swipefile
# Source: Alex Hormozi - Acquisition.com
# Extracted: 2026-02-23

version: "1.0"
source:
  title: "$100M Lifetime Value Playbook"
  author: "Alex Hormozi"
  publisher: "Acquisition.com"
  year: 2025

core_concept:
  definition: "Lifetime value (LTV) is the gross profit collected over lifespan of a customer"
  aliases: ["LTGP (Lifetime Gross Profit)", "CLV (Customer Lifetime Value)"]
  importance: "If advertising is the machine, LTV is the fuel"
  competitive_advantage: "Business owner who makes customer more valuable wins - can outspend competition"

frameworks:
  ltv_calculation:
    step_1_gross_profit:
      definition: "What's leftover from purchase after delivering goods/service"
      product_example: "$100 widget - $20 cost = $80 gross profit"
      service_example: "10 clients x $3000/mo - $6000 rep cost = $24,000 GP (80%)"

    step_2_transactions_or_churn:
      product_method: "Export customer data, average transaction column"
      recurring_method: "Calculate churn = people who left / original amount"
      churn_note: "New signups don't affect churn calculation"

    step_3_calculate:
      product_formula: "Gross profit x average transactions = LTGP"
      recurring_formula: "Gross profit / churn = LTGP"
      product_example: "$80 x 4 = $320 LTGP"
      recurring_example: "$2400 / 5% = $48,000 LTGP"

  crazy_eight:
    - id: 1
      name: "Increase Prices"
      type: "profit_lever"
    - id: 2
      name: "Decrease Costs"
      type: "profit_lever"
    - id: 3
      name: "Increase # of Purchases"
      type: "frequency"
    - id: 4
      name: "Cross-Sell Something Different"
      type: "expansion"
    - id: 5
      name: "Sell More (Increase Quantity)"
      type: "upsell"
    - id: 6
      name: "Sell Better (Increase Quality)"
      type: "upsell"
    - id: 7
      name: "Downsell Fewer (Lower Quantity)"
      type: "downsell"
    - id: 8
      name: "Downsell Lower Quality"
      type: "downsell"

strategies:
  1_increase_prices:
    impact: "Affects gross profit more than any other lever"
    math: "10% profit business + 20% price increase = 3x profit"
    testing: "Test prices every quarter"
    process:
      - "Set new price"
      - "Calculate gross profit difference"
      - "Find break-even conversion rate"
      - "Track conversion with new price"
      - "Test again until conversion x LTGP drops"
    tip: "Start low, nudge 20% every 10 sales until dramatic drop"

  2_decrease_costs:
    tactics:
      - name: "Increase employee to customer ratio"
        example: "Rep handles 10 clients instead of 5"
      - name: "Offshore talent"
        benefit: "80%+ cost reduction possible"
      - name: "Productize delivery"
        method: "Templates and automation for similar customers"
      - name: "Done for you to Done with you"
        benefit: "Dramatically increase customer ratio"
      - name: "Cap usage"
        method: "Limit revisions, charge per use thereafter"
      - name: "Lifetime to annual"
        benefit: "Don't service indefinitely from one transaction"
      - name: "In-person to remote"
        benefit: "Fewer travel costs"
      - name: "Cut meeting times"
        method: "Delete all recurring meetings quarterly, add back only what's needed"
      - name: "Buy in bulk and prepay"
        benefit: "10-20% discounts"

  3_increase_purchases:
    add_recurring:
      service: "Membership for ongoing needs"
      physical: "Product of the month membership"
      digital: "Accountability calls as monthly service"
    decrease_churn:
      service: "Customer appreciation events via handwritten letter"
      physical: "Allow quantity/frequency changes via text"
      digital: "Add community feature for engagement"
    follow_up:
      method: "Quarterly promotions + value content between"
      examples:
        - "Quarterly 'best lawn' competition"
        - "Quarterly weight loss challenge"
        - "Quarterly cohort launch"

  4_cross_sell:
    definition: "Sell another product that complements first product"
    formula: "Old LTV + (conversion rate x gross profit of upsell) = New LTV"
    examples:
      service: "Lawn care + snow blowing in winter"
      physical: "Burgers + fries and soda"
      digital: "Course + community on top"

  5_upsell_quantity:
    bulk: "Prepay for a year (12x)"
    more_often: "Monthly to every 3 weeks (1.33x)"
    bigger: "1 hour to 3 hours each time (3x)"
    tactic: "Offer this first, then downsell standard offer"

  6_upsell_quality:
    service_premiums:
      - "Faster response times"
      - "More time availability"
      - "All days vs limited days"
      - "24hrs vs 9-5"
      - "Longer support calls"
      - "All locations vs one location"
      - "Free reschedules vs fees"
      - "Priority/same day delivery"
      - "One-on-one vs one-to-many"
      - "Video call vs chat support"
      - "Senior provider vs junior"
      - "Live vs recorded"
      - "In-person vs remote"
      - "Done for you vs done with you"
      - "Personalized vs generic"
    physical_premiums:
      - "Better ingredients"
      - "Better materials (steel vs iron)"

  7_downsell_quantity:
    principle: "If it's this or nothing, this beats nothing"
    math: "Lower price sale beats no sale for per-visitor revenue"
    rule: "Only downsell people who don't qualify for main offer"
    examples:
      less_quantity: "3 months instead of 12"
      less_often: "Every other month instead of monthly"
      smaller: "30 min instead of 1 hour"

  8_downsell_quality:
    method: "Take quality upsell list and reverse it"
    service_downgrades:
      - "Slower response times"
      - "Less availability"
      - "Fewer locations"
      - "Fewer days"
      - "Limited hours"
      - "Less flexibility"
      - "Junior employees"
      - "Higher customer to employee ratio"
      - "Less convenient communication"
      - "More recorded, less live"
      - "More remote, less in person"
      - "DFY to DWY to DIY"
      - "Less personalization"
      - "Worse or no guarantee"
    physical_downgrades:
      - "Lower quality ingredients"
      - "Worse warranty"
      - "Longer wait times"

tactics:
  favorite_upsell:
    formula: "More of - or more help with - what they just bought"
    enhancements:
      - "Faster results"
      - "Less risk"
      - "Less effort"
      - "Less hassle"
    price: "For more money"

  testing_cadence:
    pricing: "Test every quarter"
    correlation: "Company profitability correlates with pricing test frequency"

checklist:
  - "Calculate current LTV (gross profit x transactions OR gross profit / churn)"
  - "Increase price: Set date for first price test"
  - "Decrease cost: Pick 1-2 tactics to implement"
  - "Cross-sell: Think of something to sell immediately after first purchase"
  - "Increase purchases: Add recurring, decrease churn, or follow up"
  - "Upsell quantity: Offer first, downsell current offer"
  - "Upsell quality: Offer premium version first"
  - "Downsell quantity: Offer to unqualified prospects only"
  - "Downsell quality: Offer to unqualified prospects only"

agent_usage:
  pm:
    - "Design product ladder using crazy eight"
    - "Structure upsell/downsell sequences"
  po:
    - "Define premium vs standard feature sets"
    - "Validate pricing tiers with customer research"
  dev:
    - "Build flexible pricing and packaging systems"
    - "Implement upgrade/downgrade flows"
  analyst:
    - "Calculate LTV by segment"
    - "Track conversion rates at each price point"
    - "Measure churn and transaction frequency"
```

```yaml
# $100M Marketing Machine Swipefile
# Source: Alex Hormozi - Acquisition.com Playbooks
# Extracted: 2026-02-23

version: "1.0"
source:
  title: "$100M Marketing Machine"
  author: "Alex Hormozi"
  type: "playbook"
  origin: "acquisition.com"

core_insight: |
  A Maquina de Marketing transforma atividades que voce ja faz
  em um fluxo constante de anuncios e criativos gerados por clientes.
  Resultado: anuncios infinitos SEM depender do seu rosto.

key_metric: |
  Na Gym Launch, 40 dos 50 melhores anuncios NAO tinham o rosto do fundador.
  80% eram de clientes. Negocios independentes do fundador sao mais valiosos.

frameworks:
  marketing_machine_components:
    description: "9 fontes de conteudo gerado por clientes"
    components:
      - name: "Ciclo de Vida"
        description: "Cortar momentos antes/durante/depois de ligacoes"
        implementation:
          - "Gravar todas as ligacoes: vendas, integracao, suporte, ascensao"
          - "Cortar momento ANTES (dor) das ligacoes de vendas"
          - "Cortar momento DURANTE das ligacoes de suporte"
          - "Cortar momento DEPOIS das ligacoes de marco/upsell"

      - name: "Raspagem de Midia Social"
        description: "Coletar midia de clientes nas redes"
        implementation:
          - "Criar hashtag da comunidade: #gymlord #gymlaunch"
          - "Definir lembretes para raspar stories (24h expira)"
          - "Separar bons dos ruins em pastas"
          - "Usar melhor desempenho organico como criativos de anuncio"

      - name: "Eventos Presenciais"
        types:
          palco: "Fotos/videos no palco com multidao atras"
          profissional: "Sala separada, iluminacao, script 6 pontos"
          homem_na_rua: "Soundbites rapidos, perguntas de 1 resposta"

      - name: "Raspagem de Comunicacao"
        sources:
          - "Chats de suporte/rep de conta"
          - "Posts e comentarios da comunidade"
          - "Sites de avaliacao (Glassdoor, Yelp, Google)"
        tactics:
          - "Buscar termos-chave: PIF, Sales, $, Profit, Revenue"
          - "Gravar tela rolando comentarios de vitoria"

      - name: "Desbloqueios de Bonus"
        description: "Troque depoimento por bonus valioso"
        process:
          - "Criar brinde que cobra separadamente"
          - "Oferecer gratis em troca de video de 5min"
          - "Usar script de 6 pontos"

      - name: "Depoimentos de Premio"
        description: "4 provas de 1 premio"
        proofs:
          - "Post com numero de vendas (PROVA 1)"
          - "Video por email (PROVA 2)"
          - "Video desembrulhando (PROVA 3)"
          - "Video no palco recebendo (PROVA 4)"

      - name: "Competicoes"
        description: "Competicao de depoimento estilo iPhone"
        rules:
          - "1-2x por ano max (evitar fadiga)"
          - "Melhor = maior conversao como anuncio em 30 dias"
          - "Premio louco: 6 meses gratis"

  testimonial_6_point_script:
    description: "Script de 6 pontos para depoimentos"
    points:
      - name: "Luta Interna"
        prompt: "Qual foi o fundo do poco? O que voce odiava fazer?"
      - name: "Luta Externa"
        prompt: "Quais eram suas metricas objetivas?"
      - name: "Ceticismo"
        prompt: "Quais preocupacoes sobre comprar/clicar/juntar-se?"
      - name: "Superar"
        prompt: "O que te fez fazer mesmo assim?"
      - name: "Vitoria Externa"
        prompt: "Quais sao suas metricas objetivas agora?"
      - name: "Vitoria Interna"
        prompt: "Qual foi o melhor momento? O que pode fazer agora?"

strategies:
  weekly_content_machine:
    description: "Fluxo semanal de conteudo baseado em prova"
    deliverables:
      - "Lista de nomes de pessoas com otimos resultados"
      - "Midia social raspada (imagens e videos)"
      - "Screenshots de chat/mensagem"
      - "Depoimentos de posts da comunidade"
      - "Novas avaliacoes 5 estrelas"
      - "Desbloqueios de bonus"
      - "Entregas de premios"
      - "Videos de reacao de cliente"

  implementation_order:
    description: "Ordem recomendada de implementacao"
    sequence:
      - priority: 1
        item: "Competicao"
        reason: "Grande influxo inicial"
      - priority: 2
        item: "Raspagem de chat/mensagem"
        reason: "Ja existe, edicao minima"
      - priority: 3
        item: "Raspagem de comunidade"
        reason: "Ja existe"
      - priority: 4
        item: "Raspagem de avaliacoes"
        reason: "Ja existe"
      - priority: 5
        item: "Raspagem de midia social"
        reason: "Ja existe"
      - priority: 6
        item: "Desbloqueios de bonus"
        reason: "Requer criar algo"
      - priority: 7
        item: "Desbloqueios de premio"
        reason: "Requer criar algo"
      - priority: 8
        item: "Eventos"
        reason: "Muito trabalho, mas vale"
      - priority: 9
        item: "Ciclo de vida"
        reason: "Maior forca de edicao"

checklists:
  legal:
    - "Adicionar linguagem de conformidade a contratos"
    - "Permissao para usar gravacoes em publicidade"

  tech:
    - "Gravar todas as ligacoes"
    - "Comprar espaco de armazenamento extra"
    - "Desligar auto-deletar"
    - "Sistema de rotulagem pesquisavel para clips"

  events:
    - "Reservar sala separada para gravacao"
    - "Contratar equipe de camera extra"
    - "Testar iluminacao e som"
    - "Escolher clientes para depoimento antecipadamente"
    - "Imprimir lista de alvos"
    - "Anunciar no inicio do evento"
    - "Dar incentivo por depoimento"

tactics:
  event_testimonial_capture:
    timing: "Final do dia 1 ou antes do almoco dia 2"
    selfie: "Multiplas imagens + video"
    equipment: "2 cameras + 2 mics + 1 corredor"

  scraping_keywords:
    examples:
      - "PIF"
      - "Sales"
      - "$"
      - "Profit"
      - "Revenue"
      - "Monthly"
      - "close"
      - "closed"
      - "leads"
      - "show"
      - "scheduled"
      - "win"

agent_usage:
  pm:
    - "Planejar cronograma de competicoes e eventos"
    - "Definir metas de conteudo semanal"
  dev:
    - "Implementar sistema de rotulagem"

  analyst:
    - "Rastrear desempenho de criativos"
    - "Identificar melhores performers"
  qa:
    - "Validar qualidade de clips"
    - "Testar fluxos de upload"
```

```yaml
# Brazilian Naming Swipefile

version: "1.0"

# =============================================================================
# CATEGORY 1: BRAZILIAN UNICORNS - Names That Defined New Brazil
# =============================================================================
category_unicorns_br:
  description: "Brazilian unicorn names and their psychology"

  cases:
    - name: "Nubank"
      valuation: "R$ 250 billion (US$ 50B market cap)"
      etymology: "Nu (new, naked, essential) + Bank"
      why_works: "Radical simplicity against banking complexity"
      icp_original: "Millennials denied cards by big banks"
      icp_current: "90+ million Brazilians, from CLT to MEI"
      brazilian_psychology: "'Nu' suggests transparency in country traumatized by hidden fees"
      color_strategy: "Purple differentiated in sector dominated by blue/yellow"
      positioning: "End of complexity - name suggests stripping the unnecessary"
      lesson: "Extreme simplicity in complex market = dominance"

    - name: "iFood"
      valuation: "R$ 28 billion (US$ 5.4B)"
      etymology: "'i' (personal, digital) + Food"
      why_works: "Personalized food"
      icp_original: "Urban middle class without time to cook"
      icp_evolved: "Any Brazilian with smartphone and hunger"
      psychology: "'i' was Apple-inspired in 2011, suggested innovation"
      market_share: "80% - became synonym for delivery"
      pandemic_shift: "From convenience to essential"
      lesson: "Simple name + timing + execution = cultural monopoly"

    - name: "PicPay"

      strategy: "QR code payment pioneer in Brazil"
```

```yaml
# Global Naming Swipefile
# 500+ Analyses of Names That Sold Millions
# Total documented revenue: $178.5+ billion
# Source: swipefile-master-integrado.md

version: "1.0"
extraction_date: "2026-02-23"
source: "swipefile-master-integrado.md"
total_cases: "500+"
total_revenue_documented: "$178.5B+"

# =============================================================================
# CATEGORY 1: NAMES THAT BECAME VERBS (Holy Grail of Branding)
# =============================================================================
category_verbs:
  description: "Names that became cultural verbs - maximum brand dominance"

  cases:
    - name: "Google"
      phrase: "Just Google it"
      valuation: "$2 trillion market cap"
      etymology: "Derived from 'Googol' (10^100)"
      why_works: "Playful sound, suggests infinite search, non-intimidating for non-tech users in 1998"
      icp_original: "Academics and researchers"
      icp_current: "All humanity with internet"
      psychology: "Transformed complex act (internet search) into something simple and fun"
      positioning: "Organize world's information"
      lesson: "Invented name can dominate if product creates category"

    - name: "Uber"
      phrase: "Let's Uber there"
      valuation: "$150B current"
      etymology: "German 'über' (above/superior)"
      why_works: "Short, strong, masculine, suggests premium service"
      icp_original: "SF executives"
      icp_evolved: "Anyone without car"
      psychology: "Status + convenience. Uber Black stayed premium while UberX democratized"
      positioning: "Started luxury, pivoted to utility"
      lesson: "Premium name can democratize without losing brand value"

    - name: "Zoom"
      phrase: "Let's Zoom"
      valuation: "$160B peak (2020)"
      etymology: "Onomatopoeia of speed"
      why_works: "Suggests instant closeness. More human than 'Skype' or 'WebEx'"
      icp_pandemic: "Companies forced remote + separated families"
      psychology: "Fun name reduced tech anxiety during crisis"
      positioning: "Video conferencing that actually works"
      lesson: "Simplicity wins in moments of stress"

    - name: "Photoshop"
      phrase: "That's photoshopped"
      valuation: "$260B (Adobe market cap)"
      etymology: "Photo + Shop (photo workshop)"
      why_works: "Literal but transformative"
      icp_original: "Professional photographers ($20K software)"
      icp_current: "Any content creator"
      psychology: "Made professional editing psychologically accessible"
      lesson: "Being a verb = cultural dominance > legal protection"

    - name: "Venmo"
      phrase: "Just Venmo me"
      valuation: "$800M (PayPal acquisition 2013)"
      etymology: "Ven(der) + Mo(ney)"
      why_works: "Sold as social, not financial"
      icp: "Millennials splitting bills"
      psychology: "Social feed removed shame of asking friends for money"
      positioning: "Social network that moves money vs payment app"
      lesson: "Reframe difficult category (finance) as easy category (social)"

# =============================================================================
# CATEGORY 2: BILLION-DOLLAR SAAS - Name Architecture
# =============================================================================
category_saas:
  description: "SaaS names that built billion-dollar companies"

  cases:
    - name: "Canva"
      valuation: "$32B, $2.55B ARR (2024)"
      why_works: "'Canvas' simplified. Removes blank canvas intimidation. Soft, feminine, accessible."
      icp: "Non-designers who need to create (teachers, SMBs, marketers)"
      psychology: "Artistic but non-intimidating. Democratizes creativity."
      positioning_vs_adobe: "Design for normal humans"
      lesson: "Simplifying complex category name = 100X market expansion"

    - name: "HubSpot"
      valuation: "$2.63B revenue, 247,939 clients"
      why_works: "Hub (center) + Spot (place). Communicates consolidation instantly."
      icp: "SMBs overwhelmed with 20+ marketing tools"
      psychology: "Promises simplification and central control"
      positioning: "'All-in-one' before it became cliché"
      lesson: "Name that IS strategy (hub) allows natural expansion"

    - name: "Notion"
      valuation: "$10B, $400M ARR"
      why_works: "Real word with abstract meaning. Suggests ideas, not features."
      icp: "Knowledge workers tired of switching between 10 apps"
      psychology: "Philosophical name attracts intellectual early adopters"
      positioning: "Lego for productivity"
      lesson: "Abstraction allows pivots without rebrand"

    - name: "Slack"
      valuation: "$27.7B (Salesforce acquisition)"
      why_works: "Means relaxation - opposite of stressful work"
      icp: "Startups that hate email"
      psychology: "Promises frictionless work"
      backronym: "Searchable Log of All Communication and Knowledge"
      lesson: "Counter-intuitive name can redefine category"

    - name: "ClickFunnels"
      valuation: "$265M ARR, 150,000 active clients"
      why_works: "Click (simple action) + Funnels (conversion concept). Ultra literal."
      icp: "Non-technical entrepreneurs who want to sell online"
      psychology: "Removes mystery of 'funnel building'"
      lesson: "Extreme literality works for non-technical audience"

    - name: "Zapier"
      valuation: "$5B, $310M ARR"
      why_works: "'Zap' suggests instant, magic connection. Energetic sound."
      icp: "Non-programmers needing automation"
      psychology: "Makes complex (APIs, webhooks) into simple (Zaps)"
      cultural_verb: "Just zap it together"
      lesson: "Energetic invented word > technical description"

    - name: "Stripe"
      valuation: "$95B, processes $1 trillion/year"
      why_works: "Simple, technical, reliable. A 'stripe' of code."
      icp: "Developers who hate traditional gateways"
      psychology: "Technical but not intimidating"
      positioning: "7 lines of code to accept payments"
      lesson: "For technical ICP, simplicity > creativity"

# =============================================================================
# CATEGORY 3: HIGH-TICKET COACHING ($10K-$250K) - Status Psychology
# =============================================================================
category_high_ticket:
  description: "Names that justify $10K-$250K price points"

  cases:
    - name: "Tony Robbins Platinum Partnership"
      price_range: "$65K-200K/year"
      revenue: "$50M+ just this program"
      why_works: "Platinum = metal more valuable than gold. Partnership = you're not a client, you're a partner."
      icp: "Entrepreneurs $1M-10M wanting to scale to $100M"
      psychology: "Maximum status + belonging + direct access to Tony"
      scarcity: "Maximum 300 members globally"
      lesson: "Precious metal + relationship = extreme pricing justified"

    - name: "Grant Cardone 10X"
      valuation: "$5B+ company valuation"
      why_works: "Simple math formula. Promises multiplication, not addition."
      icp: "Aggressive salespeople and entrepreneurs, mostly men"
      psychology: "Appeals to 'more is more' mentality, anti-minimalism"
      ecosystem: "10X Conference (35,000 people), 10X University, 10X Stages"
      lesson: "Multiplier number creates viral mental framework"

    - name: "Russell Brunson Inner Circle"
      price_tiers: "$50K, $150K, $250K/year"
      why_works: "'Inner' = exclusive access, 'Circle' = community/protection"
      icp: "Only those already making $1M+ ('Two Comma Club')"
      psychology: "Creates aspirational hierarchy within community"
      qualification: "You need to financially 'qualify'"
      lesson: "Pre-qualification increases desire and reduces refunds"

    - name: "Knowledge Business Blueprint"
      revenue: "$33M in 2 weeks, 25,000 students at $1,997"
      creators: "Dean Graziosi & Tony Robbins"
      why_works: "Knowledge (trend) + Business (goal) + Blueprint (clear plan)"
      icp: "Experts who don't know how to monetize knowledge"
      psychology: "'Blueprint' removes fear of not knowing where to start"
      lesson: "[Trend] + [Goal] + [Plan] = massive conversion"

    - name: "Sam Ovens Consulting Accelerator"
      revenue: "$20M+, created 52 documented millionaires"
      why_works: "Consulting (high-value skill) + Accelerator (speed)"
      icp: "Professionals wanting to leave job for consulting"
      psychology: "'Accelerator' promises time shortcut"
      lesson: "Document specific results > vague promises"

# =============================================================================
# CATEGORY 4: DIRECT-TO-CONSUMER - Disrupting Incumbents
# =============================================================================
category_dtc:
  description: "DTC names that disrupted billion-dollar incumbents"

  cases:
    - name: "Dollar Shave Club"
      outcome: "$1B Unilever acquisition (2016)"
      why_works: "Price in name = instant positioning. 'Club' = recurring."
      icp: "Men tired of paying $20+ for Gillette blades"
      launch_video: "'Our blades are f***ing great' - 26M views"
      psychology: "Demystified overcomplicated category"
      lesson: "Putting price in name can be positioning genius"

    - name: "Harry's"
      outcome: "$1.37B Edgewell acquisition attempt (blocked)"
      why_works: "Personal masculine name, casual. Humanizes cold category."
      icp: "Urban millennials wanting quality without Gillette prices"
      psychology: "'Harry' = your trustworthy friend, not corporation"
      lesson: "Personal name creates instant trust in commoditized category"

    - name: "Warby Parker"
      valuation: "$6.8B IPO valuation"
      why_works: "Sounds heritage but is invented. Combines two literary names."
      icp: "Educated urban millennials who think glasses are too expensive"
      psychology: "Name sounds established, trustworthy, intellectual"
      lesson: "Invented name can sound heritage and create instant trust"

    - name: "Bombas"
      valuation: "$3.42B, $325M revenue"
      why_works: "'Bomba' in Latin = pump, also energetic sound"
      icp: "Conscious consumers willing to pay more"
      psychology: "Buying = donating (1-for-1 model)"
      impact: "150M+ items donated"
      lesson: "Energetic name + real mission = premium pricing justified"

    - name: "Gymshark"
      valuation: "$1.3B+, $709M revenue"
      why_works: "Gym (obvious) + Shark (alpha predator)"
      icp: "Young men 18-25 wanting to look muscular"
      psychology: "Shark = aggressive, alpha, apex predator"

      lesson: "Aggressive name for aggressive audience = perfect cultural fit"

# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
category_mobile:
  description: "Mobile app names that generated billions"

  cases:
    - name: "Candy Crush Saga"
```
