```yaml
# Downsell Strategy Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-001 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Modelos: Seção 4 Ofertas de Downsell - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: downsell-strategy
  purpose: "Capture revenue from customers who said NO by adjusting offers to find the best value-budget match"
  domain: sales-recovery
  source_playbook: "$100M Modelos: Seção 4 Ofertas de Downsell"

  core_principle: |
    "Any offer you make after someone says no is a downsell."
    Two levers: HOW they pay (payment plans, trials) and WHAT they get (features)
    Target: Double close rates (25% → 50%+) through systematic downselling

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: downsell-coordinator
      role: "Route rejected leads to appropriate downsell process"
      decisions:
        - "Determine primary objection type"
        - "Select appropriate downsell process"
        - "Escalate complex cases"
      kpis:
        - "Downsell conversion rate"
        - "30-day cash collected"
        - "Customer lifetime value by entry method"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: objection-classifier
      role: "Identify the true reason for rejection"
      inputs:
        - "Customer rejection statement"
        - "Previous offer details"
        - "Customer qualification data"
      outputs:
        - "Primary objection type (price/value/timing)"
        - "Recommended downsell process"
        - "Desire level assessment"

    - agent: payment-analyzer
      role: "Assess customer payment capacity and preferences"
      inputs:
        - "Payment history"
        - "Stated budget constraints"
        - "Pay schedule information"
      outputs:
        - "Optimal payment structure"
        - "Risk assessment"
        - "Collection probability"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: payment-plan-specialist
      role: "Execute 7-step payment plan downsell process"
      specialization: "Process I: Payment Plan Downsells"
      techniques:
        - "Prepay discount framing"
        - "Third-party financing presentation"
        - "Paycheck alignment strategy"
        - "Desire check gate"
        - "Seesaw downselling"

    - agent: trial-architect
      role: "Structure and sell penalty trials"
      specialization: "Process II: Trial com Penalidade"
      capabilities:
        - "Trial criteria design"
        - "Penalty fee structuring"
        - "Card capture process"
        - "Commitment extraction"
        - "Check-in scheduling"

    - agent: feature-sculptor
      role: "Morpheus feature-reduced offers that maintain value"
      specialization: "Process III: Feature Downsells"
      techniques:
        - "Strategic feature removal"
        - "Quality tier adjustments"
        - "Quantity reduction offers"
        - "DIY alternative presentation"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: value-reframer
      role: "Help customers see value through strategic feature removal"
      insights:
        - "Remove high-value features first to demonstrate worth"
        - "Use downsell to re-upsell to main offer"
        - "Match removed features to customer preferences"

    - agent: trust-guardian
      role: "Maintain pricing integrity and customer trust"
      responsibilities:
        - "Prevent pure discounting"
        - "Ensure consistent pricing"
        - "Monitor customer sentiment"
        - "Flag trust-eroding patterns"

    - agent: collection-optimizer
      role: "Maximize payment plan success and minimize defaults"
      focus_areas:
        - "Payment timing optimization"
        - "Default prediction"
        - "Recovery strategies"
        - "Churn prevention"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

agents:
  downsell-coordinator:
    id: downsell-coordinator
    title: "Downsell Strategy Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "🔄"

    purpose: |
      Route rejected customers to the optimal downsell process based on their
      objection type. Maximize recovery rate while maintaining trust and integrity.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Three Downsell Processes"
        components: ["Payment Plans", "Penalty Trials", "Feature Downsells"]
      - name: "Six Rules of Downselling"
        principles:
          - "No to this offer, not all offers"
          - "Downsells are trades"
          - "Personalize, don't pressure"
          - "Same thing, new ways"
          - "Never just lower price"
          - "Customers talk about price"

    decision_authority:
      - "Objection-to-process routing"
      - "Escalation trigger assessment"
      - "Process abandonment decisions"
      - "Customer experience protection"

    inputs:
      - "Customer rejection and objection"
      - "Original offer details"
      - "Customer history and profile"
      - "Available downsell options"

    outputs:
      - "Selected downsell process"
      - "Customized offer parameters"
      - "Agent assignment"
      - "Success probability estimate"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Downsell Conversion Rate"
          target: ">40%"
          calculation: "Downsells Closed / Total Rejections"
        - name: "30-Day Cash Collected"
          target: "Track against baseline"
      secondary:
        - "Full Payment Ratio maintained"
        - "Trial-to-Paid Conversion >50%"
        - "Customer Satisfaction maintained"

  objection-classifier:
    id: objection-classifier
    title: "Objection Analysis Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🔍"

    purpose: |
      Identify the TRUE reason behind customer rejection.
      Surface vs. stated objections often differ.

    objection_types:
      price_objection:
        indicators:
          - "Too expensive"
          - "Can't afford it"
          - "Not in budget"
        recommended_process: "Payment Plan Downsell"
        source: "Seção 4, p.70-71"

      value_objection:
        indicators:
          - "Not sure it's worth it"
          - "Need to think about it"
          - "Not convinced"
        recommended_process: "Feature Downsell (remove to demonstrate value)"
        source: "Seção 4, p.253-254"

      timing_objection:
        indicators:
          - "Not ready yet"
          - "Maybe later"
          - "Need more time"
        recommended_process: "Trial with Penalty"
        source: "Seção 4, p.154-156"

      fit_objection:
        indicators:
          - "Not sure it's for me"
          - "My situation is different"
          - "I don't need all that"
        recommended_process: "Feature Downsell (customize)"
        source: "Seção 4, p.21"

    diagnostic_questions:
      - "What specifically made you say no?"
      - "Is it the price or the offer itself?"
      - "What would need to be different for you to say yes?"
      - "On a scale of 1-10, how much do you want this?"

    outputs:
      - "Primary objection classification"
      - "Confidence level"
      - "Recommended downsell process"
      - "Key talking points"

  payment-analyzer:
    id: payment-analyzer
    title: "Payment Capacity Analyst"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "💳"

    purpose: |
      Assess customer's actual payment capacity and optimal payment structure.
      Align payment timing with income timing for maximum success.

    analysis_dimensions:
      capacity:
        questions:
          - "When do you get paid?"
          - "What's the most you can put down today?"
          - "Do you have a credit card you can use?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.94"

      risk_factors:
        indicators:
          - "Inability to put any money down"
          - "Unstable income"
          - "Previous payment issues"
        mitigation: "Layaway or card on file required"

      timing_optimization:
        rule: "Align payments with paydays"
        benefit: "Higher completion rates"
        source: "Seção 4, p.111"

    outputs:
      - "Recommended payment structure"
      - "Optimal payment timing"
      - "Risk level (Low/Medium/High)"
      - "Collection probability %"

  payment-plan-specialist:
    id: payment-plan-specialist
    title: "Payment Plan Downsell Expert"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "📅"

    purpose: |
      Execute the 7-step payment plan downsell process to capture customers
      who want the offer but can't pay full price upfront.

    seven_step_process:
      step_1:
        name: "Reward for Prepay"
        action: "Present price with interest included, offer discount for prepay"
        script: "It's $15, but it's $10 if you prepay. You save $5."
        source: "Seção 4, p.86-87"

      step_2:
        name: "Third-Party Options"
        options:
          - type: "Third-party financing"
            description: "Company pays you now, customer pays them over time"
          - type: "Credit card"
            script: "Do you prefer I decide your payment terms or you decide?"
          - type: "Layaway"
            description: "Pay before receiving, flexible terms"
        source: "Seção 4, p.88-93"

      step_3:
        name: "Half Now, Half Later"
        script: |
          "When is the next time you get paid?"
          "Want to put half today and the rest when you get paid?"
          "What's the most you can put down today?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.94"

      step_4:
        name: "Desire Check"
        script: "On a scale of 1-10, how much do you want to do this?"
        decision_tree:
          "8-10": "Continue to step 5"
          "<8": "Ask 'Why not a 10?' then pivot to feature downsell"
        source: "Seção 4, p.96-97"

      step_5:
        name: "Three Payments"
        structure: "1/3 now, 1/3 next payday, 1/3 following payday"
        source: "Seção 4, p.98"

      step_6:
        name: "Spread Evenly"
        example: "16-week program = 16 weekly payments"
        source: "Seção 4, p.100"

      step_7:
        name: "Free Trial"
        action: "Transition to Process II (Trial with Penalty)"
        source: "Seção 4, p.102"

    alternative_process:
      name: "Seesaw Downselling"
      description: "Simplified version for less experienced salespeople"
      script: |
        "Would you rather have giant monthly payments or small ones?"
        [They say small]
        "Normally it's X, and if you prepay today, you get a huge discount
        and zero monthly payments. Does that work?"
      source: "Seção 4, p.107-108"

    upsell_opportunities:
      during_plan: |
        "Make periodic offers for the original prepay discount during the
        payment plan. If they pay off the balance, they still get the discount."
      source: "Seção 4, p.109"

  trial-architect:
    id: trial-architect
    title: "Penalty Trial Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Structure and execute penalty trials that convert free trial customers
      into paying customers through action-based requirements.

    trial_definition: |
      "Customers can try your product or service for free AS LONG AS they
      meet your terms. If they don't meet terms, they pay the penalty fee."
      Source: Seção 4, p.154

    five_step_process:
      step_1:
        name: "Offer Trial Last"
        rule: "Only after customer clearly rejected main offer and payment plans"
        script: |
          "Hmm, that's really a problem. Tell you what, how about we start
          you for free? Would you be okay with that? We can just help you
          out and if you like it, you can stay. Let me get your ID and
          we can start the process. Fair?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.175"

      step_2:
        name: "Always Get a Card"
        rule: "No card = no trial"
        response_to_resistance: "It's just how we've always done it."
        hard_rule: "If they won't put card down AND commit to work = walk away"
        source: "Seção 4, p.176-177"

      step_3:
        name: "Sell Staying and Paying"
        question: "If this program gets you the result, will you stay long-term?"
        integrity_script: |
          "I don't want you to just try, I want you to get results. Being
          honest, you won't reach your long-term goals during this trial,
          but you'll establish the habits to help you achieve them. And
          we'll help you do that for free. But if you want your long-term
          results, you'll have to continue after."
        source: "Seção 4, p.178-179"

      step_4:
        name: "Explain Fees After Card"
        timing: "Always AFTER getting card, not before"
        script: |
          "We'll do our part as long as you do yours. That's fair, right?
          So now I just ask you to bet on yourself. If you miss or skip
          anything, your results will suffer. We charge to keep you on
          track. If you mess up, no problem. You get charged a small fee,
          but it puts you back on track. If you comply, you get all of
          this for free. Best of both worlds."
        source: "Seção 4, p.179-180"

      step_5:
        name: "Make Check-Ins Mandatory"
        purpose: "Built-in upsell opportunities"
        template: |
          "Yes, and you agree to attend each of these three check-ins:
          First, we do X so that you can...
          Second, we do Y so that you can...
          Third, we do Z so that you can...
          Obviously, we charge if you miss these because it's the only
          way to get results."
        source: "Seção 4, p.181"

    fee_structure_options:
      split_fees:
        description: "$50 per missed item rather than $500 for first failure"
        benefit: "More people agree to terms"
        source: "Seção 4, p.171"

      single_fee:
        when: "When single failure truly derails results"
        source: "Seção 4, p.171"

    trial_outcomes:
      liked:
        action: "They're already on auto-billing. Offer higher-tier option."
        source: "Seção 4, p.184"

      hated:
        script: |
          "Ask what they'd like different. Say you're right and you're
          annoyed you missed that. Don't blame them. Only one person can
          be angry and it needs to be you. Ask if they'll give you a
          chance to make it right. Offer your higher-tier thing."
        close_rate: "~50%"
        source: "Seção 4, p.185"

      didnt_use:
        action: |
          "Contact multiple times before getting here. Offer to waive fee
          if they meet with you. Try to get them back on track or offer
          something more suitable."
        note: "A small fee isn't worth a one-star review"
        source: "Seção 4, p.186"

    naming_rule: "Just call it a 'free trial' even though it has penalties"
    source: "Seção 4, p.191"

  feature-sculptor:
    id: feature-sculptor
    title: "Feature Downsell Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "✂️"

    purpose: |
      Morpheus feature-reduced offers that lower price while maintaining
      perceived value. Use strategic removal to demonstrate feature worth.

    core_formula: |
      "Take something out, lower the price, and ask 'How about now?'"
      Source: Seção 4, p.253

    key_insight: |
      "People will see the value in the thing you removed AFTER they see
      the price difference. This can make MORE people buy the full-price
      offer."
      Source: Seção 4, p.253-254

    removal_order_rule: |
      "Remove features from HIGHEST to LOWEST value. Removing high-value
      features makes customers re-upsell themselves to the premium offer."
      Source: Seção 4, p.254

    downsell_types:
      quantity_product:
        example: "Instead of a three-month supply, start with just one?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.257"

      quantity_service:
        example: "Instead of four sessions per month, start with two?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.257"

      quality_product:
        example: "Instead of leather seats, we can do vinyl. Sound good?"
        source: "Seção 4, p.261"

      quality_service:
        dimensions:
          - "Time availability: Specific hours vs anytime"
          - "Days: Mon/Wed/Fri vs any day"
          - "Response speed: Overnight vs 5 minutes"
          - "Delivery speed: Next week vs same day"
          - "Ratio: 1-to-many vs 1-to-1"
          - "Method: Text vs video call"
          - "Provider: New employee vs owner"
          - "Live vs recorded"
          - "DIY vs Done-With-You vs Done-For-You"
          - "Expiration: Limited time vs forever"
          - "Customization: Generic vs personalized"
          - "Insurance/guarantee duration and coverage"
        source: "Seção 4, p.267-281"

      remove_feature_entirely:
        example: "Keep chat and email, drop the calls"
        source: "Seção 4, p.282-284"

      diy_alternative:
        examples:
          - "Chiropractor → Foam rollers, massage tools, mats"
          - "Painter → Rent spray machine, sell paint"
          - "Agency → Join a workshop instead"
        source: "Seção 4, p.285-290"

    guarantee_removal_example:
      before: "25% close rate"
      after: "75% close rate (35 premium + 40 downsell)"
      how: "Remove full money-back guarantee for lower price"
      why: "Removing shows value of guarantee, many re-upsell to keep it"
      source: "Seção 4, p.217-248"

  value-reframer:
    id: value-reframer
    title: "Value Perception Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "💎"

    purpose: |
      Help customers see true value through strategic positioning.
      Use downsell as a tool to close at full price.

    reframing_strategies:
      contrast_principle:
        description: "Make premium vs basic contrast enormous"
        rule: "Make decoy as basic as possible, premium as amazing as possible"
        source: "Seção 4, p.307"

      permission_approach:
        script: "Are you here for free stuff or lasting results?"
        effect: "Most say 'results', which gives permission to sell premium"
        source: "Seção 4, p.313"

      assumptive_presentation:
        style: |
          "Operate from a position of 'this is what everyone does, this is
          just a formality.' Friendly, almost bored disposition of how
          regularly people buy."
        source: "Seção 4, p.315-316"

      surprise_upgrade:
        when: "Customer takes decoy option"
        action: "Surprise them with some zero-to-low cost premium features"
        benefit: "Builds goodwill, increases upsell probability"
        source: "Seção 4, p.317"

  trust-guardian:
    id: trust-guardian
    title: "Pricing Integrity Protector"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🛡️"

    purpose: |
      Prevent trust-eroding practices like pure discounting.
      Ensure consistent pricing and customer experience.

    anti_patterns:
      car_salesman_trap:
        description: "Lowering price for same thing"
        example: "$5,000 → $3,000 → $1,000 → $400 for same insurance"
        result: "Customer said no to ALL and questioned car price"
        source: "Seção 4, p.11-14"

      moment_discounting:
        rule: "Never charge less in the moment because you're scared"
        why: "Customers talk. Different prices = upset customers."
        source: "Seção 4, p.27-28"

    integrity_rules:
      - rule: "Every price reduction must have corresponding value reduction"
        source: "Seção 4, p.25"

      - rule: "Test prices with specific number of people ahead of time"
        source: "Seção 4, p.27"

      - rule: "Personalize offer, not discount price"
        source: "Seção 4, p.21"

  collection-optimizer:
    id: collection-optimizer
    title: "Payment Collection Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "💰"

    purpose: |
      Maximize payment plan success and minimize defaults.
      Optimize collection timing and recovery strategies.

    optimization_strategies:
      paycheck_alignment:
        rule: "Charge on days people get paid"
        benefit: "Higher likelihood of payment"
        source: "Seção 4, p.111"

      multiple_passes:
        strategy: "If declined first, run card multiple times that day"
        result: "Recover 1/3 of declined payments"
        source: "Seção 4, p.111"

      frequency_impact:
        data:
          monthly: "10.7% monthly churn"
          quarterly: "5% monthly churn"
          annual: "2% monthly churn"
        insight: "Fewer, larger payments = lower churn"
        source: "Seção 4, p.115 (ProfitWell data)"

    health_check:
      success_criteria: |
        "Payment plans make money when:
        - Total closes increase
        - Full payment percentage stays same
        - New downsell customers ADDED to full-pay customers

        BAD SIGN:
        - Full payment customers moving to payment plans
        - Payment plans failing before profit point"
      source: "Seção 4, p.113-114"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

executor_matrix:
  # Diagnosis Tasks
  - task: "Classify objection type"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates AI classification"

  - task: "Assess payment capacity"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Sensitive financial conversation"

  - task: "Calculate payment options"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Pre-approved terms only"

  # Payment Plan Process
  - task: "Present prepay discount"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Frame as reward, not punishment"

  - task: "Offer third-party financing"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Partner integrations configured"

  - task: "Process credit card option"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Secure processing required"

  - task: "Structure layaway terms"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Clear delivery conditions"

  - task: "Conduct desire check (1-10)"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "If <8, pivot to feature downsell"

  - task: "Calculate payment splits"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Align with pay schedule"

  - task: "Execute seesaw downselling"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Simplified script available"

  # Trial Process
  - task: "Present trial offer"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Only after main offer rejected"

  - task: "Capture card for trial"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "No card = no trial"

  - task: "Extract continuation commitment"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Use integrity script"

  - task: "Explain penalty fees"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "After card captured, separate initial"

  - task: "Schedule mandatory check-ins"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Build in upsell opportunities"

  - task: "Process penalty charges"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Per agreed terms only"

  - task: "Offer makeup opportunity"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "For engaged customers"

  # Feature Downsell Process
  - task: "Present quantity reduction"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Maintain core value"

  - task: "Present quality tier options"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Pre-built tier menu"

  - task: "Execute strategic feature removal"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Remove high-value first to demonstrate worth"

  - task: "Present DIY alternative"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Products support same outcome"

  - task: "Apply surprise upgrade"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Zero-to-low cost features only"

  # Collection & Monitoring
  - task: "Schedule payments to paydays"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Customer confirms pay dates"

  - task: "Process scheduled payments"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Multiple retry attempts"

  - task: "Send payment reminders"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Before charge date"

  - task: "Handle declined payments"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Multiple passes same day"

  - task: "Monitor full-payment ratio"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Alert if declining"

  - task: "Track churn by entry method"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Compare across segments"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUALITY GATES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Objection Identification Gate"
    transition: "Rejection → Downsell Process"
    condition: "objection_type_identified == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Return to discovery questions"

  QG-002:
    name: "Desire Check Gate"
    transition: "Payment Plan Step 3 → Step 5"
    condition: "desire_score >= 8"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Ask 'Why not 10?' then pivot to feature downsell"
    source: "Seção 4, p.96-97"

  QG-003:
    name: "Card Capture Gate"
    transition: "Trial Agreement → Trial Start"
    condition: "card_on_file == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "End conversation politely"
    source: "Seção 4, p.176-177"

  QG-004:
    name: "Continuation Commitment Gate"
    transition: "Card Captured → Fee Explanation"
    condition: "verbal_commitment_to_stay == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "No trial without commitment"
    source: "Seção 4, p.178"

  QG-005:
    name: "Fee Acknowledgment Gate"
    transition: "Fee Explanation → Trial Start"
    condition: "fees_acknowledged AND fee_clause_initialed"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Re-explain fees, get initials"
    source: "Seção 4, p.180"

  QG-006:
    name: "Value Reduction Gate"
    transition: "Price Reduction Request → Implementation"
    condition: "corresponding_value_reduction_identified"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Block pure discounting"
    source: "Seção 4, p.25"

  QG-007:
    name: "Full Payment Ratio Gate"
    transition: "Payment Plan Implementation → Continue"
    condition: "full_payment_percentage >= baseline"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Investigate cannibalization"
    source: "Seção 4, p.113-114"

  QG-008:
    name: "Trust Consistency Gate"
    transition: "Price Quote → Customer"
    condition: "price_matches_standard_terms"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Use standard pricing only"
    source: "Seção 4, p.27-28"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WORKFLOWS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

workflows:
  rejection_recovery_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer says NO to main offer"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: objection-classifier
        action: "Identify true objection type"
        output: "Objection classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: downsell-coordinator
        action: "Route to appropriate downsell process"
        decision_tree:
          price_objection: "Payment Plan Process"
          value_objection: "Feature Downsell Process"
          timing_objection: "Trial Process"

      - step: 3
        agent: "[Selected specialist]"
        action: "Execute downsell process"
        output: "Sale or escalation"

      - step: 4
        agent: trust-guardian
        action: "Verify pricing integrity maintained"
        validation: "No pure discounting occurred"

  payment_plan_workflow:
    trigger: "Price objection identified"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Present prepay discount"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 2"

      - step: 2
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Offer third-party options"
        options: ["Financing", "Credit Card", "Layaway"]
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 3"

      - step: 3
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Offer half now, half later"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 4"

      - step: 4
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Desire check (1-10)"
        gate: "QG-002"
        decision: "If >= 8 → Step 5, else → Feature Downsell"

      - step: 5
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Offer three-payment split"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 6"

      - step: 6
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Offer spread payments evenly"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 7"

      - step: 7
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Transition to trial process"
        handoff: "Trial Workflow"

  trial_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer declined payment plans OR timing objection"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Present trial offer"
        script: "How about we start you for free?"

      - step: 2
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Capture card"
        gate: "QG-003"

      - step: 3
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Get continuation commitment"
        gate: "QG-004"
        script: "If this gets you results, will you stay long-term?"

      - step: 4
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Explain penalty fees"
        gate: "QG-005"

      - step: 5
        agent: trial-architect
        action: "Schedule mandatory check-ins"
        output: "Trial enrollment complete"

      - step: 6
        agent: collection-optimizer
        action: "Monitor trial progress"
        triggers: ["Completion", "Penalty event", "Non-engagement"]

  feature_downsell_workflow:
    trigger: "Value objection OR low desire score"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: feature-sculptor
        action: "Identify highest-value feature to remove"
        strategy: "Remove high-value first to demonstrate worth"

      - step: 2
        agent: value-reframer
        action: "Present feature-reduced offer with price"
        check: "Did removing feature re-upsell them?"
        decision: "If upsold to main → Complete, else → Step 3"

      - step: 3
        agent: feature-sculptor
        action: "Present quantity reduction"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 4"

      - step: 4
        agent: feature-sculptor
        action: "Present quality tier reduction"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → Step 5"

      - step: 5
        agent: feature-sculptor
        action: "Present DIY alternative"
        decision: "If accepted → Complete, else → End"

  collection_workflow:
    trigger: "Payment plan or trial enrolled"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: collection-optimizer
        action: "Align payments with paydays"
        source: "Customer pay schedule"

      - step: 2
        agent: collection-optimizer
        action: "Schedule payment reminders"
        timing: "Before each charge date"

      - step: 3
        agent: collection-optimizer
        action: "Process scheduled payment"
        on_decline: "Multiple passes same day"

      - step: 4
        agent: payment-plan-specialist
        action: "Offer prepay discount for remaining balance"
        timing: "During plan lifecycle"

      - step: 5
        agent: collection-optimizer
        action: "Monitor completion and churn"
        output: "Performance metrics"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KPIs & SUCCESS METRICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

kpis:
  primary:
    downsell_conversion_rate:
      formula: "Downsells Closed / Total Rejections"
      target: ">40%"
      benchmark: "25% → 75% in example case"
      source: "Seção 4, p.217"

    thirty_day_cash:
      formula: "Cash collected in 30 days post-sale"
      target: "Increase vs baseline"
      impact: "Explodes 30-day profits"
      source: "Seção 4, p.30"

  secondary:
    full_payment_ratio:
      formula: "Full Payments / Total Sales"
      target: "Maintain baseline %"
      critical: "Must not decline when adding downsells"
      source: "Seção 4, p.113-114"

    trial_to_paid:
      formula: "Trials Converted / Trials Started"
      target: ">50%"
      source: "Seção 4, p.156"

    payment_plan_completion:
      formula: "Plans Completed / Plans Started"
      target: ">70%"
      optimization: "Align with pay schedules"

  by_process:
    payment_plans:
      - "Steps to close (avg)"
      - "Prepay discount uptake %"
      - "Third-party financing %"
      - "Completion rate by frequency"
      - "Churn by billing frequency"

    trials:
      - "Trial acceptance rate"
      - "Penalty fee collection rate"
      - "Check-in attendance rate"
      - "Trial-to-paid conversion"
      - "Upsell rate from trials"

    feature_downsells:
      - "Re-upsell rate (back to premium)"
      - "Feature reduction acceptance"
      - "DIY conversion rate"
      - "LTV by entry method"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

troubleshooting:
  - symptom: "Low downsell acceptance rate"
    possible_causes:
      - "Leading with downsell instead of main offer"
      - "Downsell not matching objection type"
      - "Terms too restrictive"
    diagnosis:
      - "Review objection classification accuracy"
      - "Check downsell sequencing"
      - "Compare terms to market"
    solutions:
      - "Always present main offer first"
      - "Match downsell process to objection type"
      - "Adjust terms based on acceptance data"

  - symptom: "Full payment ratio declining"
    possible_causes:
      - "Payment plans cannibalizing full payments"
      - "Too easy to get payment plan"
      - "Prepay discount not compelling"
    diagnosis:
      - "Compare before/after full payment %"
      - "Review step progression data"
      - "Survey full-pay vs plan customers"
    solutions:
      - "Increase prepay discount value"
      - "Add friction to payment plan path"
      - "Review step 4 desire check compliance"

  - symptom: "High trial penalty charges but low retention"
    possible_causes:
      - "Penalties too harsh"
      - "Requirements unrealistic"
      - "Not enough support during trial"
    diagnosis:
      - "Review penalty frequency distribution"
      - "Survey churned trial customers"
      - "Audit check-in quality"
    solutions:
      - "Split fees into smaller amounts"
      - "Adjust requirements to be achievable"
      - "Increase support touchpoints"

  - symptom: "Feature downsell re-upsell rate low"
    possible_causes:
      - "Removing wrong features"
      - "Price difference not meaningful"
      - "Feature value not clear to customer"
    diagnosis:
      - "Analyze which features being removed"
      - "Check price-value gap perception"
      - "Review sales conversation recordings"
    solutions:
      - "Remove highest-value features first"
      - "Increase price difference"
      - "Better articulate what's being lost"

  - symptom: "Payment plan defaults high"
    possible_causes:
      - "Not aligned with pay schedule"
      - "Customers over-committed"
      - "No reminder system"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check payment timing vs paydays"
      - "Review customer capacity assessments"
      - "Audit reminder delivery"
    solutions:
      - "Align all payments with paydays"
      - "Strengthen capacity assessment"
      - "Implement payment reminders"
      - "Add multiple retry passes"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

technology:
  required:
    - tool: "Payment Processing System"
      purpose: "Store cards, schedule payments, handle retries"
      features:
        - "Card on file capability"
        - "Scheduled charging"
        - "Multiple retry attempts"
        - "Pay schedule alignment"

    - tool: "CRM with Downsell Tracking"
      purpose: "Track downsell journey and conversions"
      features:
        - "Objection classification"
        - "Downsell step tracking"
        - "Conversion attribution"
        - "LTV by entry method"

    - tool: "Contract/Agreement System"
      purpose: "Document terms and get acknowledgments"
      features:
        - "Separate fee initials"
        - "Commitment documentation"
        - "Trial terms capture"

    - tool: "Payment Calculator"
      purpose: "Generate payment options in real-time"
      features:
        - "Multiple split options"
        - "Interest/discount calculations"
        - "Pay schedule alignment"

  recommended:
    - tool: "Third-Party Financing Integration"
      purpose: "Offer financing without carrying risk"
      benefit: "Get paid today, customer pays them"

    - tool: "Trial Management System"
      purpose: "Track requirements, trigger penalties"
      features:
        - "Checklist tracking"
        - "Automated penalty processing"
        - "Check-in scheduling"
        - "Makeup opportunity tracking"

    - tool: "Churn Analysis Dashboard"
      purpose: "Compare performance by entry method"
      metrics:
        - "LTV by acquisition type"
        - "Churn by payment frequency"
        - "Completion rates"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GAPS TO RESOLVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

gaps_to_resolve:
  - id: GAP-001
    description: "Specific third-party financing partner recommendations"
    severity: Medium
```

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/email-campaign-sop.md

# Email Campaign SOP

> **Source:** $100M Money Models Blueprint: Email/SMS Copy and Mailers - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Execute complete email and SMS campaign sequences for product launches, event registrations, and buyer nurturing. This SOP covers the **exact templates and sequences** used to generate millions of registrations and purchases.

**Core Objective:**
```
Move leads through a deliberate sequence:
Registration -> Pre-Order/VIP -> Event Attendance -> Post-Event Purchase -> Upsell

Each touchpoint maximizes:
- Open rates through compelling subject lines
- Click rates through clear CTAs
- Conversion through urgency and value stacking
```

**Business Impact:** A properly executed email/SMS campaign can convert 20-40% of registrants into buyers, with VIP pre-orders representing the highest LTV segment.

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Product/book launches with registration events
- Live event promotions (virtual or in-person)
- Multi-tier offer sequences (VIP, standard, bundles)
- Affiliate/referral program communications
- Cart abandonment recovery campaigns

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- Daily newsletter content (covered in content SOP)
- Customer support communications
- Transactional emails (shipping, receipts)
- Cold outreach campaigns

### Campaign Types Covered
- **Registration Sequences:** Opt-in to event
- **Pre-Launch Sequences:** Countdown to event
- **VIP/Upsell Sequences:** Upgrade registered leads
- **Abandoned Cart Sequences:** Recover lost purchases
- **Event Reminders:** 48h, 24h, 1h before
- **Post-Event Sequences:** Purchase, redemption, affiliate rewards
- **Affiliate Sequences:** Referral program communications

---

## Part 3: Preconditions

| Precondition | Requirement | Validation |
|--------------|-------------|------------|
| Email Platform | HubSpot or equivalent with automation | Workflows configured |
| SMS Platform | Compliant SMS sender (Twilio, etc.) | Opt-in verified |
| List Segmentation | Ability to segment by purchase/action | Tags functional |
| Smart Links | Dynamic cart links with user data | {{smart_link}} working |
| Calendar Integration | Add-to-calendar functionality | Links tested |
| Tracking | UTM parameters and conversion tracking | Analytics verified |

---

## Part 4: The Campaign Architecture Framework

### Campaign Phase Overview

```
+------------------+-------------------+--------------------+-------------------+
|   REGISTRATION   |    PRE-LAUNCH     |      LAUNCH        |    POST-LAUNCH    |
+------------------+-------------------+--------------------+-------------------+
| Confirmation     | Countdown emails  | Event reminders    | Purchase confirm  |
| Affiliate invite | Value reveals     | 48h/24h/1h         | Bonus access      |
| VIP upsell       | Social proof      | Last chance        | Upsell sequences  |
| Cart abandon     | Scarcity setup    | Mystery tease      | Affiliate rewards |
+------------------+-------------------+--------------------+-------------------+
     45-14 days           14-1 days           Launch Day          Post-Event
```

### Sequence Structure Principle
Every email sequence follows the **AIDA-U Pattern:**
- **A**ttention: Subject line that demands open
- **I**nterest: First line hooks with relevance
- **D**esire: Value stack and social proof
- **A**ction: Single, clear CTA
- **U**rgency: Deadline or scarcity element

---

## Part 5: Process Steps

| **Output** | Confirmation delivered, calendar link sent |
| **Guardrails** | Must include: date, time, timezone, save-this-email instruction |

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Segment Selection
```yaml
rule: EMAIL_SEGMENT_SELECTION
trigger: New campaign email
condition:
  - IF registered == true AND purchased == false AND abandoned == false THEN "VIP_UPSELL"
  - IF registered == true AND purchased == true THEN "BUYER_SEQUENCE"
  - IF abandoned == true THEN "CART_RECOVERY"
  - IF registered == false THEN "ACQUISITION"
action: Route to appropriate sequence
confidence: HIGH
```

### DR-002: Timing Intervals
```yaml
rule: EMAIL_TIMING
trigger: Sequence progression
condition:
  - IF immediate_confirmation THEN send_within_seconds
  - IF follow_up_upsell THEN delay_15_minutes
  - IF reminder_sequence THEN delay_24_hours
  - IF abandoned_cart THEN [20_min, 24_hour, 48_hour]
action: Apply appropriate delay
confidence: HIGH
```

### DR-003: Mystery/Scarcity Deployment
```yaml
rule: MYSTERY_SCARCITY
trigger: Pre-launch email
condition:
  - IF days_to_launch > 14 THEN tease_mystery_only
  - IF days_to_launch <= 14 AND > 7 THEN reveal_headliners_vague
  - IF days_to_launch <= 7 THEN full_urgency_mode
action: Calibrate mystery/urgency ratio
confidence: HIGH
```

### DR-004: CTA Placement
```yaml
rule: CTA_PLACEMENT
trigger: Email composition
condition:
  - ALWAYS include primary CTA after value proposition
  - ALWAYS include secondary CTA in PS section
  - IF long_email THEN include mid-email CTA
action: Place CTAs strategically
confidence: HIGH
```

### DR-005: SMS vs Email Selection
```yaml
rule: CHANNEL_SELECTION
trigger: Message send
condition:
  - IF announcement == true THEN email_first
  - IF reminder < 24h THEN sms_primary
  - IF urgent_action THEN sms_and_email
  - IF long_content THEN email_only
action: Select appropriate channel
confidence: HIGH
```

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Double Purchase
**Trigger:** Customer pre-orders AND purchases at event
**Action:** Send clarifying email explaining separate shipments

### Exception 2: Affiliate + Customer
**Trigger:** Person is both affiliate and customer
**Action:** Receive both sequences, ensure no duplicate sends

### Exception 3: Technical Issues with Zoom Link
**Trigger:** Wrong link type configured
**Action:** Send correction email immediately with clear instructions

**Template (Correction):**
```
Subject: Action Required: Your Zoom Access Has Been Updated

Hi [First Name],

Turns out even the $100M team makes mistakes. We accidentally
set up the original Zoom link as a webinar instead of a meeting.

You are now registered for the correct format.

There's nothing you need to do other than:
1. Delete the original Zoom calendar event
2. Look for a new email from Zoom confirming registration
3. Accept the new invite

You're still confirmed for Saturday, August 16 at 9:00 AM PT.

Thank you for your understanding.

The $100M Money Models Support Team
```

### Exception 4: High-Value Abandoned Cart (200/800 Bundles)
**Trigger:** $2999+ cart abandoned
**Action:** Extended sequence (5 emails) + phone support offer

## Appendix A: Subject Line Patterns

### Pattern Categories

| Pattern | Example | Use Case |
|---------|---------|----------|
| Direct Benefit | "Get your book first + VIP Livestream" | Upsell emails |
| Curiosity Gap | "I'm giving something HUGE away...LIVE" | Tease emails |
| Personal | "Because you referred friends last time..." | Re-engagement |
| Urgency | "[FINAL NOTICE] Cart closes at 11:59 pm" | Deadline emails |
| Status | "You're registered. (Save this email)" | Confirmation |
| Pattern Interrupt | "Did you miss this?" | Re-engagement |
| Social Proof | "5 Mystery headliners...1 event...free?" | Value emails |

### Subject Line Formulas
1. **[Bracket] + Statement:** "[Your Invite Inside]"
2. **Number + Curiosity:** "5 Mystery headliners...1 event...free?"
3. **Direct + Benefit:** "Get your book first + VIP Livestream"
4. **Status + Instruction:** "You're registered. (Save this email)"
5. **Urgency + Deadline:** "[2HR NOTICE] Cart closes at 11:59 pm PT"

| D-11 | Headliner Reveal | Pre-Launch #7 | Full List |
| D-9 | Content Sneak Peek | Pre-Launch #8 | Full List |
| D-7 | Meta-Book Reveal | Pre-Launch #9 | Full List |
| D-2 | 48h Reminder | Event Reminder | VIP/Zoom |
| D-1 | 24h Reminder | Event Reminder | VIP/Zoom |
| D-0 -1h | Final Reminder | Event Reminder | VIP/Zoom |
| D+0 | Post-Event Confirm | Confirmation | Purchasers |
| D+3 | Skool Offer | Post-Event | Non-200 |
| D+5 | Skool Final | Post-Event | All |

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/email-campaign-squad-blueprint.yaml

```yaml
# Email Campaign Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-001 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Money Models Blueprint: Email/SMS Copy and Mailers - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: email-campaign
  purpose: "Execute complete email and SMS campaign sequences for product launches, event registrations, and buyer nurturing"
  domain: marketing-automation
  source_playbook: "$100M Money Models Blueprint: Email/SMS Copy"

  core_equation: |
    Campaign ROI = (Registrations × VIP Rate × Show Rate × Purchase Rate) × LTV
    Target: 20-40% conversion from registration to purchase
    Impact: Properly executed sequences drive multi-million dollar launches

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: campaign-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate email/SMS sequences across all campaign phases"
      decisions:
        - "Campaign phase transitions"
        - "Sequence timing adjustments"
        - "Emergency send holds"
        - "A/B test routing"
      kpis:
        - "Overall campaign conversion rate"
        - "Sequence completion rate"
        - "Revenue per email sent"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: list-segmenter
      role: "Segment lists based on behavior and purchase status"
      inputs:
        - "Registration data"
        - "Purchase history"
        - "Cart abandonment status"
        - "Affiliate status"
      outputs:
        - "Segment assignment"
        - "Exclusion lists"
        - "Merge variable population"

    - agent: deliverability-monitor
      role: "Monitor and protect email deliverability"
      inputs:
        - "Bounce rates"
        - "Spam complaints"
        - "Open rate trends"
        - "Blacklist checks"
      outputs:
        - "Deliverability health score"
        - "Send throttle recommendations"
        - "List hygiene alerts"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: sequence-writer
      role: "Write email/SMS copy following proven templates"
      specialization: "Phase-specific copywriting"
      templates:
        registration: ["confirmation", "vip_upsell", "affiliate_invite"]
        pre_launch: ["announcement", "invitation", "value_reveal", "countdown"]
        abandoned_cart: ["immediate", "comparison", "deadline"]
        event_reminder: ["48h", "24h", "1h"]
        post_event: ["confirmation", "redemption", "upsell"]
        affiliate: ["recruitment", "welcome", "leaderboard"]

    - agent: automation-builder
      role: "Build and configure email automation workflows"
      specialization: "HubSpot/Marketing Automation"
      capabilities:
        - "Trigger configuration"
        - "Delay sequencing"
        - "Conditional branching"
        - "Smart link generation"
        - "A/B test setup"

    - agent: sms-specialist
      role: "Execute SMS campaigns with compliance"
      specialization: "SMS marketing"
      capabilities:
        - "Opt-out handling"
        - "Character limit optimization"
        - "Timing optimization"
        - "Compliance monitoring"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: conversion-optimizer
      role: "Optimize sequences based on performance data"
      inputs:
        - "Open rates by subject line"
        - "Click rates by CTA"
        - "Conversion by sequence"
        - "Revenue attribution"
      outputs:
        - "Subject line recommendations"
        - "CTA optimization"
        - "Timing adjustments"
        - "Sequence modifications"

    - agent: urgency-calibrator
      role: "Calibrate urgency and scarcity messaging"
      inputs:
        - "Days to deadline"
        - "Inventory levels"
        - "Conversion velocity"
      outputs:
        - "Urgency level (1-5)"
        - "Scarcity messaging"
        - "Deadline specificity"

    - agent: personalization-engine
      role: "Enhance personalization across sequences"
      responsibilities:
        - "Merge variable selection"
        - "Segment-specific variations"
        - "Behavioral triggers"
        - "Dynamic content blocks"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  campaign-coordinator:
    id: campaign-coordinator
    title: "Email Campaign Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "📧"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate all email/SMS campaign sequences to maximize conversions
      across the full customer journey from registration to purchase.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Campaign Phases"
        components: ["Registration", "Pre-Launch", "Launch", "Post-Launch"]
      - name: "AIDA-U Pattern"
        components: ["Attention", "Interest", "Desire", "Action", "Urgency"]
      - name: "Sequence Architecture"
        principle: "Right message, right time, right segment"

    decision_authority:
      - "Phase transition timing"
      - "Emergency send holds"
      - "A/B test decisions"
      - "Sequence pause/resume"

    inputs:
      - "Campaign calendar"
      - "Conversion metrics"
      - "List health data"
      - "Event timeline"

    outputs:
      - "Send schedules"
      - "Phase status reports"
      - "Performance dashboards"
      - "Optimization recommendations"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Registration to Purchase Rate"
          target: ">20%"
        - name: "VIP Upgrade Rate"
          target: ">15%"
      secondary:
        - "Open Rate >30%"
        - "Click Rate >5%"
        - "Cart Recovery >20%"

  list-segmenter:
    id: list-segmenter
    title: "List Segmentation Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "📋"

    purpose: |
      Ensure every email reaches the right audience by maintaining
      accurate segmentation based on behavior and purchase status.

    segmentation_rules:
      registration_status:
        registered_not_purchased:
          criteria: "opted_in = true AND purchased = false AND abandoned = false"
          receives: ["vip_upsell", "pre_launch", "event_reminder"]

        registered_purchased:
          criteria: "opted_in = true AND purchased = true"
          receives: ["buyer_sequence", "event_reminder", "post_event"]

        cart_abandoner:
          criteria: "cart_created = true AND purchased = false"
          receives: ["cart_recovery"]
          exclude_from: ["vip_upsell"]

        affiliate:
          criteria: "affiliate_registered = true"
          receives: ["affiliate_sequence"]
          note: "May also receive customer sequences"

      purchase_tier:
        vip_only: "$29.99 single book VIP"
        vip_15: "$479.84 VIP + 15 books"
        bundle_200: "$2,999 200-book bundle"
        bundle_800: "$17,994 800-book advisory"

    data_sources:
      - "HubSpot contact properties"
      - "Shopify purchase data"
      - "Cart abandonment webhooks"
      - "Affiliate registration system"

    outputs:
      - "Segment assignment"
      - "Exclusion lists"
      - "Merge variables populated"
      - "Duplicate detection"

  deliverability-monitor:
    id: deliverability-monitor
    title: "Email Deliverability Guardian"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🛡️"

    purpose: |
      Protect sender reputation and ensure emails reach inboxes,
      not spam folders.

    monitoring_metrics:
      critical:
        - metric: "Bounce Rate"
          threshold: "<2%"
          action: "List cleaning if exceeded"
        - metric: "Spam Complaint Rate"
          threshold: "<0.1%"
          action: "Immediate send hold if exceeded"
        - metric: "Unsubscribe Rate"
          threshold: "<0.5%"
          action: "Review content frequency"

      warning:
        - metric: "Open Rate Decline"
          threshold: ">10% drop"
          action: "Subject line review"
        - metric: "Click Rate Decline"
          threshold: ">15% drop"
          action: "CTA/content review"

    actions:
      list_cleaning:
        trigger: "High bounce rate"
        process: ["Remove hard bounces", "Suppress soft bounces >3", "Re-engagement campaign"]

      warm_up:
        trigger: "New IP/domain"
        process: ["Gradual volume increase", "Best engagers first", "Monitor closely"]

    outputs:
      - "Daily health score"
      - "Send throttle recommendations"
      - "Blacklist alerts"
      - "List hygiene reports"

  sequence-writer:
    id: sequence-writer
    title: "Email Sequence Copywriter"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "✍️"

    purpose: |
      Write compelling email and SMS copy that follows proven Hormozi
      templates while adapting to specific campaign needs.

    writing_frameworks:
      aida_u:
        attention: "Subject line that demands open"
        interest: "First line hooks with relevance"
        desire: "Value stack and social proof"
        action: "Single, clear CTA"
        urgency: "Deadline or scarcity element"

      hormozi_patterns:
        personal_tone: "Write like Alex, not corporate"
        value_first: "Lead with benefit, not feature"
        proof_heavy: "Statistics and stories"
        cta_everywhere: "Primary CTA + PS CTA"
        mystery_tease: "Better than NFT, less than Bitcoin"

    template_library:
      registration:
        - "b1: You're registered (confirmation)"
        - "b2: in case you missed this (15min upsell)"
        - "b3: Get your book first (24h upsell)"
        - "b4: Win a day with me (48h affiliate)"
        - "b5: Free Audiobook (72h affiliate follow)"

      pre_launch:
        - "1: I've got a new book (45d)"
        - "2: [Your Invite Inside] (41d)"
        - "3: What's a money model? (35d)"
        - "4: [new pic] - shipment (28d)"
        - "5: I'm giving something HUGE (19d)"
        - "6: Bigger than... (14d)"
        - "7: 5 Mystery headliners (11d)"
        - "8: Money Models (sneak peek) (9d)"
        - "9: Did you miss this? (7d)"

      abandoned_cart:
        - "Abandon 1: Pre-order checkout failed (20min)"
        - "Abandon 2: checkout failed x 2 (24h)"
        - "Abandon 3: Smart link expires tonight (48h)"

      event_reminder:
        - "48 Hours Until..."
        - "Final Countdown..."
        - "goes live in 1 hour!"

      post_event:
        - "$1: VIP Pre-Order Confirmation"
        - "$2: Purchase Confirmation"
        - "$3: Bundle Confirmation"
        - "Redemption Code emails"

      affiliate:
        - "#1: Full List Blast"
        - "#2: Follow-up"
        - "#3: Previous affiliates"
        - "#4: Last chance"
        - "Welcome + goodie"
        - "Leaderboard updates"

    subject_line_patterns:
      direct_benefit: "Get your book first + VIP Livestream"
      curiosity_gap: "I'm giving something HUGE away...LIVE"
      personal: "Because you referred friends last time..."
      urgency: "[FINAL NOTICE] Cart closes at 11:59 pm"
      status: "You're registered. (Save this email)"
      pattern_interrupt: "Did you miss this?"

  automation-builder:
    id: automation-builder
    title: "Marketing Automation Engineer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "⚙️"

    purpose: |
      Build and configure email automation workflows that deliver
      the right message at the right time to the right segment.

    workflow_types:
      trigger_based:
        - trigger: "Form submission"
          action: "Registration confirmation"
          delay: "Immediate"

        - trigger: "No purchase + 15 min"
          action: "VIP upsell"
          condition: "purchased = false"

        - trigger: "Cart abandonment"
          action: "Recovery sequence"
          delays: ["20min", "24h", "48h"]

      time_based:
        - trigger: "Days before event"
          sequence: ["45d", "41d", "35d", "28d", "19d", "14d", "11d", "9d", "7d"]

        - trigger: "Hours before event"
          sequence: ["48h", "24h", "1h"]

      behavior_based:
        - trigger: "Affiliate registration"
          action: "Affiliate welcome sequence"
          frequency: "Weekly updates"

    configuration:
      delays:
        immediate: "0 minutes"
        quick_follow: "15 minutes"
        standard: "24 hours"
        extended: "48-72 hours"

      conditions:
        - "purchased = true/false"
        - "cart_abandoned = true/false"
        - "affiliate = true/false"
        - "segment = [segment_name]"

      smart_links:
        format: "{{smart_link}}"
        includes: ["cart_contents", "user_data", "utm_parameters"]

    outputs:
      - "Configured workflows"
      - "Test sends"
      - "Automation logs"
      - "Error alerts"

  sms-specialist:
    id: sms-specialist
    title: "SMS Marketing Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "📱"

    purpose: |
      Execute compliant SMS campaigns that complement email
      with high-urgency, time-sensitive messages.

    sms_guidelines:
      compliance:
        - "Include opt-out in first message"
        - "Reply STOP to stop"
        - "Respect quiet hours"
        - "Verify consent"

      character_limits:
        standard: "160 characters"
        with_link: "120 characters + URL"
        extended: "320 characters (2 segments)"

      timing:
        best_times: "10am-8pm local time"
        avoid: "Before 9am, after 9pm"
        urgency_window: "24h before deadline"

    template_library:
      registration:
        template: |
          Hey {Name}, it's Alex Hormozi - you'll get 6 more launch texts:
          3 reminders + 3 goodies. Check email for details. Reply "Stop" to stop.
        characters: 147

      announcement:
        template: |
          {Name}, it's Hormozi. Big news. New book(!): 100M Money Models.
          Live launch: Aug 16. Register for free -> signup.acq.com
          Reply Stop to Stop.
        characters: 149

      affiliate:
        template: |
          Alex Hormozi here. You referred friends last book launch.
          This year, the prizes are even juicier. See prizes here:
          refers.acq.com
        characters: 142

      cart_close:
        template: |
          Final hours. After 11:59pm PST tonight. Grab your 90 days
          free on Skool + Lifetime $9/mo: {insert link}
        characters: 105

    outputs:
      - "SMS copy within limits"
      - "Compliance verification"
      - "Delivery reports"
      - "Opt-out processing"

  conversion-optimizer:
    id: conversion-optimizer
    title: "Email Conversion Optimizer"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "📈"

    purpose: |
      Analyze campaign performance and optimize sequences
      for maximum conversion at every stage.

    optimization_areas:
      subject_lines:
        metrics: ["open_rate", "unique_opens"]
        tests: ["curiosity_vs_benefit", "personalized_vs_generic", "length"]
        target: ">30% open rate"

      cta_optimization:
        metrics: ["click_rate", "conversion_rate"]
        tests: ["button_vs_text", "single_vs_multiple", "placement"]
        target: ">5% click rate"

      timing_optimization:
        metrics: ["engagement_by_hour", "conversion_by_delay"]
        tests: ["send_time", "sequence_spacing"]

      segment_optimization:
        metrics: ["conversion_by_segment"]
        tests: ["messaging_variations", "offer_variations"]

    analysis_framework:
      step_1: "Identify lowest converting step"
      step_2: "Hypothesize cause"
      step_3: "Design A/B test"
      step_4: "Implement winner"
      step_5: "Document learning"

    outputs:
      - "Performance reports"
      - "A/B test recommendations"
      - "Winning variations"
      - "Optimization playbook"

  urgency-calibrator:
    id: urgency-calibrator
    title: "Urgency & Scarcity Calibrator"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "⏰"

    purpose: |
      Calibrate urgency and scarcity messaging to maximize
      action without eroding trust.

    urgency_levels:
      level_1_awareness:
        days_out: ">14 days"
        tone: "Exciting news, save the date"
        scarcity: "None"

      level_2_anticipation:
        days_out: "7-14 days"
        tone: "Getting real, don't miss"
        scarcity: "Limited VIP slots"

      level_3_countdown:
        days_out: "3-7 days"
        tone: "Final week, act now"
        scarcity: "Spots filling"

      level_4_urgency:
        days_out: "1-3 days"
        tone: "Last chance"
        scarcity: "Almost full"

      level_5_deadline:
        days_out: "<24 hours"
        tone: "Hours left, now or never"
        scarcity: "Closes at [specific time]"

    scarcity_types:
      time_based: "Offer ends [date/time]"
      quantity_based: "Only [X] spots left"
      bonus_based: "VIP bonuses disappear"
      access_based: "Registration closes"

    calibration_rules:
      - "Never fake scarcity"
      - "Specific deadlines > vague urgency"
      - "Countdown to actual events"
      - "Match urgency to actual constraints"

    outputs:
      - "Urgency level assignment"
      - "Scarcity messaging"
      - "Deadline copy"
      - "Countdown timers"

  personalization-engine:
    id: personalization-engine
    title: "Email Personalization Engine"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Enhance email relevance through smart personalization
      beyond basic merge fields.

    personalization_levels:
      basic:
        fields: ["{FNAME}", "{Name}", "{{first_name}}"]
        usage: "Greeting, sign-off"

      behavioral:
        fields: ["{{smart_link}}", "{{purchase_history}}", "{{last_action}}"]
        usage: "Dynamic CTAs, relevant offers"

      segment_based:
        fields: ["{{segment_content}}", "{{segment_offer}}"]
        usage: "Different value props by segment"

      advanced:
        fields: ["{{ai_recommendation}}", "{{predicted_interest}}"]
        usage: "Hyper-relevant content"

    dynamic_content:
      by_purchase_tier:
        non_purchaser: "Pre-order now"
        vip: "Your VIP access"
        bundle_200: "Your 200-book order"
        bundle_800: "Your Scale Advisory access"

      by_engagement:
        high_engager: "As one of our most engaged..."
        new_subscriber: "Welcome to the..."
        dormant: "We miss you..."

    outputs:
      - "Merge variable mapping"
      - "Dynamic content blocks"
      - "Segment-specific variations"
      - "Personalization audit"

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # Registration Phase
  - task: "Send registration confirmation"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Trigger immediately on form submit"

  - task: "Send VIP upsell (15min)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Exclude purchasers and cart abandoners"

  - task: "Send affiliate invitation (48h)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Exclude previous affiliates"

  # Pre-Launch Phase
  - task: "Send pre-launch sequence emails"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Follow campaign calendar"

  - task: "Write announcement email copy"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Use proven templates, customize for offer"

  - task: "Configure countdown automations"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Test triggers before launch"

  # Abandoned Cart
  - task: "Trigger cart abandonment email 1"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "20 min delay from abandon"

  - task: "Send comparison email (24h)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Include smart link"

  - task: "Send deadline email (48h)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Specific time deadline"

  # Event Reminders
  - task: "Send 48h reminder"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Include all event details"

  - task: "Send 24h reminder"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Personal touch"

  - task: "Send 1h reminder"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "High energy, short"

  # Post-Event
  - task: "Send purchase confirmation"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Segment by purchase tier"

  - task: "Send redemption codes"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Unique codes per buyer"

  - task: "Send bonus access links"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Verify links before send"

  # Affiliate
  - task: "Send affiliate welcome sequence"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Include blackbook link"

  - task: "Generate leaderboard email"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Manual data, automated send"

  - task: "Send affiliate reward notifications"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Verify winner eligibility"

  # SMS
  - task: "Send SMS notifications"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Compliance check, opt-out included"

  # Optimization
  - task: "Analyze campaign performance"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Weekly review minimum"

  - task: "Run A/B tests"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Statistical significance required"

  - task: "Optimize subject lines"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Test against baseline"

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "List Segmentation Gate"
    transition: "Campaign Build -> Send"
    condition: "segments_verified = true AND exclusions_applied = true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Review segmentation rules"

  QG-002:
    name: "Subject Line Gate"
    transition: "Copy -> Automation"
    condition: "subject_length < 60 AND preview_text_set = true"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Shorten subject, add preview"

  QG-003:
    name: "Deliverability Gate"
    transition: "Test -> Send"
    condition: "spam_score < 5 AND links_validated = true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Fix spam triggers, validate links"

  QG-004:
    name: "Personalization Gate"
    transition: "Template -> Send"
    condition: "merge_fields_populated = true AND fallbacks_set = true"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Add fallback values"

  QG-005:
    name: "Compliance Gate"
    transition: "SMS Build -> Send"
    condition: "opt_out_included = true AND consent_verified = true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Add opt-out, verify consent"

  QG-006:
    name: "Timing Gate"
    transition: "Scheduled -> Send"
    condition: "send_time_optimal = true AND no_conflicts = true"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Adjust timing"

# ===============================================================================
# WORKFLOWS
# ===============================================================================

workflows:
  registration_workflow:
    trigger: "New registration form submission"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: list-segmenter
        action: "Assign to registration segment"
        output: "Contact segmented"

      - step: 2
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Trigger confirmation email"
        timing: "Immediate"

      - step: 3
        agent: sms-specialist
        action: "Send welcome SMS"
        timing: "Immediate"
        condition: "phone_number_present"

      - step: 4
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Queue VIP upsell"
        timing: "15 minutes"
        condition: "purchased = false"

      - step: 5
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Queue affiliate invite"
        timing: "48 hours"
        condition: "not_previous_affiliate"

  abandoned_cart_workflow:
    trigger: "Cart abandoned"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: list-segmenter
        action: "Flag as cart abandoner"
        output: "Abandon status set"

      - step: 2
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Trigger recovery email 1"
        timing: "20 minutes"

      - step: 3
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Trigger recovery email 2"
        timing: "24 hours"
        condition: "still_abandoned"

      - step: 4
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Trigger recovery email 3"
        timing: "48 hours"
        condition: "still_abandoned"

  pre_launch_workflow:
    trigger: "Campaign start date"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: sequence-writer
        action: "Prepare announcement email"
        timing: "D-45"

      - step: 2
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Schedule full sequence"
        timing: "D-45 through D-1"

      - step: 3
        agent: conversion-optimizer
        action: "Monitor and optimize"
        timing: "Ongoing"

      - step: 4
        agent: urgency-calibrator
        action: "Escalate urgency"
        timing: "D-14, D-7, D-3, D-1"

  event_reminder_workflow:
    trigger: "48 hours before event"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Send 48h reminder"
        timing: "48 hours before"

      - step: 2
        agent: automation-builder
        action: "Send 24h reminder"
        timing: "24 hours before"
```
