        urgent: "< 15 min - Slack #emergency + SMS"
        important: "< 1 hour - Slack channel + Email"
        regular: "< 4 hours - Project management + Docs"
      dashboard_metrics:
        - metric: "Registros"
          update: "Real-time"
          alert: "<90% expected/hour"
        - metric: "Conversao"
          update: "5 min"
          alert: "<1%"
        - metric: "Faturamento"
          update: "1 min"
          alert: "<$X/min target"
        - metric: "Support queue"
          update: "Real-time"
          alert: ">50 in queue"
        - metric: "Uptime"
          update: "Real-time"
          alert: "<99.9%"

    - agent: contingency-handler
      role: "Gerenciar matriz de contingencia e planos de backup"
      contingency_matrix:
        - problem: "Site down"
          probability: "Low"
          impact: "Critical"
          action: "Failover to backup"
          escalation: "CEO in 5min"
        - problem: "Payment fail"
          probability: "Medium"
          impact: "High"
          action: "Activate backup gateway"
          escalation: "CFO in 15min"
        - problem: "Low conversion"
          probability: "High"
          impact: "Medium"
          action: "Adjust copy/offer"
          escalation: "CMO in 30min"
        - problem: "Ad account ban"
          probability: "Medium"
          impact: "High"
          action: "Switch to backup"
          escalation: "CMO immediate"
        - problem: "Supply shortage"
          probability: "Low"
          impact: "Medium"
          action: "Communicate + compensate"
          escalation: "COO in 1h"
        - problem: "PR crisis"
          probability: "Low"
          impact: "High"
          action: "Holding statement"
          escalation: "CEO immediate"
      escalation_protocol:
        level_1: "Operational: Team Lead -> 15min solution"
        level_2: "Tactical: Area Leader -> 30min solution"
        level_3: "Strategic: Project Owner -> 1h solution"
        level_4: "Critical: CEO/Board -> Immediate decision"

    - agent: post-launch-analyst
      role: "Conduzir post-mortem e documentar learnings"
      post_mortem_framework:
        session_1:
          name: "NUMEROS"
          duration: "2h"
          focus: ["Revenue vs meta", "Custos vs budget", "Conversoes por canal", "LTV vs CAC"]
        session_2:
          name: "QUALITATIVO"
          duration: "2h"
          focus: ["O que funcionou", "O que nao funcionou", "O que fariamos diferente", "Surpresas"]
        session_3:
          name: "PESSOAS"
          duration: "1h"
          focus: ["MVPs", "Gaps de competencia", "Necessidades de treinamento", "Mudancas organizacionais"]
        session_4:
          name: "PROXIMOS PASSOS"
          duration: "1h"
          focus: ["Quick wins", "Mudancas estruturais", "SOPs", "Roadmap proximo lancamento"]

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  launch-coordinator:
    id: launch-coordinator
    title: "Launch Operations Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "🚀"

    purpose: |
      Orquestrar lancamentos completos usando o framework E.V.E.N.T.O,
      coordenar as 8 fases cronologicas, e gerenciar os 10 papeis criticos.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "E.V.E.N.T.O"
        components: ["Escassez", "Valor", "Escada", "Network", "Tensao", "Oferta"]
      - name: "8-Phase Chronology"
        phases: 8
      - name: "10 Critical Roles"
        roles: 10
      - name: "T.E.A.M Framework"
        components: ["Talentos", "Escalabilidade", "Autonomia", "Metricas"]

    decision_authority:
      - "Launch size classification"
      - "Resource allocation"
      - "Timeline approval"
      - "Go/No-Go decision"
      - "Emergency pivots"

    inputs:
      - "Product/offer to launch"
      - "Launch size target"
      - "D-Day date"
      - "Available resources"

    outputs:
      - "Complete launch playbook"
      - "Team structure"
      - "Timeline with milestones"
      - "Contingency matrix"
      - "KPIs and benchmarks"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Revenue vs Target"
          benchmark: ">100%"
        - name: "ROI"
          benchmark: ">131% (2.3X)"
      secondary:
        - "Timeline compliance >95%"
        - "Budget variance <10%"
        - "Show-up rate >30%"

  launch-auditor:
    id: launch-auditor
    title: "Launch Readiness Auditor"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🔍"

    purpose: |
      Auditar preparacao do lancamento e identificar gaps criticos.
      Score de 0-100 com Go/No-Go recommendation.

    audit_checklist:
      evento_framework:
        - "Escassez defined (temporal, quantitative, exclusive)"
        - "Valor stacked (10X minimum)"
        - "Escada de compromisso mapped"
        - "Network effect activated"
        - "Tensao narrativa crafted"
        - "Oferta irrecusavel designed"

      phases_coverage:
        - "Phase 1: Infrastructure ready"
        - "Phase 2: Affiliates activated"
        - "Phase 3: Announcement prepared"
        - "Phase 4: Warmup scheduled"
        - "Phase 5: Event structure defined"
        - "Phase 6: Sales team trained"
        - "Phase 7: Recovery sequences ready"
        - "Phase 8: Post-mortem planned"

      roles_staffing:
        - "Project Owner hired"
        - "Revenue Lead hired"
        - "E-commerce Owner hired"
        - "Media Manager hired"
        - "Marketing Manager hired"
        - "Logistics Manager hired"
        - "Support Lead hired"
        - "Studio Setup hired"
        - "Facilities hired"
        - "Tech Infrastructure hired"

      contingency_matrix:
        - "Site down plan"
        - "Payment fail plan"
        - "Low conversion plan"
        - "Ad account ban plan"
        - "Supply shortage plan"
        - "PR crisis plan"

    scoring_system:
      90_100: "GO - Ready to launch"
      70_89: "CONDITIONAL GO - Minor gaps to close"
      50_69: "DELAY RECOMMENDED - Significant gaps"
      0_49: "NO GO - Critical gaps, not ready"

    outputs:
      - "Readiness score"
      - "Gap prioritization"
      - "Risk assessment"
      - "Go/No-Go recommendation"
      - "Action plan for gaps"

  evento-architect:
    id: evento-architect
    title: "E.V.E.N.T.O Framework Architect"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Aplicar o framework E.V.E.N.T.O a cada elemento do lancamento.
      Garantir que todos os 6 componentes estao presentes e otimizados.

    frameworks:
      escassez:
        description: "Crie um momento unico e irrepetivel no tempo"
        types:
          temporal: "Janela de 24-72 horas"
          quantitativa: "Limite real ou percebido de unidades"
          exclusividade: "Acesso apenas para registrados"
        applications:
          produto_fisico: "Lote limitado da primeira producao"
          servico: "Apenas X vagas com founder/criador"
          b2b: "Piloto exclusivo para primeiros clientes"
          local: "Soft opening apenas para lista VIP"
        anti_pattern: "NUNCA usar escassez falsa"

      valor_empilhado:
        description: "Stack de ofertas que supera o preco em 10X"
        architecture: |
          Produto Core: Valor $X
          + Bonus 1: Valor $Y (Remove objecao principal)
          + Bonus 2: Valor $Z (Acelera resultado)
          + Bonus 3: Valor $W (Seguranca/garantia)
          + Surpresa: Priceless (So hoje)
          = Total: $X+Y+Z+W
          Preco Hoje: $X/3

      escada_compromisso:
        description: "Micro-compromissos levando a grande conversao"
        flow: "Register (Free) -> Show Up -> Engage -> Consider -> Buy Core -> Upsell -> Advocate"

      network_effect:
        description: "Transforme compradores em promotores instantaneos"
        tiers:
          embaixadores: "Top 1% - Acesso antecipado + co-criacao"
          advogados: "Top 10% - Preco especial + bonus exclusivos"
          amplificadores: "Todos - Ganhe ao compartilhar"

      tensao_narrativa:
        description: "Historia com inicio, meio e climax emocional"
        formula: |
          "Ha [tempo] eu [problema doloroso].
          Depois de [jornada/tentativas], descobri [solucao].
          Agora, pela primeira vez, vou [grande revelacao]."
        triggers: ["Curiosidade", "Identificacao", "Autoridade"]

      oferta_irrecusavel:
        description: "Inversao de risco + garantias impossiveis"
        components: ["Valor 10X", "Garantia risk-reversal", "Escassez genuina", "Urgencia real"]

  phase-manager:
    id: phase-manager
    title: "8-Phase Execution Manager"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "📅"

    purpose: |
      Gerenciar execucao sequencial das 8 fases cronologicas.
      Garantir que cada fase entrega seus deliverables no tempo.

    phases:
      phase_1:
        name: "Preparacao"
        timing: "6 semanas antes"
        duration: "2-3 semanas"
        objective: "Construir toda infraestrutura e ativos"
        deliverables:
          - "1000+ variacoes de ads + 2 hero ads"
          - "7 paginas de funil"
          - "30+ sequencias de email"
          - "Infrastructure (LED Wall, estudio virtual)"
          - "Load testing para 1M+ acessos"
          - "10+ pessoas core contratadas"
        triggers: ["Antecipacao", "Curiosidade"]
        resources: "$500K setup"

      phase_2:
        name: "Kickoff Afiliados"
        timing: "6 semanas antes"
        duration: "Continuo ate lancamento"
        objective: "Ativar exercito de promotores com gamificacao"
        deliverables:
          - "Email para lista de afiliados anteriores"
          - "Plataforma de tracking configurada"
          - "Recursos para afiliados (swipes, ads, videos)"
        triggers: ["Competicao", "Exclusividade", "Recompensa"]
        incentive_tiers:
          top_10: "Jantar privado + Fireside chat + Workshop presencial"
          top_50: "Workshop presencial + Q&A grupo"
          10_signups: "Sorteio para workshop + Audiobook exclusivo"
          all: "$100M Ads Folder + Blackbook + Gravacao HD"

      phase_3:
        name: "Anuncio Publico"
        timing: "4 semanas antes"
        duration: "1 semana"
        objective: "Criar buzz e iniciar registros"
        deliverables:
          - "Video announcement no YouTube"
          - "Ads iniciados com $10K/dia"
          - "5 videos organicos"
          - "4-5 podcasts estrategicos"
        triggers: ["Prova Social", "Autoridade", "FOMO"]

      phase_4:
        name: "Aquecimento"
        timing: "3 semanas antes"
        duration: "3 semanas"
        objective: "Escalar registros para 1M+ pessoas"
        deliverables:
          - "Escalonamento de ads $10K -> $250K/dia"
          - "1M+ registros"
          - "Regra 7-7-7 omnipresenca"
        content_strategy:
          week_3: "PROBLEMA - Dados, casos, controversias"
          week_2: "POSSIBILIDADE - Demonstracoes, bastidores, teasers"
          week_1: "PROMESSA - Countdown, social proof, urgencia"
        metrics:
          target: "1M+ registros, CAC < $3"
        resources: "$3M budget de ads"

      phase_5:
        name: "Evento Ao Vivo"
        timing: "Dia D"
        duration: "4+ horas"
        objective: "Converter massa em compradores"
        structure:
          block_1: "90 min - Webinar principal"
          block_2: "60-90 min - 6 Guest speakers surpresa"
          block_3: "30+ min - Giveaways e FAQ"
        triggers: ["Reciprocidade", "Autoridade", "Escassez", "Prova Social"]
        streaming:
          - "YouTube Principal (publico geral)"
          - "YouTube VIP (acesso exclusivo)"
          - "Zoom Backup (contingencia)"
          - "Gravacao 4K"

      phase_6:
        name: "Facilitacao de Vendas"
        timing: "Durante evento"
        duration: "24 horas"
        objective: "Maximizar conversao com suporte"
        team_structure:
          senior_closers: "10 pessoas - high-ticket $5,998+"
          mid_closers: "40 pessoas - mid-ticket $450"
          sdrs_chat: "250 pessoas - core offer $30"
        shifts:
          morning: "06:00-14:00 (125 pessoas)"
          peak: "12:00-20:00 (300 pessoas)"
          night: "18:00-02:00 (125 pessoas)"
        metrics:
          conversion: ">15%"
          queue_wait: "<30 calls"
          abandonment: "<5%"

      phase_7:
        name: "Cart Close"
        timing: "3 dias apos"
        duration: "72 horas"
        objective: "Urgencia final e recuperacao"
        recovery_sequence:
          during_event: "Email 'Voce saiu antes da melhor parte' + SMS extending offer"
          day_1: "Oferta degradada + Depoimentos de compradores"
          day_2: "Preco aumenta + Remove bonus"
          day_3: "FECHANDO EM 1 HORA"
        insight: "50-60% de todas as vendas acontecem nas ultimas 4 horas"

      phase_8:
        name: "PR e Maximizacao"
        timing: "Pos-lancamento"
        duration: "2-4 semanas"
        objective: "Capitalizar em autoridade e recordes"
        post_launch_actions:
          immediate: "Onboarding memoravel, Surprise & delight, Pedido de depoimento"
          first_week: "Caso de sucesso, Comunidade exclusiva, Upsell"
          first_month: "Evento para compradores, Preview proximo lancamento, Programa embaixadores"

  team-builder:
    id: team-builder
    title: "10 Critical Roles Builder"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "👥"

    purpose: |
      Estruturar e dimensionar os 10 papeis criticos para o tamanho do lancamento.
      Definir KPIs, hiring timeline, e protocolos de coordenacao.

    sizing_by_launch:
      micro:
        registrations: "10K"
        budget: "$10K"
        team: "3 pessoas"
        duration: "2 semanas"
        roles: ["Project Owner (simplified)", "Sales/Marketing", "Tech/Support"]
      small:
        registrations: "50K"
        budget: "$50K"
        team: "5 pessoas"
        duration: "3 semanas"
        roles: ["Project Owner", "Sales Lead", "Marketing", "Tech", "Support"]
      medium:
        registrations: "250K"
        budget: "$250K"
        team: "10 pessoas"
        duration: "4 semanas"
        roles: "All 10 roles (1 per role)"
      large:
        registrations: "500K"
        budget: "$1M"
        team: "20 pessoas"
        duration: "5 semanas"
        roles: "All 10 roles (2 per role average)"
      mega:
        registrations: "1M+"
        budget: "$3M+"
        team: "30+ pessoas"
        duration: "6 semanas"
        roles: "All 10 roles (3+ per role)"

    hiring_timeline:
      s_12: "Aprovacao headcount e budget"
      s_10: "Job descriptions e divulgacao"
      s_8: "Primeira rodada entrevistas"
      s_6: "Entrevistas finais e ofertas"
      s_4: "Onboarding e treinamento"
      s_2: "Simulacoes e role-play"
      s_1: "War games e briefing final"

    onboarding_program:
      day_1: "CONTEXTO - Visao, historico, cultura, conhecer time"
      day_2: "PRODUTO - Oferta, USPs, personas, competidores"
      day_3: "PROCESSOS - Ferramentas, SOPs, workflows, comunicacao"
      day_4: "PRATICA - Shadowing, exercicios, simulacoes, feedback"
      day_5: "CERTIFICACAO - Teste, role-play avaliado, certificacao, go-live"

  war-room-commander:
    id: war-room-commander
    title: "War Room Operations Commander"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🎖️"

    purpose: |
      Comandar operacoes da sala de guerra durante D-Day.
      Monitorar metricas em tempo real e executar protocolo de escalacao.

    war_room_essentials:
      - "WAR ROOM BIBLE - Documento unico com tudo"
      - "CONTACT MATRIX - Telefones, WhatsApp, responsabilidades"
      - "DYNAMIC FAQ - Atualizado em tempo real"
      - "SCRIPTS BOOK - Todos os scripts por situacao"
      - "EMERGENCY PROCEDURES - Passo a passo para cada crise"
      - "VENDOR CONTACTS - Fornecedores com SLAs"
      - "LEGAL CLEARANCES - Aprovacoes e disclaimers"
      - "BACKUP PLANS - Plano B para cada sistema"

    d_day_timeline:
      "05:00": "Chegada e setup inicial"
      "06:00": "Checagem de todos os sistemas"
      "07:00": "Briefing geral com 200+ pessoas"
      "08:00": "Ensaio final"
      "09:00": "INICIO DO EVENTO"
      "12:00": "Status update"
      "15:00": "Numeros parciais"
      "18:00": "Ajustes evening"
      "21:00": "Wrap up e preparacao dia seguinte"

    meeting_cadence:
      during_launch:
        - "06:00 - Pre-flight check (30min)"
        - "09:00 - Go-live briefing (15min)"
        - "12:00 - Status update (10min)"
        - "15:00 - Numeros parciais (10min)"
        - "18:00 - Ajustes evening (15min)"
        - "21:00 - Wrap-up do dia (30min)"
        - "00:00 - Overnight briefing (15min)"

    command_center_dashboard:
      metrics:
        - name: "Registros"
          update: "Real-time"
          visual: "Counter"
          alert: "<90% expected/hour"
        - name: "Conversao"
          update: "5 min"
          visual: "Grafico"
          alert: "<1%"
        - name: "Faturamento"
          update: "1 min"
          visual: "Ticker"
          alert: "<target/min"
        - name: "Support Queue"
          update: "Real-time"
          visual: "Queue"
          alert: ">50 in queue"
        - name: "Uptime"
          update: "Real-time"
          visual: "Status"
          alert: "<99.9%"
        - name: "Ad Spend"
          update: "15 min"
          visual: "Burn rate"
          alert: ">110% budget/hour"
        - name: "Refunds"
          update: "30 min"
          visual: "Numero"
          alert: ">2%"

  contingency-handler:
    id: contingency-handler
    title: "Contingency & Crisis Manager"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🚨"

    purpose: |
      Gerenciar matriz de contingencia e executar planos de backup.
      Protocolo de escalacao em 4 niveis.

    contingency_matrix:
      - problem: "Site down"
        probability: "Baixa"
        impact: "Critico"
        immediate_action: "Failover para backup"
        responsible: "Tech Lead"
        escalation: "CEO em 5min"
      - problem: "Payment fail"
        probability: "Media"
        impact: "Alto"
        immediate_action: "Ativar gateway backup"
        responsible: "Tech + Finance"
        escalation: "CFO em 15min"
      - problem: "Low conversion"
        probability: "Alta"
        impact: "Medio"
        immediate_action: "Ajustar copy/oferta"
        responsible: "Revenue + Product"
        escalation: "CMO em 30min"
      - problem: "Ad account ban"
        probability: "Media"
        impact: "Alto"
        immediate_action: "Switch para backup"
        responsible: "Marketing"
        escalation: "CMO imediato"
      - problem: "Supply shortage"
        probability: "Baixa"
        impact: "Medio"
        immediate_action: "Comunicar + compensar"
        responsible: "Ops + CS"
        escalation: "COO em 1h"
      - problem: "PR crisis"
        probability: "Baixa"
        impact: "Alto"
        immediate_action: "Holding statement"
        responsible: "PR + Legal"
        escalation: "CEO imediato"

    escalation_protocol:
      level_1:
        name: "Operacional"
        flow: "Problema -> Team Lead -> Solucao em 15min"
      level_2:
        name: "Tatico"
        flow: "Team Lead -> Lider de Area -> Solucao em 30min"
      level_3:
        name: "Estrategico"
        flow: "Lider de Area -> Project Owner -> Solucao em 1h"
      level_4:
        name: "Critico"
        flow: "Project Owner -> CEO/Board -> Decisao imediata"

    disaster_recovery:
      level_1: "CDN alternativo (30 seg)"
      level_2: "Servidor backup (2 min)"
      level_3: "Regiao alternativa (5 min)"
      level_4: "Processamento manual (10 min)"
      level_5: "Pagina estatica emergencial"

  post-launch-analyst:
    id: post-launch-analyst
    title: "Post-Launch Analysis Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "📊"

    purpose: |
      Conduzir post-mortem estruturado e documentar learnings.
      Garantir que cada lancamento alimenta o proximo.

    post_mortem_framework:
      session_1_numbers:
        duration: "2h"
        agenda:
          - "Revenue vs Meta"
          - "Custos vs Budget"
          - "Conversoes por canal"
          - "LTV vs CAC"
          - "KPIs por fase"
          - "Metricas por papel"

      session_2_qualitative:
        duration: "2h"
        agenda:
          - "O que funcionou?"
          - "O que nao funcionou?"
          - "O que fariamos diferente?"
          - "Surpresas positivas"
          - "Surpresas negativas"
          - "Feedback do time"

      session_3_people:
        duration: "1h"
        agenda:
          - "MVPs do lancamento"
          - "Gaps de competencia"
          - "Necessidades de treinamento"
          - "Mudancas organizacionais"
          - "Score cards por papel"
          - "Bonuses e reconhecimento"

      session_4_next_steps:
        duration: "1h"
        agenda:
          - "Quick wins para implementar"
          - "Mudancas estruturais necessarias"
          - "SOPs a criar/atualizar"
          - "Roadmap proximo lancamento"
          - "Calendario tentativo"
          - "Recursos necessarios"

    score_card_template: |
      NOME: [Nome]
      FUNCAO: [Cargo]
      PERIODO: [Lancamento X]

      KPIs PRIMARIOS (70% peso):
      - KPI 1: [Meta] vs [Realizado] = ___%
      - KPI 2: [Meta] vs [Realizado] = ___%
      - KPI 3: [Meta] vs [Realizado] = ___%

      KPIs SECUNDARIOS (20% peso):
      - Colaboracao: [1-10]
      - Proatividade: [1-10]
      - Problem-solving: [1-10]

      WILD CARDS (10% peso):
      - Ideias implementadas: ___
      - Crises resolvidas: ___
      - Acima e alem: ___

      SCORE FINAL: ___/100
      RANKING: ___/[Total team]

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # E.V.E.N.T.O Framework
  - task: "Design escassez strategy"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must be genuine scarcity, never fake"

  - task: "Build valor stack"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Must exceed 10X price"

  - task: "Map escada de compromisso"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Each step leads to next"

  - task: "Activate network effect"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Affiliate tracking platform required"

  - task: "Morpheus tensao narrativa"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must follow formula"

  - task: "Design oferta irrecusavel"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Risk reversal required"

  # 8 Phases Execution
  - task: "Phase 1: Produce 1000+ ads"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "10 headlines x 5 copies x 20 formats x 5 CTAs"

  - task: "Phase 2: Activate affiliates"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Tracking platform configured"

  - task: "Phase 3: Launch announcement"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Video + ads + podcasts"

  - task: "Phase 4: Scale ads"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "$10K -> $250K/day scaling"

  - task: "Phase 5: Execute live event"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "4+ hours, 3 blocks"

  - task: "Phase 6: Manage sales floor"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "300 sellers, 3 shifts"

  - task: "Phase 7: Cart close recovery"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "72h sequence automated"

  - task: "Phase 8: Post-mortem"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "4 sessions framework"

  # War Room Operations
  - task: "Monitor real-time metrics"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Dashboard updated per second"

  - task: "Execute escalation protocol"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "4-level protocol"

  - task: "Activate contingency plans"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Pre-defined playbooks"

  - task: "Coordinate team communication"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Hierarchy of urgency"

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Launch Readiness Gate"
    transition: "Planning -> Execution"
    condition: "readiness_score >= 70"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Delay launch, close gaps"

  QG-002:
    name: "E.V.E.N.T.O Completeness Gate"
    transition: "Framework Design -> Announcement"
    condition: "all_6_components_defined == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Complete missing components"

  QG-003:
    name: "Team Readiness Gate"
    transition: "Hiring -> Training"
    condition: "10_roles_filled AND training_complete"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Expedite hiring or training"

  QG-004:
    name: "Tech Load Test Gate"
    transition: "Setup -> Launch"
    condition: "load_test_passed_10x"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Scale infrastructure"

  QG-005:
    name: "Contingency Test Gate"
    transition: "Preparation -> D-Day"
    condition: "all_contingencies_tested"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Complete contingency drills"

  QG-006:
    name: "Registration Target Gate"
    transition: "Warmup -> Event"
    condition: "registrations >= target * 0.9"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Increase ad spend or extend warmup"

  QG-007:
    name: "Post-Mortem Completion Gate"
    transition: "Launch -> Next Launch Planning"
    condition: "4_sessions_complete AND learnings_documented"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Complete post-mortem before next launch"

# ===============================================================================
# WORKFLOWS
# ===============================================================================

workflows:
  launch_planning_workflow:
    trigger: "New launch requested"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: sizing-analyst
        action: "Classify launch size (Micro/Small/Medium/Large/Mega)"
        output: "Size classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: evento-architect
        action: "Apply E.V.E.N.T.O framework"
        output: "Complete framework design"

      - step: 3
        agent: phase-manager
        action: "Create 8-phase timeline"
        output: "Timeline with milestones"

      - step: 4
        agent: team-builder
        action: "Define 10 roles for size"
        output: "Team structure"

      - step: 5
        agent: contingency-handler
        action: "Build contingency matrix"
        output: "Complete contingency plan"

      - step: 6
        agent: launch-auditor
        action: "Audit readiness"
        output: "Readiness score and Go/No-Go"

  execution_workflow:
    trigger: "Go decision approved"
    phases:
      - phase: "Preparation"
        duration: "2-3 weeks"
        agents: ["team-builder", "evento-architect"]
        deliverables: ["Infrastructure", "Ads", "Funnels", "Emails"]

      - phase: "Affiliate Kickoff"
        duration: "Continuous"
        agents: ["phase-manager"]
        deliverables: ["Affiliate activation", "Tracking", "Resources"]

      - phase: "Announcement"
        duration: "1 week"
        agents: ["phase-manager"]
        deliverables: ["Video", "Ads", "Podcasts"]

      - phase: "Warmup"
        duration: "3 weeks"
        agents: ["phase-manager"]
        deliverables: ["1M+ registrations", "Ad scaling"]

      - phase: "Live Event"
        duration: "4+ hours"
        agents: ["war-room-commander"]
        deliverables: ["Event execution", "Real-time coordination"]

      - phase: "Sales Facilitation"
        duration: "24 hours"
        agents: ["war-room-commander"]
        deliverables: ["Sales conversion", "Support"]

      - phase: "Cart Close"
        duration: "72 hours"
        agents: ["phase-manager"]
        deliverables: ["Recovery", "Final urgency"]

      - phase: "PR & Maximization"
        duration: "2-4 weeks"
        agents: ["post-launch-analyst"]
        deliverables: ["Post-mortem", "Learnings", "Next launch preview"]

  contingency_workflow:
    trigger: "Problem detected"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: war-room-commander
        action: "Identify problem severity"
        output: "Severity classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: contingency-handler
        action: "Look up contingency plan"
        output: "Pre-defined response"

      - step: 3
        agent: war-room-commander
        action: "Execute immediate action"
        output: "Action taken"

      - step: 4
        agent: contingency-handler
        action: "Escalate if needed"
        condition: "If not resolved in SLA"

      - step: 5
        agent: war-room-commander
        action: "Document and report"
        output: "Incident report"

  post_launch_workflow:
    trigger: "Launch completed"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: post-launch-analyst
        action: "Session 1: Numbers analysis"
        duration: "2h"

      - step: 2
        agent: post-launch-analyst
        action: "Session 2: Qualitative review"
        duration: "2h"

      - step: 3
        agent: post-launch-analyst
        action: "Session 3: People assessment"
        duration: "1h"

      - step: 4
        agent: post-launch-analyst
        action: "Session 4: Next steps"
        duration: "1h"

      - step: 5
        agent: launch-coordinator
        action: "Document learnings for replicable system"
        output: "Updated SOPs and playbooks"

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/lead-magnet-sop.md

# Lead Magnet Creation SOP

> **Source:** $100M Leads - Alex Hormozi, Section II: "Engaje Seus Leads: Ofertas e Lead Magnets"
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Create lead magnets that get more leads to engage and more customers for less money. A lead magnet is **a complete solution to a specific problem** that, once solved, **reveals another problem solved by your main offer**.

**Core Definition:**
```
Lead Magnet = Complete solution to narrow problem
           + Reveals problem solved by core offer
           + Valuable enough to charge for (but given free/low-cost)
```

**Business Impact:** A good lead magnet can get you 10x more engaged leads for the same cost as advertising your core offer alone. This translates to 3x reduction in customer acquisition cost.

**Example from Source:**
> "Imagine que você anuncia um lead magnet gratuito em vez da sua oferta principal. Seu lead magnet custa $25 para entregar, e porque e gratis para eles, mais se engajarao. O engajamento extra significa que custa apenas $75 em publicidade para colocar alguem em uma ligacao. No total, sao $100 por ligacao. Ao entregar valor antes de comprarem, voce consegue dez vezes mais leads engajados pelo mesmo custo." (p.302-307)

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Creating new lead magnets for any product or service
- Optimizing existing lead magnets that underperform
- Testing lead magnet names, formats, and delivery methods
- Designing the Problem-Solution Cycle for offers

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- Advertising the lead magnet (covered in Core Four playbooks)
- Long-term nurture sequences after lead magnet consumption
- Core offer creation (covered in $100M Offers)

### Business Types
- B2B and B2C
- High-ticket (most common) and low-ticket
- Service businesses, SaaS, info products, physical products
- Any business wanting more engaged leads before the sale

---

## Part 3: Preconditions

| Precondition | Requirement | Validation |
|--------------|-------------|------------|
| Core Offer Defined | Main product/service exists | Offer is sellable |
| Target Customer Known | Specific audience identified | Can describe ideal customer |
| Problem Understanding | Know problems your audience has | List of 5+ problems documented |
| Delivery Capability | Can deliver chosen format | Infrastructure exists or can be built |
| Testing Mechanism | Way to test names/headlines | Access to audience or ad platform |
| Budget for Delivery | Can afford delivery cost per lead | ROI calculation shows positive return |

---

## Part 4: The Problem-Solution Cycle Framework

### Framework Overview

```
+------------------+     +-----------------+     +------------------+
|    PROBLEM 1     | --> |   SOLUTION 1    | --> |    PROBLEM 2     |
| (Narrow/Specific)|     | (Lead Magnet)   |     | (Revealed)       |
+------------------+     +-----------------+     +------------------+
                                                          |
                                                          v
                                                 +------------------+
                                                 |   SOLUTION 2     |
                                                 | (Core Offer - $) |
                                                 +------------------+
```

**Source Reference:**
> "Todo problema tem uma solucao. Toda solucao revela mais problemas. Este e o ciclo interminavel de negocios (e vida). E ciclos menores de problema-solucao ficam dentro de ciclos maiores de problema-solucao." (p.133-138)

### Three Types of Lead Magnets

| Type | Mechanism | Best When | Example |
|------|-----------|-----------|---------|
| **Reveal Problems** | Diagnosis that shows gap | Problems worsen over time | Speed test showing 30% below standard |
| **Samples & Trials** | Full access, limited time/uses | Core offer solves recurring problem | 30-day free trial, sample pack |
| **One Step of Multi-Step** | Give one step, sell the rest | Core offer is complex process | Free first coat of 3-coat sealer |

---

## Part 5: Process Steps

### Step 1: Discover the Problem to Solve and for Whom

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Choose a narrow, specific problem that reveals a problem your core offer solves |
| **Cognitive Type** | Analysis + Judgment |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires strategic thinking |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Core offer defined, target customer known |
| **Output** | Specific problem statement + target audience |
| **Guardrails** | Problem must be narrow (not broad), must reveal next problem |
| **Decision Rule** | "If solving this reveals a problem my core offer solves = winner" |

**Source Reference:**
> "Comecamos escolhendo um problema que e estreito e significativo. Entao, resolve-lo. E, como acabamos de aprender, quando resolvemos um problema, um novo problema se revela. Aqui vem a parte importante - se podemos resolver esse novo problema com nossa oferta principal, temos um vencedor." (p.138-140)

**Example from Source - Real Estate:**
> "Imagine que ajudamos proprietarios de imoveis a vender suas casas. Essa e uma solucao ampla. Mas e os passos antes de vender uma casa? Os proprietarios querem saber quanto vale sua casa. Eles querem saber como aumentar seu valor. Eles precisam de fotos. Eles precisam que seja limpa. Eles precisam de paisagismo. Eles precisam de pequenos reparos. Eles precisam de servicos de mudanca. Eles podem precisar de staging. Etc. Esses sao todos problemas especificos - otimos para lead magnets." (p.140-142)

**Action Step:**
> "Escolha o problema especificamente definido que voce quer resolver. Entao, certifique-se de que sua oferta principal possa resolver o proximo problema que surge." (p.143-144)

---

### Step 2: Figure Out How to Solve It

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Choose which of the 3 lead magnet types best solves your chosen problem |
| **Cognitive Type** | Analysis + Creativity |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Strategic decision |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Problem defined from Step 1 |
| **Output** | Lead magnet type selected (Reveal, Sample/Trial, or One Step) |
| **Guardrails** | Type must match problem nature and core offer structure |
| **Decision Rule** | See Type Selection Matrix below |

**Type Selection Matrix:**

| If Your Situation Is... | Choose Type | Why |
|------------------------|-------------|-----|
| Audience has problem they don't know | Reveal Problems | Makes them aware + creates urgency |
| Core offer solves recurring problem | Samples & Trials | Let them experience full value briefly |
| Core offer is multi-step process | One Step of Multi-Step | Give valuable step, sell rest |

**Type 1: Reveal Problems - "Diagnosis"**

> "Esses lead magnets funcionam muito bem quando revelam problemas que pioram quanto mais voce espera." (p.151-158)

Examples from Source:
- Speed test showing website loads 30% slower than it should
- Posture analysis showing gap between current and ideal posture
- Termite inspection revealing damage or prevention opportunity

**Type 2: Samples & Trials**

> "Voce da acesso completo mas breve a sua oferta principal. Voce pode limitar o numero de usos, o tempo de acesso, ou ambos. Isso funciona muito bem quando sua oferta principal e uma solucao recorrente para um problema recorrente." (p.160-167)

Examples from Source:
- Connect to faster server, show website at light speed
- Free chiropractic adjustment showing relief
- Single-serving food samples (how Costco sells more food)

**Type 3: One Step of Multi-Step Process**

> "Quando sua oferta principal tem passos, voce pode dar um passo valioso de graca e o resto quando comprarem. Isso funciona muito bem quando sua oferta principal resolve um problema mais complexo." (p.169-176)

Examples from Source:
- This book ($100M Leads) - helps get to $1M, then reveals scaling problems
- Free first coat of 3-coat wood sealer system
- Free finance courses/guides that reveal time investment needed

**Action Step:**
> "Escolha como voce quer resolver seu problema especificamente definido." (p.178)

---

### Step 3: Figure Out How to Deliver It

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Choose delivery format: Software, Information, Services, or Physical Products |
| **Cognitive Type** | Creativity + Synthesis |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Format selection can follow patterns |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Problem and solution type defined |
| **Output** | Delivery format selected + initial concept |
| **Guardrails** | Consider creating multiple formats for same solution |
| **Decision Rule** | "Make as many versions as you can and rotate them" |

**Four Delivery Methods:**

| Method | Description | Gym Owner Example |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Software** | Tool that does work for them (spreadsheet, calculator, app) | Dashboard with business stats, industry comparison, rating |
| **Information** | Teaching (courses, lessons, interviews, tips) | Mini course on how to write an ad |
| **Services** | Free work done for them | Run their ads free for 30 days |
| **Physical Products** | Something they can hold | Book called "Gym Launch Secrets" |

**Source Reference:**
> "Com tres tipos diferentes de lead magnets e quatro maneiras de entrega-los, sao ate doze lead magnets que resolvem um unico problema especifico. Tantos imas, tao pouco tempo!" (p.192)

**Key Insight:**
> "Faco tantas versoes de um lead magnet quanto posso e as rotaciono. Isso mantem a publicidade fresca e com pouco esforco. Alem disso, voce ve quais funcionam melhor. Como minha historia de estudo de caso no inicio do capitulo, os resultados sao frequentemente surpreendentes. E voce nao sabera ate tentar." (p.193-195)

**Action Step:**
> "Como exercicio de pensamento, pense em um lead magnet e depois em uma versao dele para cada metodo de entrega. Voce sempre pode, eu prometo. Entao, escolha como entregar seu lead magnet." (p.196-197)

---

### Step 4: Test How to Name It

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Test title, image, and subtitle to maximize engagement |
| **Cognitive Type** | Analysis + Testing |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH - Can run A/B tests automatically |
| **Executor** | Hybrid (Worker runs tests, Human decides winners) |
| **Precondition** | Lead magnet concept created |
| **Output** | Winning name/title, image, subtitle |
| **Guardrails** | Test in order: Title first, then Image, then Subtitle |
| **Decision Rule** | "If people engage in mass, you have a winner" |

**Source Reference - David Ogilvy:**
> "Quando voce escreveu seu titulo, voce gastou 80 centavos do seu dolar (de publicidade). O que isso significa e que cinco vezes mais pessoas leem seu titulo do que qualquer outra parte da sua promocao." (p.199-200)

**Testing Order:**
1. **Title** - Most important (test first)
2. **Image** - Second most important
3. **Subtitle** - Third

**Example - $100M Leads Testing Results:**

Title Tests:
- Advertising vs. Promotion -> Advertising won
- Advertising vs. Leads -> Leads won
- Marketing vs. Leads -> Leads won

Image Tests:
- Real vs. Cartoon -> Real won

Subtitle Tests:
- "How to make more people want to buy your stuff" vs. "How to make strangers want to buy your stuff" -> Strangers won
- "How to make more strangers want to buy your stuff" vs. "How to make strangers want to buy your stuff" -> Removing "more" won
- "Make strangers want to buy your stuff" vs. "How to make strangers want to buy your stuff" -> Adding "How to" won

**Key Insight:**
> "Pequenas mudancas podem fazer grandes diferencas." (p.231)

**Action Step:**
> "Teste. Se as pessoas se engajam em massa, voce tem um vencedor. E se voce tem algum seguidor, pode fazer enquetes como essas. Voce nao precisa de muitos votos para ter uma ideia direcional. Se nao pode fazer isso, faca um post em cada plataforma e peca as pessoas para responderem com um '1' ou um '2', depois conte. Se ainda nao consegue fazer isso, entao apenas envie mensagens para as pessoas e pergunte." (p.236)

**Bonus Signal:**
> "Se as pessoas respondem a enquete e perguntam quando podem colocar as maos nele, voce tem um mega vencedor." (p.238-239)

---

### Step 5: Make It Easy to Consume

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Package lead magnet in multiple formats to maximize consumption |
| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis + Perception |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Format conversion can be automated |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Lead magnet created |
| **Output** | Multi-format lead magnet package |
| **Guardrails** | Offer ALL formats, let them choose |
| **Decision Rule** | "More formats = 2-4x more engagement for same work" |

**Source Reference:**
> "As pessoas preferem fazer coisas que exigem menos esforco. Entao, se queremos que mais pessoas aceitem nosso lead magnet e o consumam, precisamos torna-lo facil. Voce pode ver aumentos de 2x, 3x e ate 4x+ nas taxas de aceitacao e consumo simplesmente tornando-o mais facil de consumir." (p.241-243)

**Format Optimization by Delivery Type:**

| Delivery Type | How to Make Easy |
|---------------|------------------|
| **Software** | Accessible on phone + computer + multiple formats |
| **Information** | Video + Text + Audio + Images - offer all |
| **Services** | More hours, more days, more channels (video, phone, in-person) |
| **Physical Products** | Easy ordering, fast shipping, simple opening, clear instructions |

**$100M Offers Example:**
> "Meu livro $100M Offers tem uma divisao quase perfeita de 1/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4 entre ebooks, livros fisicos, audiolivros e videos (gratis em Acquisition.com). Tornar o livro disponivel em varios formatos e a maneira mais facil que conheco de obter 2-3-4x a quantidade de leads pelo mesmo trabalho." (p.253-255)

**Action Step:**
> "Empacote seu lead magnet de todas as maneiras que puder. Isso aumenta dramaticamente quantos leads engajados vem em sua direcao. E mais leads se engajando com seu lead magnet significa mais leads obtendo valor dele." (p.252)

---

### Step 6: Make It Really Good

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Make lead magnet so valuable people feel obligated to pay you |
| **Cognitive Type** | Judgment + Creativity |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Quality requires human judgment |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Lead magnet created and formatted |
| **Output** | High-value lead magnet that exceeds expectations |
| **Guardrails** | Free stuff should be as good as paid stuff |
| **Decision Rule** | "Give away the secrets, sell the implementation" |

**Core Philosophy:**
> "O mercado julga tudo o que voce tem a oferecer - gratis ou nao. E voce nunca pode fornecer valor demais. Mas voce pode fornecer de menos. Entao voce quer que seu lead magnet forneca tanto valor que as pessoas se sintam obrigadas a pagar voce. O objetivo e fornecer mais valor do que o custo da sua oferta principal antes de comprarem." (p.257-259)

**Why Give Away Secrets:**
> "Se voce tem medo de distribuir seus segredos, imagine a alternativa: Voce distribui porcaria sem valor. Entao, pessoas que poderiam ter se tornado clientes pensam 'essa pessoa e pessima! Eles so tem porcaria sem valor!' Entao, eles compram de outra pessoa. Tao triste. Nao apenas isso, eles dizem a outras pessoas que poderiam ter comprado de voce, para nao comprar. E um ciclo vicioso que voce nao quer andar." (p.260-261)

**Buying Psychology:**
> "As pessoas compram coisas baseado em quanto valor elas acham que vao obter depois de comprar. E a maneira mais facil de faze-las pensar que vao obter toneladas de valor depois de comprar e... rufem os tambores por favor... fornecer a elas valor antes de comprarem." (p.262-263)

**Action Step:**
> "99% das pessoas nao vao comprar, mas elas criarao (ou destruirao) sua reputacao baseada no valor das suas coisas gratuitas. Entao, faca seus lead magnets tao bons quanto suas coisas pagas. Sua reputacao depende disso. Forneca valor. Empilhe o baralho. Colha as recompensas." (p.266-267)

---

### Step 7: Make It Easy for Them to Say They Want More

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Include clear Call To Action with reasons to act now |
| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis + Persuasion |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Templates can be automated |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Lead magnet delivered/consumed |
| **Output** | CTA that converts consumers to buyers |
| **Guardrails** | Clear + Simple + Frequent + With Reasons |
| **Decision Rule** | "Don't be clever, be clear" |

**CTA Components:**

| Component | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| **What to Do** | Clear action | "Call now", "Click here", "Book a call" |
| **Reasons to Act Now** | Why not delay | Scarcity, Urgency, Invented reasons |

**Source Reference:**
> "Uma vez que os leads consomem o lead magnet, alguns deles estarao prontos para comprar ou aprender mais sobre sua oferta. Este e o momento de dar uma Chamada Para Acao (CTA - Call To Action). Trinity CTA diz a audiencia o que fazer a seguir. Mas ha um pouco mais do que isso... Boas CTAs tem duas coisas: 1) o que fazer e 2) razoes para fazer agora mesmo." (p.269-273)

**Three Types of Reasons:**

**a) Scarcity (Limited Quantity)**
> "Quando algo e escasso, como seu lead magnet ou oferta, as pessoas tambem tendem a quere-lo mais... A melhor estrategia que conheco para escassez e - realidade." (p.276-277)

Examples:
- "Os horarios de aula mais convenientes preenchem rapido. Ligue agora para conseguir o que voce quer."
- "So posso lidar com cinco pessoas por semana, entao se voce quer resolver logo, faca xyz..."
- "Imprimimos apenas um lote de camisas e nunca reimprimiremos este design..."

**b) Urgency (Limited Time)**
> "Urgencia e quando as pessoas agem mais rapido porque tem pouco tempo. E quanto menos tempo as pessoas tem, mais rapido (mais urgente) elas tendem a agir." (p.284)

Examples:
- "Nossa promocao de 4 de julho termina segunda-feira a meia-noite, entao se voce quiser, aja agora."
- "Nossa promocao de Black Friday termina a meia-noite. Restam apenas quatro horas."
- "Ate sexta-feira, tambem vou dar um chapeu gratis para quem comprar mais de tres livros."

**c) Invented Reasons (Frat Party Host)**
> "Sua razao nem precisa fazer sentido, e ainda fara mais pessoas agirem. Na verdade, Harvard fez um experimento mostrando que as pessoas eram mais propensas a deixar alguem furar a fila se apenas dessem uma razao." (p.292-293)

Examples:
- "Porque... maes sabem melhor."
- "Porque... seu pais precisa de voce."
- "Porque... e meu aniversario, e quero que voce comemore comigo."

**Action Step:**
> "De uma CTA clara, simples e orientada para acao. Entao, de a eles um 'motivo' usando escassez, urgencia e quaisquer outras razoes que voce possa pensar. E faca isso com frequencia. Nao seja esperto, seja claro." (p.298-299)

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Problem Selection
```yaml
rule: PROBLEM_SELECTION
trigger: Starting Step 1
condition:
  - IF problem_is_narrow AND problem_reveals_core_offer_problem THEN "PROCEED"
  - IF problem_is_broad THEN "NARROW IT DOWN"
  - IF solution_doesnt_reveal_next_problem THEN "CHOOSE DIFFERENT PROBLEM"
action: Only proceed when problem meets both criteria
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.138-144)
```

### DR-002: Lead Magnet Type Selection
```yaml
rule: TYPE_SELECTION
trigger: Step 2 - Choosing solution type
condition:
  - IF audience_unaware_of_problem THEN type = "Reveal Problems"
  - IF core_offer_solves_recurring_problem THEN type = "Samples & Trials"
  - IF core_offer_is_multistep THEN type = "One Step of Multi-Step"
action: Match type to offer structure
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.147-176)
```

### DR-003: Delivery Method Multiplication
```yaml
rule: DELIVERY_MULTIPLICATION
trigger: Step 3 - Delivery selection
condition:
  - IF single_delivery_method THEN "CREATE ADDITIONAL VERSIONS"
  - IF all_four_methods_explored THEN "SELECT BEST FIT(S)"
action: Create multiple delivery versions, rotate to find winners
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.192-197)
```

### DR-004: Name Testing Protocol
```yaml
rule: NAME_TESTING
trigger: Step 4 - Naming
condition:
  - IF mass_engagement THEN "WINNER FOUND"
  - IF people_ask_when_available THEN "MEGA WINNER"
  - IF low_engagement THEN "CONTINUE TESTING"
action: Test in order: Title -> Image -> Subtitle
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.199-239)
```

### DR-005: Format Multiplication
```yaml
rule: FORMAT_MULTIPLICATION
trigger: Step 5 - Consumption ease
condition:
  - IF single_format THEN "ADD MORE FORMATS"
  - IF all_consumption_preferences_covered THEN "PROCEED"
action: Offer video + text + audio + multiple access methods
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.241-255)
```

### DR-006: Quality Assessment
```yaml
rule: QUALITY_CHECK
trigger: Step 6 - Quality validation
condition:
  - IF could_charge_for_it THEN "QUALITY SUFFICIENT"
  - IF feels_like_giving_away_too_much THEN "PERFECT QUALITY"
  - IF worried_about_secrets THEN "PROCEED - sell implementation not secrets"
action: Make free stuff as good as paid stuff
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.257-267)
```

### DR-007: CTA Optimization
```yaml
rule: CTA_STRENGTH
trigger: Step 7 - CTA creation
condition:
  - IF clear_action + reason_to_act_now THEN "GOOD CTA"
  - IF multiple_reasons (scarcity + urgency + invented) THEN "GREAT CTA"
  - IF clever_but_unclear THEN "SIMPLIFY"
action: Clear beats clever; always include reason
confidence: HIGH (Source: p.269-299)
```

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Audience Already Engaged
**Trigger:** You're selling to existing customers/followers
**Response:** Can skip lead magnet and advertise core offer directly
**Source:** "Anunciar sua oferta principal pode ser tudo o que voce precisa para fazer os leads se engajarem. Tente desta forma primeiro." (p.113-114)

### Exception 2: Low-Cost Core Offer
**Trigger:** Core offer is inexpensive and simple
**Response:** May not need lead magnet - direct offer may work
**Validation:** Test direct offer first before building lead magnet

### Exception 3: Delivery Cost Too High
**Trigger:** Lead magnet costs more to deliver than ROI justifies
**Response:** Choose different delivery method or simplify
**Math Check:** Cost per lead + delivery cost < lifetime customer value / conversion rate

### Exception 4: Testing Yields No Winners
**Trigger:** Multiple name tests show low engagement
**Response:**
1. Check if problem is actually relevant to audience
2. Verify delivery method matches preferences
3. Test radically different approaches
**Source:** "E voce nao sabera ate tentar." (p.194-195)

### Exception 5: Grand Slam Offer Complexity
**Trigger:** Need to make lead magnet more valuable
**Response:** Apply $100M Offers framework
**Source:** "Grand Slam Offers funcionam para coisas gratuitas tanto ou melhor do que funcionam para coisas pagas. Entao faca seu lead magnet tao insanamente bom que as pessoas se sentirao estupidas dizendo nao." (p.127-128)

## Appendix A: The 12 Lead Magnet Matrix

Create up to 12 lead magnets for a single problem by combining 3 types x 4 delivery methods:

```
                    | Software | Information | Services | Physical |
--------------------|----------|-------------|----------|----------|
Reveal Problems     |    1     |      2      |    3     |    4     |
Samples & Trials    |    5     |      6      |    7     |    8     |
One Step of Multi   |    9     |     10      |   11     |   12     |
```

**Source:** "Com tres tipos diferentes de lead magnets e quatro maneiras de entrega-los, sao ate doze lead magnets que resolvem um unico problema especifico." (p.192)

## Appendix B: Problem-Solution Cycle Examples

### Real Estate Example (from Source)
```
Core Offer: Help homeowners sell their houses

Narrow Problems (potential lead magnets):
├── How much is my house worth? -> Free valuation
├── How do I increase home value? -> Free guide
├── Need photos for listing -> Free photography tips
├── House needs cleaning -> Cleaning checklist
├── Landscaping needed -> Landscaping guide
├── Small repairs required -> DIY repair course
├── Need moving services -> Moving checklist
└── Need staging -> Virtual staging tool

Each solves narrow problem -> Reveals "still need to sell house" -> Core offer
```

### Gym Owner Example (from Source)
```
Core Offer: Gym launch/scaling services

Lead Magnets Created:
├── Software: Dashboard with stats, industry comparison, rating
├── Information: Mini course on ad writing
├── Services: Run ads free for 30 days
└── Physical: Book "Gym Launch Secrets"
```

### $100M Leads Book Example
```
Problem: Business makes <$1M/year profit
Solution (Lead Magnet): This book - teaches how to get leads
Revealed Problem: Business now has leads but needs help scaling
Core Offer: Acquisition.com investment to help scale
```

## Appendix C: Name Testing Templates

### Poll Template (Social Media)
```
Which interests you more?
1. [Option A]
2. [Option B]
Comment with 1 or 2!
```

### Direct Message Template
```
Hey [Name], quick question - if you saw these two offers, which would catch your attention more?

A: [Title A]
B: [Title B]

No wrong answer, just want your gut reaction!
```

### A/B Test Framework
```
Test Round 1: Title
- Test 2-3 titles against each other
- Winner advances

Test Round 2: Image
- Test winning title with 2-3 images
- Winner advances

Test Round 3: Subtitle
- Test winning title+image with 2-3 subtitles
- Winner = final package
```

| Case Study Title | Story | p.83-84 | "'Estudo de Caso GRATUITO: Como adicionamos 213 membros e $112.000 em receita a uma pequena academia em San Diego.'" |
| Results | Story | p.97-107 | "Estranhos reservaram meu calendario solido tipo pela proxima semana." |
| Key Lesson | Story | p.109 | "Eles nao queriam meu webinar. Mas eles queriam meu estudo de caso... voce tem que dar as pessoas algo que elas querem." |

---

**Validation Score: 11/11 parts complete**
**Step Anatomy Fields: 8/8 per step**
**Source References: 100+ elements mapped**
**Blueprint ready for squad creation.**
