```yaml
# Lead Nurture Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-001 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Playbook: Lead Nurture - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: lead-nurture
  purpose: "Maximize throughput: get more leads to respond, schedule, and show up to buy"
  domain: sales-operations
  source_playbook: "$100M Playbook: Lead Nurture"

  core_equation: |
    Throughput = Schedule Rate × Show Rate
    Target: 20-40% improvement in show rates
    Impact: At 20% margins = 2-3x profit increase

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: nurture-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate the Four Pillars workflow and optimize throughput"
      decisions:
        - "Route leads to appropriate pillar focus"
        - "Identify bottlenecks in nurture funnel"
        - "Escalate edge cases to human review"
      kpis:
        - "Overall throughput rate"
        - "Pillar performance balance"
        - "Time-to-show metrics"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: lead-scorer
      role: "Score and classify incoming leads (Red/Yellow/Green)"
      inputs:
        - "Lead opt-in data"
        - "Qualification responses"
        - "Demographic information"
      outputs:
        - "Lead score (Red/Yellow/Green)"
        - "Recommended closer match"
        - "Personalization tags"

    - agent: availability-auditor
      role: "Monitor and optimize scheduling availability"
      inputs:
        - "Calendar data"
        - "Booking patterns"
        - "No-show data"
      outputs:
        - "Availability gaps report"
        - "Optimal time slot recommendations"
        - "Staffing recommendations"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: speed-daemon
      role: "Ensure rapid first contact and appointment booking"
      specialization: "Pillar II: Speed"
      targets:
        first_contact: "<5 minutes (target: <60 seconds)"
        appointment_window: "<72 hours"
      techniques:
        - "Double-dial protocol"
        - "Voicemail + immediate text"
        - "Pull-forward scripts"
        - "Hot handoff execution"

    - agent: personalizer
      role: "Morpheus personalized messaging and incentives"
      specialization: "Pillar III: Personalization"
      capabilities:
        - "Multi-channel initial contact"
        - "Lead research synthesis"
        - "Segmented messaging selection"
        - "Push/Pull incentive deployment"
        - "Proof matching to demographics"

    - agent: volume-engine
      role: "Execute high-volume contact cadences"
      specialization: "Pillar IV: Volume"
      cadences:
        day_1: "6 attempts (call-call-vm-text, call-text, call-text)"
        days_2_3: "2 calls + 1 text per day"
        days_4_7: "1 call + 1 text per day"
        day_8_plus: "Transition to long-term nurture"
      reminders:
        automated: ["Immediate confirmation", "24h", "12h", "3h"]
        manual: ["Night before", "Morning of", "60 min before"]

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: closer-router
      role: "Match qualified leads to optimal closers"
      inputs:
        - "Lead score and profile"
        - "Closer performance data"
        - "Availability matrix"
      outputs:
        - "Optimal lead-closer pairing"
        - "Hot handoff package"
        - "Edification talking points"

    - agent: ghost-hunter
      role: "Recover leads who go dark"
      triggers:
        - "No response for 24h with appointment scheduled"
        - "Missed appointment"
        - "Dropped off after qualification"
      techniques:
        - "Multi-channel re-engagement"
        - "Proof of results from their cohort"
        - "90-day nurture sequence"
        - "Calendar double-booking for uncertain shows"

    - agent: culture-keeper
      role: "Maintain 'Garbage Man Culture' standards"
      responsibilities:
        - "Track rep performance rankings"
        - "Reinforce cultural mantras"
        - "Identify and celebrate top performers"
        - "Coach underperformers on process adherence"
      mantras:
        - "Volume negates luck"
        - "Yellows are the new gold"
        - "BAMFAM as a way of life"
        - "Process > All"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

agents:
  nurture-coordinator:
    id: nurture-coordinator
    title: "Lead Nurture Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate the Four Pillars of Lead Nurture to maximize throughput.
      Ensure leads flow efficiently from opt-in to show-up.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Four Pillars"
        components: ["Availability", "Speed", "Personalization", "Volume"]
      - name: "Throughput Optimization"
        equation: "Schedule Rate × Show Rate"
      - name: "ALAN Principles"
        origin: "Artificial Lead Automation & Nurture"

    decision_authority:
      - "Lead routing between pillars"
      - "Resource allocation across team"
      - "Escalation trigger assessment"
      - "Performance intervention thresholds"

    inputs:
      - "Lead volume and source data"
      - "Current throughput metrics"
      - "Team capacity status"
      - "Exception flags"

    outputs:
      - "Pillar priority recommendations"
      - "Resource reallocation directives"
      - "Performance reports"
      - "Optimization experiments"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Throughput Rate"
          target: ">25%"
          calculation: "Shows / Total Leads"
        - name: "Lead-to-Close Ratio"
          target: ">17.5%"
      secondary:
        - "Schedule Rate >40%"
        - "Show Rate >60%"
        - "First Contact <5min"

  lead-scorer:
    id: lead-scorer
    title: "Lead Qualification Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🎨"

    purpose: |
      Score incoming leads using Red/Yellow/Green system.
      Match lead quality to appropriate handling and closer assignment.

    scoring_system:
      green:
        definition: "Prime lead - matches ideal customer profile"
        indicators:
          - "Demographic match to best customers"
          - "High intent signals"
          - "Budget/authority confirmed"
          - "Timeline urgency"
        action: "Route to best closer immediately"

      yellow:
        definition: "Less qualified but workable"
        indicators:
          - "Partial demographic match"
          - "Moderate intent"
          - "Some qualification gaps"
        action: "Standard process - 'Yellows are the new gold'"
        philosophy: "Every lead is free practice"

      red:
        definition: "Unqualified - poor fit"
        indicators:
          - "Budget mismatch"
          - "Wrong geography/industry"
          - "No decision authority"
          - "Unrealistic timeline"
        action: "Remove from calendar, offer resources/downsell"

    data_sources:
      - "Opt-in form responses"
      - "Application answers"
      - "Social media profiles"
      - "Website/company research"
      - "Historical customer patterns"

    outputs:
      - "Lead score (R/Y/G)"
      - "Qualification summary"
      - "Recommended closer"
      - "Personalization tags"
      - "Risk flags"

  availability-auditor:
    id: availability-auditor
    title: "Scheduling Availability Optimizer"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "📅"

    purpose: |
      Monitor and optimize appointment availability across all dimensions.
      Ensure leads can always find convenient scheduling options.

    availability_dimensions:
      days_per_week:
        current: "Track current days available"
        target: "7 days"
        rationale: "5 days = 71%, 7 days = 100% availability"

      hours_per_day:
        current: "Track current hours"
        target: "6am-6pm PST (9am-9pm EST)"
        rationale: "Available when customers are available to buy"

      slots_per_hour:
        current: "Track interval options"
        target: "4 per hour (15-minute intervals)"
        rationale: "More options = more bookings"

      scheduling_methods:
        required: ["Inbound", "Outbound", "Self-schedule"]
        optimization: "Track conversion by method"

    audit_outputs:
      - "Availability gap report"
      - "Peak demand analysis"
      - "Staffing recommendations"
      - "Self-scheduler UX audit"

    red_flags:
      - "Days with <50% slot utilization"
      - "Hours with zero availability"
      - "Self-scheduler abandonment >30%"
      - "Long gaps between available times"

  speed-daemon:
    id: speed-daemon
    title: "Speed-to-Contact Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "⚡"

    purpose: |
      Execute lightning-fast first contact and appointment booking.
      Every minute of delay = lost revenue.

    speed_targets:
      first_contact:
        exceptional: "<60 seconds (391% conversion increase)"
        standard: "<5 minutes"
        warning: ">5 minutes"
        critical: ">1 hour (7x qualification drop)"

      first_appointment:
        ideal: "Same call / today"
        acceptable: "Within 72 hours"
        warning: ">72 hours"
        discourage: ">5 days"

      response_time:
        target: "Minutes, not hours"
        tracking: "Timestamp every interaction"

    techniques:
      double_dial:
        description: "Call twice immediately - second call often gets through"
        rationale: "Many phones block first unknown call"

      immediate_voicemail_text:
        sequence: ["Call 1", "Call 2", "Voicemail", "Text within 30 seconds"]

      pull_forward:
        script: |
          "Hey, this is [Name] from [Company]... I saw you booked for [Day].
          Just calling to confirm details. Is now a terrible time?
          [Qualify] Great - I have an opening today at [time]...
          unless now is a good time?"

      hot_handoff:
        description: "Transfer to closer while lead is hot"
        includes: ["3-way text intro", "Edification", "Qualification summary"]

    litmus_test: |
      "If you're not hearing 'Man, that was fast! You guys are on top of it!'
      at least once a day, you're not calling leads fast enough."

  personalizer:
    id: personalizer
    title: "Personalization & Incentive Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🎁"

    purpose: |
      Make every interaction feel custom and valuable.
      Give leads reasons to show up through personalization and incentives.

    communication_strategy:
      initial_blast:
        channels: ["Call", "Text", "DM", "Email"]
        rule: "Hit all channels, continue where they respond"

      continuation:
        principle: "Follow the lead's preferred channel"
        escalation: "Move to richer medium when appropriate"

      style: |
        "Reach out like you're actually trying to get ahold of them -
        not just going through the motions. Like you need to reach
        your parents about an emergency."

    personalization_levels:
      easy:
        effort: "5 minutes per lead"
        activities:
          - "Check social media profiles"
          - "Review website/company"
          - "Note recent activities"
        example: |
          "Hey Greg, I see your site traffic is down 18% this quarter.
          We helped another customer in similar situation go up 100%
          in 90 days. I prepped a walkthrough for your auto shop."

      hard:
        effort: "One-time setup, then automated"
        activities:
          - "Create sequences per revenue level"
          - "Create sequences per pain point"
          - "Create sequences per industry"

    incentives:
      push_type:
        mechanism: "Give gift before appointment (reciprocity)"
        example: |
          "Hey [Name]! I wanted to make sure you're caffeinated for
          our meeting tomorrow. Check your email - I sent you a $5
          gift card."
        psychology: "Even when they know what you're doing, it still works"

      pull_type:
        mechanism: "A/B choice that assumes attendance"
        example: |
          "Since you're a first-time client, I'm setting aside
          some free products for you. Would you prefer face cream
          or hand lotion?"
        psychology: "Choosing = implicit commitment to show"

        ab_categories:
          - "Quantity: One bottle or two?"
          - "Start dates: Tomorrow or Monday?"
          - "Type: Shirt or shorts?"
          - "Colors: Black or white?"
          - "Personnel: John or Sara?"
          - "Times: Morning or afternoon?"

    proof_deployment:
      timing:
        - "After schedule, before show"
        - "Between first and second call"
        - "Every 90 days for ghosted leads"

      matching_rule: |
        Match proof demographics to lead demographics:
        - Age, gender, ethnicity
        - Industry, company size
        - Problem type, desired outcome

  volume-engine:
    id: volume-engine
    title: "High-Volume Contact Executor"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "📞"

    purpose: |
      Execute relentless contact cadences. Most salespeople give up
      after 1.3 attempts. We do 7+.

    philosophy: |
      "Volume negates luck. Nearly half of all salespeople give up
      after the first attempt. The more often you reach out, the
      more of them show up."

    contact_cadence:
      day_1_opt_in:
        - step: 1
          action: "Call within 5 minutes"
          timing: "Immediate"
        - step: 2
          action: "Double-dial"
          timing: "Immediately after step 1"
        - step: 3
          action: "Leave voicemail"
          timing: "If no answer"
        - step: 4
          action: "Text immediately"
          timing: "Within 30 seconds of voicemail"
        - step: 5
          action: "Double-dial + text"
          timing: "Few hours later"
        - step: 6
          action: "Double-dial + text"
          timing: "Few more hours later"

      days_2_3:
        - "Call early in day"
        - "Call later in day"
        - "Text after second call"

      days_4_7:
        - "Call once per day"
        - "Text once per day"

      day_8_plus:
        action: "Transition to long-term nurture"
        content: "Free value with soft CTAs"
        trigger: "Re-engagement restarts from top"

    reminder_system:
      automated:
        - timing: "Immediately"
          content: "Confirmation: time, date, caller number, person meeting"
        - timing: "24 hours before"
          content: "Reminder with details"
        - timing: "12 hours before"
          content: "Reminder"
        - timing: "3 hours before"
          content: "Final automated reminder"

        template: |
          [Auto msg] Hey [Name]! Quick reminder about your appointment
          tomorrow at [time]. You'll be speaking with [Closer] from
          [Area Code]. Looking forward to it!

      manual:
        - timing: "Night before"
          content: "Personal check-in"
        - timing: "Morning of"
          content: "Confirmation"
        - timing: "60 minutes before"
          content: "See you soon"

        source: "Real cell phone (iPhone for blue messages)"

    conversation_framework:
      name: "A-C-A"
      steps:
        - "Acknowledge: Respond to what they said"
        - "Compliment: Something genuine about them"
        - "Ask: The next question (qualify or pull forward)"

  closer-router:
    id: closer-router
    title: "Lead-to-Closer Matching Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Match the best leads to the best closers.
      A timeshare company went from $200M to $1B by getting this right.

    matching_algorithm:
      step_1: "Identify best customer patterns (demographics + actions)"
      step_2: "Ask those questions in opt-ins/applications"
      step_3: "Score leads 1-5 or Red/Yellow/Green"
      step_4: "Route best leads to best closers"
      step_5: "Track conversion by pairing, optimize"

    closer_ranking:
      metrics:
        - "Show rate (measures work ethic)"
        - "Close rate (measures skill)"
        - "Lead-to-close ratio (total performance)"
      insight: "Best closers are typically best setters"

    hot_handoff_package:
      edification_script: |
        "You're in luck. You're going to speak with one of our top
        experts on [topic]. He's been in this game for a while and
        helped [similar businesses] achieve [desired outcome].
        We're fortunate to have him."

      handoff_includes:
        - "Lead qualification summary"
        - "Key pain points mentioned"
        - "Specific desired outcomes"
        - "Any concerns raised"
        - "Best contact channel"

    bamfam_enforcement:
      rule: "NEVER end a call without scheduling the next one"
      philosophy: "BAMFAM as a way of life"
      objection_handling: "Being dodgy about next call = objection to handle"
      script: |
        "Great, let me pull up my calendar... What day works better -
        [Day A] or [Day B]? Morning or afternoon? Great, I've got you
        locked in for [specific time]. You'll get a confirmation shortly."

  ghost-hunter:
    id: ghost-hunter
    title: "Lead Recovery Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "👻"

    purpose: |
      Recover leads who go dark. Never give up completely.
      Show them what they missed by not showing up.

    ghost_triggers:
      - "No response 24h before scheduled appointment"
      - "Missed appointment without cancellation"
      - "Stopped responding after qualification"
      - "Ghosted during scheduling conversation"

    recovery_techniques:
      immediate_ghost:
        action: "Double-book the calendar slot"
        rationale: "Reduce impact of no-show"

      proof_recovery:
        timing: "Every 90 days"
        content: "Show results of people who signed up around when they ghosted"
        psychology: "Makes them feel left behind but offers chance to catch up"

      multi_channel_surge:
        description: "Reach out on all channels simultaneously"
        message_style: "Genuine concern, not desperate"

      long_term_nurture:
        trigger: "After 7-day cadence exhausted"
        content: "Free value with soft CTAs"
        goal: "Keep top of mind until they re-engage"

    calendar_management:
      uncertain_shows: "Double-book slots with qualified backup lead"
      confirmed_ghosts: "Release slot, mark lead for 90-day nurture"

  culture-keeper:
    id: culture-keeper
    title: "Performance Culture Guardian"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🏆"

    purpose: |
      Maintain the 'Garbage Man Culture' that drives relentless execution.
      Culture = rules that govern good and bad behavior.

    core_mantras:
      - mantra: "Volume negates luck"
        meaning: "More attempts = more success"
        application: "Do more than everyone else"

      - mantra: "Yellows are the new gold"
        meaning: "Less qualified leads = opportunity"
        application: "Don't sleep on any lead"

      - mantra: "BAMFAM as a way of life"
        meaning: "Book-A-Meeting-From-A-Meeting"
        application: "Never leave calls open"

      - mantra: "Be a garbage man"
        meaning: "Take leads others reject"
        application: "Every lead is free practice"

      - mantra: "Process > All"
        meaning: "No one is above the process"
        application: "Follow the system religiously"

    performance_tracking:
      rankings:
        - metric: "Show Rate"
          measures: "Work ethic"
        - metric: "Close Rate"
          measures: "Skill"
        - metric: "Lead-to-Close"
          measures: "Complete performance"

      display: "Public leaderboard, updated weekly"
      insight: "Same people should top all three lists if culture is healthy"

    reinforcement:
      positive:
        - "Give kudos to highest show rates"
        - "Ask top performers what they did"
        - "When they say 'I just followed the process,' celebrate that"

      corrective:
        - "High close rate + low lead work = entitled, wasteful"
        - "Cherry-picking = against culture"
        - "Judging leads = missing opportunity"

    compensation:
      commission_bump: "5-30% of sale commission for high show rates"
      non_monetary: ["Attention", "Affection", "Approval"]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

executor_matrix:
  # Pillar I: Availability
  - task: "Configure 7-day calendar"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Staff rotation schedule required"

  - task: "Set extended hours (6am-6pm PST)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Coverage capacity verified"

  - task: "Enable 15-minute intervals"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use gaps for lead follow-up"

  - task: "Optimize self-scheduler UX"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "A/B test changes"

  # Pillar II: Speed
  - task: "Alert on new lead opt-in"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Real-time notification required"

  - task: "Make first contact call"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must be within 5 minutes"

  - task: "Execute double-dial protocol"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Follow local laws"

  - task: "Send immediate text after voicemail"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Template must feel personal"

  - task: "Pull appointment forward"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Use pull-forward script"

  - task: "Hot handoff to closer"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Include edification, 3-way text"

  # Pillar III: Personalization
  - task: "Multi-channel initial blast"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Hit all channels simultaneously"

  - task: "Research lead profile"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "5 minutes minimum for high-value"

  - task: "Score lead (R/Y/G)"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates AI scoring"

  - task: "Route lead to closer"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Match quality to skill"

  - task: "Select segmented messaging"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Must match lead profile"

  - task: "Deploy push incentive (gift)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Amount not insulting"

  - task: "Deploy pull incentive (A/B)"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Track choice as commitment signal"

  - task: "Match proof to demographics"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Proof library organized by segment"

  # Pillar IV: Volume
  - task: "Execute Day 1 contact cadence"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "6 attempts minimum"

  - task: "Execute Days 2-7 cadence"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Decreasing frequency"

  - task: "Send automated reminders"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Be transparent they're automated"

  - task: "Send manual reminders"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must feel personal, use iPhone"

  - task: "Execute BAMFAM"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Never end call without next meeting"

  - task: "Transition to long-term nurture"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "After Day 7 cadence exhausted"

  # Culture & Performance
  - task: "Track rep performance metrics"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Show rate, close rate, lead-to-close"

  - task: "Generate leaderboard"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Update weekly, display publicly"

  - task: "Coach underperformers"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Focus on process adherence"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUALITY GATES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Speed Gate"
    transition: "Opt-in → First Contact"
    condition: "contact_time < 5_minutes"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Escalate to manager, add capacity"

  QG-002:
    name: "Scheduling Window Gate"
    transition: "Contact → Appointment"
    condition: "appointment_date <= now + 72_hours"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Apply pull-forward technique"

  QG-003:
    name: "Lead Quality Gate"
    transition: "Score → Calendar"
    condition: "lead_score != RED"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Remove from calendar, offer resources"

  QG-004:
    name: "Volume Gate"
    transition: "Day 1 → Day 2"
    condition: "day_1_attempts >= 6"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Complete remaining attempts"

  QG-005:
    name: "Reminder Gate"
    transition: "Scheduled → Show"
    condition: "automated_reminders_sent AND manual_reminders_sent"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Complete reminder sequence"

  QG-006:
    name: "BAMFAM Gate"
    transition: "Call End → Next Call Scheduled"
    condition: "next_appointment_scheduled == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Do not end call without scheduling"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WORKFLOWS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

workflows:
  new_lead_workflow:
    trigger: "Lead opts in"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: lead-scorer
        action: "Score lead (R/Y/G)"
        output: "Lead classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: speed-daemon
        action: "Alert for immediate contact"
        sla: "<5 minutes"

      - step: 3
        agent: speed-daemon
        action: "Execute first contact (double-dial, VM, text)"
        output: "Contact status"

      - step: 4
        agent: personalizer
        action: "Research lead, prepare personalized approach"
        parallel_to: "step 3"

      - step: 5
        agent: closer-router
        action: "Match to appropriate closer"
        condition: "If lead_score == GREEN"

      - step: 6
        agent: speed-daemon
        action: "Book appointment within 72h or close now"
        output: "Appointment scheduled"

      - step: 7
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Start reminder sequence"
        trigger: "Appointment confirmed"

  no_response_workflow:
    trigger: "Lead not responding to contact"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Continue Day 1 cadence (6 attempts)"
        condition: "If day == 1 AND attempts < 6"

      - step: 2
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Execute Days 2-3 cadence"
        condition: "If day <= 3"

      - step: 3
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Execute Days 4-7 cadence"
        condition: "If day <= 7"

      - step: 4
        agent: ghost-hunter
        action: "Transition to long-term nurture"
        condition: "If day > 7"

  appointment_reminder_workflow:
    trigger: "Appointment scheduled"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send immediate confirmation"
        timing: "Immediately"

      - step: 2
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send 24h automated reminder"
        timing: "24 hours before"

      - step: 3
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send manual night-before reminder"
        timing: "Evening before"

      - step: 4
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send 12h automated reminder"
        timing: "12 hours before"

      - step: 5
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send morning-of manual reminder"
        timing: "Morning of appointment"

      - step: 6
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send 3h automated reminder"
        timing: "3 hours before"

      - step: 7
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Send 60-min manual reminder"
        timing: "60 minutes before"

  ghost_recovery_workflow:
    trigger: "Lead ghosts scheduled appointment"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: ghost-hunter
        action: "Mark lead for recovery"
        output: "Ghost status flagged"

      - step: 2
        agent: ghost-hunter
        action: "Multi-channel surge outreach"
        timing: "Same day"

      - step: 3
        agent: ghost-hunter
        action: "Add to 90-day proof sequence"
        condition: "If no response to surge"

      - step: 4
        agent: personalizer
        action: "Send proof of results from their cohort"
        timing: "Every 90 days"

      - step: 5
        agent: volume-engine
        action: "Re-enter standard cadence"
        trigger: "Lead re-engages"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KPIs & SUCCESS METRICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

kpis:
  primary:
    throughput:
      formula: "Shows / Total Leads"
      target: ">25%"
      impact: "20-40% improvement = 2-3x profit at 20% margins"

    lead_to_close:
      formula: "Closed / Total Leads"
      target: ">17.5%"
      benchmark:
        minimum: "7.5%"
        target: "17.5%"
        top_performer: "34%"

  secondary:
    schedule_rate:
      formula: "Scheduled / Engaged Leads"
      target: ">40%"

    show_rate:
      formula: "Shows / Scheduled"
      target: ">60%"

    first_contact_speed:
      formula: "Avg time to first contact"
      target: "<5 minutes"
      exceptional: "<60 seconds"

  by_pillar:
    availability:
      - "Days per week with availability"
      - "Hours per day available"
      - "Slots per hour offered"
      - "Self-scheduler conversion rate"

    speed:
      - "First contact time distribution"
      - "Appointment booking window distribution"
      - "Response time to messages"

    personalization:
      - "Channel preference match rate"
      - "Lead score accuracy"
      - "Incentive conversion rate"
      - "Proof engagement rate"

    volume:
      - "Average contact attempts per lead"
      - "Reminder completion rate"
      - "BAMFAM compliance rate"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

troubleshooting:
  - symptom: "Low schedule rate"
    possible_causes:
      - "Limited availability (days/hours/slots)"
      - "Self-scheduler friction"
      - "Slow first contact"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check availability audit report"
      - "Review self-scheduler abandonment"
      - "Check first contact time metrics"
    solutions:
      - "Expand availability to 7 days"
      - "Reduce self-scheduler steps"
      - "Add capacity for faster contact"

  - symptom: "Low show rate"
    possible_causes:
      - "Appointments too far out"
      - "Insufficient reminders"
      - "No incentives/personalization"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check appointment window distribution"
      - "Verify reminder sequence completion"
      - "Review incentive deployment"
    solutions:
      - "Enforce 72h max window"
      - "Implement full reminder sequence"
      - "Deploy push/pull incentives"

  - symptom: "High show rate, low close rate"
    possible_causes:
      - "Reps cherry-picking leads"
      - "Poor lead-closer matching"
      - "Qualification gaps"
    diagnosis:
      - "Review lead quality distribution by rep"
      - "Compare conversion by lead-closer pairing"
      - "Audit qualification questions"
    solutions:
      - "Enforce 'garbage man' culture"
      - "Optimize lead-closer routing"
      - "Improve qualification criteria"

  - symptom: "Team giving up too early"
    possible_causes:
      - "Culture not reinforced"
      - "No volume tracking"
      - "Compensation not aligned"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check average attempts per lead"
      - "Review leaderboard usage"
      - "Audit commission structure"
    solutions:
      - "Reinforce 'volume negates luck' mantra"
      - "Implement public leaderboards"
      - "Add show rate commission bump"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

technology:
  required:
    - tool: "Auto Dialer"
      purpose: "2-3x team efficiency"
      features:
        - "Lead prioritization"
        - "Cadence automation"
        - "Performance tracking"

    - tool: "CRM with Timestamps"
      purpose: "Track all interactions"
      features:
        - "Response time tracking"
        - "Lead scoring integration"
        - "Rep performance dashboard"

    - tool: "Multi-channel Messaging"
      purpose: "Reach leads on preferred channel"
      features:
        - "SMS, Email, DM integration"
        - "Automated sequences"
        - "Response tracking"

    - tool: "Online Scheduler"
      purpose: "Self-scheduling option"
      features:
        - "15-minute intervals"
        - "Mobile-optimized"
        - "Minimal steps"

    - tool: "Local Area Code Wrapping"
      purpose: "Higher pick-up rates"
      features:
        - "Dynamic area code matching"
        - "Compliance tracking"

  recommended:
    - tool: "iPhone Fleet"
      purpose: "Blue messages = higher trust"

    - tool: "Call Recording"
      purpose: "Training and coaching"

    - tool: "Lead Scoring AI"
      purpose: "Automated R/Y/G classification"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GAPS TO RESOLVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

gaps_to_resolve:
  - id: GAP-001
    description: "Specific lead scoring criteria questions"
    severity: Medium
    clarification_needed: "What exact questions determine Red/Yellow/Green?"

  - id: GAP-002
    description: "Long-term nurture sequence details"
    severity: Low
    note: "Covered in separate playbook"
```

## 1. Proposito

Maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) de cada cliente atraves de uma sequencia deliberada de ofertas que:
1. Recupera CAC em 30 dias
2. Atinge ratio LTGP:CAC de 3:1 ou superior
3. Mantem churn abaixo de 5% mensal

**Insight Central:**
> "Voce pode tosquiar uma ovelha por toda a vida, mas so pode esfola-la uma vez." - John, mentor de Alex Hormozi

---

## 2. Escopo

**Aplica-se a:**
- Negocios com produtos/servicos recorrentes
- Ofertas de ticket medio a alto ($500+)
- Empresas com CAC documentado
- Modelos B2B e B2C com ciclo de venda definido

**NAO aplica-se a:**
- Commodities sem diferenciacao
- Negocios sem capacidade de entrega escalavel
- Modelos com margem bruta < 30%
- Taxa de reembolso > 5%

---

## 3. Pre-condicoes

### Validacao de Negocio
- [ ] Produto validado: pelo menos 10 clientes satisfeitos pagantes
- [ ] Custo de aquisicao conhecido: CAC documentado e consistente
- [ ] Capacidade de entrega: consegue entregar 2x volume atual
- [ ] Sistema de cobranca: processador que aceita planos e recorrencia
- [ ] Caixa minimo: 3 meses de despesas OU linha de credito
- [ ] Tracking instalado: metricas de conversao por estagio

### Red Flags - NAO esta pronto se:
- Taxa de reembolso > 5%
- Nao consegue explicar valor em 30 segundos
- Nao tem depoimentos/casos de sucesso
- Margem bruta < 30%
- Churn > 10% mensal

---

## 4. Framework GMMM (Get Money, More Money, Max Money)

### Visao Geral

```
ESTAGIO 1: GET MONEY (Ofertas de Atracao)
├─ Objetivo: Transformar estranhos em clientes
├─ Meta: Cobrir CAC + COGs
└─ KPI: Lucro de 30 dias > $0

ESTAGIO 2: MORE MONEY (Upsells + Downsells)
├─ Objetivo: Maximizar lucro por cliente
├─ Meta: 3-5x valor inicial
└─ KPI: LTV de 30 dias > 3x CAC

ESTAGIO 3: MAX MONEY (Continuidade)
├─ Objetivo: Receita recorrente previsivel
├─ Meta: 80%+ em continuidade
└─ KPI: Churn < 5% mensal
```

### Matriz de Ofertas 4x3

```
           | Quantidade | Qualidade | Diferente   |
-----------|------------|-----------|-------------|
Atracao    | Mais       | Premium   | Novo        |
Upsell     | Dobro      | Melhor    | Complementar|
Downsell   | Menos      | Inferior  | Alternativa |
Continuidade| Ilimitado | Mantida   | Recorrente  |
```

---

## 5. Os 4 Pilares do LTV

### Pilar 1: Lucro em 30 Dias

**Definicao:** Fazer lucro suficiente para cobrir custos de aquisicao + entrega em 30 dias ou menos.

**Por que e essencial:** Permite usar cartao de credito como capital de giro infinito.

**Consequencia de ignorar:** Ficar sem caixa, parar publicidade, morrer lentamente.

**Formula:**
```
L30 = (P1 x C1) + Sum(Un x Cn x Vn) - CAC - COGS

Onde:
L30 = Lucro em 30 dias
P1 = Preco oferta inicial
C1 = Taxa conversao inicial
Un = Preco upsell n
Cn = Taxa conversao upsell n
Vn = Volume ofertas upsell n
CAC = Custo de aquisicao
COGS = Custo de entrega
```

### Pilar 2: Sequencia Problema-Solucao

**Definicao:** Toda solucao cria um novo problema que requer outra solucao.

**Por que e essencial:** Cria oportunidades naturais de upsell sem parecer forcado.

**Consequencia de ignorar:** Perder 80% do lucro potencial de cada cliente.

**Exemplo:**
- Carro alugado -> precisa seguro (problema criado)
- Desafio fitness -> precisa suplementos (problema criado)
- Software -> precisa treinamento (problema criado)

### Pilar 3: Ancoragem de Valor

**Definicao:** Apresentar primeiro a opcao mais cara para fazer outras parecerem baratas.

**Por que e essencial:** Psicologicamente recalibra percepcao de valor.

**Consequencia de ignorar:** Clientes compram sempre a opcao mais barata.

**Caso Real - Loja de Ternos:**
- Orcamento do cliente: $500
- Primeiro terno apresentado: $16,000
- Segundo terno apresentado: $2,200
- Cliente comprou: $2,200 + $300 acessorios = $2,500 (5x orcamento)

### Pilar 4: Friccao Zero

**Definicao:** Remover toda barreira entre decisao e pagamento.

**Por que e essencial:** 50% das vendas morrem na friccao do pagamento.

**Consequencia de ignorar:** Perder metade das vendas ja fechadas.

**Tecnica - Cartao em Arquivo:**
- NAO pergunte: "Voce quer comprar?"
- PERGUNTE: "Qual cartao voce quer usar?"

---

## 6. ESTAGIO I: Ofertas de Atracao (Get Cash)

### Oferta #1: Ganhe Seu Dinheiro de Volta

**Formula:**
```
INVESTIMENTO INICIAL (100% reembolsavel)
+ CRITERIOS CLAROS DE QUALIFICACAO
+ PRAZO DEFINIDO
= RISCO PERCEBIDO ZERO
= 2-3X MAIS CONVERSOES
```

**Sistema de 5 Passos:**

1. **Definir Investimento**
   - Valor: 3-5x seu custo de entrega
   - Sweet spot: $300-$3,000 (B2C) | $3,000-$30,000 (B2B)
   - Regra: Alto o suficiente para filtrar, baixo o suficiente para ser acessivel

2. **Estabelecer Criterios (3 Modelos)**
   - Modelo A - BASEADO EM RESULTADOS: Perder X quilos em Y semanas
   - Modelo B - BASEADO EM ACOES: Comparecer 100% sessoes, completar 100% tarefas
   - Modelo C - HIBRIDO (MAIS EFICAZ): Acoes obrigatorias (70%) + Resultado minimo (30%)

3. **Estruturar Timeline**
   - Curto (21-28 dias): Maxima urgencia
   - Medio (6-8 semanas): Equilibrio ideal
   - Longo (12-16 semanas): Transformacoes profundas

4. **Aplicar Credito (3 Opcoes)**
   - Opcao A: 100% aplicado na proxima compra imediatamente
   - Opcao B: Credito distribuido ($600 = $50/mes por 12 meses)
   - Opcao C: Cliente escolhe entre A ou B

5. **Script Magico (Todos Ganham)**
   > "Sei que voce esta tentando atingir [meta curto prazo], mas qual e sua meta de longo prazo? ...Para mostrar o quanto quero que voce alcance isso, vou creditar este programa para o proximo QUER VOCE ATINJA SUA META OU NAO. Como isso soa?"

**Numeros Reais:**
- Academia Danny: $500 desafio -> cliente atingiu meta -> usou reembolso para comprar mais -> fotos antes/depois geraram 13 indicacoes
- Academia Alex: $600 desafio -> 34:1 ROI em 48 horas
- 70% dos vencedores convertem para continuidade

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Investimento: $600
Custo de entrega: $120
10% pedem reembolso: -$60
90% ficam (na media): $540 receita
Liquido primeiros 30 dias: $540 - $120 = $420 lucro
Custo por lead (se CAC $100): $420 / $100 = 4.2:1 LTGP:CAC em 30 dias
```

### Oferta #2: Sorteios (Giveaways)

**Como Funciona:**
Muitos entram para ganhar. Um ganha. O resto recebe "bolsa parcial" (desconto).

**Sistema de 6 Passos:**

1. **Escolher Premio Principal**
   - Premio = Exatamente o que quer vender depois
   - Valor Percebido = 10-20x seu ticket medio

2. **Criar Oferta Promocional (O SEGREDO)**
   - "Bolsa Parcial" = 30-50% desconto no total
   - Mas APRESENTE como 70-90% desconto
   - Math: $10,000 premio -> "bolsa parcial" $7,000 -> cliente paga $3,000

3. **Estruturar Captura**
   - Obrigatorio: Nome, Email, Telefone, Pergunta Qualificadora
   - Pergunta Magica: "Por que voce merece ganhar?"

4. **Definir Timeline**
   - Dias 1-3: Promocao massiva
   - Dias 4-5: "Ultimas vagas"
   - Dia 6: "Ultimo dia!"
   - Dia 7: Anunciar vencedor
   - Dias 7-14: Converter "perdedores"

5. **Executar Anuncio**
   - Publico: Post celebrando vencedor
   - Privado: Email/SMS "perdedores" - ONDE ESTA O DINHEIRO

6. **Converter os "Perdedores" (Master Script)**
   > "Oi [Nome], primeiro PARABENS! Suas respostas foram TAO BOAS que consegui uma bolsa parcial de $[X]! Normalmente $[cheio], com bolsa apenas $[preco real]. Preciso resposta ate [amanha], apenas [3] bolsas parciais. Pode aproveitar?"

**Hacks:**
- VENCEDOR DUPLO: "Se alguem que voce indicou ganhar, voce tambem ganha!" = 3-5x participantes
- The Economist Play em bolsas: A ($59), B ($125), A+B ($125) -> 80% escolhem combo

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Custo premio: $5,000 | Marketing: $2,000 | Total: $7,000
500 participantes -> 200 compram a $3,000 (40%) = $600,000
ROI: $600,000 / $7,000 = 85.7:1
```

### Oferta #3: Oferta Isca (Decoy)

**Como Funciona:**
Versao basica gratuita/barata vs versao premium completa. Isca existe APENAS para fazer premium parecer obvio.

**Construcao:**
- **ISCA:** Remova suporte, garantias, bonus, prioridade, personalizacao. Mantenha APENAS funcao core. Preco: Custo + 10% margem.
- **PREMIUM:** Adicione tudo. 1-on-1, garantia, todos bonus, acesso vitalicio. Preco: 3-5x isca.

**Script de Apresentacao:**
> "Voce esta aqui para coisas gratis ou resultados duradouros?" [99% dizem resultados]
> "BASICO $497: [minimalista] - Voce esta por conta propria."
> "PREMIUM $1,997: [impressionante] - Garantimos seu sucesso."
> "Qual te leva ao seu objetivo 10x mais rapido?"

**Base do Calculo:**
```
100 prospects: 25 isca a $497 = $12,425 | 60 premium a $1,997 = $119,820
Total: $132,245 vs oferta unica $997: ~30 compradores = $29,910 -> 4.4x lift
```

### Oferta #4: Compre X Ganhe Y Gratis

**Como Funciona:**
Mesma matematica, frame diferente -> 5x mais vendas.
"Compre 1 par $600, ganhe 2 gratis" vs "$200/par" = mesma margem, 5x volume

**Configuracoes por Margem:**
```
< 30% margem:  Compre 2, Ganhe 1 (fisico)
30-60% margem: Compre 1, Ganhe 1 (servicos)
60-80% margem: Compre 1, Ganhe 2 (digital)
> 80% margem:  Compre 1, Ganhe 3+ (software)
```

**Caso Real - Boot Factory Nashville:**
"Compre 1, ganhe 2 gratis" a $600 -> 5x vendas, dominio de mercado por decadas

### Oferta #5: Pague Menos Agora ou Pague Mais Depois

**Como Funciona:**
- Opcao A (DEPOIS): $0 hoje, $497 amanha. Risco zero. Cartao em arquivo.
- Opcao B (AGORA): $297 hoje (40% menos) + bonus exclusivos.
- 60% escolhem pagar agora.

**Matrix por Ticket:**
```
Baixo (<$500):   Depois 100%, Agora 60% (40% off)
Medio ($500-2k): Depois 100%, Agora 50% (50% off)
Alto (>$2k):     Depois 100%, Agora 40% (60% off)
```

**Base do Calculo:**
```
100 prospects: 60 pagam $297 = $17,820 | 40 pagam depois $497 (80% completam) = $15,904
Total: $33,724 vs oferta unica $497: ~40 compradores = $19,880 -> 1.7x lift
```

---

## 7. ESTAGIO II: Ofertas de Upsell (More Cash)

### Oferta #6: Upsell Classico

**Formula:** "Voce nao pode ter X sem Y"

**Exemplo - Aluguel de Carro:**
- Carro alugado -> seguro -> gasolina -> checkout tardio = 5.2x ($19 -> $100)

**Exemplo - Hamburguer:**
- Hamburguer -> batatas -> bebida -> supersize = 11.6x ($0.25 -> $3.00 lucro)

**Taticas Chave:**
1. Upsells mais lucrativos primeiro
2. "Voce nao quer mais nada, quer?" (Nao = Sim)
3. Surprise and delight: de TODOS bonus mesmo se aceitarem antes
4. Hiper-compra: casamentos, bebes, novos hobbies -> abrace upsells
5. Bonus gratis CRIAM problemas que upsells resolvem
6. Quanto mais rapido acesso, maior o valor
7. Agrupe upsells e NOMEIE (pacote transformacao)
8. BAMFAM: Book A Meeting From A Meeting = 5x mais oportunidades
9. Integre upsells na entrega de outras ofertas

**Numeros Reais:**
- 19 pitches falhados -> "chocolate ou baunilha?" -> venda instantanea -> $5-10k/dia
- Win-back: 200 videos personalizados -> $1.9M ARR
- Media 2-4x aumento LTV quando bem posicionado

### Oferta #7: Menu Upsell

**Formula:** Unsell -> Prescribe -> A/B -> Cartao em Arquivo

1. **UNSELLING:** Risque o que NAO precisam -> constroi boa vontade -> 25% para 75% conversao
2. **PRESCRICAO:** Diga o que precisam, como usar, quando, quanto
3. **A/B:** "Chocolate ou baunilha?" remove "sim/nao" -> ambas escolhas = venda
4. **CARTAO EM ARQUIVO:** "Usar o cartao em arquivo?" -> 40% aumento conversao

**The Economist Play:**
A ($59), B ($125), A+B ($125) -> 80% escolhem combo

**Numeros Reais:**
- $0 para $5-10k/dia vendas suplemento usando menu upsell
- 80%+ conversao quando feito corretamente
- Unselling: 25% -> 75% conversao (3x)

### Oferta #8: Anchor Upsell

**Formula:** Premium primeiro -> Engasgo -> Resgate -> Oferta principal -> Pagamento

**Passos:**
1. Apresente a ancora (5-10x preco)
2. Espere o engasgo
3. Venha ao resgate: "Voce se importa muito com [feature premium]?"
4. Apresente oferta principal
5. Pergunte como querem pagar

**CRITICO:** Trate ancora como oferta REAL. Se falsa, perdem confianca.

> "A unica coisa pior que fazer oferta de $1,000 para pessoa com orcamento de $100 e fazer oferta de $100 para pessoa com orcamento de $1,000."

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Sem ancora: 30 compram a $2,200 = $66,000
Com ancora: 15 premium a $16k + 45 principal a $2.2k = $240k + $99k = $339k
Lift: 5.1x receita
```

### Oferta #9: Rollover Upsell

**Formula:** Credite compra anterior para proxima compra maior

**4 Situacoes:**
1. REENGAJAR clientes antigos (6+ meses)
2. RESGATAR clientes chateados (em vez de reembolso)
3. ROUBAR clientes insatisfeitos de concorrentes
4. UPSELL clientes atuais (distribua credito)

**Precificacao:** Upsell pelo menos 4x o credito -> maximo 25% desconto

**Hack - Jogada do Cartao-Presente:**
- Venda cartoes-presente de $200 por $20
- Limite a dois por cliente, so podem usar em outros
- Quando vierem, role cartao para oferta de $1,000+
- Clientes PAGAM VOCE para indicar amigos

**Numeros Reais:**
- 200 videos personalizados -> 20% aceitaram -> $1.9M extra ARR
- Um dia gravando -> $480k/ano receita liquida nova

---

## 8. ESTAGIO III: Ofertas de Downsell (Turn No's into Yes's)

### Regras de Downselling

1. **Nao significa nao para ESTA oferta, nao todas**
2. **Downsells sao TROCAS** - de algo, receba algo
3. **Personalize, nao pressione**
4. **Mesma coisa de maneiras NOVAS**
5. **NUNCA baixe preco da mesma coisa** - mude oferta com preco
6. **Clientes falam sobre preco** - consistencia importa

### Oferta #10: Downsell de Plano de Pagamento

**Processo de 7 Passos (pare quando comprarem):**

1. **Recompense pagar integralmente** (preco COM juros -> pre-pagar = desconto)
2. **Financiamento terceiros / cartao credito / layaway**
   - "Voce prefere que EU decida seus termos ou VOCE decide?" -> "Eu decido" -> cartao
3. **Metade agora, metade depois** (alinhe com dia pagamento)
4. **CHECK:** Escala 1-10. 8+ continue. 7- mude para downsell recursos
5. **Divida em tres pagamentos**
6. **Espalhe uniformemente** (ex: 16 semanas = 16 pagamentos)
7. **Trial gratuito** (-> Trial com Penalidade)

**Tecnica Gangorra:**
> "Pagamentos mensais gigantes ou pequenos?" -> "Pequenos"
> "Pre-pague hoje: desconto massivo + zero mensais. Funciona?"
> Se nao: "Quanto mais der agora = menores mensais."

**Dados de Churn (14,000 empresas via ProfitWell):**
```
Mensal:     10.7% churn/mes
Trimestral: 5% churn/mes
Anual:      2% churn/mes

REGRA: Dobrar periodo = metade do churn. Sempre comece alto.
```

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Sem plano: 30 compram a $1,000 = $30,000
Com plano downsell: 30 integral + 20 planos (80% completam) = $30k + $16k = $46,000
Lift: 53% aumento receita
```

### Oferta #11: Trial com Penalidade

**Formula:** "Se voce fizer X, Y, Z, deixo voce comecar de graca."

**5 Passos:**

1. **Ofereca trial POR ULTIMO** (so apos principal rejeitada)
2. **SEMPRE pegue cartao** ("Qual cartao?" / "E como sempre fizemos")
3. **Venda ficar e pagar** ("Se funcionar, voce ficara a longo prazo?")
4. **Explique taxas APOS cartao** (nao antes -> mais resistencia)
5. **Check-ins OBRIGATORIOS** (suas oportunidades de upsell)

**Pos-Trial:**
- **Gostou:** Facil upsell para servico maior/mais longo
- **Odiou:** "Voce esta certo, estou irritado. Suas necessidades combinam com nosso premium." (50% compram)
- **Nao usou:** Contate multiplas vezes, dispense taxa se encontrarem

**Base do Calculo:**
```
100 leads: 30 compram principal $1,000 + 40 trial
8 falham criterios ($200 penalidade) + 24 convertem ($500/mes)
30 dias: $30,000 + $1,600 + $12,000 = $43,600 -> 45% lift
```

### Oferta #12: Downsell de Recursos

**Formula:** Remova recurso -> baixe preco -> "E agora?"

**O Hack da Garantia:**
```
Oferta completa $1,000 com garantia: 25 compram
Remova garantia, $600: alguns compram ISSO
MAS muitos reconsideram -> compram COMPLETA $1,000 porque AGORA veem valor da garantia
Resultado: 35 completa + 40 sem = 75 total (era 25) -> triplicou taxa fechamento
```

**O Que Remover (maior valor primeiro para triggerar re-upsell):**
- Quantidade, qualidade, nivel servico, disponibilidade, velocidade
- Ratio, comunicacao, provedor, ao vivo vs gravado
- DIY vs DFY, personalizacao, seguro/garantia, recursos inteiros

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Antes: 25 x $1,000 = $25,000
Depois: 35 x $1,000 + 40 x $600 = $59,000 -> 2.36x lift
40% dos compradores downsell eventualmente fazem upgrade
```

---

## 9. ESTAGIO IV: Ofertas de Continuidade (Max Cash)

### Oferta #13: Bonus de Continuidade

**Formula:** Bonus incrivel para assinar hoje. Valor bonus > primeiro pagamento.

**Tipos:**
- **Produtos:** "$800 em brinquedos gratis com $59/mes racao cachorro"
- **Servicos:** "$1,000 acelerador gratis com $100/mes membresia"
- **Digital:** "Todas 40 newsletters passadas ($15,880) com $399/mes assinatura"

**Pricing Standalone vs Continuidade:**
```
50% continuidade: Standalone = 1.33x mensal
60% continuidade: Standalone = 1.66x mensal
70% continuidade: Standalone = 2.00x mensal
80% continuidade: Standalone = 2.33x mensal
90% continuidade: Standalone = 2.66x mensal
```

**Upsell Apos Entrada:** Pre-pago em bloco (compre 5 ganhe 1 gratis)
- 1 em 8 pegando = 50% mais lucro 30 dias

**Numeros Reais:**
- Academia: Antes 17% continuidade efetiva. Apos bonus: 40% direto. 2.35x lift.
- 8 de 40 pegam pre-pago anual -> boost massivo caixa

**Base do Calculo:**
```
40 entram $99/mes (custo bonus $50 cada = $2,000)
8 pre-pagam anual $990
Mensal: $3,168 + $660 = $3,828/mes -> $45,936/ano
vs desafio-apenas: $20,196/ano -> 2.27x lift ARR
```

### Oferta #14: Desconto de Continuidade

**Formula:** Tempo gratis com compromisso
- "3 meses gratis com commit 12 meses" -> 25% off efetivo
- "Compre 6 meses, ganhe 6 meses gratis" -> 50% off, dobra compromisso

**4 Formatos de Anuncio:**
1. Percentual: 25% off
2. Dolar: $300 off
3. Porcao gratis: 3 meses gratis
4. Total: 12 meses por $900 (riscado $1,200)

**Base do Calculo:**
```
Mes-a-mes $99: media 10 meses = $990 LTV
Commit 12 meses $75/mes: garantido $900 + 60% renovam = $1,440 media LTV -> 45% lift
```

### Oferta #15: Taxa Dispensada

**Formula:** Taxa setup com mes-a-mes OU dispensada com commit anual

```
Opcao A: $5,000 setup + $1,000/mes, cancele quando quiser
Opcao B: $0 setup, commit 12 meses a $1,000/mes
Sair cedo -> paga taxa dispensada

85% escolhem compromisso. Churn <5%.
```

**Por Que Funciona:**
- Pessoas COMECAM para evitar taxa
- Pessoas FICAM porque sair > ficar
- Apos compromisso: taxa desaparece para sempre (equitativo)

**Cancelamento Baseado em Causa (Avancado):**
> "Qual causa voce absolutamente ODEIA?"
> "Se cancelar cedo, doando sua taxa para eles."
> Dupla aversao = 50% reducao churn adicional

**Setup:**
- Duracao: 12 meses minimo
- Taxa: 3-5x mensal
- Saida antecipada: paga taxa dispensada
- Se >5% querem sair cedo -> investigue produto, nao pricing

**Base do Calculo:**
```
85 anual $1,000/mes = $1,020,000
15 mes-a-mes $5,000 setup + $15,000/mes
Ano 1: $1,020k + $75k + $120k = $1,215,000
Sem taxa: 100 x $1,000 x media 6 meses = $600,000 -> 2x+ lift
```

---

## 10. Health Check System

### LTGP:CAC Analysis

```
LTGP:CAC > 3:1 -> "Escalar agressivamente. Modelo imprimindo dinheiro.
  Invista cada centavo em aquisicao. Use cartao como capital infinito.
  O unico erro agora e nao escalar rapido o suficiente."

LTGP:CAC 2-3:1 -> "Otimizar Money Model. Ganhando dinheiro mas
  deixando na mesa. Provavelmente faltam upsells ou continuity fraca.
  Adicione pelo menos 2 ofertas na sequencia."

LTGP:CAC < 2:1 -> "PARAR E CONSERTAR URGENTE. Modelo sangrando.
  Cada cliente novo custando mais que deveria. Redesenhe sequencia
  de ofertas ANTES de gastar mais um centavo em marketing."
```

### 30-Day CAC Recovery

```
CAC Recovery < 30 dias -> "Negocio saudavel. Pode usar cartao
  como capital de giro infinito. Continue escalando."

CAC Recovery > 30 dias -> "RISCO DE FALENCIA. Gastando mais rapido
  do que ganha. A cada dia acima de 30, acumula divida operacional.
  82% dos negocios morrem por falta de cash flow, nao de clientes."
```

### Churn Rate Analysis

```
Churn < 5% mensal -> "Excepcional. Produto forte, entrega forte.
  Foque em aquisicao e upsells."

Churn 5-10% mensal -> "Saudavel mas melhoravel. Considere ofertas de
  taxa dispensada e bonus de continuity para reduzir."

Churn > 10% mensal -> "PROBLEMA CRITICO. Ou vendendo produto
  errado, entregando mal, ou atraindo cliente errado.
  Nao adianta otimizar Money Model se produto nao entrega."
```

### Benchmarks de Performance

```
RUIM:      Lucro 30 dias negativo
MEDIO:     Lucro 30 dias = 1x CAC
BOM:       Lucro 30 dias = 2x CAC
EXCELENTE: Lucro 30 dias = 3x+ CAC
```

---

## 11. D.I.E. Framework

```
DIAGNOSE -> IMPLEMENT -> EVALUATE

DIAGNOSE: Onde esta o problema?
  Pergunte: "CAC, ticket medio, conversao, churn, billing cycle?"
  Calcule: LTGP:CAC, 30-day recovery, churn rate
  Identifique: Qual dos 4 estagios quebrado ou faltando?

IMPLEMENT: Qual Money Model resolve?
  CAC > 30-day revenue -> Conserte Oferta Atracao
  Margens baixas -> Adicione Upsells
  Conversao < 20% -> Adicione Downsells
  Sem previsibilidade -> Adicione Continuidade

EVALUATE: Numeros em 30 dias
  30-day cash: $X -> $Y
  CAC payback: X -> Y dias
  LTGP:CAC: X:1 -> Y:1
```

---

## 12. Cash First Hierarchy

```
1. CONSERTE ATRACAO (se CAC > 30-day revenue)
   -> Perdendo dinheiro por cliente. Nada mais importa.

2. ADICIONE UPSELLS (se cobriu mas margens baixas)
   -> Classico primeiro -> Menu -> Anchor -> Rollover

3. ADICIONE DOWNSELLS (se conversao < 20%)
   -> Plano Pagamento primeiro -> Trial Penalidade -> Recursos

4. ADICIONE CONTINUIDADE (se 1-3 funcionam)
   -> Bonus primeiro -> Taxa Dispensada -> Desconto
```

---

## 13. 10 Verdades Contra-Intuitivas

1. **Gratis custa mais que pago** (gratis 40% show-up, $1 = 80%, $10 = 90%)
2. **Mais ofertas = mais vendas** (9 sequenciais = 3x conversao vs 1)
3. **Preco maior = menos churn** (14,000 empresas provam)
4. **Penalidades aumentam satisfacao** (80% conclusao vs 20%)
5. **Comecar caro = vender mais barato** ($16k ancora -> $2.2k parece negocio)
6. **Dificultar saida = facilitar permanencia** (sair > ficar = retencao)
7. **Dar para receber mais** (margem zero front-end OK se upsells compensam)
8. **Vender o que NAO precisam** (unselling: 25% -> 75% conversao)
9. **Esconder preco ate fim** (valor primeiro = 3x conversao)
10. **Menos escolha = mais compra** ("Chocolate ou baunilha?" > "Quer comprar?")

---

## 14. 10 Erros Fatais

1. **Mesma coisa mais barata** -> confianca destruida
2. **Pular upsell** -> perde 80% lucro
3. **Desistir no primeiro nao** -> perde 60% vendas
4. **Sem cartao em trials** -> 90% somem
5. **Tempo demais para decidir** -> momentum morre
6. **Explicar antes de ancorar** -> efeito perdido
7. **Muito complexo** -> paralisia
8. **Sem follow-up** -> perde 40%
9. **Aceitar "nao tenho dinheiro"** -> sempre ofereca plano
10. **Tudo de uma vez** -> sistema quebra (um estagio por trimestre)

## 17. Troubleshooting

| Sintoma | Causa Provavel | Solucao |
|---------|---------------|---------|
| Conversao < 10% | Oferta errada | Mude para outro tipo atracao |
| Upsell < 20% | Timing/relevancia | Mova para momento diferente |
| Downsell < 30% | Muito caro/complexo | Simplifique opcoes |
| Churn > 10% | Produto nao entrega | Conserte produto primeiro |
| Lucro negativo | Poucas ofertas | Adicione ofertas ou aumente precos |

## Appendix A: Scripts Chave

### Script Upsell Classico
> "Otimo! Agora que voce tem [solucao A], precisa resolver [problema B criado por A]. 90% dos nossos clientes que conseguem [resultado] tambem pegam [produto B]. Voce nao pode ter [resultado final] sem [produto B]. Quer adicionar por apenas $[X] ao inves dos $[2X] normais? ...Voce nao quer mais nada, quer?" [Nao = Sim]

### Script Downsell Gangorra
> "Prefere pagamentos mensais gigantes ou pequenos?" [Cliente: Pequenos]
> "Normalmente custa $[X], mas se pre-pagar hoje, zero pagamentos mensais. Funciona?"
> [Se nao] "Quanto mais der agora, menores seus pagamentos. Qual valor funciona hoje?"

### Script Trial com Penalidade
> "Que tal comecarmos voce gratuitamente? So preciso do cartao para garantir comprometimento. Se fizer tudo certinho, nao paga nada. Se pular algo, pequena taxa para manter no caminho. E assim que sempre fizemos. Justo?"

### Script Anchor
> "Temos duas opcoes. Primeiro, nosso [premium] por $[5-10x]. Inclui [tudo].
> [Espere engasgo] Voce se importa muito com [feature premium]?"
> [Cliente: Nao] "Perfeito. Entao nosso [principal] por $[X] e exatamente o que precisa. Qual cartao prefere?"

```yaml
          ├─ YES → PAY LESS NOW/LATER
```
