            format: "Write personalized instructions as if already own"

          ab_choice:
            description: "'Chocolate or vanilla?' removes yes/no"
            categories:
              - "Quantity: One or two?"
              - "Dates: Tomorrow or Monday?"
              - "Type: Shirt or shorts?"
              - "Colors: Black or white?"
              - "Personnel: John or Sara?"
              - "Times: Morning or afternoon?"

          card_on_file:
            description: "Use the card on file?"
            impact: "40% conversion increase"

        economist_play: |
          A ($59), B ($125), A+B ($125) → 80% choose combo
          Make C same price as most expensive single option.

      anchor_upsell:
        formula: "Premium first → Gasp → Rescue → Main offer → Payment"

        steps:
          - "Present the anchor (5-10x price)"
          - "Wait for the gasp"
          - "Come to rescue: 'Do you care about [premium feature]?'"
          - "Present main offer"
          - "Ask how they want to pay"

        critical_rule: |
          Treat anchor as REAL offer. If fake, they know. You lose trust.
          Some WILL buy premium → massive profit.

        quote: |
          "The only thing worse than making a $1,000 offer to someone with
          a $100 budget is making a $100 offer to someone with a $1,000 budget."

      rollover_upsell:
        formula: "Credit previous purchase toward next, bigger purchase"

        situations:
          - "REENGAGE old customers (6+ months)"
          - "RESCUE angry customers (instead of refund)"
          - "STEAL competitor's unhappy customers"
          - "UPSELL current customers (distribute credit)"

        pricing: "Upsell at least 4x the credit → max 25% discount"

        gift_card_play: |
          Sell $200 gift cards for $20. Limit to two per customer.
          Only for giving to others. When they come, roll the gift card.
          Make card value 20% of next offer price.
          Customers PAY YOU to refer friends.

  downsell-specialist:
    id: downsell-specialist
    title: "Downsell Recovery Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🔄"

    purpose: |
      Design downsell offers that turn No's into Yes's.
      "No means no to THIS offer, not ALL offers."

    core_rules:
      - "No means no to THIS offer, not all offers"
      - "Downsells are TRADES - give something, get something"
      - "Personalize, don't pressure"
      - "Same thing in NEW ways (100 ways, not 100 products)"
      - "NEVER lower price of same thing - change offer with price"
      - "Customers talk about price - consistency matters"

    anti_pattern: |
      Car salesman lowered same insurance from $5,000 to $400.
      Destroyed trust. Customer questioned car price too.
      RULE: Different thing for less = OK. Same thing for less = NEVER.

    offer_toolkit:
      payment_plan:
        formula: "Progressive 7-step reduction until they buy"

        steps:
          - "Reward paying in full (price WITH interest → pre-pay = discount)"
          - "Third-party financing / credit card / layaway"
          - "Half now, half later (align with payday)"
          - "CHECK: 1-10 scale. 8+ continue. 7- switch to feature downsell."
          - "Split into three payments"
          - "Spread evenly (ex: 16 weeks = 16 payments)"
          - "Free trial (→ Trial with Penalty)"

        seesaw_technique: |
          "Giant monthly payments or small ones?" → "Small"
          "Pre-pay today: massive discount + zero monthly. Works?"
          If no: "More you put down = smaller monthly payments."
          If still no: Pull chair to their side, show options together.

        churn_data:
          monthly: "10.7% churn/month"
          quarterly: "5% churn/month"
          annual: "2% churn/month"
          rule: "Double period = halve churn. Always start high, work down."

      trial_with_penalty:
        formula: "Free IF they meet terms. Pay IF they don't."

        process:
          - "Offer trial LAST (only after main rejected)"
          - "ALWAYS get a card ('Which card?' / 'It's how we've always done it')"
          - "Sell staying and paying ('If this works, will you stay long-term?')"
          - "Explain fees AFTER card (more resistance if before)"
          - "Make check-ins MANDATORY (your upsell opportunities)"

        post_trial:
          liked_it: "Easy upsell to longer/higher-value service"
          hated_it: "'You're right, I'm upset. Your needs suit our premium.' (50% buy)"
          didnt_use: "Contact multiple times, waive fee if they meet you"

      feature_downsell:
        formula: "Remove feature → lower price → 'What about now?'"

        guarantee_hack: |
          Full offer $1,000 with guarantee: 25 buy
          Remove guarantee, $600: some buy this
          BUT many reconsider → buy FULL $1,000 because NOW they see guarantee value
          Result: 35 full + 40 without = 75 total (was 25) → tripled close rate

        what_to_remove:
          - "Quantity, quality, service level, availability, speed"
          - "Ratio, communication, provider, live vs recorded"
          - "DIY vs DFY, personalization, insurance/guarantee, entire features"

  continuity-architect:
    id: continuity-architect
    title: "Continuity Offer Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "♾️"

    purpose: |
      Design continuity offers that maximize LTV with recurring payments.
      "You can shear a sheep for its whole life, but you can only skin it once."

    core_principle: |
      Continuity alone hard to advertise profitably.
      After attraction/upsell/downsell cover costs → continuity = predictable growth.

    offer_toolkit:
      continuity_bonus:
        formula: "Amazing bonus for subscribing today. Bonus value > first payment."

        types:
          products: "$800 in dog toys free with $59/month dog food subscription"
          services: "$1,000 accelerator free with $100/month membership"
          digital: "All 40 past newsletters ($15,880) with $399/month subscription"

        pricing_vs_standalone:
          fifty_percent: "Standalone = 1.33x monthly"
          sixty_percent: "Standalone = 1.66x monthly"
          seventy_percent: "Standalone = 2.00x monthly"
          eighty_percent: "Standalone = 2.33x monthly"
          ninety_percent: "Standalone = 2.66x monthly"

        bulk_upsell: |
          Pre-paid bulk (buy 5 get 1 free)
          1 in 8 taking this = 50% more 30-day profit

        tactics:
          - "Focus on the BONUS, not the membership"
          - "Make bonuses from things you ALREADY have"
          - "Physical bonus with digital, digital bonus with physical"
          - "Titles after 3, 6, 12 months (silver, gold, diamond)"
          - "Stack bonuses: sell benefit of each, show individual values"

      continuity_discount:
        formula: "Free time with commitment"

        examples:
          - "3 months free with 12-month commit" (25% off effective)
          - "Buy 6 months, get 6 months free" (50% off, doubles commitment)

        announcement_formats:
          - "Percentage: 25% off"
          - "Dollar: $300 off"
          - "Free portion: 3 months free"
          - "Total: 12 months for $900 (crossed $1,200)"

      waived_fee:
        formula: "Setup fee with m2m OR waived with annual commit"

        structure:
          option_a: "$5,000 setup + $1,000/month, cancel anytime"
          option_b: "$0 setup, commit 12 months at $1,000/month"
          early_exit: "Pay waived fee"
          result: "85% choose commitment. Churn <5%."

        why_it_works:
          - "People START to avoid fee"
          - "People STAY because leaving > staying"
          - "After commitment: fee disappears forever (equitable)"

        cause_based_cancellation: |
          "What cause do you absolutely HATE?"
          "If you cancel early, donating your fee to them."
          Double aversion = additional 50% churn reduction.

        setup:
          duration: "12 months minimum"
          fee: "3-5x monthly"
          early_exit: "Pay waived fee"
          red_flag: "If >5% want early exit → investigate product, not pricing"

  ltv-optimizer:
    id: ltv-optimizer
    title: "LTV Optimization Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Continuously optimize offer sequence for maximum LTV.
      Test, measure, iterate.

    optimization_areas:
      offer_sequence:
        - "Test different attraction offer types"
        - "A/B test upsell timing"
        - "Optimize downsell recovery rate"
        - "Test continuity bonus combinations"

      pricing:
        - "Test anchor ratios (5x vs 10x)"
        - "Optimize standalone vs continuity pricing"
        - "Test payment plan structures"
        - "A/B test discount percentages"

      timing:
        - "When to present each offer type"
        - "Optimal follow-up cadence for upsells"
        - "Best moment for continuity pitch"

    measurement_framework:
      primary:
        - "30-day profitability by cohort"
        - "LTGP:CAC by acquisition channel"
        - "Offer acceptance rate by type"
      secondary:
        - "Upsell sequence completion rate"
        - "Downsell recovery rate"
        - "Continuity conversion rate"
        - "Churn by billing frequency"

  churn-hunter:
    id: churn-hunter
    title: "Churn Prevention Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Identify and prevent churn before it happens.
      Every saved customer = full LTV preserved.

    churn_triggers:
      - "Usage drop >50%"
      - "Missed payment"
      - "Support complaint"
      - "Billing frequency mismatch"
      - "No engagement for 30 days"

    prevention_techniques:
      rollover_save:
        description: "Credit previous purchase toward renewal"
        timing: "Before cancellation request"
        target: "20% acceptance"

      feature_downsell:
        description: "Remove feature, lower price, keep customer"
        timing: "At cancellation request"
        target: "30% save rate"

      cause_based_penalty:
        description: "Donation to hated cause if cancel"
        timing: "At signup (preventive)"
        target: "50% additional churn reduction"

      billing_optimization:
        description: "Move to longer billing cycle"
        timing: "Proactive for high-risk customers"
        data: "Annual = 2% churn vs Monthly = 10.7%"

    recovery_workflow:
      - "Identify at-risk customer (trigger detected)"
      - "Deploy appropriate save offer"
      - "If declined, offer feature downsell"
      - "If still declining, document feedback"
      - "Add to win-back campaign (rollover upsell in 6 months)"

  cash-flow-guardian:
    id: cash-flow-guardian
    title: "30-Day Cash Flow Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "💰"

    purpose: |
      Ensure 30-day CAC recovery across all offer combinations.
      "82% of businesses die from lack of cash flow, not customers."

    core_mandate: |
      If you don't recover CAC in 30 days, you're going bankrupt slowly.
      Credit card as infinite working capital ONLY works with 30-day recovery.

    monitoring:
      daily:
        - "New customer acquisition cost"
        - "30-day revenue per customer"
        - "Offer sequence conversion"

      weekly:
        - "CAC recovery trend"
        - "LTGP:CAC ratio movement"
        - "Cash flow projection"

      monthly:
        - "Full cohort analysis"
        - "Channel profitability"
        - "Offer sequence ROI"

    alerts:
      warning:
        trigger: "CAC recovery 25-30 days"
        action: "Review offer sequence, add upsells"

      critical:
        trigger: "CAC recovery >30 days"
        action: "STOP acquisition, fix offer sequence"

      emergency:
        trigger: "LTGP:CAC <2:1"
        action: "Pause all marketing, redesign Money Model"

    mantras:
      - "30 days or death"
      - "Math doesn't lie"
      - "Cash flow > Revenue"
      - "Pay fast, grow fast"

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # Stage I: Attraction
  - task: "Design Win Your Money Back offer"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Criteria must drive excellent customer behavior"

  - task: "Execute Giveaway campaign"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Prize must be what you want to sell next"

  - task: "Create Decoy Offer structure"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Premium must be 3-5x decoy price"

  - task: "Configure Buy X Get Y"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Match to margin profile"

  - task: "Set up Pay Less Now/Later"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Must get card on file"

  # Stage II: Upsell
  - task: "Identify Classic Upsell opportunities"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Map problem-solution chain first"

  - task: "Execute Menu Upsell"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Follow Unsell → Prescribe → A/B → Card sequence"

  - task: "Deploy Anchor Upsell"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Premium must be real offer"

  - task: "Run Rollover campaign"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Offer must be 4x+ the credit"

  # Stage III: Downsell
  - task: "Execute Payment Plan downsell"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Follow 7-step process, stop when they buy"

  - task: "Deploy Trial with Penalty"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Always get card, explain fees AFTER"

  - task: "Execute Feature Downsell"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Remove highest value first to trigger re-upsell"

  # Stage IV: Continuity
  - task: "Design Continuity Bonus"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Bonus value > first payment"

  - task: "Calculate standalone vs continuity pricing"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use pricing formula based on target %"

  - task: "Implement Waived Fee structure"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Fee = 3-5x monthly, 12 month minimum"

  - task: "Set up Cause-Based Cancellation"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must be cause they genuinely hate"

  # Health Check
  - task: "Calculate LTGP:CAC ratio"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use actual numbers, not projections"

  - task: "Monitor 30-day CAC recovery"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Alert if >25 days"

  - task: "Analyze churn by billing frequency"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Segment by monthly/quarterly/annual"

  - task: "Generate Health Check report"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Include all three metrics with status"

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Attraction Profitability Gate"
    transition: "Attraction Offer → Live"
    condition: "projected_30_day_profit > CAC"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Redesign offer or increase price"

  QG-002:
    name: "Upsell Relevance Gate"
    transition: "Main Offer → Upsell"
    condition: "upsell_solves_problem_created_by_main == true"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Map problem-solution chain"

  QG-003:
    name: "Anchor Reality Gate"
    transition: "Anchor Offer → Presentation"
    condition: "anchor_is_real_deliverable_offer == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Create genuine premium offer"

  QG-004:
    name: "Downsell Trade Gate"
    transition: "Main Offer Rejection → Downsell"
    condition: "downsell_changes_offer_not_just_price == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Restructure downsell as trade"

  QG-005:
    name: "Continuity Value Gate"
    transition: "One-time → Continuity"
    condition: "bonus_value > first_payment"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Enhance bonus package"

  QG-006:
    name: "Cash Flow Gate"
    transition: "Weekly Review"
    condition: "cac_recovery < 30_days"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "STOP acquisition, fix offer sequence"

  QG-007:
    name: "LTGP:CAC Gate"
    transition: "Monthly Review"
    condition: "ltgp_cac >= 2:1"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Add offers or increase prices"

  QG-008:
    name: "Churn Health Gate"
    transition: "Monthly Review"
    condition: "monthly_churn < 10%"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Investigate product, implement waived fee"

# ===============================================================================
# WORKFLOWS
# ===============================================================================

workflows:
  new_customer_workflow:
    trigger: "Lead shows interest"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: attraction-architect
        action: "Present appropriate attraction offer"
        decision_tree: |
          Requires effort? → Win Your Money Back
          Ticket >$1000? → Pay Less Now/Later
          Have authority? → Giveaway
          Default → Buy X Get Y or Decoy

      - step: 2
        agent: upsell-engineer
        action: "Deploy Classic Upsell"
        timing: "Immediately after acceptance"
        script: "You can't have X without Y"

      - step: 3
        agent: upsell-engineer
        action: "Execute Menu Upsell if applicable"
        condition: "Multiple products available"

      - step: 4
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Deploy downsell sequence if rejection"
        sequence: ["Payment Plan", "Trial with Penalty", "Feature Downsell"]

      - step: 5
        agent: continuity-architect
        action: "Present continuity option"
        timing: "After all other offers complete"

      - step: 6
        agent: cash-flow-guardian
        action: "Calculate 30-day profitability"
        alert_if: "CAC recovery > 30 days"

  upsell_optimization_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer completes main purchase"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: offer-sequence-mapper
        action: "Identify problems created by purchase"
        output: "Upsell opportunity list"

      - step: 2
        agent: upsell-engineer
        action: "Select and sequence upsell offers"
        priority: "Most profitable first"

      - step: 3
        agent: upsell-engineer
        action: "Execute upsell sequence"
        rule: "Continue until 'no' or sequence complete"

      - step: 4
        agent: ltv-optimizer
        action: "Record acceptance/rejection data"
        purpose: "Optimize future sequences"

  downsell_recovery_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer says 'no' to offer"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Assess rejection reason"
        categories: ["Price", "Timing", "Fit", "Trust"]

      - step: 2
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Deploy Payment Plan if price objection"
        process: "7-step progressive reduction"

      - step: 3
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Check commitment level (1-10 scale)"
        branch_point: "8+ continue, 7- switch to Feature Downsell"

      - step: 4
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Deploy Trial with Penalty if still hesitant"
        rule: "Card first, fees after"

      - step: 5
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Deploy Feature Downsell as final option"
        technique: "Remove highest value feature first"

  continuity_conversion_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer eligible for continuity"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: continuity-architect
        action: "Select continuity offer type"
        options: ["Bonus", "Discount", "Waived Fee"]

      - step: 2
        agent: continuity-architect
        action: "Present bonus/discount structure"
        anchor: "Show standalone price first"

      - step: 3
        agent: continuity-architect
        action: "Offer pre-paid bulk upsell"
        timing: "Immediately after continuity acceptance"

      - step: 4
        agent: churn-hunter
        action: "Set up churn prevention triggers"
        monitors: ["Usage", "Payment", "Engagement"]

  health_check_workflow:
    trigger: "Weekly scheduled"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: unit-economics-auditor
        action: "Calculate LTGP:CAC ratio"
        output: "Ratio with status (Excellent/Optimize/Critical)"

      - step: 2
        agent: cash-flow-guardian
        action: "Calculate 30-day CAC recovery"
        output: "Days with status (Healthy/Warning/Critical)"

      - step: 3
        agent: churn-hunter
        action: "Calculate monthly churn rate"
        output: "Churn % with status (Exceptional/Acceptable/Critical)"

      - step: 4
        agent: money-model-coordinator
        action: "Generate Health Check report"
        distribution: "Leadership + relevant agents"

      - step: 5
        agent: money-model-coordinator
        action: "Trigger interventions if needed"
        conditions:
          - "LTGP:CAC < 2:1 → STOP acquisition"
          - "CAC recovery > 30 days → Fix offer sequence"
          - "Churn > 10% → Investigate product"

  churn_prevention_workflow:
    trigger: "At-risk customer identified"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: churn-hunter
        action: "Identify churn trigger"
        triggers: ["Usage drop", "Missed payment", "Complaint"]

      - step: 2
        agent: churn-hunter
        action: "Deploy Rollover save offer"
        script: "Credit previous purchase toward renewal"

      - step: 3
        agent: downsell-specialist
        action: "Deploy Feature Downsell if still declining"
        timing: "At cancellation request"

      - step: 4
        agent: continuity-architect
        action: "Offer billing frequency change"
        target: "Move to longer cycle = lower churn"

      - step: 5
        agent: churn-hunter
        action: "Add to win-back campaign if cancelled"
        timing: "6 months, then Rollover Upsell"

# ===============================================================================
# KPIs & SUCCESS METRICS
# ===============================================================================

kpis:
  primary:
    ltgp_cac:
      formula: "Lifetime Gross Profit / Customer Acquisition Cost"
      target: ">3:1"
      impact: "Determines scaling viability"

    thirty_day_cac_recovery:
      formula: "Days until 30-day profit > CAC"
      target: "<30 days"
      impact: "Enables credit card as working capital"

    monthly_churn:
      formula: "Customers lost / Total customers"
      target: "<5%"
      impact: "Determines LTV ceiling"

  secondary:
    offer_conversion:
      attraction: ">25%"
      upsell: ">30%"
      downsell: ">40%"
      continuity: ">60%"

    thirty_day_profit:
      ruim: "Negative"
      medio: "= 1x CAC"
      bom: "= 2x CAC"
      excelente: "= 3x+ CAC"

  by_stage:
    attraction:
      - "Conversion rate by offer type"
      - "30-day profit margin"
      - "CAC recovery timeline"

    upsell:
      - "Acceptance rate by type"
      - "Average upsell value"
      - "Sequential completion rate"

    downsell:
      - "Recovery rate (no → yes)"
      - "Payment plan completion rate"
      - "Trial conversion rate"

    continuity:
      - "Adoption rate"
      - "Churn by billing frequency"
      - "Pre-paid bulk uptake"

# ===============================================================================
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ===============================================================================

troubleshooting:
  - symptom: "Conversion < 10%"
    diagnosis: "Attraction offer wrong type or price"
    solutions:
      - "Test different attraction offer type"
      - "Validate problem-solution fit"
      - "Check price anchoring"

  - symptom: "Upsell < 20%"
    diagnosis: "Wrong timing or irrelevant offer"
    solutions:
      - "Verify problem-solution chain"
      - "Move to different moment"
      - "Improve value articulation"

  - symptom: "Downsell < 30%"
    diagnosis: "Still too expensive or complex"
    solutions:
      - "Add more payment plan steps"
      - "Simplify feature downsell options"
      - "Test trial with penalty"

  - symptom: "Churn > 10%"
    diagnosis: "Product problem, not pricing"
    solutions:
      - "Audit product delivery"
      - "Check customer expectations alignment"
      - "Investigate billing frequency"

  - symptom: "30-day profit negative"
    diagnosis: "Offer sequence incomplete"
    solutions:
      - "Add upsells"
      - "Increase prices"
      - "Reduce acquisition cost"

  - symptom: "CAC recovery > 30 days"
    diagnosis: "Insufficient 30-day revenue"
    solutions:
      - "Add front-loaded offers"
      - "Increase attraction offer price"
      - "Add immediate upsells"

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/marketing-machine-sop.md

# Marketing Machine SOP

> **Source:** $100M Playbook: Marketing Machine - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Transform your business into an automated ads machine that produces endless marketing content without relying on the founder's face. The Marketing Machine gets fresh ads delivered to your inbox every week from your customers.

**Core Insight:**
```
"A company that relies on your face will always be less valuable than one that doesn't."
Source: p.5

"Forty out of the fifty top performers didn't have my face in them.
Yes, eighty percent of them weren't me. They were our customers."
Source: p.5
```

**Business Impact:**
- Eliminates founder dependency for customer acquisition
- Creates enterprise value (sold Gym Launch for $46.2M after implementing)
- Generates "more ads, better ads, without using my face" (p.3)
- Enables business sale without keyman risk

**Core Philosophy:**
```
"It's never really been about you...it's about them.
They are the star of the story. Put them in the spotlight, not you."
Source: p.5
```

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Business has existing customers getting results
- Need scalable ad creative without founder dependency
- Want to capture proof from normal business operations
- Building enterprise value for potential sale

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- Pre-product/market fit (no customer results yet)
- Need for founder-led brand building (initial traction phase)
- Pure cold advertising (no warm proof sources)

### Business Types
- Remote/virtual businesses with recorded calls
- Local businesses with in-person delivery moments
- Service businesses with measurable customer outcomes
- Product businesses with visible results

---

## Part 3: Preconditions

| Precondition | Requirement | Validation |
|--------------|-------------|------------|
| Customer Base | Existing customers getting results | Results being tracked |
| Legal Framework | Permission language in contracts | Contracts updated |
| Recording Infrastructure | Calls recorded, storage configured | Auto-delete disabled |
| Social Presence | Hashtags, profiles for tagging | Tags defined |
| Community Platform | Customer interaction space | Platform active |
| Support System | Account reps, chat logs | Messages searchable |
| Event Capability | In-person or virtual events | Camera crews available |
| Incentive Inventory | Awards, bonuses to give | Items ready |

## Part 4: The Marketing Machine Framework

### Seven Nodes Overview

```
+=====================================================================+
|                    THE MARKETING MACHINE                             |
|              "Turn everything you do into ads"                       |
+=====================================================================+
|                                                                      |
|  +----------------+  +----------------+  +------------------+        |
|  |   LIFECYCLE    |  | SOCIAL MEDIA   |  |     EVENTS       |        |
|  |     ADS        |  |    SCRAPE      |  |                  |        |
|  +-------+--------+  +-------+--------+  +--------+---------+        |
|          |                   |                    |                  |
|          v                   v                    v                  |
|  Before/During/      Tags, Hashtags,        Stage Ads,              |
|  After Moments       Stories, Posts         Pro Testimonials,       |
|  from Calls                                 Man in Street           |
|                                                                      |
|  +----------------+  +----------------+  +------------------+        |
|  | COMMUNICATION  |  |   BONUSES &    |  |   COMPETITIONS   |        |
|  | & COMMUNITIES  |  |    AWARDS      |  |                  |        |
|  +-------+--------+  +-------+--------+  +--------+---------+        |
|          |                   |                    |                  |
|          v                   v                    v                  |
|  Chat Screenshots,   Bonus Unlocks,         Testimonial             |
|  Community Posts,    Award Testimonials     Contest                 |
|  Review Sites        (4 forms of proof)     (measure by ad perf)    |
|                                                                      |
|  +------------------+                                                |
|  |    DELIVERY      |  (Local Business Only)                        |
|  +--------+---------+                                                |
|           |                                                          |
|           v                                                          |
|  Ribbon Cutting,                                                     |
|  First Reaction,                                                     |
|  Results Reveal                                                      |
+=====================================================================+
```

Source: p.6 - "There are many nodes you can turn on once you put the system in place"

### Implementation Priority (Starting Out)

```
1. Competition          - Big influx of content
2. Chat/Messaging Scrape - Already have it, minimal editing
3. Community Scrape     - Already have it, minimal editing
4. Reviews Scrape       - Already have it, minimal editing
5. Social Media Scrape  - Already have it, minimal editing
6. Bonus Unlocks        - Requires creating something to give
7. Award Unlocks        - Requires creating award/trophy
8. Events               - Lot of work, but pays for itself in proof
9. Lifecycle            - Most editing horsepower, but very unique
```

Source: p.24-25 - "If I were starting out, I would implement them in this order"

## Part 5: Process Steps

### NODE I: LIFECYCLE ADS

#### Step 1.1: Legal Compliance Setup
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Add compliance and permission language to all customer contracts |
| **Cognitive Type** | Analysis (legal review) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - One-time manual setup |
| **Executor** | Human (legal/operations) |
| **Precondition** | Business has customer contracts |
| **Output** | Updated contracts with permission language |
| **Guardrails** | "All our clients consent to using recordings of them for compliance, training, and advertising purposes" (p.8) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Even though they sign a document, we still ask if they feel OK with using their story" (p.8) |

#### Step 1.2: Recording Infrastructure
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Record all calls: sales, onboarding, support, ascension, milestone calls |
| **Cognitive Type** | Perception (system configuration) |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH - IT configuration |
| **Executor** | Worker (IT setup) |
| **Precondition** | Recording platform selected |
| **Output** | All customer calls recorded |
| **Guardrails** | "Buy extra storage space so calls don't get deleted. Turn off auto-delete." (p.8) |
| **Decision Rule** | Record everything - you never know which customer will become a star |

#### Step 1.3: Calendar Event Standardization
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create calendar events for all calls and include the client's name in the title |
| **Cognitive Type** | Execution (process compliance) |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH - Calendar rules |
| **Executor** | Worker (all departments) |
| **Precondition** | Recording system active |
| **Output** | Searchable calendar with client names |
| **Guardrails** | Consistent naming convention required |
| **Decision Rule** | "Cross reference calendar events for calls to make sure names and dates match" (p.8) |

#### Step 1.4: Weekly Win Collection
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Sales sends happy-customer-calls to marketing each week |
| **Cognitive Type** | Judgment (identify wins) |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Requires human review |
| **Executor** | Hybrid (Sales identifies, system tracks) |
| **Precondition** | Calls recorded, results tracked |
| **Output** | List of names of successful customers |
| **Guardrails** | Regular cadence required |
| **Decision Rule** | Focus on measurable results and emotional breakthroughs |

#### Step 1.5: Lifecycle Video Creation
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Clip before/during/after moments from customer journey calls |
| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis (creative editing) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires creative judgment |
| **Executor** | Human (marketing/editing) |
| **Precondition** | Happy customer identified, calls located |
| **Output** | Lifecycle ad showing customer journey |
| **Guardrails** | "Clip the before moment from the initial sales calls, a during moment from 1-2 support calls, and the after moment from an upsell, milestone, or testimonial call" (p.8) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Show rather than tell a client's entire journey through time with us" (p.7) |

**Example Ad:** https://www.facebook.com/HormoziAlex/videos/1092224811300421/ (p.8)

#### Step 1.6 [LOCAL BUSINESS]: Delivery Moment Capture
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Capture "ribbon cutting" moments at physical delivery |
| **Cognitive Type** | Perception (moment capture) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires human presence |
| **Executor** | Human (delivery team) |
| **Precondition** | Physical delivery or reveal moment |
| **Output** | Raw reaction videos |
| **Guardrails** | "Think of these like a 'ribbon cutting' ceremony" (p.7) |
| **Decision Rule** | "You want those raw reactions. Those become the hook (first 3-5 sec) of the ad" (p.7) |

**Local Examples:**
- Kitchen remodel reveal (eyes closed then sees)
- Scale results (weight loss)
- Teeth after veneers
- "You got the job!" reactions (recruiting)

Source: p.7 - Author Note

### NODE III: IN-PERSON EVENTS

#### Step 3.1: Event Recording Setup
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Reserve separate rooms and hire camera teams for testimonial capture |
| **Cognitive Type** | Planning (logistics) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Manual coordination |
| **Executor** | Human (operations) |
| **Precondition** | Event scheduled |
| **Output** | Recording infrastructure ready |
| **Guardrails** | "Reserve two separate rooms at the event. A room for the event itself, and a small room close by for recording" (p.13-14) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Hire at least one extra camera team (sometimes two). Testimonials being more important. Put the better team on those" (p.14) |

**Team Structure:**
- 2 camera operators for testimonials
- 1 runner to bring clients to/from testimonial area
- Separate team for main event recording

Source: p.14

#### Step 3.2: Stage Ads Capture
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Get picture while on stage with people celebrating behind you |
| **Cognitive Type** | Perception (moment capture) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Manual execution |
| **Executor** | Human (speaker + camera) |
| **Precondition** | Event in progress |
| **Output** | Stage photos and videos |
| **Guardrails** | "You only get one take, so make it count!" (p.13) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Do this at the end of day one or before lunch on day two" (p.13) |

**Capture Checklist:**
- [ ] Picture on stage with crowd celebrating behind
- [ ] Multiple selfie images
- [ ] Video if possible (one take)

Source: p.13

#### Step 3.3: Professional Testimonials
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Grab people during event and take them to side room for recorded testimonials |
| **Cognitive Type** | Judgment (subject selection) + Execution (recording) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires human interaction |
| **Executor** | Human (camera team + handler) |
| **Precondition** | Recording room ready, hit list prepared |
| **Output** | Professional quality testimonial videos |
| **Guardrails** | "Set up the lighting and sound so it looks good. Have multiple mics and cameras. Trust me. Then TEST. TEST. TEST." (p.14) |
| **Decision Rule** | "The worst thing that happens is you lose audio or video from every testimonial for an entire event" (p.14) |

**Pre-Event Preparation:**
- [ ] Pick customers for testimonials ahead of time
- [ ] Confirm in writing
- [ ] Print hit list on clipboard
- [ ] Let them know it won't be during keynotes
- [ ] Offer to give notes for minutes they miss

**During Event:**
- [ ] Announce at beginning that team will be doing this
- [ ] Introduce handler so people know who's tapping shoulders
- [ ] Give bonus for testimonial participation
- [ ] Give handler $50 bonus for each person captured not on list

Source: p.14

#### Step 3.4: Six-Point Testimonial Script
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Walk customers through standardized 6-point testimonial script |
| **Cognitive Type** | Execution (script following) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Human delivery required |
| **Executor** | Human (interviewer) |
| **Precondition** | Customer in recording room |
| **Output** | Complete testimonial covering all angles |
| **Guardrails** | "The most important part of the testimonial is the hook. Be explicit." (p.16) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Have them say their name at the beginning of the video. Your camera team often has no idea so this helps match names to videos later" (p.16) |

**The 6-Point Script:**
```
1. (Internal Struggle) What was rock bottom before doing this?
   What did you have to do that you hated?
   What things did you want to do that you couldn't?

2. (External Struggle) What were your objective metrics?

3. (Skepticism) What were your main concerns about buying/clicking/joining?

4. (Overcome) What made you do it anyways?

5. (External Victory) What are your objective metrics now?

6. (Internal Victory) What's been the best moment since?
   What can you do now you couldn't do before?
   What things did you hate doing you don't have to do anymore?
```
Source: p.15

**Hook Tips:**
- Have them say a few different hooks before getting into story
- Test what works better
- Name at beginning of video

Source: p.15-16

#### Step 3.5: Man in the Street Testimonials
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Quick soundbite interviews during breaks - one question at a time |
| **Cognitive Type** | Execution (rapid collection) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Human interaction |
| **Executor** | Human (second camera team) |
| **Precondition** | 10 core questions prepared |
| **Output** | 10+ responses per question for highlight reels |
| **Guardrails** | "These take seconds to capture. You turn them into fast hitting highlight reels" (p.16) |
| **Decision Rule** | "Ask only that question until you get the number of answers you want" (p.16) |

**Example Questions:**
```
- How many new customers have you gained since you started?
- What were you making before X vs now?
- How much extra income has X added?
- How much weight have you lost since you started here?
- How much has your credit score improved?
- What was your old credit score and what is it now? From what to what?
```
Source: p.16

**Alternative Approach:**
- Ask 6-point script questions piecemeal
- Create "mondo testimonial" with fast-hitting answers from 5+ people
- Same characters woven through testimonial reel

Source: p.16

**Logistics:**
- Print questions for camera team
- Space below each question to tally responses
- Target 10+ responses per question

**Example Compilation:** https://www.gymlaunch.com/secrets (about 1min 20sec in) - p.16

#### Step 4.3: Community Wins Scrape
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|

| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Reminders automated, capture manual |

| **Precondition** | Community platform active |
| **Output** | Community wins folder with screenshots |
| **Guardrails** | "Create a post category called 'wins'" (p.18) |
| **Decision Rule** | Regular cadence, weekly wins post |

**Implementation:**
- [ ] Create "wins" post category if platform allows
- [ ] Create community wins folder
- [ ] Every Friday: encourage wins of the week posts
- [ ] Monday: screenshot wins from weekend
- [ ] Search same key terms inside group
- [ ] Sort by newest, screenshot best ones

Screen record scrolling through the comments/wins of the community
for the week (or over multiple weeks). This gives you yet another ad to run.
```

| **Executor** | Hybrid |

| **Output** | Review screenshots folder |

Glassdoor, Yelp, Google, Facebook, TrustPilot, Amazon, etc.

### NODE V: BONUSES & AWARDS

#### Step 5.1: Bonus Unlock Creation
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create valuable giveaway that can be unlocked with testimonial video |
| **Cognitive Type** | Creativity (offer design) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Creative decision |
| **Executor** | Human (marketing leadership) |
| **Precondition** | Deliverable asset exists |
| **Output** | Bonus offer with clear value |
| **Guardrails** | "Make it big and sexy" - must be genuinely valuable |
| **Decision Rule** | "It could be a training, a tiny project, one-time access, or a status tier" (p.20) |

**Examples:**
- Sales scripts
- Ad training for different platforms
- Exclusive content
- Status tier access

Source: p.20

#### Step 5.2: Bonus Unlock Promotion
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Sell people on the bonus, then offer testimonial video as unlock mechanism |
| **Cognitive Type** | Persuasion (value framing) |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Recording can be placed in customer journey |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Bonus created with price attached |
| **Output** | Customers submitting testimonials for bonus access |
| **Guardrails** | "Put the recording of you pitching it somewhere all customers see" (p.20) |
| **Decision Rule** | Frame as trade: "Buy it OR make a testimonial to unlock free" |

**Unlock Instructions Template:**
```
1. Send a video under 5min that hits these 6 points
   to this email: proof@yourco.com
2. Use this video as a reference/example (put your best one)
3. Post the video in the group with your stats associated
   (auto-get second testimonial in written format)
4. Tag the community manager in your post
5. Include keywords to make them easy to scrape later
```
Source: p.20

#### Step 5.3: Award System Creation
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create aspirational award tied to meaningful customer milestone |
| **Cognitive Type** | Creativity (status design) |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Strategic decision |
| **Executor** | Human (leadership) |
| **Precondition** | Aspirational customer goal identified |
| **Output** | Physical award with status association |
| **Guardrails** | "Make it big and cool. Spend some money on it. It will make you more back. Promise. People have to crave this thing." (p.20) |
| **Decision Rule** | Tie to community identity, not boring generic award |

**Examples:**
```
Gym Launch: Sword and shield for "Gym Lords" community
- Swords associated with bodybuilding trophies (fitness prestige)
- Community called "Gym Lords" (brand alignment)
```
Source: p.20

#### Step 5.4: Four-Form Award Testimonial System
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Extract 4 forms of proof from each award recipient |
| **Cognitive Type** | Execution (process compliance) |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Prompts automated, collection human |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Award system established |
| **Output** | 4 testimonials per award recipient |
| **Guardrails** | "You can get FOUR forms of proof from one award per person" (p.20) |
| **Decision Rule** | Never give award without capturing all 4 forms |

**The Four Forms:**
```
PROOF 1: Post showing actual numbers in group using template
         Tag community owner

PROOF 2: Video sent to proof@yourco.com

PROOF 3: Unboxing video when they receive mailed award

PROOF 4: Recording at in-person or stage presentation
         (Personalized/engraved one mailed + generic one for stage)
```

### NODE VII: WEEKLY ASSEMBLY

#### Step 7.1: Weekly Content Assembly
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Assemble all proof-based marketing content from all nodes weekly |
| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis (content aggregation) |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Collection automated, assembly human |
| **Executor** | Hybrid (marketing team) |
| **Precondition** | All nodes active |
| **Output** | Weekly content package |
| **Guardrails** | "Make your marketing team's start of week checklist to check all the above" (p.23) |
| **Decision Rule** | Every week should have content from each active node |

**Weekly Content Checklist:**
```
[ ] List of names of people who got great results
[ ] Scraped Social media from you, tags, and customers (images + videos)
[ ] Chat/messaging screenshots from account reps
[ ] Community post & comments testimonials
    (screenshots, videos, comment section screen recordings)
[ ] All new 5-star reviews on external sites
    (screenshots + scroll recordings)

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Implementation Priority
```yaml
rule: STARTING_PRIORITY
trigger: New Marketing Machine implementation
condition:
  - IF no_customer_testimonials THEN start_with_competition()
  - IF has_existing_chat_logs THEN add_chat_scrape()
  - IF has_community THEN add_community_scrape()
  - IF has_reviews THEN add_reviews_scrape()
  - IF has_social_tags THEN add_social_scrape()
action: Follow priority order from p.24-25
confidence: HIGH (Hormozi direct recommendation)
source: p.24-25
```

### DR-002: Content Winnability Assessment
```yaml
rule: CONTENT_PERFORMANCE
trigger: New content captured
condition:
  - IF organic_engagement > average THEN flag_as_stud()
  - IF organic_engagement <= average THEN mark_as_dud()
  - IF stud THEN test_as_ad()
action: "Good organic performance correlates highly with good ad performance"
confidence: HIGH
source: p.9
```

### DR-003: Testimonial Subject Selection
```yaml
rule: TESTIMONIAL_PRIORITY
trigger: Event or competition
condition:
  - IF customer_has_measurable_results THEN high_priority()
  - IF customer_has_emotional_story THEN high_priority()
  - IF customer_matches_target_avatar THEN high_priority()
  - IF customer_is_willing THEN proceed()
action: Focus on results + story + avatar match
confidence: HIGH
source: p.14
```

### DR-004: Permission Protocol
```yaml
rule: CONTENT_PERMISSION
trigger: Before using any customer content
condition:
  - IF contract_permission_signed THEN can_use()
  - IF personal_ask_confirmed THEN can_use()
  - IF customer_says_no THEN honor_wishes()
action: "Even though they sign a document, we still ask"
confidence: HIGH
source: p.8
```

### DR-005: Event ROI Calculation
```yaml
rule: EVENT_JUSTIFICATION
trigger: Event planning
condition:
  - IF not_selling_at_event THEN media_is_ROI()
  - IF capturing_testimonials THEN event_pays_for_itself()
action: "Since the events cost a fortune, and I didn't sell anything, that media was the only way I could get returns"
confidence: HIGH
source: p.12
```

### DR-006: Award Investment
```yaml
rule: AWARD_QUALITY
trigger: Creating award/trophy
condition:
  - IF award_is_boring THEN redesign()
  - IF award_is_cheap THEN upgrade()
  - IF people_dont_crave_it THEN iterate()
action: "Spend some money on it. It will make you more back. Promise."
confidence: HIGH
source: p.20
```

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Small Customer Base
**Trigger:** Not enough customers for Marketing Machine
**Action:** Build customer base first
**Script:** "If you have a small amount of customers, refer to the Warm Outreach chapter in $100M Leads - work for free. Get those testimonials. Then you can start the flow of customers that follow and begin to spin the wheel." (p.25)

### Exception 2: Customer Refuses Permission
**Trigger:** Customer declines to have story used
**Action:** Honor wishes, move on
**Response:** "If they say no, we honor their wishes. Plenty more successful clients feel ecstatic to share their stories with the world." (p.8)

### Exception 3: Lost Audio/Video at Event
**Trigger:** Technical failure during event testimonials
**Action:** Prevention is key
**Prevention:** "TEST. TEST. TEST. The worst thing that happens is you lose audio or video from every testimonial for an entire event. You will want to kill everyone." (p.14)

### Exception 4: Testimonial Fatigue
**Trigger:** Community tired of testimonial requests
**Action:** Space out competitions
**Rule:** "People tire of them, so you can't do them very often, like once or twice a year max" (p.21)

### Exception 5: No Physical Location
**Trigger:** Virtual/remote business
**Action:** Skip delivery moments, focus on call recording
**Note:** "If you're an in-person business you have an insane advantage over virtual or remote businesses. Every day is an in-person event." (p.12) - Virtual businesses use lifecycle ads from calls instead.

## Appendix A: The Six-Point Testimonial Script

```
1. INTERNAL STRUGGLE (Emotional Before)
   "What was rock bottom before doing this?"
   "What did you have to do that you hated?"
   "What things did you want to do that you couldn't?"

2. EXTERNAL STRUGGLE (Measurable Before)
   "What were your objective metrics?"

3. SKEPTICISM (Objection Handling)
   "What were your main concerns about buying/clicking/joining?"

4. OVERCOME (Decision Trigger)
   "What made you do it anyways?"

5. EXTERNAL VICTORY (Measurable After)
   "What are your objective metrics now?"

6. INTERNAL VICTORY (Emotional After)
   "What's been the best moment since?"
   "What can you do now you couldn't do before?"
   "What things did you hate doing you don't have to do anymore?"
```

Source: p.15

  source_playbook: "$100M Playbook: Marketing Machine"

  core_insight: |
    "A company that relies on your face will always be less valuable than one that doesn't."
    "Eighty percent of top-performing ads weren't me. They were our customers."
    Source: p.5

  business_impact:
    - "Eliminates founder dependency for customer acquisition"
    - "Creates enterprise value ($46.2M sale achieved after implementation)"
    - "Generates more ads, better ads, without founder face"
    - "Enables business sale without keyman risk"

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: machine-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate all seven nodes of the Marketing Machine"
      decisions:
        - "Prioritize which nodes to activate based on business stage"
        - "Allocate resources across content capture workflows"
        - "Identify bottlenecks in testimonial pipeline"
        - "Schedule events and competitions for content surges"
      kpis:
        - "Weekly content flow (>5 new pieces/week)"
        - "Customer-generated ratio (>80% of top ads)"
        - "Testimonial pipeline volume"
        - "Node coverage (5+ nodes active)"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: content-auditor
      role: "Monitor content health across all nodes and identify gaps"
      inputs:
        - "Current content inventory"
        - "Ad performance data"
        - "Node activity metrics"
        - "Testimonial submission rates"
      outputs:
        - "Content gap report"
        - "Node activation recommendations"
        - "Resource reallocation needs"
        - "Priority customers for testimonials"

    - agent: permission-guardian
      role: "Ensure all content usage complies with permission protocols"
      inputs:
        - "Customer contracts"
        - "Permission requests"
        - "Content usage logs"
      outputs:
        - "Permission status by customer"
        - "Compliance flags"
        - "Content cleared for use"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: lifecycle-harvester
      role: "Extract before/during/after moments from customer journey calls"
      specialization: "Node I: Lifecycle Ads"
      capabilities:
        - "Identify happy customers from weekly reports"
        - "Locate call recordings across timeline"
        - "Clip key moments (before, during, after)"
        - "Assemble lifecycle narrative"
      targets:
        weekly_submissions: "Sales sends happy-customer-calls weekly"
        video_output: "1+ lifecycle video per key customer"

    - agent: social-scraper
      role: "Monitor and capture customer-generated social content"
      specialization: "Node II: Social Media Scrape"
      capabilities:
        - "Monitor hashtags and tags across platforms"
        - "Capture ephemeral content (stories) within 24h"
        - "Organize media with searchable naming"
        - "Separate studs from duds based on engagement"
      targets:
        daily_scrape: "All platforms monitored"
        story_capture: "<24 hours for ephemeral content"

    - agent: event-captain
      role: "Maximize testimonial capture at in-person events"
      specialization: "Node III: In-Person Events"
      capabilities:
        - "Coordinate camera teams and recording rooms"
        - "Execute hit list of priority testimonials"
        - "Capture stage ads at key moments"
        - "Run man-in-the-street rapid interviews"
      techniques:
        stage_ads: "Selfie with crowd, end of day 1 or before lunch day 2"
        pro_testimonials: "6-point script in dedicated room"
        man_in_street: "10 questions, 10+ responses each"

    - agent: community-miner
      role: "Extract proof from support chats, communities, and reviews"
      specialization: "Node IV: Communication & Communities"
      capabilities:
        - "Search key terms in support messages"
        - "Screenshot customer wins"
        - "Screen record community scrolls"
        - "Scrape review sites"
      keywords:
        - "PIF, Sales, $, Profit, Revenue, Monthly"
        - "close, closed, leads, show, scheduled, win"

    - agent: incentive-architect
      role: "Design and execute bonus unlocks and award testimonials"
      specialization: "Node V: Bonuses & Awards"
      capabilities:
        - "Create compelling bonus offers"
        - "Design aspirational awards"
        - "Execute four-form proof capture per award"
        - "Track testimonial-for-bonus exchanges"
      four_proofs:
        - "Post with numbers in group (PROOF 1)"
        - "Video to proof@yourco.com (PROOF 2)"
        - "Unboxing video when received (PROOF 3)"
        - "Stage/in-person presentation recording (PROOF 4)"

    - agent: competition-runner
      role: "Execute testimonial competitions with ad performance judging"
      specialization: "Node VI: Competitions"
      capabilities:
        - "Design competition structure"
        - "Execute multi-channel announcement"
        - "Personal outreach to top 50 customers"
        - "Run all submissions as ads for 30 days"
        - "Measure by conversions, announce winner"
      frequency: "1-2x per year maximum (fatigue prevention)"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: content-curator
      role: "Assess content quality and route to appropriate use"
      inputs:
        - "Raw content from all nodes"
        - "Organic performance data"
        - "Historical ad performance"
      outputs:
        - "Stud vs dud classification"
        - "Recommended ad combinations"
        - "Content ready for production"
      insight: "Good organic performance correlates highly with good ad performance"

    - agent: assembly-director
      role: "Combine content pieces into final ad creatives"
      capabilities:
        - "Match proven visuals with proven copy"
        - "Create lifecycle narratives"
        - "Build highlight reel compilations"
        - "Package weekly content for ad team"

    - agent: calendar-strategist
      role: "Plan content surges from events and competitions"
      responsibilities:
        - "Schedule events 2x/year"
        - "Schedule competitions 1x/year"
        - "Run competitions between events"
        - "Ensure big flow every 12 weeks"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  machine-coordinator:
    id: machine-coordinator
    title: "Marketing Machine Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "factory"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate all seven nodes of the Marketing Machine to produce
      endless customer-generated ads without founder dependency.
      "Turn everything you do into ads."

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Seven Nodes"
        components:
          - "Lifecycle Ads"
          - "Social Media Scrape"
          - "In-Person Events"
          - "Communication & Communities"
          - "Bonuses & Awards"
          - "Competitions"
          - "Delivery (local only)"
      - name: "Implementation Priority"
        order:
          - "Competition (big influx)"
          - "Chat/Messaging Scrape"
          - "Community Scrape"
          - "Reviews Scrape"
          - "Social Media Scrape"
          - "Bonus Unlocks"
          - "Award Unlocks"
          - "Events"
          - "Lifecycle"

    decision_authority:
      - "Node activation priority"
      - "Resource allocation across nodes"
      - "Event and competition scheduling"
      - "Content production pipeline"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Customer-Generated Ratio"
          target: ">80% of top 50 ads"
          source: "p.5 - 'eighty percent of them weren't me'"
        - name: "Weekly Content Flow"
          target: ">5 new pieces"
      secondary:
        - "Active nodes: 5+"
        - "Testimonial pipeline: >10/month"
        - "Content surge every 12 weeks"

  content-auditor:
    id: content-auditor
    title: "Content Health Monitor"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "chart"

    purpose: |
      Monitor the health of content flow across all seven nodes.
      Identify gaps before they become problems.

    audit_dimensions:
      node_activity:
        - "Lifecycle: Weekly happy customer names submitted?"
        - "Social: Daily tag monitoring happening?"
        - "Events: Next event scheduled with camera plan?"
        - "Communication: Weekly screenshot collection?"
        - "Bonuses: Unlock submissions flowing?"
        - "Awards: Four-form capture completing?"
        - "Competitions: Next competition planned?"

      content_quality:
        - "Stud/dud ratio improving?"
        - "Organic engagement trending up?"
        - "Ad performance by content type"

    outputs:
      - "Weekly content health report"
      - "Node activation recommendations"
      - "Priority customer list for testimonials"
      - "Resource reallocation needs"

  permission-guardian:
    id: permission-guardian
    title: "Permission & Compliance Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "shield"

    purpose: |
      Ensure all customer content usage complies with permissions.
      "Even though they sign a document, we still ask."

    permission_protocol:
      contract_level:
        requirement: "Compliance and permission language in all customer contracts"
        covers: "Compliance, training, and advertising purposes"

      personal_level:
        requirement: "Ask if they feel OK with using their story"
        action_if_no: "Honor their wishes"
        philosophy: "Plenty more successful clients feel ecstatic to share"

    outputs:
      - "Permission status by customer"
      - "Content cleared for advertising use"
      - "Compliance flags for review"

  lifecycle-harvester:
    id: lifecycle-harvester
    title: "Lifecycle Content Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "video"

    purpose: |
      Extract before/during/after moments from customer journey
      to create powerful lifecycle testimonial ads.

    workflow:
      step_1_collect:
        action: "Receive weekly happy-customer list from Sales"
        output: "Names of customers with great results"

      step_2_locate:
        action: "Search calendar events for all calls with that customer"
        output: "Timeline of all recorded interactions"

      step_3_clip:
        action: "Extract key moments"
        moments:
          before: "Initial sales call - struggle, pain point"
          during: "1-2 support calls - journey, learning"
          after: "Upsell, milestone, or testimonial call - victory"

      step_4_assemble:
        action: "Create lifecycle narrative"
        output: "Complete customer journey video"

    local_business_variant:
      name: "Delivery Moment Capture"
      description: "Ribbon cutting ceremony style"
      examples:
        - "Kitchen reveal (eyes closed then sees)"
        - "Scale results (weight loss)"
        - "Teeth after veneers"
        - "Job offer reaction"
      hook: "Raw reactions become first 3-5 seconds of ad"

    infrastructure_requirements:
      - "All calls recorded"
      - "Extra storage (no auto-delete)"
      - "Client names in calendar event titles"
      - "Searchable labeling system"

  social-scraper:
    id: social-scraper
    title: "Social Media Content Hunter"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "hashtag"

    purpose: |
      Monitor and capture all customer-generated social content
      before it disappears.

    hashtag_system:
      purpose: "Unified tagging for easy discovery"
      examples:
        gym_launch: ["#gymlord", "#gymlaunch", "#gymowner"]
        prestige_labs: ["#poweredbyprestige"]
        personal: ["#neverskipdessert", "#acquisition", "#100moffers", "#100mleads"]

    capture_workflow:
      daily_tasks:
        - "Monitor all defined hashtags"
        - "Check tagged posts/stories"
        - "Capture stories within 24 hours (ephemeral!)"
        - "Save with searchable naming convention"

      organization:
        - "Tag with relevant facts"
        - "Create searchable names"
        - "Separate studs from duds folder"

    performance_correlation: |
      "Good organic performance correlates highly with
      good ad and outbound performance"

    ad_creation:
      rule: "Use best-performing images/videos with already-performing ad copy"
      includes: "Yes, including stuff you posted"

  event-captain:
    id: event-captain
    title: "Event Testimonial Commander"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "stage"

    purpose: |
      Maximize testimonial capture at every in-person event.
      "Every event should more than pay for itself in proof alone."

    event_philosophy: |
      "If you're an in-person business you have an insane advantage.
      Every day is an in-person event."
      "Since events cost a fortune and I didn't sell anything,
      that media was the only way I could get returns."

    three_capture_types:
      stage_ads:
        description: "Ads recorded on stage with crowd"
        checklist:
          - "Picture on stage with people celebrating behind"
          - "Multiple selfie images"
          - "Video if possible (one take!)"
        timing: "End of day one or before lunch day two"

      professional_testimonials:
        description: "Dedicated room recordings with 6-point script"
        setup:
          - "Reserve two rooms: event + recording"
          - "Or 2-3 extra hotel rooms for recording"
          - "Two camera operators + one runner"
          - "Better team on testimonials"
          - "Multiple mics and cameras"
          - "TEST. TEST. TEST. equipment"
        pre_event:
          - "Pick customers ahead of time"
          - "Confirm in writing"
          - "Print hit list on clipboard"
          - "Announce at event start"
          - "Introduce handler to everyone"
        incentives:
          - "Bonus for testimonial participation"
          - "$50 handler bonus for each non-list capture"
        execution:
          - "Avoid pulling during keynotes"
          - "Use mornings, lunches, breaks, end of day"
          - "Name at beginning of video"
          - "Multiple hook versions"

      man_in_street:
        description: "Quick soundbite interviews during breaks"
        setup: "Second two-man camera team"
        preparation: "10 core questions, target 10+ responses each"
        example_questions:
          - "How many new customers have you gained since you started?"
          - "What were you making before X vs now?"
          - "How much extra income has X added?"
          - "How much weight have you lost?"
          - "What was your credit score before/after?"
        execution:
          - "Print questions for camera team"
          - "Tally space below each question"
          - "Ask only that question until target reached"
        output: "Fast-hitting highlight reels"

    six_point_script:
      - question: "What was rock bottom before doing this?"
        type: "Internal Struggle"
      - question: "What were your objective metrics?"
        type: "External Struggle"
      - question: "What were your main concerns about buying?"
        type: "Skepticism"
      - question: "What made you do it anyways?"
        type: "Overcome"
      - question: "What are your objective metrics now?"
        type: "External Victory"
      - question: "What's been the best moment since?"
        type: "Internal Victory"

  community-miner:
    id: community-miner
    title: "Communication & Community Harvester"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "messages"

    purpose: |
      Extract proof from every customer communication channel.
      "Weaponize all those great little moments."

    three_sources:
      support_chat:
        description: "Screenshot juicy messages when things go well"
        keywords: ["PIF", "Sales", "$", "Profit", "Revenue", "Monthly", "close", "closed", "leads", "show", "scheduled", "win"]
        workflow:
          - "Create shared folder for all reps"
          - "Set reminder to search key terms"
          - "Sort by date, screenshot new ones"
          - "Optional: sub-folders by type"
        culture:
          - "Manager notes who turned in screenshots"
          - "Give kudos (they won't do it otherwise)"
          - "Optional: $100 gift card for winning ad screenshots"

      community_wins:
        description: "Posts and comments from customer community"
        workflow:
          - "Create 'wins' post category if possible"
          - "Create community wins folder"
          - "Friday: wins of the week post"
          - "Monday: screenshot weekend wins"
          - "Search same key terms in group"
        bonus_technique: |
          "Screen record scrolling through the comments/wins
          for the week (or over multiple weeks).
          This gives you yet another ad to run."

      reviews_scrape:
        description: "External review site monitoring"
        sites: ["Glassdoor", "Yelp", "Google", "Facebook", "TrustPilot", "Amazon"]
        workflow:
          - "List all review sites"
          - "Create reviews folder"
          - "Calendar reminder per site"
          - "Sort by newest, screenshot good ones"

  incentive-architect:
    id: incentive-architect
    title: "Bonus & Award Testimonial Designer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "trophy"

    purpose: |
      Design irresistible bonuses and awards that generate testimonials.
      "Ask people to submit testimonials to get the award."

    bonus_unlocks:
      concept: "Trade testimonial for valuable bonus"
      types:
        - "Training content"
        - "Tiny project/deliverable"
        - "One-time access"
        - "Status tier"
      requirements:
        - "Make it big and sexy"
        - "Attach a price to it"
        - "Make it for sale (then offer testimonial as alternative)"
      unlock_instructions:
        - "Send video under 5min hitting 6 points to proof@yourco.com"
        - "Use reference video (your best one)"
        - "Post video in group with stats"
        - "Tag community manager"
        - "Include keywords for scraping"

    award_testimonials:
      concept: "Create aspirational award, exchange for 4 forms of proof"
      design_principles:
        - "Tie to community identity"
        - "Make it big and cool"
        - "Spend money on it (makes more back)"
        - "People must crave this thing"
        - "Don't do boring"
      example:
        company: "Gym Launch"
        award: "Sword and shield"
        why: "Swords = bodybuilding prestige, community = Gym Lords"

      four_forms_capture:
        proof_1:
          type: "Written/Screenshot"
          action: "Post showing actual numbers in group"
          requirement: "Tag community owner"
        proof_2:
          type: "Video"
          action: "Email video to proof@yourco.com"
        proof_3:
          type: "Unboxing Video"
          action: "Record receiving and opening mailed award"
        proof_4:
          type: "Stage Recording"
          action: "Record in-person or stage presentation"
          note: "Keep personalized/engraved one to mail + generic for stage"

  competition-runner:
    id: competition-runner
    title: "Testimonial Competition Executor"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "medal"

    purpose: |
      Run high-impact testimonial competitions judged by ad performance.
      "The one with the most conversions over 30 days wins."

    frequency_warning: |
      "People tire of them, so you can't do them very often,
      like once or twice a year max."

    competition_structure:
      format: "Raw iPhone-style testimonial"
      judging: "Ad conversion performance over 30 days"
      award_example: "6 months of free service/product"

    execution_workflow:
      phase_1_setup:
        - "Set announcement date & deadline"
        - "Define crazy award"
        - "Prepare submission instructions"
        - "Gather reference video (last winner or best)"
        - "Attach 6-point script"

      phase_2_announce:
        - "Announce via ALL internal channels (email, group, community)"
        - "Countdown to deadline"
        - "Personal invitations to top 50 customers"
        - "Regular follow-up"

      phase_3_collect:
        tip: |
          "Ask them to do it the moment - 'right now, it takes 5min,
          just take out your phone so you don't have to think about it'"
        quality: "The raw-er the better"

      phase_4_judge:
        - "Cut off submissions at deadline"
        - "Format all as ads"
        - "Run them for 30 days"
        - "Count conversions"
        - "Announce winner publicly"

  content-curator:
    id: content-curator
    title: "Content Quality Assessor"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "filter"

    purpose: |
      Separate studs from duds and route content appropriately.
      "Good organic performance correlates highly with good ad performance."

    classification_system:
      studs:
        definition: "Content that outperformed typical posts"
        indicators:
          - "High organic engagement"
          - "Strong emotional response"
          - "Clear results/metrics mentioned"
          - "Authentic feel"
        destination: "Top performer folder for ad testing"

      duds:
        definition: "Average or below-average performing content"
        use: "Archive for volume/backup"

    workflow:
      - "Review all incoming content"
      - "Check organic performance metrics"
      - "Apply stud/dud classification"
      - "Route studs to ad combination testing"
      - "Track ad performance to refine classification"

  assembly-director:
    id: assembly-director
    title: "Ad Creative Assembly Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "combine"

    purpose: |
      Combine content pieces into final ad creatives.
      "Use best-performing images and videos with already-performing ad copy."

    assembly_types:
      lifecycle_narrative:
        description: "Before/during/after customer journey"
        source: "Lifecycle Harvester outputs"

      highlight_reel:
        description: "Fast-hitting compilation of responses"
        source: "Man-in-street testimonials"
        format: "Same question, multiple people answering"

      community_scroll:
        description: "Screen recording of wins/comments"
        source: "Community miner outputs"

      stud_combinations:
        description: "Proven visual + proven copy"
        source: "Content curator outputs"

    weekly_output:
      name: "Weekly Content Package"
      contents:
        - "List of names with great results"
        - "Scraped social media (images + videos)"
        - "Chat screenshots"
        - "Community testimonials"
        - "New 5-star reviews"
        - "Bonus unlock submissions"
        - "Award deliveries"
        - "Customer reaction videos"

  calendar-strategist:
    id: calendar-strategist
    title: "Content Surge Planner"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "calendar"

    purpose: |
      Plan the annual calendar of events and competitions
      to create regular content surges.

    planning_framework:
      rhythm: "Big flow every 12 weeks"
      components:
        events: "2 per year"
        competitions: "1 per year"
        relationship: "Run competitions between events"

    annual_calendar_template:
      q1: "Event 1"
      q2: "Competition"
      q3: "Event 2"
      q4: "Ongoing node collection"

    philosophy: |
      "For some, this is all the ad content they'll ever need."

  - task: "Screen record community scroll"

  - task: "Scrape review sites"

    guardrails: "30 day measurement window"

  - task: "Count conversions, announce winner"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    node: Competitions
    guardrails: "Public announcement"

  # Node VII: Weekly Assembly

    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    node: Assembly
    guardrails: "Start of week checklist"

  - task: "Plan 6-month content calendar"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    node: Assembly
    guardrails: "Big flow every 12 weeks"

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Permission Gate"
    transition: "Content Capture -> Content Use"
    condition: "contract_signed AND personal_ok"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Honor wishes, do not use"
    source: "p.8"

  QG-002:
    name: "Lifecycle Completeness Gate"
    transition: "Clips -> Final Video"
    condition: "before_clip AND during_clip AND after_clip"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Wait for missing moments"

  QG-003:
    name: "Event Equipment Gate"
    transition: "Setup -> Recording"
    condition: "tested_audio AND tested_video AND backup_available"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Do not proceed until tested"
    source: "p.14 - TEST. TEST. TEST."

  QG-004:
    name: "Award Four-Form Gate"
    transition: "Award Given -> Complete"
    condition: "proof_1 AND proof_2 AND proof_3 AND proof_4"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Follow up for missing proofs"

  QG-005:
    name: "Competition Frequency Gate"
    transition: "Plan -> Launch"
    condition: "last_competition > 6_months_ago"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Wait - fatigue risk"
    source: "p.21 - once or twice a year max"

  QG-006:
    name: "Weekly Content Gate"
    transition: "Week End -> Week Start"
    condition: "new_content >= 5"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Audit all nodes for gaps"

  QG-007:
    name: "Customer-Generated Ratio Gate"
    transition: "Ad Production -> Launch"
    condition: "customer_generated_ratio >= 80%"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Reduce founder content in rotation"
    source: "p.5 - 80% weren't me"
