## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/registration-page-sop.md

# Registration Page SOP

> **Source:** $100M Money Models Blueprint - Registration Page Content & Main Offer Landing Page
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Create registration pages for events, webinars, and launches that maximize opt-in conversions while building anticipation and pre-qualifying prospects for future offers. A registration page is NOT a sales page - it captures commitment and creates the foundation for the entire launch sequence.

**Core Philosophy:**
```
Registration Page = Commitment Device + Anticipation Builder + Lead Qualifier

Unlike landing pages that sell, registration pages:
├── Capture COMMITMENT (email, calendar block, mental investment)
├── Build ANTICIPATION (mystery, curiosity, FOMO)
├── Pre-QUALIFY (segment by engagement level)
└── Create ASCENSION PATH (free → VIP → premium)
```

**The Hormozi Registration Framework:**
"Pergunta rapida. Posso pegar seu endereco de email? Porque quero convida-lo para o maior evento de empreendedores da temporada." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 5)

**Business Impact:** With proper registration page optimization, Hormozi achieved "mais de 1.000.000+ registrations by launch day" (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 13). Registration is the gateway to the entire launch funnel - get this wrong, and everything downstream fails.

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Creating registration pages for live events (virtual or in-person)
- Book launch registrations
- Webinar/workshop signups
- Product launch waitlists
- Free training registrations
- Challenge/bootcamp enrollments

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- Direct sales pages (use Landing Page SOP)
- Lead magnet download pages
- General content opt-ins
- Checkout/purchase pages

### Business Types
- Info-product businesses launching events
- SaaS companies doing webinars
- Coaches/consultants running workshops
- E-commerce businesses doing launch events
- Any business using event-based marketing

---

## Part 3: Preconditions

| Precondition | Requirement | Validation |
|--------------|-------------|------------|
| Event Definition | Date, time, platform finalized | "Aug 16, 2025 and starts at 9am Pacific / 12pm Eastern" (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 13) |
| Hook/Promise | Clear value proposition for event | "giving them all away - LIVE - at the book launch" (Source: line 13) |
| Mystery Element | Something unrevealed to build curiosity | "something else I've quietly worked on for over a year" (Source: line 13) |
| Ascension Path | Post-registration upsell ready | VIP upgrade path documented |
| Technical Stack | Registration form, email automation, calendar integration | "Todas as nossas paginas de funil estao hospedadas na Loja eCommerce com formularios hubspot incorporados" (Source: Main_Offer_Landing_Page.md, line 104) |
| Follow-up Sequences | Post-registration email flow ready | SMS + Email sequences documented |

---

## Part 4: Core Framework (Registration Page Architecture)

### The 5-Part Registration Framework

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    REGISTRATION PAGE ARCHITECTURE                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PART 1: THE HOOK (0-3 seconds)                                              │
│ ├── Authority Statement                                                      │
│ ├── Event Promise                                                           │
│ └── Registration CTA                                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PART 2: THE PROOF (Value Stack)                                             │
│ ├── Credentials & Results                                                    │
│ ├── What They'll Learn                                                       │
│ └── Why It Matters                                                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PART 3: THE MYSTERY (Curiosity Driver)                                       │
│ ├── Secret/Surprise Tease                                                    │
│ ├── Exclusivity Element                                                      │
│ └── FOMO Trigger                                                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PART 4: THE FORM (Friction Minimization)                                     │
│ ├── Minimal Fields (Email + Name)                                            │
│ ├── Single CTA                                                               │
│ └── Privacy Assurance                                                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ PART 5: THE POST-REGISTRATION FLOW                                           │
│ ├── Immediate Confirmation                                                   │
│ ├── Calendar Integration                                                     │
│ ├── VIP Upsell                                                               │
│ └── Referral Opportunity                                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### The Registration-to-Revenue Funnel

```
Registration Opt-in → VIP Upgrade → Pre-Order → Live Event → Premium Offer
        ↓                 ↓              ↓            ↓             ↓
    Free Entry      $29.99 Book    15/200 Books   Engagement    $5,998+
```

**Source:** "Oferta de Pre-Pedido: Teremos uma oferta VIP de pre-pedido que direcionara clientes que se registram para a chamada para pre-encomendar sua copia e fazer upgrade para VIP." (Main_Offer_Landing_Page.md, line 120)

---

## Part 5: Process Steps

### PHASE 1: PRE-REGISTRATION PAGE SETUP

#### Step 1.1: Define Event Core Details
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Establish all event parameters before page creation |
| **Cognitive Type** | Planning/Organization |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires strategic decisions |
| **Executor** | Human (Event Owner) |
| **Precondition** | Business goal defined |
| **Output** | Event brief with date, time, platform, promise |
| **Guardrails** | Must include: Date (with timezone), Platform (YouTube Live, Zoom), Core Promise, Mystery Element |
| **Decision Rule** | "It's on Aug 16, 2025 and starts at 9am Pacific / 12pm Eastern" - Always include multiple timezones (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 13) |

**Template:**
```
Event: [NAME]
Date: [DATE] at [TIME PT] / [TIME ET]
Platform: [YouTube Live / Zoom / Other]
Core Promise: [What they'll get]
Mystery Element: [What you're teasing but not revealing]
Registration Goal: [Number]
```

#### Step 1.2: Prepare Technical Infrastructure
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Set up all technical systems before page launch |
| **Cognitive Type** | Technical Execution |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Template-based |
| **Executor** | Worker (Tech Team) |
| **Precondition** | Event details finalized |
| **Output** | Working registration form, email automation, calendar links |
| **Guardrails** | Must test: Form submission, email delivery, calendar add |
| **Decision Rule** | "Todas as nossas paginas de funil estao hospedadas na Loja eCommerce com formularios hubspot incorporados para capturar dados. Cada pagina tem um subdominio Vanity URL" (Source: Main_Offer_Landing_Page.md, line 104) |

**Required Integrations:**
- Registration form (HubSpot, etc.)
- Email automation platform
- SMS platform
- Calendar integration (Google, Apple, Outlook)
- Vanity URL subdomain

#### Step 1.3: Create Registration-to-VIP Ascension Path
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Map the complete journey from registration to purchase |
| **Cognitive Type** | Strategic Planning |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires strategy |
| **Executor** | Human (Marketing Lead) |
| **Precondition** | Products/offers defined |
| **Output** | Complete funnel map with pages and automations |
| **Guardrails** | Each step must provide value AND advance toward purchase |
| **Decision Rule** | Follow the proven path: "Opt-in de Registro → Pagina de Vendas VIP (VSL) → Pagina de Checkout → Pagina de obrigado (VSL)" (Source: Main_Offer_Landing_Page.md, lines 106-115) |

---

### PHASE 2: REGISTRATION PAGE COPY

#### Step 2.1: Create Hook/Opening
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Write the opening that immediately captures attention and states the invitation |
| **Cognitive Type** | Copywriting |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW - Requires human creativity |
| **Executor** | Human (Copywriter) |
| **Precondition** | Event details defined |
| **Output** | Opening hook that transitions into registration ask |
| **Guardrails** | Must be conversational, direct, and immediately state the value |
| **Decision Rule** | Use the direct invitation formula: "Pergunta rapida. Posso pegar seu endereco de email? Porque quero convida-lo para o maior evento de empreendedores da temporada." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 5) |

**Hormozi Hook Template:**
```
"Pergunta rapida. Posso pegar seu [EMAIL/INFO]?
Porque quero convida-lo para [THE BIGGEST/MOST VALUABLE EVENT DESCRIPTION].
Eu gastei [INVESTMENT] neste evento."
```

#### Step 2.2: Establish Authority
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Quickly establish why you're worth listening to |
| **Cognitive Type** | Trust Building |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Credibility metrics available |
| **Output** | 2-3 sentence authority statement with quantifiable results |
| **Guardrails** | Numbers must be real and verifiable |
| **Decision Rule** | Lead with portfolio results, not personal brags: "Eu sou dono da acquisition.com. Sao empresas do portfolio que fizeram mais de 250 milhoes de dolares no ano passado, e eu vendi tres empresas em 2021." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, lines 6-9) |

**Authority Template:**
```
"I [OWN/RUN] [COMPANY].
[PORTFOLIO/CLIENTS] have done [SPECIFIC RESULT] in [TIMEFRAME].
I [PERSONAL ACCOMPLISHMENT with specific numbers]."
```

#### Step 2.3: Define the Event Value
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Explain what they'll learn and why it matters |
| **Cognitive Type** | Value Communication |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Event content outline complete |
| **Output** | Clear articulation of takeaways |
| **Guardrails** | Focus on outcomes, not features |
| **Decision Rule** | Frame around the 4 business goals: "Todo negocio tem quatro objetivos principais em termos de ganhar dinheiro. Entao, um e conseguir que as pessoas entrem pela porta para comprar algo. Queremos que elas gastem mais dinheiro, queremos que facam isso em menos tempo. Queremos que facam isso repetidamente." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, lines 11-13) |

**Value Framework:**
```
"Every business has [NUMBER] main goals when it comes to [TOPIC]:
1. [Goal 1 - Get people in]
2. [Goal 2 - Get them to spend more]
3. [Goal 3 - Get them to do it faster]
4. [Goal 4 - Get them to do it repeatedly]

This is exactly what I'll break down at the live event."
```

#### Step 2.4: Inject Mystery/Curiosity
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create an irresistible curiosity gap that can only be satisfied by attending |
| **Cognitive Type** | Psychological Persuasion |
| **Automation Potential** | LOW |
| **Executor** | Human |
| **Precondition** | Surprise/reveal planned for event |
| **Output** | Mystery hook that builds anticipation |
| **Guardrails** | MUST be real - never fake mystery. Deliver on the promise. |
| **Decision Rule** | Use the comparison framework: "E melhor que um NFT e custa menos que um Bitcoin" (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 17) |

**Mystery Template:**
```
"I've also been working on a secret project for over [TIME].
I won't tell you what it is yet, but I can tell you:
- It's better than [KNOWN VALUABLE THING]
- It costs less than [MORE VALUABLE THING]
- Every person who shows up live gets one FREE.

You have to be there live to get it."
```

#### Step 2.5: Create the Registration CTA
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Write the simple, direct call-to-action |
| **Cognitive Type** | Conversion Optimization |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Template-based |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Form ready |
| **Output** | Clear, simple CTA |
| **Guardrails** | Make it feel effortless |
| **Decision Rule** | Make it sound like the easiest thing ever: "Tudo que voce precisa fazer e uma coisa. Voce se inscreve abaixo e clica em enviar. E isso." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, lines 20-21) |

**CTA Template:**
```
"All you have to do is ONE thing:
Enter your email below and click submit.
That's it."
```

#### Step 2.6: Add Social Proof Numbers
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Display real-time or milestone registration numbers |
| **Cognitive Type** | Social Proof |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH - Can be automated |
| **Executor** | Worker |
| **Precondition** | Tracking in place |
| **Output** | Dynamic or updated registration count |
| **Guardrails** | Numbers must be real. Update regularly. |
| **Decision Rule** | Show momentum: "Ja temos mais de 300.000 pessoas registradas. Provavelmente serao cerca de 500.000 quando o evento comecar" (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, lines 24-25) |

### PHASE 3: POST-REGISTRATION CONFIRMATION

#### Step 3.1: Immediate Confirmation Email
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|

| **Output** | Confirmation email delivered within seconds |

**Confirmation Email Elements:**
```
SUBJECT: "You're registered. (Save this email)"

1. Congratulations + Event Name
2. "PLEASE SAVE THIS EMAIL. IT HAS IMPORTANT BOOK LAUNCH DETAILS."
3. What you'll get at the event
4. Registration milestone ("We have A LOT OF PEOPLE registered already. Our goal is to pass 1,000,000+")
5. Event logistics:
   - Platform: "I will stream it on YouTube Live. No fancy tech. Just straight YouTube Live. You click. You're in. Simple."
   - Date/Time with multiple timezones
   - Calendar link: "Tap here to add it to your calendar"
6. Tease the mystery: "AND something else I've quietly worked on for over a year. It's finally ready...but...I can't say any more."
7. VIP upgrade mention
```

(Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 13)

#### Step 3.2: SMS Confirmation
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Send immediate SMS confirmation |
| **Cognitive Type** | Technical Execution |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH |
| **Executor** | Worker |
| **Precondition** | SMS platform configured, phone number captured |
| **Output** | SMS delivered immediately |
| **Guardrails** | Keep under 160 characters, include opt-out |
| **Decision Rule** | Template: "Hey {Name}, it's [CREATOR] - you'll get [NUMBER] more launch texts: [X] reminders + [Y] goodies. Check email for details. Reply 'Stop' to stop." (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 10) |

#### Step 3.3: Thank You Page with VIP Upsell
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create thank you page that presents VIP upgrade opportunity |
| **Cognitive Type** | Conversion |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | VIP offer ready |
| **Output** | Thank you page with calendar add + VIP upsell |
| **Guardrails** | Don't be pushy - make it a no-brainer value add |
| **Decision Rule** | "Na pagina de agradecimento. Se voce quiser pre-encomendar uma copia do livro. Eu tenho quatro outros bonus incriveis para voce la. Voce pode fazer upgrade para VIP e literalmente e tudo gratis." (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, lines 21-22) |

**Thank You Page Structure:**
```
1. "You're In!" confirmation
2. Calendar integration buttons (Google, Apple, Outlook)
3. VIP Upgrade Section:
   "Now if you think you're gonna [ACTION] at the event, you might as well [PRE-ACTION] and get instantly upgraded to VIP which includes:
   ✅ [VIP Benefit 1]
   ✅ [VIP Benefit 2]
   ✅ [VIP Benefit 3]
   ✅ [VIP Benefit 4]"
4. Affiliate/Referral CTA
```

### PHASE 7: LAUNCH DAY COMMUNICATIONS

| **Cognitive Type** | Reminder |
| **Automation Potential** | HIGH |

| **Guardrails** | Different for VIP vs non-VIP |

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Registration Form Fields
```yaml
rule: MINIMAL_FORM_FIELDS
trigger: Form design
condition:
  - IF lead_magnet_event THEN fields = [email]
  - IF qualification_needed THEN fields = [email, name]
  - IF phone_for_SMS THEN fields = [email, name, phone]
  - IF fields > 3 THEN "FAIL - too much friction"
action: Use minimum fields necessary
rationale: "Voce se inscreve abaixo e clica em enviar. E isso." - Make it effortless
confidence: HIGH (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 21)
```

### DR-002: Mystery Element Required
```yaml
rule: CURIOSITY_GAP_REQUIRED
trigger: Registration page copy
condition:
  - IF mystery_element == null THEN "WARNING - weaker conversion"
  - IF mystery_element != deliverable THEN "FAIL - never fake"
action: Include real mystery that will be revealed live
rationale: "E melhor que um NFT e custa menos que um Bitcoin" creates irresistible curiosity
confidence: HIGH (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 17)
```

### DR-003: VIP Path Required
```yaml
rule: ASCENSION_PATH
trigger: Registration thank you page
condition:
  - IF vip_upsell == null THEN "WARNING - leaving money on table"
  - IF vip_value < registration_action THEN "REVISE"
action: Always present VIP upgrade on thank you page
rationale: "Se voce quiser pre-encomendar uma copia do livro. Eu tenho quatro outros bonus incriveis para voce la."
confidence: HIGH (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 21)
```

### DR-004: Timezone Inclusion
```yaml
rule: MULTIPLE_TIMEZONES
trigger: Any time mention
condition:
  - IF timezones < 2 THEN "FAIL"
  - IF major_regions_missing THEN "FAIL"
action: Include PT, ET minimum; full list for 48hr/24hr emails
example: "9am Pacific / 12pm Eastern" minimum, full world list for final emails
confidence: HIGH (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 218)
```

### DR-005: Social Proof Numbers
```yaml
rule: REGISTRATION_MOMENTUM
trigger: Page content
condition:
  - IF registration_count_visible == false THEN "WARNING"
  - IF count_not_updated THEN "FAIL"
action: Show real, updated registration numbers
example: "Ja temos mais de 300.000 pessoas registradas"
confidence: HIGH (Source: Pre_Event_Registration_VSL.md, line 24)
```

### DR-006: Follow-Up Timing
```yaml
rule: NURTURE_SEQUENCE_TIMING
trigger: Post-registration automation
condition:
  - IF immediate_confirmation == false THEN "FAIL"
  - IF first_followup > 15_minutes THEN "WARNING"
  - IF no_24hr_followup THEN "WARNING"
  - IF no_48hr_affiliate THEN "WARNING"
action: Follow the timing pattern from source
sequence:
  - Immediate: Confirmation email + SMS
  - 15 minutes: VIP reminder (non-purchasers only)
  - 24 hours: Value reminder
  - 48 hours: Affiliate invitation
confidence: HIGH (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md)
```

### DR-007: Early Join Warning
```yaml
rule: JOIN_EARLY_WARNING
trigger: 48hr and 24hr emails
condition:
  - IF early_join_warning == false THEN "FAIL"
action: Include early join recommendation
text: "Due to larger volumes than expected, it is best to join 12-17 minutes early"
confidence: HIGH (Source: Registration_Page_Content.md, line 218)
```

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Cold Audience Registration
**Trigger:** Audience doesn't know you
**Adjustment:**
- More authority proof needed
- Consider video on registration page
- May need to explain the value more thoroughly
- Social proof numbers extra important

### Exception 2: Paid Event Registration
**Trigger:** Event has a cost to attend
**Adjustment:**
- Registration becomes checkout
- Value stack more prominent
- Guarantee considerations
- Use Landing Page SOP instead

### Exception 3: Time-Limited Registration
**Trigger:** Limited spots or closing deadline
**Adjustment:**
- Add countdown timer
- "X spots remaining" counter
- Real scarcity messaging
- More aggressive follow-up

### Exception 4: International Audience
**Trigger:** Global audience base
**Adjustment:**
- Full timezone list in all emails
- Consider time-friendly scheduling
- Multiple reminder emails at local times
- Replay option if possible

### Exception 5: Multi-Day Event
**Trigger:** Event spans multiple days
**Adjustment:**
- Session-by-session reminders
- Day-specific calendar adds
- Recap emails between days
- Engagement tracking per session

## Appendix A: The Hormozi Registration Formula

### Registration Page VSL Script Template

```
[HOOK]
"Quick question. Can I get your email address?
Because I want to invite you to the biggest [AVATAR] event of the [SEASON/YEAR].
I spent over [INVESTMENT] on this event."

[AUTHORITY]
"Before I tell you more about it, let me tell you about what the whole event is about, which is [THIS THING].
I [OWN/RUN] [COMPANY].
[These are portfolio companies] that did [RESULT] [TIMEFRAME].
I [PERSONAL ACCOMPLISHMENT]."

[FRAMEWORK]
"When I look at all the businesses I've had throughout my career, there were [NUMBER] things that separated the winners from the losers.
Piece by piece, I started putting them together into what I call [CONCEPT NAME].

Every business has [NUMBER] main goals when it comes to [MAKING MONEY]:
1. [Goal 1]
2. [Goal 2]
3. [Goal 3]
4. [Goal 4]

And this is exactly what I cover inside [THE THING].
I will break down the strategies I use to scale my companies at the live event."

[MYSTERY]
"It's going to be insane.
I've also been working on a secret project for over [TIME].
I won't tell you what it is yet, but I can tell you that it's better than [THING A] and costs less than [THING B].
And every person who shows up live, including you, will receive one absolutely free.
All you have to do is one thing..."

[CTA]
"You sign up below and click submit.
That's it.
On the thank you page, if you want to [PRE-ORDER], I have [NUMBER] other amazing bonuses for you there.
You can upgrade to VIP and it's literally all free.
If you just [REGISTER], it's going to be incredible.
It's going to be THE event of the [SEASON]."

[SOCIAL PROOF]
"We already have over [NUMBER] people registered.
It'll probably be around [BIGGER NUMBER] when the event starts.
So I hope to see you there."
```

## 1. Proposito

Reduzir churn, maximizar LTV, e construir um negocio que cresce por composicao atraves de retencao sistematica de clientes. Este SOP cobre o framework completo de Retention do Alex Hormozi.

**Insight Central:**
> "You're doing sales because you failed at marketing. You're doing marketing because you failed at product." - Naval

**Impacto Financeiro:**
- Reduzir churn de 10% para 3% = 3.3x aumento em LTV
- 5% melhoria em retencao = 25-95% aumento em lucro (Harvard Business Review)
- Custa 5x a 25x mais adquirir um novo cliente do que reter um existente

---

## 2. Escopo

**Aplica-se a:**
- Negocios de recorrencia (SaaS, memberships, assinaturas)
- Negocios de servico com clientes recorrentes
- Comunidades e programas de coaching
- E-commerce com compras repetidas
- Qualquer negocio que quer aumentar LTV

**NAO aplica-se a:**
- Vendas transacionais unicas sem possibilidade de recorrencia
- Produtos commodity sem diferenciacao

---

## 3. Pre-condicoes

### Dados Minimos Requeridos
- [ ] Churn rate mensal atual (ou dados para calcular)
- [ ] ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) ou ticket medio
- [ ] CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
- [ ] Tempo medio de permanencia do cliente
- [ ] Numero atual de clientes

### Dados Estendidos (coletar quando possivel)
- [ ] Metricas de engajamento (frequencia de uso, login, attendance)
- [ ] NPS ou scores de satisfacao
- [ ] Top 3 razoes de cancelamento
- [ ] Time to first value / activation point
- [ ] Taxa de referral
- [ ] Revenue por tenure do cliente (mes 1 vs 6 vs 12)
- [ ] Taxa de churn involuntario (falhas de pagamento)

---

## 4. Formulas Fundamentais

### Calculo de Churn
```
Churn = Clientes que sairam / Pool original de clientes

Exemplo: 100 clientes em 01/Jan, 95 em 01/Fev = 5/100 = 5% churn
NOTA: Novos clientes NAO afetam o calculo de churn.
```

### Calculo de LTV

**Para Negocios de Recorrencia:**
```
LTGP = Gross Profit Mensal / Churn Rate
Exemplo: $2,400 GP / 5% churn = $48,000 LTGP
```

**Para Negocios Transacionais:**
```
LTGP = Gross Profit por Transacao x Media de Transacoes
Exemplo: $80 x 4 transacoes = $320 LTGP
```

### LTV:CAC Health Check
```
SAUDAVEL: LTV:CAC >= 3:1 -> Pode escalar agressivamente
ALERTA: LTV:CAC entre 2:1 e 3:1 -> Margens finas, priorizar LTV ou reduzir CAC
CRITICO: LTV:CAC < 2:1 -> Parar de escalar, consertar backend primeiro
```

---

## 5. The 5 Horsemen of Retention

Descobertos atraves de entrevistas com donos de academia com menos de 3% de churn mensal.

### Horseman 1: Track Attendance (Rastrear Frequencia)

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Analise + Predicao
**Executor:** Hybrid (sistema rastreia, humano intervem)

**Padrao de Churn:**
```
Semana 1: 3 sessoes
Semana 2: 2 sessoes <- ALERTA
Semana 3: 2 sessoes
Semana 4: 1 sessao
Semana 5: CANCELAMENTO
```

**Padrao de Resgate:**
```
Semana 1: 3 sessoes
Semana 2: 2 sessoes <- REACH OUT IMEDIATO
Semana 3: 3 sessoes
Semana 4: 3 sessoes
Semana 5: 3 sessoes
```

**Regra:** Se frequencia cai para 2x/semana, intervir imediatamente.

---

### Horseman 2: Reach Out 2x Per Week

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Execucao + Relacionamento
**Executor:** Human

**Atividades:**
1. Elogiar clientes sobre participacao e progresso
2. Resolver pequenos problemas que eles tem
3. Fazer ambos

**Frequencia:** Minimo 2x por semana por cliente ativo.

---

### Horseman 3: Handwritten Cards

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Execucao
**Executor:** Human

**Quando enviar:**
- [ ] Quando se inscrevem
- [ ] Nos marcos de 3, 6, 12 meses (momento de pedir referrals)
- [ ] Feriados e aniversarios
- [ ] Quando atingem metas
- [ ] Quando precisam de motivacao extra

**Regra:** "Nunca ha um momento ruim para enviar um cartao escrito a mao."

---

### Horseman 4: Member Events

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Execucao + Comunidade
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Framework:**
- Manter eventos regulares em calendario interno
- Manter regular para voce, aleatorio para eles
- Cadencia recomendada: A cada 21, 42, ou 63 dias
- Usar convites escritos a mao

**Beneficio duplo:** Reduz churn E gera referrals.

---

### Horseman 5: Exit Interviews

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Julgamento + Negociacao
**Executor:** Human

**Estatistica:** Salva cerca de METADE dos cancelamentos por telefone/email.

**Protocolo:**
1. Estabelecer expectativa de exit interview durante onboarding
2. Usar aviso de cancelamento como gatilho para agendar
3. Na ligacao:
   - Deixar desabafar
   - Ficar mais indignado que eles: "Isso e completamente ridiculo. Voce esta 100% correto."
   - Perguntar: "Me da a oportunidade de consertar isso?"
   - Revender o valor de ficar
   - Mostrar o que perdem (URLs, posts, acesso, pricing de founder)

**Script:**
```
"Hey, sem pressao. Eu adoraria ouvir todas as razoes pelas quais voce me odeia.
Isso realmente me ajudaria para que no futuro eu possa evitar isso."
```

**Impacto:** Assumindo que metade aparece, corta churn em 25% = 33% aumento em LTV.

---

## 6. Timeline de Implementacao (5 Horsemen)

**O Que Esperar:**

| Mes | Churn | Explicacao |
|-----|-------|------------|
| Mes 1 | SOBE 50% | "Shaking the tree" - pessoas que iam cancelar de qualquer forma + billing automatico de clientes ja inativos |
| Mes 2 | DESCE 50% | Sistema comeca a funcionar |
| Mes 3 | DESCE mais 50% | Estabilizacao |

**Trajetoria tipica:** 10% -> 15% -> 7% -> 3%

## 7. The 9-Step Churn Checklist

### Step 1: Descobrir Activation Points

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Analise + Sintese
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Definicao:** "Todo cliente que faz (X coisa) ou obtem (Y resultado) fica mais tempo que clientes que nao fazem."

**Processo:**
1. Encontrar clientes churned que ficaram 3+ meses
2. Ordenar por quem gastou mais dinheiro, pegar top 20%
3. Aprender tudo sobre eles (demograficos, psicograficos, uso)
4. Encontrar fatores comuns = candidatos a activation point
5. Reduzir para 5 fatores e testar
6. Atualizar messaging para atrair melhores clientes
7. Atualizar onboarding para direcionar ao activation point
8. Retestar a cada 6-12 meses

**Exemplos de Activation Points:**
- B2B service: Primeira vez que conseguem leads
- Software: Primeira vez que fazem login e veem o dashboard
- Produto fisico: Primeira vez que usam o produto consumivel
- Gym Launch: Clientes que recuperaram investimento nos primeiros 30 dias

**Caso:** Gym Launch - Churn foi de 8% para 3% em 6 meses ao criar "The Fast Cash Play" focado em recuperar investimento em 30 dias.

---

### Step 2: Onboard Your Customers

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Execucao + Educacao
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Definicao:** "Ensinar clientes a atingir os activation points."

**Hierarquia de Eficacia (maior para menor):**
```
1. Custom + Personal + Live = Retencao maxima
2. Custom + Group + Live = Otima retencao, mais escalavel
3. Generic + Group + Recorded = Retencao decente, mais escalavel
4. Sem onboarding = Churn maximo
```

**Regras:**
- Custom > Generic
- Personal > Group
- Live > Recorded
- Carrots > Sticks
- Algum > Nenhum

**Checklist de Onboarding (Primeiros 30 Dias):**

| Periodo | Acoes |
|---------|-------|
| Dia 0 | Welcome message pessoal, revender valor, roadmap claro, definir cadencia de comunicacao |
| Dias 1-3 | Push para activation point, primeira vitoria rapida, homework com deadline de 7 dias |
| Dias 3-7 | Check-in pessoal, resolver fricoes, celebrar progresso |
| Dias 7-14 | Conectar com membros bem-sucedidos, compartilhar provas, segundo check-in |
| Dias 14-21 | Introduzir a eventos de comunidade, facilitar 2-3 conexoes significativas |
| Dias 21-30 | Revisar progresso, celebrar publicamente, pedir testimonial, apresentar unlockables futuros |

**Caso:** Portfolio company foi de $2M/mes para $2M/semana apos mudar de group para 1-on-1 onboarding (25% boost em ascensions).

---

### Step 3: Incentivize Customer Activation

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Design + Motivacao
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Principio:** Fazer valer a pena para clientes fazerem o que os melhores clientes fazem.

**Tipos de Incentivos:**
- Cursos que desbloqueiam
- Calls 1-on-1 ou bundles de calls
- Ingressos para eventos live/virtual
- Acesso a calls de tier mais alto
- Custom badges, profile images, indicadores de status
- Acesso lifetime gratis ao atingir nivel alto (ex: Level 8)

**Estrategia de Timing:**
```
Se a maioria dos clientes sai apos o mes 3, colocar algo legal que desbloqueia no mes 4.
```

**Regra:** Colocar incentivos logo apos os major churn points.

---

### Step 4: Community Linking

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Execucao + Comunidade
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Filosofia:**
> "It's easy to quit a membership, it's hard to leave a relationship."
> "They come for the bikini. They stay for the community."

**Taticas:**
1. **Group events:** Fazer onboarding 1-on-6 intencionalmente para conectar pessoas
2. **Conectar manualmente:** Se um membro se beneficiaria de conhecer outro, conecte-os
3. **Podcast de comunidade:** Entrevistar membros
4. **Elevar micro-celebridades:** Chamar publicamente e elogiar por area de expertise

---

### Step 5: Fire or Correct Bad Customers

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Julgamento
**Executor:** Human

**Framework:**
1. Incentivar comportamentos positivos (pin posts, praise publico)
2. Dar feedback sobre comportamentos ruins
3. 3 strikes em comportamento ruim = expulsao
4. Pinnar os melhores 1-2 posts novos diariamente (sinaliza o que voce recompensa)
5. Criar categorias: wins, fun, discovered, meetups

**Regra:** Bad customers fazem ser ruim para todos os outros.

---

### Step 6: Add Annual Pricing Options

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Pricing Strategy
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Principio:** "Clientes que pagam por mais tempo ficam mais tempo."

**Opcoes:**

**Opcao Padrao:**
```
"Buy 10 months get 2 free" pricing
10-20% das pessoas pegam a opcao anual
```

**Pricing do Annual:**
```
SE avg_months < 12: Precar annual ACIMA de avg_months
SE avg_months >= 12: "Buy 10 get 2 free" (16% off)
```

**Alternativa 1: Big Head, Long Tail**
```
$6,800 upfront (educacao/setup) + $199/mo (comunidade)
Base continua empilhando
LTV vai de $6,800 para $12,800+
```

**Alternativa 2: Founder Rates**
```
50% desconto para compromisso antecipado
Combina buy-in E recompensa por ficar
```

---

### Step 7: Exit Interviews / Cancellation Calls

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Negociacao + Recuperacao
**Executor:** Human

**Estatistica:** Voce pode salvar metade das pessoas que entram em uma ligacao de cancelamento.

**Dois Outcomes:**
1. **Metade diz "F you"** -> Feedback otimo sobre como melhorar
2. **Outra metade** -> Salvar com redo OU salvar com upsell

**Save com Redo:**
```
"Deixa eu tentar de novo e vou consertar isso."
```

**Save com Upsell:**
```
Perceber que precisam de mais ajuda e deveriam estar no programa mais alto.
Creditar pagamento para o programa superior.
"Voce deveria ter sido vendido para isso de qualquer forma. E isso e culpa minha."
```

**Resell Protocol:**
1. Revender por que ficar ajuda a atingir seus objetivos
2. Dizer o que perdem que gastaram tempo ou deu status: URLs, posts, acesso, pricing de founder

**Para High-Volume Low-Price:** Adicionar video de cancelamento que:
- Relembra por que comecaram
- Revende o valor
- Lembra o que arriscam perder

---

### Step 8: Survey Customers 2x/Year

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Analise + Feedback
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Duas Perguntas Essenciais:**
1. "Se eu removesse tudo dessa lista menos uma coisa, o que voce gostaria de manter mais?"
2. "Se eu mantivesse tudo dessa lista menos uma coisa, qual te incomodaria menos ver eu remover?"

**Insight:** Identificar as core 2-3 coisas que seu produto faz. Dobrar nelas.

**Framework ACA para Reach-Outs (a cada 2-3 semanas):**
- **A**cknowledge: O que voce viu eles fazerem
- **C**ompliment: Algo genuino sobre eles
- **A**sk: Uma pergunta

**Nota:** Contraintuitivamente, clientes mais ricos querem menos handholding.

---

### Step 9: Four-Step Customer Journey

**Tipo Cognitivo:** Design de Jornada
**Executor:** Hybrid

**Os 4 Milestones:**

| Milestone | Descricao | Acao |
|-----------|-----------|------|
| 1. ACTIVATE | Direcionar ao activation point | Onboarding focado |
| 2. TESTIMONIAL | Capturar historia de sucesso | Pedir quando atingem resultado |
| 3. REFER | Pedir referrals | No momento de satisfacao maxima |
| 4. ASCEND | Vender a proxima coisa | Upsell/cross-sell |

**Insight Critico:**
> "Clientes tem uma coceira para comprar mais coisas ao longo do tempo. Eles vao comprar de voce ou do cara na rua."

> "Se alguem acabou de comprar outra coisa de voce, sao os menos provaveis de fazer churn."

**Regra:** Incentivar cada milestone com unlockables.

---

## 8. The Crazy 8 - LTV Maximization

### Framework Geral

```
LTV so pode ir infinitamente para cima.
Custos so podem ir ate zero.
```

**Os 8 Metodos:**

| # | Metodo | Descricao |
|---|--------|-----------|
| 1 | Aumentar Precos | Mais impacto em gross profit |
| 2 | Diminuir Custos | Aumentar margem por unidade |
| 3 | Aumentar # de Compras | Recorrencia, reduzir churn, follow-up |
| 4 | Cross-Sell | Vender produto complementar |
| 5 | Upsell Quantity | Vender mais da mesma coisa |
| 6 | Upsell Quality | Vender versao premium |
| 7 | Downsell Quantity | Vender menos ao inves de nada |
| 8 | Downsell Quality | Vender pior ao inves de nada |

---

### #1 Increase Prices

**Impacto:** Mais poderoso dos 8. Afeta gross profit diretamente.

**Matematica:**
```
Negocio de 10% profit + 20% aumento de preco = 3x profit (nao 20%)
```

**Processo de Teste:**
1. Sales conversion rate x lifetime gross profit = optimal price
2. Testar precos a cada quarter
3. Comecar baixo, subir 20% a cada 10 vendas ate queda dramatica
4. Voltar ao sweet spot

**Formula de Breakeven:**
```
Breakeven Conv Rate = Old Revenue / New Price
Se nova conv rate > breakeven, e winner
```

---

### #2 Decrease Costs

**Taticas para Servicos:**
- Aumentar ratio employee-to-customer (5 -> 10 clientes por rep = metade do custo)
- Offshore talent (cortar custos 80%+)
- Productizar delivery (templates, automacao)
- Done For You -> Done With You
- Cap usage (limitar revisoes, cobrar por uso apos)
- Lifetime -> Annual access
- In-person -> Remote
- Cortar tempos de reuniao (deletar recorrentes, adicionar so o necessario)
- Comprar em bulk e prepagar (10-20% descontos)

---

### #3 Increase # of Purchases

**Tres Metodos:**

**a) Add Recurring:**
- Servico: Plumbing -> membership de plumbing
- Produto: Canecas -> caneca do mes membership
- Digital: Curso -> calls de accountability recorrentes

**b) Decrease Churn:**
- Churn de 10% para 5% = 2x LTV
- Seguir o Churn Checklist

**c) Follow Up:**
- Promocoes trimestrais
- Prover valor entre asks
- Manter top of mind

---

### #4 Cross-Sell Something Different

**Definicao:** Vender outro produto que complementa o primeiro.

**Formula:**
```
New LTV = Original LTV + (Conv Rate x GP do Cross-Sell)
Exemplo: $100 + (20% x $100) = $120
```

**Exemplos:**
- Lawn care -> snow blowing no inverno
- Burgers -> fries e refrigerante
- Curso -> comunidade

**Regra:** Nao quebrar o negocio por trocados. Deve ser facil de adicionar com infraestrutura existente.

---

### #5 Upsell Quantity (Sell More)

**Tres Formas:**

| Tipo | Descricao | Multiplicador |
|------|-----------|---------------|
| Bulk | Prepagar por um ano | 12x |
| More Often | Mensal -> a cada 3 semanas | 1.33x |
| Bigger | 1 hora -> 3 horas | 3x |

**Tatica:** Oferecer primeiro, depois downsell para oferta padrao.

---

### #6 Upsell Quality (Sell Better)

**Versao Premium pode ter:**

| Lever | Standard | Premium |
|-------|----------|---------|
| Response time | Horas | Minutos |
| Availability | 9-5 | 24hrs |
| Days | Mon/Wed/Fri | All Days |
| Time per session | 15min | 60min |
| Locations | 1 location | All locations |
| Cancellation | Reschedule fees | Free |
| Service ratio | 1-to-many | 1-on-1 |
| Communication | Chat | Video call |
| Provider | Junior employee | Expert/Owner |
| Live vs Recorded | Recorded | Live |
| In-person vs Remote | Remote | In-person |
| DIY/DWY/DFY | DIY | DFY |
| Expirations | Limited time | Forever |
| Personalization | Generic | Custom |

**Para Produtos Fisicos:**
- Melhores ingredientes (sirloin vs ground chuck)
- Materiais melhores, mais fortes, mais leves (steel vs iron)

---

### #7 Downsell Quantity (Sell Less Rather Than Nothing)

**Logica:** Se e isso ou nada, isso vence nada.

**Tres Formas:**
- Quantity: Prepagar 3 meses ao inves de 12
- Less Often: Uma visita a cada 2 meses ao inves de mensal
- Smaller: 30 minutos ao inves de 1 hora

**REGRA CRITICA:** Nunca downsell para um comprador qualificado. Apenas para quem NAO qualifica para a oferta principal.

---

### #8 Downsell Quality (Sell Worse Rather Than Nothing)

**Inverter a lista do Upsell Quality:**
- Response time mais lento (esperar na fila)
- Menos disponibilidade para reunioes
- Menos locais
- Menos dias por semana
- Horarios mais limitados
- Menos flexibilidade para reagendamento
- Employees mais junior
- Ratio maior de cliente para employee
- Metodos de comunicacao menos convenientes
- Mais recorded, menos live
- Mais remote, menos in-person
- Done For You -> Done With You -> DIY
- Menos personalizacao
- Sem garantia ou garantia pior

---

## 9. Continuity Offers

### Overview

**Definicao:** Ofertas que fornecem valor continuo por pagamentos continuos ate o cliente cancelar.

**Beneficio:** Voce vende uma vez mas recebe repetidamente.

**Matematica:**
```
ONE-TIME:
$1,000 produto x 100 pessoas x 10% conversao = 10 clientes = $10,000

CONTINUITY:
$50/mes x 100 pessoas x 40% conversao = 40 clientes
Se ficam 20 meses: $1,000/cliente = $40,000 total
MAIS: 40 clientes para upsell (vs 10)
```

### Type 1: Continuity Bonus Offer

**Estrutura:** Dar ao cliente algo incrivel por se inscrever HOJE.

**Regra:** Bonus deve ter mais valor percebido que o primeiro pagamento de continuity.

**Exemplos:**
- Fisico: $800 em brinquedos para cachorro gratis quando assina $59/mes de racao
- Servico: Programa acelerador de $1,000 gratis ao se tornar membro por $100/mes
- Digital: Todas as 40 newsletters passadas ($15,880 valor) gratis ao assinar $399/mes

**Regras Importantes:**
1. Vender o BONUS, nao a membership
2. Manter bonus relacionado a oferta principal
3. Usar assets que ja tem (custo marginal zero, alto valor percebido)
4. Dar status como bonus (Silver -> Gold -> Diamond)
5. Combinar com descontos de prepagamento

**Pricing: Standalone vs Continuity:**
```
1.33x standalone = 50% escolhem continuity
2x standalone = 70% escolhem continuity
3x standalone = 90% escolhem continuity
```

---

### Type 2: Continuity Discount Offer

**Estrutura:** Tempo gratis em troca de compromisso mais longo.

**4 Formas de Aplicar:**

| Tipo | Descricao | Quando Usar |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| Upfront | Meses gratis primeiro | Negocios com enforcement forte (telecom, storage) |
| Backloaded | Meses gratis apos pagamento completo | Estimula comportamento de pagamento |
| Spread | Desconto diluido em todos os pagamentos | Mantem cash flow regular |
| Prepayment | Pagar primeiro e ultimo mes no signup | Garante cash inicial para CAC |

**Hacks:**
- Cobrar a cada 4 semanas em vez de mensal (13 ciclos/ano = 8.3% mais receita)
- Waive 3% processing fee com 2 metodos de pagamento no file (reduz churn involuntario)
- Gift cards liberados apos 3 pagamentos (retencao + ferramenta de referral)
- Desconto condicional lifetime (ex: 5% off no inicio, 15% apos 5 meses)

---

### Type 3: Waived Fee Offer

**Estrutura:**
- Opcao A: Pagar setup fee (3-5x mensal) + monthly rate. Cancelar quando quiser.
- Opcao B: Compromisso de 12 meses, fee dispensada. Pagar fee se sair antes.
- Apos completar compromisso, fee oficialmente desaparece.

**Por Que Funciona:**
- Entry: Pessoas assinam para EVITAR a fee
- Durante: Fee pende como motivacao para ficar
- Retencao: Custo de sair (fee) > custo de ficar (monthly)

**Ideal Para:**
- Negocios com onboarding de alto custo
- Servicos de resultado a longo prazo (SEO, weight loss, investing)
- Consulting e programas de transformacao

**Naming:** Activation fee, setup fee, processing fee, engagement fee, onboarding fee

**Avancado:** Doar fee para uma causa que o cliente ODEIA se cancelar cedo.
```
"Qual causa voce absolutamente odeia? Otimo. Se voce cancelar cedo, estou doando sua setup fee para eles."
```

---

## 10. Engagement Scoring Framework

### Niveis de Engajamento

| Nivel | Nome | Definicao | Acao | Risco |
|-------|------|-----------|------|-------|
| 0 | GHOST | Sem atividade 30+ dias | Campanha de reativacao imediata | Extremamente alto |
| 1 | PASSIVE | Atividade minima, tendencia de queda | Outreach pessoal (ACA), incentivo para re-engajar | Alto |
| 2 | ACTIVE | Atividade regular mas nao no activation point | Guiar para activation point, community linking | Moderado |
| 3 | ENGAGED | No ou acima do activation point | Manter, pedir testimonial/referral, apresentar upsell | Baixo |
| 4 | CHAMPION | Acima do activation point, refere outros, advoga | Elevar como micro-celebridade, convidar para VIP | Muito baixo |

### Metricas por Tier

**Tier 1 - Survival (track weekly):**
- Churn rate mensal (por cohort)
- Revenue churn rate (dollar-weighted)
- LTV (rolling 90-day average)
- LTV:CAC ratio

**Tier 2 - Engagement (track daily/weekly):**
- Frequencia de login/visita
- Profundidade de uso de features
- Taxa de consumo de conteudo
- Participacao em comunidade
- Volume e sentiment de tickets de suporte
- NPS score (trimestral)

**Tier 3 - Predictive (build over time):**
- Tempo desde ultimo login/compra
- Tendencia do engagement score
- Taxa de falha de pagamento
- Taxa de resposta a outreach
- Percentual de conclusao do activation point

---

## 11. Win-Back Campaigns

### Segmentacao de Clientes Churned

| Segmento | Definicao | Causa Provavel | Abordagem |
|----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|
| Saiu em <30 dias | Activation failure | Onboarding falhou | "Percebi que falhamos com voce. Veja como e diferente agora." |
| Saiu entre 30-90 dias | Value perception issue | Valor nao claro | "Muita coisa mudou desde que voce saiu. Veja o que perdeu." |
| Saiu apos 90+ dias | Fatores externos ou necessidades evoluiram | Vida mudou | "Pessoas como voce que voltaram viram X resultados em Y tempo." |

### Sequencia de Win-Back

| Dia | Acao |
|-----|------|
| Dia 1 | Email/text pessoal reconhecendo que sairam (sem venda) |
| Dia 3 | Compartilhar success story de alguem na situacao deles |
| Dia 7 | Oferta especifica para voltar (desconto, bonus, ou waived fee) |
| Dia 14 | Ultimo outreach com incentivo por tempo limitado |
| Dia 30 | Adicionar a nurture de longo prazo (valor trimestral + soft CTA) |
| A cada 90 dias | Mostrar resultados de pessoas que assinaram quando eles sairam |

**Psicologia:** "Isso os faz sentir deixados para tras mas ainda da a opcao de recuperar o tempo perdido."

---

## 12. Reactivation for Dormant (Still Paying, Not Using)

### Framework: 3-Touch Reactivation

| Touch | Conteudo |
|-------|----------|
| 1 | Acknowledge + Compliment: "Ei, notei que voce nao logou. So queria dizer que seu progresso em [coisa especifica] foi impressionante." |
| 2 | Value reminder: "Lembrete rapido - acabamos de adicionar [feature/conteudo]. Acho que ajudaria com [objetivo deles]." |
| 3 | Personal invitation: "Estou organizando [evento/call] na proxima [data]. Adoraria que voce participasse. Guardei uma vaga para voce." |

### Escalation

- Se sem resposta apos 3 touches: Ligar (telefone > texto > email)
- Se ainda sem resposta: Marcar como alto risco de churn, incluir em revisao de retencao

---

## 13. Overwhelm - The #1 Churn Reason

**Insight Central:**
> "Think value per second, not seconds of value. Less but better beats more and decent."

**Caso:** Newsletter business a $500k/mes
- Churn mais baixo: 1 Q&A call por mes + 1 newsletter fisica longa por mes
- Adicionou calls semanais e outras coisas: Churn AUMENTOU

**Principio:** Decida nas core 2-3 coisas que voce entrega. Faca-as realmente boas.

**Gym Launch:** Na 10a versao. Cada versao ficou mais curta e mais simples.

**Regra:** Retencao se resume a garantir que eles CONSUMAM o valor, nao os sobrecarregar com ele.

---

## 14. Decision Rules

```yaml
# Churn
DR-001: "Churn > 10% mensal = problema de produto, nao de crescimento"
DR-002: "Churn floor < 1% e incomum, pedir confirmacao"
DR-003: "Churn ceiling > 25% sugere crise, priorizar fix de produto"

# LTV
DR-004: "LTV:CAC < 2:1 = parar de escalar, consertar backend"
DR-005: "LTV:CAC 2:1-3:1 = crescimento possivel mas margens finas"
DR-006: "LTV:CAC >= 3:1 = pode escalar agressivamente"

# Activation
DR-007: "Clientes que nao atingem activation point em 30 dias = alto risco de churn"
DR-008: "Activation point completion < 50% = revisar onboarding"

# Pricing
DR-009: "Testar precos a cada quarter"
DR-010: "2x preco + -20% conversao = FAZER (se +60% receita)"

# Engagement
DR-011: "Engagement Level 0-1 por 30+ dias = campanha de reativacao imediata"
DR-012: "Usage churn precede billing churn - interceptar quando para de usar"

# Volume
DR-013: "Mais deliverables que 5 por mes = verificar potential overwhelm"
```

---

## 15. Red Flags Imediatos

| Sinal | Acao |
|-------|------|
| Churn > 10% mensal | **PARAR** escala de aquisicao, diagnosticar |
| LTV:CAC < 2:1 | **PARAR** escala, consertar backend |
| Sem onboarding | **IMPLEMENTAR** imediatamente |
| Sem engagement tracking | **IMPLEMENTAR** metricas |
| Adicionando features quando clientes reclamam | **PARAR**, investigar se resposta e delecao |
| Retention investment > 1/5 CAC | **REVISAR** se excedido |

---

## 16. Anti-Patterns

```yaml
never_suggest:
  - "Apenas conseguir mais clientes" como solucao para churn
  - Descontos sem mecanicas de retencao attached
  - Adicionar mais features/conteudo como estrategia de retencao
  - Ignorar os dados e ir com gut feeling
  - Tratar todos os clientes churned igual
  - Pular onboarding para "economizar tempo"
  - Annual pricing sem primeiro consertar o produto

always_check:
  - Churn esta sendo calculado corretamente? (so cohort original)
  - Estamos resolvendo o problema certo? (acquisition vs retention vs monetization)
  - Temos activation points identificados?
  - Onboarding esta direcionando para activation points?
  - Estamos rastreando engagement antes de virar churn?
  - Price-value equation esta balanceada?
```

---

## 17. Outputs do Processo

### Por Implementacao do Churn Checklist

| Metrica | Antes | Depois (6 meses) |
|---------|-------|------------------|
| Churn Mensal | 10% | 3% |
| LTV | 10 meses | 33 meses |
| LTV Multiplier | 1x | 3.3x |

### Por Aplicacao do Crazy 8

- LTV calculation baseline estabelecido
- 3 levers de maior impacto identificados
- Projections de LTV improvement por lever
- Implementation priority definida

---

## 18. Beneficios de Implementar vs Custos de Nao Implementar

### Quando Implementa o Churn Checklist:
- Cresce todo ano mesmo se vendas ficam iguais
- Cria mais lucro dos mesmos clientes
- Negocio compoem
- Dorme bem sabendo que contas estao pagas
- Word of mouth positivo, mais clientes gratis
- Mantem melhores talentos porque veem clientes sendo ajudados

### Quando Tem Alto Churn:
- Tem que conseguir novos clientes todo mes so para ficar igual
- Nunca cria negocio que compoem
- Negocio dificil de vender (menos valioso)
- Dorme mal porque so e tao bom quanto o ultimo mes
- Feedback negativo de clientes
- Word of mouth negativo, previne novos clientes
- Dificuldade de manter funcionarios motivados
- Perde credibilidade, sempre criando "novo" para sobreviver

---

## 19. Auditoria

**Frequencia:** Minimo trimestral

**Gatilhos para Revisao:**
- Churn subiu mais de 2 pontos percentuais
- LTV:CAC caiu abaixo de 3:1
- Engajamento medio caindo por 3 meses consecutivos
- Grande mudanca de produto ou pricing
- Novos dados de activation point disponiveis

---

## 20. Historico e Referencias

**Casos de Referencia:**

| Caso | Antes | Depois | Impacto |
|------|-------|--------|---------|
| Gym Launch (5 Horsemen) | 10-15% churn | 3% churn | 3.3x LTV |
| Gym Launch (Fast Cash Play) | 8% churn | 3% churn | -62% churn |
| Portfolio Company (1-on-1 onboarding) | $2M/mes | $2M/semana | 4x growth |
| Skool Platform | Multi-tier engagement | Level 3+ retains highest | Data-driven |

**Fontes:**
- $100M Retention Playbook (completo)
- $100M Lifetime Value Playbook (completo)
- $100M Money Models - Secao 5: Ofertas de Continuidade
- Gym Launch Secrets (referencias)

```yaml
# Retention Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-002 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Retention Playbook + $100M Lifetime Value Playbook + $100M Money Models (Continuity)
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: retention-ltv
  purpose: "Reduce churn, maximize LTV, and build compounding growth through systematic customer retention"
  domain: customer-success
  source_playbooks:
    - "$100M Retention Playbook"
    - "$100M Lifetime Value Playbook"
    - "$100M Money Models - Continuity Offers"

  core_equation: |
    LTGP (Recurring) = Gross Profit / Churn Rate
    Impact: 10% -> 3% churn = 3.3x LTV increase
    Retention 5% improvement = 25-95% profit increase

  golden_rules:
    - "You're doing sales because you failed at marketing. You're doing marketing because you failed at product."
    - "If churn > 10%, you have a product problem, not a growth problem"
    - "It costs 5-25x more to acquire than to retain"
    - "LTV can go infinitely up. Costs can only go to zero."
    - "Think value per second, not seconds of value"

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: retention-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate retention & LTV maximization across all frameworks"
      decisions:
        - "Prioritize churn reduction vs LTV expansion"
        - "Route customers to appropriate retention interventions"
        - "Escalate high-value churn risks to human"
        - "Balance acquisition vs retention investment"
      kpis:
        - "Overall churn rate trend"
        - "LTV:CAC health ratio"
        - "Engagement distribution across levels"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: churn-diagnostician
      role: "Calculate churn, identify root causes, predict at-risk customers"
      inputs:
        - "Customer activity data"
        - "Cancellation history"
        - "Engagement metrics"
        - "Exit interview feedback"
      outputs:
        - "Churn rate calculation (cohort-based)"
        - "Top 5 churn causes"
        - "At-risk customer list"
        - "Churn prediction scores"

    - agent: ltv-calculator
      role: "Calculate LTV, LTV:CAC ratios, and identify optimization levers"
      inputs:
        - "Revenue per customer"
        - "Churn data"
        - "Cost data (COGS, CAC)"
        - "Transaction history"
      outputs:
        - "LTGP calculation"
        - "LTV:CAC health assessment"
        - "Crazy 8 lever priorities"
        - "Price testing recommendations"

    - agent: activation-mapper
      role: "Identify and validate customer activation points"
      inputs:
        - "Top 20% customer behaviors"
        - "Long-tenure customer patterns"
        - "Product usage data"
        - "Success milestone data"
      outputs:
        - "Activation point candidates (top 5)"
        - "Validation test plan"
        - "Onboarding optimization recommendations"
        - "Messaging alignment for acquisition"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: onboarding-architect
      role: "Design and optimize customer onboarding for activation"
      specialization: "Step 2: Onboard Your Customers"
      capabilities:
        - "30-day onboarding sequence design"
        - "Activation point acceleration"
        - "First win engineering"
        - "Handoff-to-success protocol"
      hierarchy: |
        Custom > Generic
        Personal > Group
        Live > Recorded
        Carrots > Sticks
        Something > Nothing

    - agent: engagement-tracker
      role: "Monitor customer engagement and trigger interventions"
      specialization: "5 Horsemen: Track Attendance"
      engagement_levels:
        level_0:
          name: "GHOST"
          definition: "No activity 30+ days"
          action: "Immediate reactivation campaign"
          risk: "Extremely high"
        level_1:
          name: "PASSIVE"
          definition: "Minimal activity, declining trend"
          action: "Personal outreach (ACA), re-engagement incentive"
          risk: "High"
        level_2:
          name: "ACTIVE"
          definition: "Regular activity but not at activation point"
          action: "Guide to activation, community linking"
          risk: "Moderate"
        level_3:
          name: "ENGAGED"
          definition: "At or above activation point"
          action: "Maintain, request testimonial/referral, introduce upsell"
          risk: "Low"
        level_4:
          name: "CHAMPION"
          definition: "Above activation, refers others, advocates"
          action: "Elevate as micro-celebrity, VIP invitation"
          risk: "Very low"

    - agent: touch-executor
      role: "Execute 2x/week customer touch cadence"
      specialization: "5 Horsemen: Reach Out 2x Per Week"
      touch_types:
        - type: "Progress praise"
          frequency: "Weekly"
          medium: "Text/DM"
        - type: "Problem resolution"
          frequency: "As needed"
          medium: "Call/Video"
        - type: "ACA check-in"
          frequency: "Every 2-3 weeks"
          template: "Acknowledge + Compliment + Ask"

    - agent: event-coordinator
      role: "Plan and execute member events"
      specialization: "5 Horsemen: Member Events"
      cadence: "Every 21, 42, or 63 days"
      event_types:
        - "Group onboarding cohorts (1-to-6)"
        - "Community challenges"
        - "Member spotlight calls"
        - "Q&A sessions"
        - "In-person meetups"

    - agent: incentive-designer
      role: "Create incentives for activation and retention"
      specialization: "Step 3: Incentivize Customer Activation"
      incentive_types:
        - "Courses that unlock"
        - "1-on-1 calls or bundles"
        - "Live/virtual event tickets"
        - "Higher-tier call access"
        - "Custom badges, status indicators"
        - "Lifetime access at high level achievement"
      timing_rule: "Place incentives just after major churn points"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: exit-interviewer
      role: "Conduct exit interviews and save cancellations"
      specialization: "5 Horsemen: Exit Interviews + Step 7"
      statistics:
        save_rate: "~50% of phone/email cancellations"
        ltv_impact: "25% churn reduction = 33% LTV increase"
      techniques:
        let_vent:
          description: "Let them share all complaints"
          script: "Hey, no pressure. I would love to hear all the reasons you hate me."
        match_indignation:
          description: "Get more indignant than them"
          script: "This is completely ridiculous. You're 100% correct."
        ask_permission:
          description: "Ask for second chance"
          script: "Give me the opportunity to fix this?"
        save_with_redo:
          description: "Offer to restart/fix"
          script: "Let me try again and I'll fix this."
        save_with_upsell:
          description: "Recognize they need more help"
          script: "You should have been sold into this anyway. That's my fault."
        resell_value:
          description: "Remind what they lose"
          items: ["URLs", "Posts", "Access", "Founder pricing", "Community status"]

    - agent: winback-specialist
      role: "Recover churned customers"
      specialization: "90-Day Proof Recovery"
      segmentation:
        - segment: "Churned <30 days"
          cause: "Activation failure"
          approach: "Show how onboarding is different now"
        - segment: "Churned 30-90 days"
          cause: "Value perception"
          approach: "Show what they missed"
        - segment: "Churned 90+ days"
          cause: "External factors"
          approach: "Share results of peers who returned"
      sequence:
        day_1: "Personal acknowledgment (no sell)"
        day_3: "Success story share"
        day_7: "Specific return offer"
        day_14: "Final outreach with limited incentive"
        day_30: "Add to long-term nurture"
        every_90_days: "Show results of people who signed when they left"

    - agent: pricing-strategist
      role: "Optimize pricing for LTV maximization"
      specialization: "Crazy 8 #1: Increase Prices"
      testing_protocol:
        frequency: "Every quarter"
        method: "Start low, raise 20% every 10 sales until dramatic drop"
        formula: "Breakeven Conv Rate = Old Revenue / New Price"
        decision: "If new conv rate > breakeven, winner"
      annual_pricing:
        standard: "Buy 10 months get 2 free (16% discount)"
        rule: "If avg_months < 12, price annual ABOVE avg_months"
        uptake: "10-20% take annual option"

    - agent: community-linker
      role: "Build relationships that make leaving hard"
      specialization: "Step 4: Community Linking"
      philosophy: |
        "It's easy to quit a membership, it's hard to leave a relationship."
        "They come for the bikini. They stay for the community."
      tactics:
        - "Group onboarding (1-to-6) to create connections"
        - "Manual member-to-member introductions"
        - "Community podcast featuring members"
        - "Elevate micro-celebrities by expertise area"
        - "Pin best 1-2 new posts daily"

    - agent: continuity-architect
      role: "Design continuity offers for recurring revenue"
      specialization: "Continuity Offers"
      offer_types:
        bonus:
          structure: "Give something incredible for signing up TODAY"
          rule: "Bonus perceived value > first continuity payment"
          examples:
            - "Physical: $800 dog toys free with $59/mo food subscription"
            - "Service: $1000 accelerator free when joining $100/mo membership"
            - "Digital: All 40 past newsletters ($15,880 value) free with $399/mo sub"
        discount:
          structure: "Free time in exchange for longer commitment"
          forms:
            upfront: "Free months first (strong enforcement businesses)"
            backloaded: "Free months after full payment (incentivize payment)"
            spread: "Discount diluted across payments (steady cashflow)"
            prepayment: "Pay first and last month at signup (CAC coverage)"
        waived_fee:
          structure: "Fee waived with commitment, owed if leave early"
          fee_amount: "3-5x monthly rate"
          psychology: "People sign to AVOID fee, fee motivates staying"
          ideal_for: "High onboarding cost, long-term result services"

    - agent: culture-guardian
      role: "Fire bad customers, reinforce positive behaviors"
      specialization: "Step 5: Fire or Correct Bad Customers"
      framework:
        - "Incentivize positive behaviors (pin posts, public praise)"
        - "Give feedback on bad behaviors"
        - "3 strikes = expulsion"
        - "Pin best 1-2 new posts daily (signals what you reward)"
        - "Create categories: wins, fun, discovered, meetups"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  retention-coordinator:
    id: retention-coordinator
    title: "Retention & LTV Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "retention"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate all retention and LTV initiatives. Balance churn reduction
      with LTV expansion. Ensure customer success compounds over time.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "5 Horsemen of Retention"
        components: ["Track Attendance", "Reach Out 2x/Week", "Handwritten Cards", "Member Events", "Exit Interviews"]
      - name: "9-Step Churn Checklist"
        components: ["Activation Points", "Onboarding", "Incentivize Activation", "Community Linking", "Fire Bad Customers", "Annual Pricing", "Exit Interviews", "Survey 2x/Year", "4-Step Journey"]
      - name: "Crazy 8 LTV"
        components: ["Increase Prices", "Decrease Costs", "Increase Purchases", "Cross-Sell", "Upsell Quantity", "Upsell Quality", "Downsell Quantity", "Downsell Quality"]

    decision_authority:
      - "Prioritize retention vs acquisition investment"
      - "Route high-value at-risk customers to human"
      - "Approve continuity offer structures"
      - "Escalate product issues identified through churn"

    inputs:
      - "Churn metrics by cohort"
      - "LTV:CAC ratios"
      - "Engagement level distribution"
      - "Exit interview themes"
      - "Activation point data"

    outputs:
      - "Retention priority directives"
      - "LTV optimization recommendations"
      - "Product feedback from churn analysis"
      - "Investment allocation guidance"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Monthly Churn Rate"
          target: "<5%"
          excellent: "<3%"
        - name: "LTV:CAC Ratio"
          target: ">3:1"
          excellent: ">5:1"
      secondary:
        - "Engagement Level 3+ Percentage >60%"
        - "Exit Interview Save Rate >50%"
        - "Activation Point Completion >80%"

  churn-diagnostician:
    id: churn-diagnostician
    title: "Churn Analysis Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "chart-down"

    purpose: |
      Calculate churn correctly, identify root causes, and predict at-risk customers
      before they cancel. Use cohort-based analysis, not simple percentages.

    calculation_rules:
      churn_formula: |
        Churn = Customers who left / Original customer pool (cohort)
        NOTE: New customers do NOT affect churn calculation
      example: "100 customers Jan 1, 95 on Feb 1 = 5/100 = 5% churn"

    diagnosis_methods:
      inverse_question:
        prompt: "What can I do to churn 100% of my customers?"
        purpose: "Surface hidden friction points"
        output: "List of things to STOP doing"

      top_20_analysis:
        steps:
          - "Find churned customers who stayed 3+ months"
          - "Sort by total spend, take top 20%"
          - "Learn everything about them (demographics, psychographics, usage)"
          - "Find common factors = activation point candidates"

    thresholds:
      critical: ">25% monthly (crisis)"
      warning: ">10% monthly (product problem)"
      healthy: "5-10% monthly"
      excellent: "<5% monthly"
      suspect_floor: "<1% monthly (verify data)"

    outputs:
      - "Cohort-based churn calculation"
      - "Top 5 churn causes (ranked)"
      - "At-risk customer list with scores"
      - "Activation point candidates"
      - "Product improvement recommendations"

  ltv-calculator:
    id: ltv-calculator
    title: "LTV & Monetization Analyst"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "calculator"

    purpose: |
      Calculate lifetime value accurately for both recurring and transactional
      businesses. Identify the highest-impact levers from the Crazy 8.

    formulas:
      recurring_business:
        formula: "LTGP = Gross Profit (Monthly) / Churn Rate"
        example: "$2,400 GP / 5% churn = $48,000 LTGP"

      transactional_business:
        formula: "LTGP = Gross Profit per Transaction x Average Transactions"
        example: "$80 x 4 transactions = $320 LTGP"

    ltv_cac_thresholds:
      healthy:
        ratio: ">=3:1"
        action: "Scale aggressively"
      warning:
        ratio: "2:1 to 3:1"
        action: "Thin margins, prioritize LTV improvement or CAC reduction"
      critical:
        ratio: "<2:1"
        action: "STOP scaling, fix backend first"

    crazy_8_analysis:
      levers:
        - lever: "Increase Prices"
          impact: "Highest - directly affects gross profit"
          math: "10% profit business + 20% price increase = 3x profit"

        - lever: "Decrease Costs"
          impact: "High - improves unit economics"
          tactics: ["Increase employee ratio", "Offshore", "Productize", "Cap usage"]

        - lever: "Increase Purchases"
          impact: "High - compounds LTV"
          methods: ["Add recurring", "Reduce churn", "Follow up"]

        - lever: "Cross-Sell"
          impact: "Medium-High"
          formula: "New LTV = Original + (Conv Rate x Cross-Sell GP)"

        - lever: "Upsell Quantity"
          impact: "Medium"
          types: ["Bulk", "More frequent", "Bigger package"]

        - lever: "Upsell Quality"
          impact: "Medium"
          levers: 17
          examples: ["Response time", "Availability", "Personnel quality", "1-on-1 vs group"]

        - lever: "Downsell Quantity"
          impact: "Low but preserves revenue"
          rule: "ONLY for unqualified prospects"

        - lever: "Downsell Quality"
          impact: "Low but preserves revenue"
          method: "Invert upsell quality list"

  activation-mapper:
    id: activation-mapper
    title: "Activation Point Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "target"

    purpose: |
      Identify what differentiates long-term customers from churned customers.
      Find the magic moment that predicts retention.

    definition: |
      "Every customer that does (X thing) or gets (Y result) stays for longer
      than customers that don't."

    discovery_process:
      step_1: "Find churned customers who stayed 3+ months"
      step_2: "Sort by total spend, take top 20%"
      step_3: "Learn everything about them (demographics, psychographics, usage)"
      step_4: "Find common factors = activation point candidates"
      step_5: "Reduce to 5 factors and test"
      step_6: "Update messaging to attract better customers"
      step_7: "Update onboarding to drive to activation point"
      step_8: "Retest every 6-12 months"

    examples:
      - business: "B2B service"
        activation: "First time they get leads"
      - business: "Software"
        activation: "First login and dashboard view"
      - business: "Physical product"
        activation: "First use of consumable"
      - business: "Gym Launch"
        activation: "Customers who recovered investment in first 30 days"
        impact: "Churn went from 8% to 3%"

    outputs:
      - "Top 5 activation point candidates"
      - "Validation test plan"
      - "Onboarding alignment recommendations"
      - "Acquisition messaging alignment"

  onboarding-architect:
    id: onboarding-architect
    title: "Customer Onboarding Designer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "rocket"

    purpose: |
      Design and optimize customer onboarding to achieve activation points fast.
      The goal is getting customers their first win as quickly as possible.

    hierarchy:
      effectiveness_order:
        1: "Custom + Personal + Live = Maximum retention"
        2: "Custom + Group + Live = Great retention, more scalable"
        3: "Generic + Group + Recorded = Decent retention, most scalable"
        4: "No onboarding = Maximum churn"

      rules:
        - "Custom > Generic"
        - "Personal > Group"
        - "Live > Recorded"
        - "Carrots > Sticks"
        - "Something > Nothing"

    thirty_day_sequence:
      day_0:
        - "Personal welcome message"
        - "Resell value"
        - "Clear roadmap"
        - "Define communication cadence"

      days_1_3:
        - "Push toward activation point"
        - "First quick win"
        - "Homework with 7-day deadline"

      days_3_7:
        - "Personal check-in"
        - "Resolve friction"
        - "Celebrate progress"

      days_7_14:
        - "Connect with successful members"
        - "Share proof"
        - "Second check-in"

      days_14_21:
        - "Introduce community events"
        - "Facilitate 2-3 meaningful connections"

      days_21_30:
        - "Review progress"
        - "Celebrate publicly"
        - "Request testimonial"
        - "Introduce future unlockables"

    paid_onboarding:
      strategy: "Sell onboarding separately"
      impact: "25% boost in ascensions"
      case: "Portfolio company: $2M/month to $2M/week after switching to 1-on-1 onboarding"

  engagement-tracker:
    id: engagement-tracker
    title: "Customer Engagement Monitor"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "pulse"

    purpose: |
      Track customer engagement, identify declining patterns, and trigger
      interventions before churn happens. Usage churn precedes billing churn.

    churn_pattern:
      typical_decline:
        week_1: "3 sessions"
        week_2: "2 sessions <- ALERT"
        week_3: "2 sessions"
        week_4: "1 session"
        week_5: "CANCELLATION"

      rescue_pattern:
        week_1: "3 sessions"
        week_2: "2 sessions <- IMMEDIATE REACH OUT"
        week_3: "3 sessions (back on track)"
        week_4: "3 sessions"
        week_5: "3 sessions"

    rule: "If frequency drops to 2x/week, intervene immediately"

    usage_churn_definition: |
      "Usage churn = customer still subscribed but no longer uses the product.
      This ALWAYS precedes billing churn. Intercept when they stop using."

    metrics_to_track:
      tier_1_survival:
        frequency: "Weekly"
        metrics:
          - "Monthly churn rate (by cohort)"
          - "Revenue churn rate (dollar-weighted)"
          - "LTV (rolling 90-day average)"
          - "LTV:CAC ratio"

      tier_2_engagement:
        frequency: "Daily/Weekly"
        metrics:
          - "Login/visit frequency"
          - "Feature usage depth"
          - "Content consumption rate"
          - "Community participation"
          - "Support ticket volume and sentiment"
          - "NPS score (quarterly)"

      tier_3_predictive:
        frequency: "Build over time"
        metrics:
          - "Time since last login/purchase"
          - "Engagement score trend"
          - "Payment failure rate"
          - "Outreach response rate"
          - "Activation point completion percentage"

  exit-interviewer:
    id: exit-interviewer
    title: "Cancellation Recovery Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "phone"

    purpose: |
      Conduct exit interviews to save cancellations and gather product feedback.
      Can save approximately 50% of phone/email cancellation requests.

    statistics:
      save_rate: "~50% of cancellations that reach interview"
      ltv_impact: "Assuming half show up, cuts churn by 25% = 33% LTV increase"

    protocol:
      setup: "Establish exit interview expectation during onboarding"
      trigger: "Cancellation notice initiates scheduling"

    interview_flow:
      step_1:
        name: "Let them vent"
        action: "Listen fully without defending"
        script: "Hey, no pressure. I would love to hear all the reasons you hate me. This would really help me so in the future I can avoid this."

      step_2:
        name: "Match their indignation"
        action: "Get MORE upset than they are"
        script: "This is completely ridiculous. You're 100% correct."

      step_3:
        name: "Ask permission to fix"
        action: "Request another chance"
        script: "Give me the opportunity to fix this?"

      step_4:
        name: "Save attempt"
        options:
          redo: "Let me try again and I'll fix this."
          upsell: "You should have been sold into this anyway. That's my fault."

      step_5:
        name: "Resell the value"
        items:
          - "Why staying helps achieve their goals"
          - "What they lose: URLs, posts, access, founder pricing, community status"

    high_volume_alternative:
      method: "Cancellation video"
      content:
        - "Remind why they started"
        - "Resell the value"
        - "Remind what they risk losing"

  winback-specialist:
    id: winback-specialist
    title: "Churned Customer Recovery Agent"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "return"

    purpose: |
      Systematically recover churned customers through segmented campaigns.
      Show them what they missed by not staying.

    segmentation:
      segment_1:
        definition: "Churned <30 days"
        probable_cause: "Activation failure"
        approach: "I noticed we failed you. Here's how it's different now."

      segment_2:
        definition: "Churned 30-90 days"
        probable_cause: "Value perception issue"
        approach: "A lot has changed since you left. See what you missed."

      segment_3:
        definition: "Churned 90+ days"
        probable_cause: "External factors or evolved needs"
        approach: "People like you who came back saw X results in Y time."

    sequence:
      day_1:
        action: "Personal email/text acknowledging they left"
        rule: "No selling"

      day_3:
        action: "Share success story of someone in their situation"

      day_7:
        action: "Specific offer to return (discount, bonus, or waived fee)"

      day_14:
        action: "Final outreach with limited-time incentive"

      day_30:
        action: "Add to long-term nurture (quarterly value + soft CTA)"

      every_90_days:
        action: "Show results of people who signed up when they left"
        psychology: "Makes them feel left behind but offers chance to recover"

  pricing-strategist:
    id: pricing-strategist
    title: "Price & LTV Optimization Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "dollar"

    purpose: |
      Optimize pricing for maximum LTV. Test prices quarterly.
      Implement annual pricing options and continuity structures.

    price_testing:
      frequency: "Every quarter"
      method:
        step_1: "Start at current price"
        step_2: "Raise 20% every 10 sales"
        step_3: "Continue until dramatic drop in conversion"
        step_4: "Return to sweet spot"

      formula: "Breakeven Conv Rate = Old Revenue / New Price"
      decision: "If new conversion rate > breakeven, it's a winner"

    math_example:
      premise: "10% profit margin business"
      action: "20% price increase"
      result: "3x profit (not 20%)"
      explanation: "Price increases go straight to profit"

    annual_pricing:
      standard_offer: "Buy 10 months get 2 free (16% discount)"
      uptake: "10-20% choose annual option"

      pricing_rule:
        if_avg_months_lt_12: "Price annual ABOVE avg_months"
        if_avg_months_gte_12: "Use 'Buy 10 get 2 free'"

      big_head_long_tail:
        structure: "$6,800 upfront (education) + $199/mo (community)"
        benefit: "Base keeps stacking"
        ltv_example: "$6,800 -> $12,800+"

      founder_rates:
        structure: "50% discount for early commitment"
        benefit: "Combines buy-in AND reward for staying"

    continuity_pricing:
      standalone_vs_continuity:
        ratio_1_33x: "50% choose continuity"
        ratio_2x: "70% choose continuity"
        ratio_3x: "90% choose continuity"

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # Diagnosis & Calculation
  - task: "Calculate cohort-based churn rate"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use cohort, not simple division"

  - task: "Calculate LTV (recurring/transactional)"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Verify gross profit inputs"

  - task: "Assess LTV:CAC health"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates action recommendation"

  - task: "Identify activation point candidates"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates before testing"

  - task: "Score at-risk customers"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Human reviews high-value at-risk"

  # 5 Horsemen Execution
  - task: "Track customer engagement/attendance"

  - task: "Execute 30-day onboarding touchpoints"
    executor: Hybrid
```
