## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/subscription-model-squad-blueprint.yaml

```yaml
# Subscription Model Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-003 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Money Models - Secao 5: Ofertas de Continuidade
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: subscription-model
  purpose: "Maximize recurring revenue through strategically structured continuity offers that make customers start AND keep paying"
  domain: monetization
  source_playbooks:
    - "$100M Money Models - Section 5: Continuity Offers"

  core_equation: |
    ONE-TIME: $1,000 x 10% conversion = $10,000 (10 customers)
    CONTINUITY: $50/mo x 40% conversion x 20 months = $40,000 (40 customers)
    BONUS: 4x more customers for upsell

  golden_rules:
    - "You can shear a sheep its whole life, but you can only skin it once"
    - "Continuity offers are amazing because you sell once but get paid repeatedly"
    - "By doing continuity offers last, we get the best of all worlds"
    - "No successful continuity business I've seen has a standalone membership offer"
    - "The bonus itself should have more value than the first continuity payment"

  relationship_to_retention_sop: |
    This SOP COMPLEMENTS retention-sop.md:
    - Subscription Model SOP: How to make customers START continuity
    - Retention SOP: How to make customers STAY in continuity
    Cross-reference for complete customer lifecycle coverage.

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: continuity-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate subscription model design and optimization"
      decisions:
        - "Choose offer type (Bonus, Discount, Waived Fee)"
        - "Set pricing mix (standalone vs continuity ratio)"
        - "Design prepayment upsells"
        - "Balance upfront cash vs recurring revenue"
      kpis:
        - "Continuity signup rate"
        - "Standalone vs continuity mix"
        - "30-day profit from continuity"
        - "Prepayment uptake rate"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: asset-inventory-specialist
      role: "Inventory existing assets for bonus creation"
      inputs:
        - "Existing courses, templates, tools"
        - "Historical pricing data"
        - "Onboarding processes"
        - "Content archives"
      outputs:
        - "Asset inventory with real prices"
        - "Total bonus value calculation"
        - "Bonus package recommendations"
        - "Cost-to-deliver analysis"

    - agent: pricing-analyst
      role: "Analyze and optimize pricing structure"
      inputs:
        - "Current pricing"
        - "Conversion data"
        - "Target continuity percentage"
        - "Competitor pricing"
      outputs:
        - "Standalone multiplier recommendation"
        - "Continuity pricing recommendation"
        - "Expected conversion split"
        - "Prepayment discount structure"

    - agent: offer-type-selector
      role: "Recommend optimal offer type for business context"
      inputs:
        - "Business type (product, service, digital)"
        - "Existing assets"
        - "Cash flow needs"
        - "Service delivery timeline"
      outputs:
        - "Primary offer type recommendation"
        - "Secondary offer type (if applicable)"
        - "Implementation priority"
        - "Expected outcomes"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: bonus-architect
      role: "Design and structure bonus continuity offers"
      specialization: "Continuity Bonus Offers"
      capabilities:
        - "Bonus value calculation"
        - "Bonus-to-membership anchoring"
        - "Script creation for bonus presentation"
        - "Cross-bonus strategy (physical + digital)"
      rules:
        bonus_value: "Bonus perceived value > first continuity payment"
        bonus_relevance: "Bonus must be related to main offer"
        bonus_source: "Prefer existing assets (zero marginal cost)"
        anchoring: "Use real prices, never invented values"

    - agent: waived-fee-architect
      role: "Design and structure waived fee offers"
      specialization: "Waived Fee Offers"
      capabilities:
        - "Fee calculation (3-5x monthly)"
        - "Commitment period design"
        - "Documentation creation"
        - "Cancellation fee process"
      rules:
        fee_range: "3-5x monthly rate"
        minimum_commitment: "12+ months"
        documentation: "Customer must initial understanding"
        post_commitment: "Fee disappears after completing commitment"

    - agent: prepayment-designer
      role: "Create prepayment discount structures"
      specialization: "Bulk Prepayment Upsells"
      capabilities:
        - "Prepayment offer creation"
        - "Discount calculation"
        - "Impact projection"
        - "Upsell timing optimization"
      formulas:
        impact: "1/8 accept 'buy 5 get 1' = 50% more 30-day profits"

    - agent: script-writer
      role: "Create sales scripts for continuity offers"
      specialization: "Continuity Offer Presentation"
      scripts:
        - "Bonus presentation (bonus first, membership second)"
        - "'Want to know how to get it free?' transition"
        - "Bonus stacking"
        - "Standalone vs continuity options"
        - "Waived fee presentation"
        - "Prepayment upsell"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: conversion-optimizer
      role: "Optimize conversion between standalone and continuity"
      specialization: "Pricing Psychology"
      pricing_table:
        target_50_percent: "Standalone = 1.33x monthly"
        target_60_percent: "Standalone = 1.66x monthly"
        target_70_percent: "Standalone = 2.00x monthly"
        target_80_percent: "Standalone = 2.33x monthly"
        target_90_percent: "Standalone = 2.66x monthly"
      principle: |
        Higher standalone price relative to continuity = more choose continuity
        Lower standalone price relative to continuity = more choose standalone

    - agent: commitment-designer
      role: "Design commitment structures for maximum retention"
      specialization: "Commitment + Bonus Combinations"
      options:
        - type: "Bonus only"
          description: "Customer gets bonus just for joining"
          result: "Maximum signups, less commitment"
        - type: "Bonus + Commitment"
          description: "Customer gets bonus only if committing to 3/6/12 months"
          result: "Fewer signups, stronger commitment"
        - type: "Waived Fee"
          description: "Fee waived with commitment, owed if leave early"
          result: "Strong commitment, clear exit cost"

    - agent: funnel-position-strategist
      role: "Position continuity offers correctly in the funnel"
      specialization: "Offer Sequencing"
      positioning:
        never: "Continuity as sole lead offer"
        always: "Trial/challenge/lead magnet BEFORE continuity"
        sequence:
          1: "Lead magnet / Attraction offer -> Upfront cash"
          2: "Upsell offers -> More upfront cash"
          3: "Downsell offers -> Recover lost sales"
          4: "CONTINUITY OFFERS -> Cash today + cash tomorrow"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  continuity-coordinator:
    id: continuity-coordinator
    title: "Subscription Model Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "subscription"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate all subscription model and continuity offer initiatives.
      Balance upfront cash needs with recurring revenue building.
      Ensure continuity offers are positioned correctly in the funnel.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Three Continuity Offers"
        components: ["Bonus Offers", "Discount Offers", "Waived Fee Offers"]
      - name: "Pricing Mix Optimization"
        components: ["Standalone pricing", "Continuity pricing", "Multiplier strategy"]
      - name: "Prepayment Structure"
        components: ["Bulk discounts", "Commitment bonuses", "30-day profit optimization"]

    decision_authority:
      - "Select primary offer type"
      - "Set pricing multipliers"
      - "Approve bonus packages"
      - "Design prepayment structures"

    inputs:
      - "Business type and assets"
      - "Cash flow requirements"
      - "Current conversion data"
      - "Competitor analysis"

    outputs:
      - "Continuity offer design"
      - "Pricing structure"
      - "Script templates"
      - "Expected outcomes"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Continuity Signup Rate"
          target: "Match target % (50-90% based on strategy)"
        - name: "30-Day Profit"
          target: "Meet or exceed projections"
      secondary:
        - "Prepayment uptake >12%"
        - "Early cancellation <5%"
        - "Bonus perceived value > 2x first payment"

  bonus-architect:
    id: bonus-architect
    title: "Continuity Bonus Designer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "gift"

    purpose: |
      Design bonus continuity offers that make the membership irresistible.
      Ensure bonus value exceeds first payment and is related to main offer.
      Create scripts that sell the bonus, not the membership.

    bonus_types:
      one_time:
        description: "Something amazing given once at signup"
        examples:
          - "$800 in dog toys free with $59/mo food subscription"
          - "$1,000 accelerator free when joining $100/mo membership"
          - "All 40 past newsletters ($15,880) free with $399/mo subscription"

      recurring:
        description: "Something given every month"
        examples:
          - "New dog toy every month as a member"
          - "Physical copy of newsletter mailed monthly"

      progression:
        description: "Titles and status as bonus"
        examples:
          - "Silver, Gold, Diamond, Double Diamond at 3/6/12 months"

    bonus_framework:
      more_of_same:
        description: "Extension of what they already buy"
        example: "2 years of past newsletters free when becoming member"

      complementary:
        description: "Something that adds to main product"
        example: "Nutrition services free when joining fitness membership"

      upgrade:
        description: "Higher tier as bonus"
        example: "Gold membership when buying bronze. Limited availability."

    rules:
      - rule: "Bonus value > first payment"
        source: "Line 57"
        quote: "Typically, the bonus itself has more value than the first continuity payment"

      - rule: "Bonus related to main offer"
        source: "Lines 95-96"
        quote: "If the bonus is too different, you'll attract the wrong customers"

      - rule: "Use existing assets"
        source: "Lines 97-98"
        quote: "Make bonuses from things you already have and do"

      - rule: "Realistic prices"
        source: "Lines 101-102"
        quote: "Use realistic bonus prices... won't anchor the customer and you'll lose trust"

    presentation_flow:
      step_1: "Sell the BONUS benefits (not the membership)"
      step_2: "Shock them with the value"
      step_3: "Ask: 'Want to know how to get it free?'"
      step_4: "Reveal: Become member to get bonus free"
      step_5: "Stack additional bonuses with dollar values"
      step_6: "Offer standalone option at higher price"

  waived-fee-architect:
    id: waived-fee-architect
    title: "Waived Fee Offer Designer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "shield"

    purpose: |
      Design waived fee offers that create strong commitment through
      the psychology of avoiding a fee. Ideal for services with
      long-term results (SEO, investing, weight loss).

    structure:
      option_a:
        name: "Month-to-Month with Fee"
        components:
          - "Setup fee (3-5x monthly)"
          - "Monthly rate"
          - "Cancel anytime"

      option_b:
        name: "Commitment with Waived Fee"
        components:
          - "No setup fee"
          - "Commitment period (12+ months)"
          - "Monthly rate"
          - "Pay fee if break commitment early"
          - "Fee disappears after completing commitment"

    psychology:
      entry: "People sign up to AVOID the fee"
      during: "Fee motivates staying"
      retention: "Cost to leave (fee) > cost to stay (monthly)"

    fee_calculation:
      minimum: "1.5x monthly (more upfront cash, less commitment)"
      standard: "3-5x monthly (balanced)"
      maximum: "5x monthly (maximum commitment)"

    example:
      commitment_duration: "12 months"
      monthly_rate: "$1,000"
      setup_fee: "$5,000"

      option_a_presentation: |
        "Pay $5,000 setup fee + $1,000 first month = $6,000 today
        Then $1,000/month
        Cancel whenever you want"

      option_b_presentation: |
        "Waive the $5,000 fee
        Commit to 12 months
        Pay $1,000/month
        If you leave early, pay the $5,000 you would have paid anyway"

    rules:
      - rule: "Minimum 12 month commitment"
        source: "Line 190"
        quote: "I prefer this offer for commitments of a year and longer"

      - rule: "Fee 3-5x monthly"
        source: "Line 165"
        quote: "Typically, I make the fee three to five times my monthly rate"

      - rule: "Customer must initial"
        source: "Line 155"
        quote: "I also have them initial that they understand they can leave early if they pay the fee"

      - rule: "Investigate if >5% cancel early"
        source: "Line 184"
        quote: "If more than 5% of people want to cancel early, investigate"

      - rule: "Fee disappears after commitment"
        source: "Line 188"
        quote: "If someone stays the entirety of the commitment, then wants to cancel, they earned their free cancellation"

    ideal_for:
      - "SEO services (results take time)"
      - "Investment services (compounding takes time)"
      - "Weight loss programs (transformation is gradual)"
      - "Consulting and transformation programs"
      - "Any service where clients 'get emotional' and might quit before seeing results"

    advanced_tactic:
      name: "Fee for Hated Cause"
      description: "Donate fee to cause customer hates if they cancel early"
      script: |
        "What cause do you absolutely hate?"
        [Customer answers]
        "Great. If you cancel early, I'll be donating your setup fee to them."
      psychology:
        - "Don't want to lose the money"
        - "Don't want it to go to hated cause"

  pricing-analyst:
    id: pricing-analyst
    title: "Continuity Pricing Strategist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "calculator"

    purpose: |
      Analyze and optimize pricing structure for continuity offers.
      Set standalone vs continuity multipliers based on business goals.
      Project expected conversion splits.

    multiplier_table:
      source: "Line 113 - tested across thousands of gyms"
      data:
        - target_continuity: "50%"
          standalone_multiplier: "1.33x"
          example: "$266 standalone vs $199/mo membership"

        - target_continuity: "60%"
          standalone_multiplier: "1.66x"
          example: "$333 standalone vs $199/mo membership"

        - target_continuity: "70%"
          standalone_multiplier: "2.00x"
          example: "$399 standalone vs $199/mo membership"

        - target_continuity: "80%"
          standalone_multiplier: "2.33x"
          example: "$466 standalone vs $199/mo membership"

        - target_continuity: "90%"
          standalone_multiplier: "2.66x"
          example: "$532 standalone vs $199/mo membership"

    principle: |
      "The smaller the standalone price compared to continuity, more people buy standalone.
      The bigger the standalone price compared to continuity, more people choose continuity."

    prepayment_impact:
      offer: "Buy 5 months, get 1 free"
      uptake_needed: "1 in 8 (12.5%)"
      impact: "50% more 30-day profits"
      calculation: |
        Normal: 8 customers x 1 month = 8 months revenue
        With upsell: 7 customers x 1 month + 1 customer x 5 months = 12 months revenue
        Difference: 12/8 = 1.5 = 50% increase

    decision_rules:
      - "Want maximum upfront cash -> Lower standalone multiplier (1.33x)"
      - "Want maximum recurring -> Higher standalone multiplier (2.66x)"
      - "Want balanced -> Middle multiplier (1.66x - 2x)"
      - "Need more cash -> Add prepayment upsells"

  script-writer:
    id: script-writer
    title: "Continuity Sales Script Creator"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "document"

    purpose: |
      Create sales scripts for all continuity offer types.
      Ensure scripts follow Hormozi's methodology of selling the bonus first.

    script_templates:
      bonus_presentation:
        name: "Bonus Continuity Script"
        steps:
          - step: 1
            name: "Sell the Bonus"
            script: |
              "Let me show you something incredible that we have.
              [DESCRIBE BONUS WITH ENTHUSIASM]
              This normally costs [HIGH VALUE]. People pay [VALUE] for this because
              [BENEFITS]."

          - step: 2
            name: "Pause for Reaction"
            note: "Let the value anchor sink in"

          - step: 3
            name: "The Free Question"
            script: |
              "Do you want to know how you can get this for free?"
              [Wait for YES]

          - step: 4
            name: "Reveal Membership"
            script: |
              "Become a VIP member today and you'll get all of this as a free gift
              for joining. Or you can just buy it for [HIGH VALUE].
              Which do you prefer?"

          - step: 5
            name: "Stack Bonuses"
            script: |
              "Great! And on top of that, when you become a member, you also get:
              - [BONUS 2] - value of [X]
              - [BONUS 3] - value of [Y]
              - [BONUS 4] - value of [Z]

              All of this for just [MONTHLY PRICE] per month."

      waived_fee_presentation:
        name: "Waived Fee Script"
        script: |
          "You have two options to get started.

          Option A: You can go month-to-month. This comes with a setup fee of
          [FEE] because it costs us money to get you started. But you can cancel
          whenever you want.

          Option B: If you commit to [12 MONTHS], I waive the fee completely.
          You just pay [MONTHLY] per month. If for some reason you need to leave
          early, you'd pay the fee you would have paid anyway.

          Which makes more sense for you?"

      hated_cause_script:
        name: "Fee for Hated Cause Script"
        script: |
          "What's a cause or organization that you absolutely hate?
          Something that makes you boil with anger?"

          [CUSTOMER RESPONDS]

          "Great. Here's what we'll do. If you commit to [12 MONTHS] and I waive
          your [FEE] fee, and you decide to cancel early, I'm going to donate
          that entire fee to [CAUSE].

          This gives you two reasons to stay: you don't lose the money, and it
          doesn't go to something you hate. Does that work for you?"

      prepayment_upsell:
        name: "Prepayment Upsell Script"
        script: |
          "Want to save even more money?"

          [CUSTOMER LEANS IN]

          "If you prepay for 5 months today, I'll give you the 6th month free.
          That's basically [X%] off.

          And as an extra bonus for committing, you also get [ADDITIONAL BONUS].

          Do you want to do that?"

# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Bonus Value Gate"
    transition: "Offer Design -> Ready"
    condition: "bonus_perceived_value > first_payment"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Increase bonus value or reduce first payment"

  QG-002:
    name: "Bonus Relevance Gate"
    transition: "Offer Design -> Ready"
    condition: "bonus_related_to_main_offer == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Replace bonus with relevant alternative"

  QG-003:
    name: "Fee Range Gate"
    transition: "Waived Fee Design -> Ready"
    condition: "fee >= monthly * 3 AND fee <= monthly * 5"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Adjust fee to standard range unless justified"

  QG-004:
    name: "Commitment Duration Gate"
    transition: "Waived Fee Design -> Ready"
    condition: "commitment_months >= 12"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Extend commitment to minimum 12 months"

  QG-005:
    name: "Early Cancellation Gate"
    transition: "Live -> Optimization"
    condition: "early_cancellation_rate < 5%"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Investigate product, not increase fee"

  QG-006:
    name: "Funnel Position Gate"
    transition: "Design -> Launch"
    condition: "lead_offer_exists == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Create trial/challenge/lead magnet before continuity"

  QG-007:
    name: "Pricing Documentation Gate"
    transition: "Waived Fee Launch -> Active"
    condition: "customer_initialed == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Have customer initial understanding before proceeding"

    diagnosis:
```

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/upsell-page-sop.md

# Upsell Page SOP

> **Source:** BLUEPRINT UPSELL: A ARQUITETURA DA MULTIPLICACAO DE AOV - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Multiply Average Order Value (AOV) by presenting strategic offers immediately after purchase, while the customer is in their peak psychological state.

**Core Equation:**
```
AOV Multiplier = Main Product + (Upsell #1 Take Rate × Upsell Price) + (Downsell Take Rate × Downsell Price)

Example:
- 100 buyers × R$997 = R$99,700
- 30 accept upsell (R$497) = R$14,910
- 15 accept downsell (R$197) = R$2,955
- TOTAL: R$117,565 (AOV increases 17.8%)
```

**Business Impact:** Well-executed upsells can increase AOV by 1.8-2.5x the main product value.

**Guiding Philosophy:** "O upsell nao e sobre ganhar mais dinheiro do mesmo cliente. E sobre dar a ele as ferramentas para ter sucesso mais rapido. Quando voce pensa em acelerar o resultado dele, o dinheiro extra e consequencia."

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Immediately after a customer completes a purchase
- Post-checkout confirmation page flow
- The "Golden Window" of 3-7 seconds while dopamine is elevated

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- Pre-purchase upsells (cross-sells on cart page)
- Email upsell sequences (days/weeks later)
- In-app or membership area upgrades

### Business Types
- Digital products (courses, programs, software)
- Physical products with accessories/upgrades
- Service businesses with premium tiers
- Any business with complementary offers

---

## Part 3: Preconditions

| Precondition | Requirement | Validation |
|--------------|-------------|------------|
| Purchase Completed | Customer just bought main product | Payment confirmed |
| One-Click Payment | Token from first purchase stored | Technical integration verified |
| Upsell Offer Ready | Complementary product/service exists | Offer positioned as accelerator |
| Timer System | Countdown mechanism available | Technical implementation ready |
| Downsell Variant | Lower-priced alternative exists | Pricing strategy defined |
| Social Proof | Upsell-specific testimonials collected | 2-3 short, specific testimonials |
| VSL (Optional) | 2-4 minute video prepared | Script follows upsell structure |

---

## Part 4: Psychological Foundation & Four Sections Framework

### The Post-Purchase Mental State

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           ESTADO MENTAL POS-COMPRA (Peak Buying State)                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   DOPAMINA ELEVADA          CONSISTENCIA COGNITIVA                      │
│   ├── Cerebro recompensando  ├── Tendencia a manter                     │
│   │   a decisao              │   o padrao de "sim"                      │
│   └── Peak emotional state   └── Commitment + consistency               │
│                                                                         │
│   CARTAO NA MAO             MOMENTO DE MAXIMA CONFIANCA                 │
│   ├── Barreira de pagamento  ├── Acabou de confiar em voce              │
│   │   ja superada            └── Trust at highest point                 │
│   └── Zero friction to buy                                              │
│                                                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│   A JANELA DE OURO: 3-7 segundos antes da dopamina comecar a cair       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Peak-End Rule Psychology

"A pagina de upsell explora o 'Peak-End Rule' psicologico. O cliente esta no pico emocional da compra. Cada elemento mantem esse estado elevado enquanto remove sistematicamente qualquer friccao adicional."

### Four Sections Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    UPSELL PAGE: 4 SECTIONS                              │
├─────────────────┬────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┤
│ SECTION A       │ SECTION B          │ SECTION C                        │
│ TOPO CRITICO    │ CORPO PERSUASIVO   │ CONVERSAO RAPIDA                 │
├─────────────────┼────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Above the Fold  │ Lean, not long     │ Quick decision elements          │
│ 4 Elements      │ 5 Elements         │ 5 Elements                       │
├─────────────────┴────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┤
```

## Part 5: Process Steps

### SECTION A: O TOPO CRITICO (Above the Fold)

#### Step A.1: Headline de Continuidade
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | Create headline that maintains "yes" momentum, not interrupts it |
| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis (psychological continuity) |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM - Templates available, customization needed |
| **Executor** | Hybrid (AI generates, human approves) |
| **Precondition** | Main product name and buyer name available |
| **Output** | Continuity headline that validates purchase |
| **Guardrails** | NEVER question previous purchase, create new anxiety, or imply main product is insufficient |
| **Decision Rule** | "Headline must feel like continuation, not new pitch" |

**Templates Testados:**
```
"ESPERE! Sua compra foi confirmada, mas..."
"[Nome], voce desbloqueou uma oferta exclusiva"
"Parabens! Antes de acessar seu [produto], veja isso..."
```

**Exemplo Matador:** "Joao, Sua Inscricao Foi Confirmada! Mas 87% dos Alunos Que Pegaram Este Upgrade Tiveram Resultados 3x Mais Rapidos..."

|-------|-------|

| **Cognitive Type** | Synthesis |
| **Automation Potential** | MEDIUM |
| **Executor** | Hybrid |
| **Precondition** | Upsell benefit clearly defined |
| **Output** | Subheadline showing multiplicative value |
| **Guardrails** | Must include time-limit indicator ("Oferta valida apenas agora") |
| **Decision Rule** | "Upsell = resultado adicional, nao produto alternativo" |

```
"Adicione [RESULTADO ESPECIFICO] ao que voce acabou de comprar
e [BENEFICIO MULTIPLICADOR] - Oferta valida apenas agora"
```

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Upsell Pricing Classification
```yaml
rule: UPSELL_PRICING
trigger: Upsell offer design
condition:
  - IF upsell_type == "complemento_direto" THEN price = main_price × 0.30-0.50
  - IF upsell_type == "lite_version" THEN price = main_price × 0.15-0.25
  - IF upsell_type == "premium_addon" THEN price = main_price × 0.50-1.00
action: Set pricing within appropriate range
confidence: HIGH (Source: Secao D - Logica de Progressao)
```

### DR-002: Upsell Routing Based on Response
```yaml
rule: UPSELL_SEQUENCE_ROUTING
trigger: Customer response to upsell
condition:
  - IF accepted_upsell_1 == true THEN show_upsell_3_premium
  - IF rejected_upsell_1 == true THEN show_upsell_2_lite
  - IF rejected_all == true THEN show_thank_you_page
action: Route to appropriate next page
confidence: HIGH (Source: Secao D - Logica de Progressao)
```

### DR-003: Timer Behavior
```yaml
rule: TIMER_URGENCY
trigger: Page load
condition:
  - IF time_remaining > 60_seconds THEN silent_countdown
  - IF time_remaining <= 60_seconds THEN enable_ticking_sound
  - IF time_remaining == 0 THEN redirect_to_thank_you
action: Manage timer state and audio
confidence: HIGH (Source: Element 4 - Timer de Decisao)
```

### DR-004: Exit Intent Activation
```yaml
rule: EXIT_INTENT_DOWNSELL
trigger: Exit intent detected
condition:
  - IF mouse_toward_close == true OR back_button == true THEN show_downsell_popup
  - IF downsell_accepted == true THEN process_payment_plan
  - IF downsell_rejected == true THEN redirect_to_thank_you
action: Display downsell modal
confidence: HIGH (Source: Element 14 - Exit Intent Pop-up)
```

### DR-005: Value Stack Validation
```yaml
rule: VALUE_PERCEPTION_RATIO
trigger: Value stack creation
condition:
  - IF perceived_value >= upsell_price × 5 THEN "MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE"
  - IF perceived_value >= upsell_price × 10 THEN "OPTIMAL"
  - IF perceived_value < upsell_price × 5 THEN "INSUFFICIENT - add value"
action: Validate value stack before publishing
confidence: HIGH (Source: Element 7 - Mini Stack de Valor)
```

### DR-006: Headline Validation
```yaml
rule: CONTINUITY_HEADLINE_CHECK
trigger: Headline creation
condition:
  - IF headline_questions_purchase == true THEN "FAIL - rewrite"
  - IF headline_creates_anxiety == true THEN "FAIL - rewrite"
  - IF headline_implies_insufficiency == true THEN "FAIL - rewrite"
  - ELSE "PASS - maintains momentum"
action: Validate headline before publishing
confidence: HIGH (Source: Element 1 - Headline de Continuidade)
```

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Technical Payment Failure
**Trigger:** One-click payment fails
**Action:** Display manual payment form as backup
**Script:**
```
"Houve um pequeno problema tecnico. Por favor, confirme seus dados:"
[Pre-filled payment form with card info masked]
```

### Exception 2: Timer Expires Before Decision
**Trigger:** Customer still on page when timer hits zero
**Response:** Redirect to thank you page with soft recovery offer
**Implementation:** Send follow-up email within 1 hour offering limited extension

### Exception 3: Mobile Device Constraints
**Trigger:** Customer on mobile device
**Adjustments:**
- VSL autoplay with sound muted (add tap to unmute)
- Buttons fixed at bottom of viewport
- Simplify visual elements
- Single-column layout only

### Exception 4: Customer Requests More Information
**Trigger:** Customer contacts support before deciding
**Action:** Hot handoff to sales with upsell context
**Script:**
```
"Este cliente acabou de comprar [produto principal] e esta
considerando o upgrade. Ele tem duvidas sobre [topic]."
```

### Exception 5: Very Low Take Rate (<10%)
**Trigger:** Upsell conversion significantly below target
**Diagnosis Checklist:**
1. Is one-click working? (Technical friction)
2. Is timer too aggressive? (Trust issue)
3. Is value stack strong enough? (Value perception)
4. Is headline creating interruption? (Momentum broken)
5. Is VSL too long? (Fatigue)

## Appendix A: The Mathematics of Upsells

### Example Calculation
```
100 compradores x R$997 = R$99.700
30 aceitam upsell de R$497 = R$14.910
15 aceitam downsell de R$197 = R$2.955
TOTAL: R$117.565 (AOV aumenta 17.8%)
```

### Golden Rules
1. **"Those who pay more, pay more attention"** - E quem presta mais atencao, tem mais resultados. E um circulo virtuoso.
2. **Setup First:** "Configure o one-click upsell ANTES de criar a pagina. A friccao tecnica mata mais upsells que copy ruim."
3. **Speed Matters:** "Voce tem 3-7 segundos antes da dopamina comecar a cair."

## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/upsell-page-squad-blueprint.yaml

```yaml
# Upsell Page Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-001 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: BLUEPRINT UPSELL: A ARQUITETURA DA MULTIPLICACAO DE AOV - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: upsell-page
  purpose: "Multiply AOV through strategic post-purchase upsell pages that maintain psychological momentum"
  domain: conversion-optimization
  source_playbook: "BLUEPRINT UPSELL"

  core_equation: |
    AOV Multiplier = Main Product + (Upsell Take Rate x Upsell Price) + (Downsell Take Rate x Downsell Price)
    Target: 1.8-2.5x main product value
    Example: 100 buyers x R$997 + 30 upsells x R$497 + 15 downsells x R$197 = R$117,565 (17.8% increase)

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: upsell-architect
      role: "Design and orchestrate complete upsell page flow"
      decisions:
        - "Upsell sequence logic (accept/reject paths)"
        - "Value stack composition"
        - "Timing and urgency calibration"
      kpis:
        - "Overall take rate >25%"
        - "AOV multiplier 1.8-2.5x"
        - "Time on page <90 seconds"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: psychology-analyzer
      role: "Analyze and leverage post-purchase mental state"
      inputs:
        - "Customer purchase data"
        - "Product type and price"
        - "Customer segment"
      outputs:
        - "Psychological state assessment"
        - "Optimal urgency level"
        - "Continuity angle recommendation"

    - agent: value-calculator
      role: "Calculate and validate value stack ratios"
      inputs:
        - "Upsell components and values"
        - "Main product price"
        - "Target take rate"
      outputs:
        - "Value stack (5-10x ratio validation)"
        - "Pricing recommendations"
        - "Perceived value score"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: headline-crafter
      role: "Create continuity headlines that maintain momentum"
      specialization: "Section A: Critical Top"
      constraints:
        - "NEVER question previous purchase"
        - "NEVER create new anxiety"
        - "NEVER imply main product insufficient"
      techniques:
        - "Continuity not interruption"
        - "Personalization with name"
        - "Social proof integration"

    - agent: body-builder
      role: "Construct lean persuasive body elements"
      specialization: "Section B: Persuasive Body"
      capabilities:
        - "VSL script (2-4 min structure)"
        - "Com vs Sem comparison graphics"
        - "Mini value stack (max 3 components)"
        - "Upsell-specific social proof"
        - "Stacked guarantee copy"

    - agent: conversion-optimizer
      role: "Implement rapid conversion elements"
      specialization: "Section C: Quick Conversion"
      elements:
        - "Binary choice buttons (Yes/No)"
        - "Price micro-comparison"
        - "Ultra-specific FAQ (3 questions only)"
        - "Reassurance bar"
        - "Exit intent downsell modal"

    - agent: sequence-engineer
      role: "Design and implement multi-upsell sequences"
      specialization: "Section D: Multiple Upsells"
      logic:
        upsell_1:
          pricing: "30-50% of main"
          target: "30% conversion"
          type: "Complemento direto"
        upsell_2_declined:
          pricing: "15-25% of main"
          target: "20% conversion"
          type: "Versao lite"
        upsell_3_accepted:
          pricing: "50-100% of main"
          target: "15% conversion"
          type: "Complemento premium"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: friction-hunter
      role: "Identify and eliminate conversion friction"
      triggers:
        - "Take rate below 15%"
        - "Time on page >120 seconds"
        - "Exit intent conversion <5%"
      techniques:
        - "One-click payment audit"
        - "Element-by-element friction analysis"
        - "Mobile experience review"
        - "VSL drop-off analysis"

    - agent: split-test-designer
      role: "Design and analyze upsell experiments"
      capabilities:
        - "Headline variations"
        - "Price point testing"
        - "VSL vs no-VSL comparison"
        - "Timer duration testing"
        - "Button copy optimization"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  upsell-architect:
    id: upsell-architect
    title: "Upsell Page Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "🏗️"

    purpose: |
      Design and orchestrate complete upsell page flows that maximize AOV
      while maintaining the customer's elevated psychological state.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "Peak-End Rule"
        application: "Leverage peak emotional state of purchase"
      - name: "Four Sections"
        components: ["Critical Top", "Persuasive Body", "Quick Conversion", "Multiple Upsells"]
      - name: "Golden Window"
        timing: "3-7 seconds before dopamine drops"

    decision_authority:
      - "Upsell sequence design"
      - "Value stack approval"
      - "Timing and urgency settings"
      - "Price point validation"

    inputs:
      - "Main product details and price"
      - "Available upsell products"
      - "Customer segment data"
      - "Historical take rate data"

    outputs:
      - "Complete upsell page architecture"
      - "Sequence flow diagram"
      - "Element specifications"
      - "Performance targets"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Upsell #1 Take Rate"
          target: ">25%"
        - name: "AOV Multiplier"
          target: "1.8-2.5x"
        - name: "Time on Page"
          target: "<90 seconds"
      secondary:
        - "Exit intent conversion >10%"
        - "Downsell take rate >15%"
        - "Technical success rate >99%"

  psychology-analyzer:
    id: psychology-analyzer
    title: "Post-Purchase Psychology Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🧠"

    purpose: |
      Analyze and leverage the unique psychological state of post-purchase
      customers to maximize upsell effectiveness.

    psychological_states:
      dopamine_elevated:
        description: "Brain rewarding the purchase decision"
        leverage: "Act quickly, maintain positive momentum"

      cognitive_consistency:
        description: "Tendency to maintain 'yes' pattern"
        leverage: "Frame upsell as continuation, not new decision"

      payment_barrier_overcome:
        description: "Card already in hand, friction eliminated"
        leverage: "One-click purchase, no re-entry"

      maximum_trust:
        description: "Just trusted you with money"
        leverage: "Strong guarantees, social proof"

    golden_window:
      definition: "3-7 seconds before dopamine starts dropping"
      implication: "Page must capture attention immediately"
      tactics:
        - "Above-fold impact"
        - "Progress bar visibility"
        - "Instant value recognition"

    continuity_principles:
      required:
        - "Validate the purchase just made"
        - "Position upsell as accelerator"
        - "Maintain celebration tone"
      forbidden:
        - "Question previous decision"
        - "Create new anxiety"
        - "Imply insufficiency"

  value-calculator:
    id: value-calculator
    title: "Value Stack Calculator"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🧮"

    purpose: |
      Calculate and validate value stacks to ensure 5-10x perceived value
      ratio against upsell price.

    value_stack_rules:
      minimum_ratio: 5
      optimal_ratio: 10
      max_components: 3

      structure:
        - component: "Main Component"
          value_assignment: "Highest value"
        - component: "Bonus #1"
          value_assignment: "Supporting value"
        - component: "Bonus #2"
          value_assignment: "Additional value"

    pricing_guidelines:
      upsell_1:
        range: "30-50% of main product"
        example: "Main R$997 → Upsell R$297-497"

      upsell_2_lite:
        range: "15-25% of main product"
        example: "Main R$997 → Downsell R$149-249"

      upsell_3_premium:
        range: "50-100% of main product"
        example: "Main R$997 → Premium R$497-997"

    validation_checks:
      - check: "Perceived value >= 5x price"
        action: "If fail, add value or reduce price"
      - check: "Max 3 components"
        action: "If exceed, consolidate"
      - check: "Clear value communication"
        action: "Ensure each component has dollar value"

  headline-crafter:
    id: headline-crafter
    title: "Continuity Headline Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "✍️"

    purpose: |
      Create headlines that maintain the 'yes' momentum instead of
      interrupting it with a new pitch.

    headline_types:
      continuity_confirmation:
        template: "ESPERE! Sua compra foi confirmada, mas..."
        psychology: "Confirms action, creates bridge"

      exclusive_unlock:
        template: "[Nome], voce desbloqueou uma oferta exclusiva"
        psychology: "Personalization + exclusivity"

      before_access:
        template: "Parabens! Antes de acessar seu [produto], veja isso..."
        psychology: "Celebration + anticipation"

      social_proof_integration:
        template: "[Nome], Sua Inscricao Foi Confirmada! Mas 87% dos Alunos Que Pegaram Este Upgrade Tiveram Resultados 3x Mais Rapidos..."
        psychology: "Confirmation + FOMO + specific claim"

    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "Questioning purchase"
        example: "Tem certeza que nao quer mais?"
        why_bad: "Breaks momentum, creates doubt"

      - pattern: "Creating new anxiety"
        example: "Mas voce esta perdendo algo importante..."
        why_bad: "Negative emotion, trust damage"

      - pattern: "Implying insufficiency"
        example: "O programa sozinho nao e suficiente..."
        why_bad: "Buyer's remorse trigger"

    subheadline_formula: |
      "Adicione [RESULTADO ESPECIFICO] ao que voce acabou de comprar
      e [BENEFICIO MULTIPLICADOR] - Oferta valida apenas agora"

  body-builder:
    id: body-builder
    title: "Persuasive Body Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "📝"

    purpose: |
      Construct lean, high-impact body elements that communicate value
      without causing post-purchase fatigue.

    vsl_structure:
      duration: "2-4 minutes maximum"
      segments:
        - time: "0-10s"
          content: "Parabenizar e validar compra"
          tone: "Celebratory"
        - time: "10-30s"
          content: "Revelar o 'gap' que o upsell preenche"
          tone: "Discovery"
        - time: "30-90s"
          content: "Demonstrar o resultado adicional"
          tone: "Proof-driven"
        - time: "90-180s"
          content: "Stack de valor rapido"
          tone: "Value accumulation"
        - time: "180-240s"
          content: "CTA com urgencia"
          tone: "Action-oriented"

      opening_script: |
        "Parabens! Voce acabou de tomar a melhor decisao para [resultado].
        Mas descobri que alunos que tambem pegam [upsell] conseguem
        [resultado 3x maior]. Deixe-me mostrar rapidamente..."

    comparison_graphic:
      format: "Side-by-side Com vs Sem"
      elements:
        - "Time to result"
        - "Support level"
        - "Resources included"
        - "Implementation method"
        - "Learning curve"
      footer: "Velocidade: 1x vs Velocidade: 3-5x"

    social_proof:
      quantity: "2-3 testimonials"
      requirement: "Must be specific to upsell, not main product"
      format: |
        "93% dos alunos que pegaram o [Upsell] dizem que
        foi a melhor decisao que tomaram..."

        [Foto] "O [upsell] cortou meu tempo de implementacao
        em 75%. Resultados na primeira semana!" - Maria Silva

    stacked_guarantee: |
      "Sua garantia original CONTINUA VALENDO, e ainda adiciono:
      Se o [Upsell] nao acelerar seus resultados em pelo menos 2x,
      devolvemos 100% do valor do upgrade - e voce fica com tudo."

  conversion-optimizer:
    id: conversion-optimizer
    title: "Quick Conversion Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "⚡"

    purpose: |
      Implement rapid conversion elements that simplify the decision
      to a clear binary choice.

    button_design:
      yes_button:
        text: "SIM! Quero Resultados 3x Mais Rapidos →"
        style: "Verde, Grande"
        position: "Primary"

      no_button:
        text: "Nao, prefiro ir mais devagar"
        style: "Cinza, Menor"
        position: "Secondary"

      mobile: "Fixos no rodape"

    price_anchoring: |
      Voce acabou de investir R$ 997 no programa principal.
      Por apenas R$ 297 a mais (menos de 30% extra),
      voce multiplica seus resultados por 3.

      E como comprar um carro e deixar de pegar o seguro.

    faq_specification:
      count: "Exactly 3 questions"
      questions:
        - q: "Preciso disso agora ou posso pegar depois?"
          a: "Este preco e exclusivo para agora. Depois volta para R$ 997"
        - q: "Isso nao deveria estar incluido no principal?"
          a: "O principal resolve [problema A]. Isso acelera e automatiza"
        - q: "E se eu me arrepender?"
          a: "Mesma garantia do principal + 30 dias extras so pro upgrade"

    reassurance_bar: |
      🔒 Compra Segura | Mesmo cartao ja cadastrado |
      Garantia Total | Acesso Imediato

    exit_intent:
      trigger: "Mouse toward X or back button"
      script: |
        "ULTIMA CHANCE!
        Ok, entendo que R$ 497 pode ser demais agora...
        Que tal levar o mesmo upgrade por 3x de R$ 197?"
        [SIM, QUERO PARCELADO] [Nao, obrigado]

  sequence-engineer:
    id: sequence-engineer
    title: "Multi-Upsell Sequence Engineer"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🔄"

    purpose: |
      Design and implement intelligent upsell sequences based on
      customer responses.

    sequence_logic:
      upsell_1:
        name: "Complemento Direto"
        pricing: "30-50% of main product value"
        purpose: "Accelerate main product results"
        target_conversion: "30%"
        if_accepted: "Show Upsell 3 (Premium)"
        if_rejected: "Show Upsell 2 (Lite)"

      upsell_2:
        name: "Versao Lite"
        pricing: "15-25% of main product value"
        purpose: "Lower barrier entry to value"
        target_conversion: "20%"
        if_accepted: "Show Thank You Page"
        if_rejected: "Show Thank You Page"

      upsell_3:
        name: "Complemento Premium"
        pricing: "50-100% of main product value"
        purpose: "Maximize value for committed buyers"
        target_conversion: "15% of Upsell 1 buyers"
        if_accepted: "Show Thank You Page"
        if_rejected: "Show Thank You Page"

    thank_you_page:
      required_elements:
        - "Confirmacao visual da compra total"
        - "Proximos passos numerados"
        - "Link direto para area de membros"
        - "Video de onboarding (2 min)"
        - "Oferta de 'Refer a Friend' com incentivo"

    one_click_technical:
      implementation:
        - "Use token from first purchase"
        - "Single click = instant processing"
        - "No re-entry of payment data"
      conversion_increase: "40-60% vs re-checkout"
      critical_note: |
        "Configure o one-click upsell ANTES de criar a pagina.
        A friccao tecnica mata mais upsells que copy ruim."

  friction-hunter:
    id: friction-hunter
    title: "Conversion Friction Hunter"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🔍"

    purpose: |
      Identify and eliminate any friction preventing customers
      from completing upsell purchases.

    alert_triggers:
      - trigger: "Take rate <15%"
        severity: "High"
        action: "Full page audit"
      - trigger: "Time on page >120s"
        severity: "Medium"
        action: "VSL and copy review"
      - trigger: "Exit intent <5%"
        severity: "Medium"
        action: "Downsell offer review"
      - trigger: "Technical failures >1%"
        severity: "Critical"
        action: "Immediate tech review"

    audit_checklist:
      technical:
        - "Is one-click working?"
        - "Are tokens being stored correctly?"
        - "Is payment processing fast (<3s)?"
        - "Are error messages clear?"

      psychological:
        - "Is headline creating continuity?"
        - "Is timer too aggressive (trust issue)?"
        - "Is value stack compelling (5-10x)?"
        - "Is guarantee removing risk?"

      ux:
        - "Is mobile experience optimized?"
        - "Are buttons visible without scroll?"
        - "Is progress bar clear?"
        - "Is VSL autoplaying correctly?"

    diagnosis_questions:
      low_take_rate:
        - "Is one-click working? (Technical friction)"
        - "Is timer too aggressive? (Trust issue)"
        - "Is value stack strong enough? (Value perception)"
        - "Is headline creating interruption? (Momentum broken)"
        - "Is VSL too long? (Fatigue)"

  split-test-designer:
    id: split-test-designer
    title: "Upsell A/B Test Designer"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🧪"

    purpose: |
      Design and analyze experiments to continuously improve
      upsell page performance.

    test_categories:
      headlines:
        - "Confirmation vs Exclusive unlock"
        - "With vs without social proof stat"
        - "Name personalization impact"

      pricing:
        - "30% vs 40% vs 50% of main"
        - "Round numbers vs specific (R$497 vs R$497)"
        - "Payment plan visibility"

      format:
        - "VSL vs no VSL"
        - "VSL length (2min vs 4min)"
        - "Video thumbnail variations"

      urgency:
        - "Timer duration (5min vs 10min vs 15min)"
        - "Sound on timer vs silent"
        - "Countdown vs static deadline"

      buttons:
        - "Yes button copy variations"
        - "No button psychology (shame vs neutral)"
        - "Button color impact"

    test_protocol:
      minimum_sample: "200 purchases per variant"
      significance: "95% confidence"
      primary_metric: "Take rate"
      secondary_metrics:
        - "Time on page"
        - "Scroll depth"
        - "VSL completion"
        - "Exit intent trigger rate"

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # Section A: Critical Top
  - task: "Create continuity headline"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Pass continuity validation (no questioning, anxiety, insufficiency)"

  - task: "Create subheadline"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Include time-limit indicator"

  - task: "Implement progress bar"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Step 1 must have green checkmark"

  - task: "Configure timer"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "10 min max, sound at 60s"

  # Section B: Persuasive Body
  - task: "Write VSL script"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Follow 5-segment structure, max 4 min"

  - task: "Record VSL"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must follow script structure"

  - task: "Create Com vs Sem graphic"
    executor: Worker

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Headline Continuity Gate"
    transition: "Headline Creation → Publication"
    condition: "headline_passes_continuity_check == true"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Rewrite headline using approved templates"

  QG-002:
    name: "Value Stack Ratio Gate"
    transition: "Value Stack → Publication"
    condition: "perceived_value >= price × 5"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Add value or reduce price"

  QG-003:
    name: "VSL Length Gate"
    transition: "VSL → Publication"
    condition: "vsl_duration <= 240_seconds"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Edit to reduce length"

  QG-004:
    name: "One-Click Technical Gate"
    transition: "Page → Go Live"
    condition: "one_click_tested == true AND success_rate >= 99%"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Debug payment integration"

  QG-005:
    name: "FAQ Count Gate"
    transition: "FAQ → Publication"
    condition: "faq_count == 3"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Adjust to exactly 3 questions"

  QG-006:
    name: "Take Rate Performance Gate"
    transition: "Live → Optimization"
    condition: "take_rate >= 0.25"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Trigger full page audit"

  QG-007:
    name: "Time on Page Gate"
    transition: "Live → Optimization"
    condition: "avg_time_on_page <= 90_seconds"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Review for decision paralysis"

# ===============================================================================
# WORKFLOWS
# ===============================================================================

workflows:
  new_upsell_page_workflow:
    trigger: "New upsell page request"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: upsell-architect
        action: "Define upsell strategy and sequence"
        output: "Page architecture document"

      - step: 2
        agent: value-calculator
        action: "Calculate and validate value stack"
        output: "Approved value stack (5-10x ratio)"

      - step: 3
        agent: headline-crafter
        action: "Create continuity headline and subheadline"
        output: "Approved headlines"

      - step: 4
        agent: body-builder
        action: "Create VSL script and body elements"
        outputs:
          - "VSL script"
          - "Com vs Sem graphic"
          - "Social proof section"
          - "Stacked guarantee"

      - step: 5
        agent: conversion-optimizer
        action: "Implement conversion elements"
        outputs:
          - "Binary buttons"
          - "Price comparison"
          - "3-question FAQ"
          - "Reassurance bar"
          - "Exit intent modal"

      - step: 6
        agent: sequence-engineer
        action: "Configure upsell sequence and routing"
        output: "Complete page flow"

      - step: 7
        agent: sequence-engineer
        action: "Test one-click payment"
        gate: "QG-004 must pass"

      - step: 8
        agent: upsell-architect
        action: "Final review and approval"
        output: "Page ready for launch"

  optimization_workflow:
    trigger: "Take rate <25% OR time on page >90s"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: friction-hunter
        action: "Run full page audit"
        output: "Friction report"

      - step: 2
        agent: friction-hunter
        action: "Diagnose root cause"
        output: "Priority issues list"

      - step: 3
        agent: split-test-designer
        action: "Design test for top issue"
        output: "Test specification"

      - step: 4
        agent: relevant-tier-1-agent
        action: "Implement test variant"
        output: "Variant live"

      - step: 5
        agent: split-test-designer
        action: "Analyze results at significance"
        output: "Winner declaration"

      - step: 6
        agent: relevant-tier-1-agent
        action: "Implement winning variant"
        output: "Optimization complete"

  customer_journey_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer completes main purchase"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: "Load upsell page 1"
        timing: "Immediate (Golden Window)"

      - step: 2
        action: "Customer views page"
        elements: ["Headline", "Progress bar", "Timer starts"]

      - step: 3
        decision: "Customer clicks Yes or No"
        if_yes: "Process one-click payment → Step 4a"
        if_no: "Check for exit intent → Step 4b"

      - step: 4a
        action: "Show Upsell 3 (Premium)"
        condition: "Accepted Upsell 1"

      - step: 4b
        action: "Show Upsell 2 (Lite)"
        condition: "Rejected Upsell 1"

      - step: 5
        action: "Process response to Upsell 2 or 3"

      - step: 6
        action: "Redirect to Thank You Page"
        elements: ["Confirmation", "Next steps", "Onboarding video", "Referral offer"]

# ===============================================================================
# KPIs & SUCCESS METRICS
# ===============================================================================

kpis:
  primary:
    take_rate:
      formula: "Upsell Purchases / Main Purchases"
      target: ">25%"
      source: "Metrica de Sucesso"

    aov_multiplier:
      formula: "Total Revenue / (Main Purchases × Main Price)"
      target: "1.8-2.5x"
      source: "Metrica de Sucesso"

    time_on_page:
      formula: "Average seconds on upsell page"
      target: "<90 seconds"
      source: "Metrica de Sucesso"
      rationale: "Quick decision = good page"

  secondary:
    downsell_take_rate:
      formula: "Downsell Purchases / Upsell Declines"
      target: ">15%"

    exit_intent_conversion:
      formula: "Exit Intent Purchases / Exit Intent Triggers"
      target: ">10%"

    vsl_completion:
      formula: "Completed VSL Views / Started VSL Views"
      target: ">70%"

    technical_success:
      formula: "Successful Payments / Payment Attempts"
      target: ">99%"

  by_section:
    section_a:
      - "Headline engagement (scroll past fold)"
      - "Timer visibility during decision"
      - "Progress bar comprehension"

    section_b:
      - "VSL completion rate"
      - "Com vs Sem graphic engagement"
      - "Testimonial scroll depth"

    section_c:
      - "Button click distribution (Yes vs No)"
      - "FAQ expansion rate"
      - "Exit intent trigger rate"

    section_d:
      - "Upsell 2/3 take rates"
      - "Sequence completion rate"
      - "Thank you page engagement"

# ===============================================================================
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ===============================================================================

troubleshooting:
  - symptom: "Take rate <15%"
    possible_causes:
      - "One-click not working (technical friction)"
      - "Timer too aggressive (trust issue)"
      - "Value stack weak (<5x ratio)"
      - "Headline breaking momentum"
      - "VSL too long (fatigue)"
    diagnosis:
      - "Test one-click payment flow"
      - "Review timer settings"
      - "Calculate value stack ratio"

      - "Check VSL length"
    solutions:
      - "Fix payment integration"
      - "Extend timer to 10 min"
      - "Add value to stack"
      - "Rewrite headline using templates"
      - "Edit VSL to <4 min"

  - symptom: "Time on page >120s"
    possible_causes:
      - "VSL too long"
      - "Too many elements causing paralysis"
      - "Unclear CTA"
      - "FAQ expanding unnecessarily"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check VSL duration"
      - "Count above-fold elements"
      - "Review button visibility"
      - "Check FAQ interaction rate"
    solutions:
      - "Cut VSL to 2-4 min"
      - "Simplify above-fold"
      - "Make buttons more prominent"
      - "Limit FAQ to 3 questions"

  - symptom: "High drop-off at exit intent"
    possible_causes:
      - "Downsell not compelling"

      - "Modal design issues"
    diagnosis:
      - "Review downsell offer"
      - "Check payment plan terms"
      - "Test modal on mobile"
    solutions:
      - "Improve downsell value"
      - "Offer better payment terms"
      - "Redesign modal for mobile"

  - symptom: "Technical payment failures"

      - "Card declined"
    diagnosis:
      - "Check token storage"
      - "Review gateway logs"
      - "Analyze decline reasons"
    solutions:

      - "Optimize gateway settings"
      - "Add backup payment method"
```
