## Referência: references/squad/docs/sops/workshop-launch-sop.md

# Workshop Launch SOP

> **Source:** $100M Workshop Playbook + Framework Analysis - Alex Hormozi
> **Pattern:** SC-PE-001 (SOP Extraction Standard)
> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Extracted:** 2026-02-10

---

## Part 1: Purpose

Execute high-converting online workshop launches (webinars) that convert 10-30% of live attendees into buyers. The Workshop Launch system maximizes **conversion velocity** - transforming 3-4 hours of live content into 5-20x ROI on advertising spend.

**Core Equation:**
```
Launch ROI = (Live Attendees × Conversion Rate × Average Order Value) / Ad Spend

Example:
- 5,000 Live Attendees
- 15% Conversion Rate = 750 Sales
- $997 AOV = $747,750 Revenue
- $50K Ad Spend = 15x ROI
```

**Business Impact:** A well-executed workshop can generate $500K-$10M+ in a single event, with 2-8 hours of concentrated selling creating urgency impossible to replicate in evergreen funnels.

---

## Part 2: Scope

### When This SOP Applies
- Online webinar/workshop launches (NOT in-person events)
- 3-4 hour live presentation format
- Product/service with validated offer ($500-$50K range)
- Audience size 500-100,000+ live viewers

### When This SOP Does NOT Apply
- In-person seminars or conferences
- Short-form webinars (<90 minutes)
- Evergreen automated webinars (different optimization)
- Product launches without live component

### Business Types
- Info-products and courses

## Part 4: The 7-Block Framework

### Framework Overview

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   WORKSHOP LAUNCH: 7-BLOCK STRUCTURE                           |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
|     BLOCK      |  TIME  |               PURPOSE                                |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Hook        | 10 min | Promise + stakes + live proof element                |
| Impossivel     |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Origem e    | 15 min | Personal story + discovery + first transformation    |
| Conexao        |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Educacao    | 60 min | Framework + 3 insights + demonstration               |
| Profunda       |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Casos em    | 30 min | Personal + 3-5 clients + live case if possible       |
| Cascata        |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 5. Stack de    | 20 min | High anchor + sequential reductions + bonuses        |
| Valor          |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 6. Inversao    | 10 min | Guarantee + fast-action bonus + penalty for waiting  |
| de Risco       |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
| 7. Demonstracao| 30 min | Q&A + consultoria ao vivo + close final              |
| Final          |        |                                                      |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
|                | ~3h    | TOTAL WORKSHOP TIME                                  |
+----------------+--------+------------------------------------------------------+
```

**Source:** Framework extracted from "$ 100M Workshop Playbook.md" Section 1 and "FRAMEWORK WORKSHOP HORMOZI.md" Sections 1-2.

## Part 6: Decision Rules

### DR-001: Slide Pacing
```yaml
rule: SLIDE_RATE_CONTROL
trigger: During presentation
condition:
  - IF slides_per_minute < 6 THEN "WARNING: Too slow, losing attention"
  - IF slides_per_minute >= 6 AND <= 10 THEN "OPTIMAL"
  - IF slides_per_minute > 10 THEN "WARNING: May be too fast for comprehension"
action: Adjust pacing in real-time
confidence: HIGH (from Playbook de Conteudo)
```

### DR-002: Retention Monitoring
```yaml
rule: RETENTION_THRESHOLD
trigger: During workshop at 1h and 2h marks
condition:
  - IF retention_1h < 40% THEN "PROBLEM: Hook too weak"
  - IF retention_1h >= 40% AND < 60% THEN "OK"
  - IF retention_1h >= 60% THEN "EXCELLENT"
  - IF retention_2h < 25% THEN "CRITICAL: Not delivering value early"
  - IF retention_2h >= 40% THEN "EXCELLENT"
action: If retention dropping, accelerate to value/demonstration
confidence: HIGH (from source KPIs)
```

### DR-003: Conversion Target
```yaml
rule: CONVERSION_ASSESSMENT
trigger: Post-workshop analysis
condition:
  - IF live_conversion < 5% THEN "PROBLEM: Offer misaligned or insufficient urgency"
  - IF live_conversion >= 5% AND < 10% THEN "ACCEPTABLE"
  - IF live_conversion >= 10% AND < 30% THEN "TARGET RANGE"
  - IF live_conversion >= 30% THEN "EXCEPTIONAL"
action: Analyze each block for optimization opportunities
confidence: HIGH (from source targets)
```

### DR-004: Price Reduction Sequencing
```yaml
rule: PRICE_REVEAL_SEQUENCE
trigger: During Stack de Valor block
condition:
  - ALWAYS anchor high first
  - ALWAYS reduce in minimum 3 steps
  - ALWAYS justify each reduction
  - IF audience_energy_low THEN add surprise element
action: Follow script exactly; improvisation here kills sales
confidence: HIGH (from Framework)
```

### DR-005: Urgency Authenticity
```yaml
rule: SCARCITY_INTEGRITY
trigger: When presenting urgency elements
condition:
  - IF scarcity_is_real THEN "PROCEED with full emphasis"
  - IF scarcity_is_artificial THEN "WARNING: Destroys long-term trust"
  - MUST have verifiable limitation
action: Only use real scarcity; build business model to support it
confidence: HIGH (from cultural elements)
```

### DR-006: Education-to-Offer Ratio
```yaml
rule: CONTENT_BALANCE
trigger: Workshop planning
condition:
  - IF education_percentage < 50% THEN "TOO SALESY: Increase value"
  - IF education_percentage >= 60% AND <= 70% THEN "OPTIMAL"
  - IF education_percentage > 80% THEN "Consider adding more conversion elements"
action: Block 3 (Educacao) should be largest block
confidence: HIGH (from Framework)
```

---

## Part 7: Exceptions & Edge Cases

### Exception 1: Low Registration to Live Ratio (<15%)
**Trigger:** Live attendance significantly below registrations
**Analysis:**
- Email deliverability issues
- Wrong time zone selected
- Insufficient reminder sequence
**Action:**
- Add SMS reminders
- Shorten time between registration and event
- Increase warmup content value
- [INFERRED] Consider multiple time zone options

### Exception 2: High Retention, Low Conversion
**Trigger:** >50% retention through offer but <5% conversion
**Analysis:**
- Offer disconnected from content
- Price not justified
- Insufficient urgency
- Audience came for free content only
**Action:**
- Review transition script
- Add more price justification
- Verify urgency elements are real
- Pre-qualify audience better

### Exception 3: Technical Failure During Live
**Trigger:** Streaming platform goes down
**Response:**
- Immediate switch to backup (Zoom)
- Email blast with new link
- Chat team directs to backup
- Continue from where you stopped
**Guardrail:** Always have backup stream running in parallel

### Exception 4: Objections Flooding Chat
**Trigger:** Chat filled with concerns/objections
**Analysis:**
- Didn't anticipate objections in content
- Transition to offer too abrupt
- Missing proof points
**Action:**
- Address top 3 objections immediately
- Slow down, add proof
- Have team moderate and collect objections for Q&A

### Exception 5: B2B vs B2C Adjustments
**Trigger:** Workshop for business audience
**Adaptation:**
- Increase data/ROI focus
- Reduce emotional stories, increase case studies
- Longer educational component
- More demonstrations, fewer testimonials

|------|-----------|------------------|
| Registration Volume | 1,000+ for viable event | Extend ads or postpone |
| Live Attendance | 25%+ of registrations | Improve reminder sequence |
| 1-Hour Retention | >40% | Strengthen hook and early value |
| Conversion Rate | 10-30% | Audit offer-content alignment |
| ROI | 5x+ minimum | Review ad spend efficiency |

|--------|------|-----|-------|

```
- Proporcao: 16:9 (1920x1080 minimo)
```

## Appendix C: Psychological Triggers Reference

### Gatilhos Obrigatorios (from source)

| Gatilho | Implementacao | Timing |
|---------|---------------|--------|
| **Reciprocidade** | Dar framework completo, resolver problema ao vivo, bonus surpresa | Block 3-4 |
| **Prova Social** | Mostrar vendas em tempo real, depoimentos, numero de participantes | Throughout |
| **Autoridade** | Credenciais no inicio, demonstracao de expertise, correcao de "gurus" | Block 1-2 |
| **Escassez** | Unidades limitadas reais, bonus que expira, preco que aumenta | Block 5-6 |
| **Urgencia** | Condicao especial ao vivo, fast action bonus, penalidade por esperar | Block 6-7 |

| **Pattern Interrupt** | Da educacao para a oferta gratuita |
| **Future Pacing** | "Picture this, tomorrow, without changing anything..." |
| **Reframing** | Transformar doacao em investimento |

```yaml
# Workshop Launch Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-001 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Workshop Playbook + Framework Analysis - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: workshop-launch
  purpose: "Execute high-converting online workshop launches that convert 10-30% of live attendees"
  domain: launch-marketing
  source_playbooks:
    - "$ 100M Workshop Playbook.md"
    - "FRAMEWORK WORKSHOP HORMOZI.md"
    - "CHECKLIST COMPLETO WORKSHOP.md"
    - "PLAYBOOK DE CONTEUDO E SLIDES.md"
    - "ANALISE DO FRAMEWORK DO WORKSHOP.md"

  core_equation: |
    Launch ROI = (Live Attendees x Conversion Rate x AOV) / Ad Spend
    Target: 10-30% live conversion rate
    Impact: 5-20x ROI on advertising spend

# ===============================================================================
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ===============================================================================

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: workshop-commander
      role: "Orchestrate the 7-Block workshop and coordinate all phases"
      decisions:
        - "Phase transition timing"
        - "Resource allocation across team"
        - "Real-time performance adjustments"
        - "Escalation trigger assessment"

        - "Overall conversion rate"
        - "Live attendance vs registrations"
        - "Revenue vs ad spend ROI"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: offer-architect
      role: "Design and validate offer structure with value stack"
      inputs:
        - "Product/service details"

      outputs:
        - "Complete offer document"
        - "Pricing matrix with anchor"
        - "Bonus stack with values"

    - agent: proof-curator
      role: "Organize and match social proof to audience segments"
      inputs:
        - "Customer testimonials"
        - "Case studies"
        - "Screenshots and results"
      outputs:
        - "Proof library by demographic"
        - "Case study scripts"
        - "Real-time proof displays"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: content-producer
      role: "Create slides, scripts, and educational framework"
      specialization: "Block 3: Educacao Profunda"
      deliverables:
        - "100-1600 slide deck"
        - "Framework documentation"
        - "Transition scripts"
        - "Demonstration materials"

    - agent: traffic-driver
      role: "Execute registration campaigns and warmup sequences"
      specialization: "Phase A: Pre-Workshop"
      capabilities:
        - "Ad campaign management"
        - "Email sequence creation"
        - "Registration optimization"
        - "Reminder automation"

    - agent: tech-director
      role: "Manage all technical systems and backups"
      specialization: "Technical execution"
      responsibilities:
        - "Streaming setup and backup"
        - "Payment gateway testing"
        - "Chat moderation setup"
        - "Real-time monitoring"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: conversion-closer
      role: "Execute offer presentation and handle objections"
      specialization: "Blocks 5-7: Stack, Risk Inversion, Close"
      techniques:
        - "Price reduction scripting"
        - "Urgency creation"
        - "Live objection handling"
        - "Q&A facilitation"

    - agent: performance-analyst
      role: "Monitor KPIs and recommend real-time adjustments"
      inputs:
        - "Live attendance data"
        - "Retention metrics"
        - "Engagement rates"
        - "Conversion tracking"
      outputs:
        - "Performance alerts"
        - "Optimization recommendations"
        - "Post-event analysis"

    - agent: follow-up-specialist
      role: "Execute post-workshop conversion and downsell"
      specialization: "Phase C: Post-Workshop"
      techniques:
        - "Replay sequence"
        - "Last chance urgency"
        - "Downsell positioning"
        - "Non-buyer recovery"

# ===============================================================================
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ===============================================================================

agents:
  workshop-commander:
    id: workshop-commander
    title: "Workshop Launch Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate the complete workshop launch from preparation through
      post-event follow-up. Ensure all 7 blocks execute flawlessly and
      conversion targets are achieved.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "7-Block Structure"
        components:
          - "Hook Impossivel (10 min)"
          - "Origem e Conexao (15 min)"
          - "Educacao Profunda (60 min)"
          - "Casos em Cascata (30 min)"
          - "Stack de Valor (20 min)"
          - "Inversao de Risco (10 min)"
          - "Demonstracao Final (30 min)"
      - name: "Launch ROI Optimization"
        equation: "(Live Attendees x Conversion Rate x AOV) / Ad Spend"

    decision_authority:
      - "Phase timing and transitions"
      - "Resource allocation"
      - "Real-time pivots during live event"
      - "Escalation triggers"

    inputs:
      - "Registration and attendance data"
      - "Real-time retention metrics"
      - "Team status reports"
      - "Technical system status"

    outputs:
      - "Phase transition signals"
      - "Performance alerts"
      - "Resource reallocation directives"
      - "Post-event analysis report"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Live Conversion Rate"
          target: "10-30%"
        - name: "Launch ROI"
          target: "5-20x ad spend"
      secondary:
        - "Registration to live: >25%"
        - "1-hour retention: >40%"
        - "Chat engagement: >20%"

  offer-architect:
    id: offer-architect
    title: "Offer & Stack Designer"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "💎"

    purpose: |
      Design irresistible offers with high-anchor pricing and sequential
      value stacking. Create the psychological framework for conversion.

    offer_components:
      core_offer:
        requirements:
          - "Clear primary deliverable"
          - "Specific outcome promise"
          - "Defined delivery mechanism"
          - "Strong guarantee"

      value_stack:
        structure: |
          Stack total must be 10x+ final price.
          Example from Hormozi:
          - Lead System: $15,999
          - Sales System: $5,999
          - Delivery System: $6,499
          - Profit System: $41,458
          - Total: $69,955 (then reduce to $5,997)

      bonus_categories:
        - "Sistema/template pratico (valor 3-5x preco)"
        - "Treinamento complementar"
        - "Comunidade ou suporte"
        - "Ferramentas/software"
        - "Sessoes ao vivo/consultoria"
        - "Conteudo exclusivo futuro"

      scarcity_bonuses:
        - "Bonus para primeiros X"
        - "Bonus apenas ao vivo"
        - "Item que desaparece quando live termina"

    pricing_strategy:
      anchor_establishment:
        - "Calculate true market value"
        - "Sum all component values"
        - "Add time/expertise value"

      reduction_sequence:
        - "First reduction: 50-70% off anchor"
        - "Second reduction: Additional 50% off"
        - "Final price: 90-95% off anchor"

      payment_options:
        - "A vista com desconto"
        - "Parcelado sem juros"
        - "Entrada + parcelas"
        - "Gateway backup"

    outputs:
      - "Complete offer document"
      - "Pricing matrix with justifications"
      - "Bonus stack with individual values"
      - "Guarantee formulation"
      - "Downsell structure"

  proof-curator:
    id: proof-curator
    title: "Social Proof Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "📊"

    purpose: |
      Collect, organize, and strategically deploy social proof throughout
      the workshop. Match proof demographics to audience segments.

    proof_types:
      personal_results:
        - "Faturamento comprovavel"
        - "Numero de empresas vendidas"
        - "Evolucao temporal (de X para Y em Z tempo)"
        - "Screenshots de dashboards/relatorios"
        - "Prints de transferencias bancarias"

      client_results:
        minimum: 10
        requirements:
          - "Screenshots de depoimentos"
          - "Videos de 30-60 segundos"
          - "Prints de conversas WhatsApp/email"
          - "Antes/depois com numeros especificos"
          - "Diversidade de nichos/industrias"

      external_validations:
        - "Certificacoes relevantes"
        - "Aparicoes em midia"
        - "Parcerias com empresas conhecidas"
        - "Numero de seguidores/inscritos"
        - "Reviews em plataformas publicas"
        - "Premiacoes ou reconhecimentos"

      real_time_proof:
        - "Dashboard ao vivo de vendas"
        - "Contador de participantes"
        - "Testemunhos durante evento"
        - "Demonstracoes funcionando"

    organization_strategy:
      by_demographic:
        - "Age and gender"
        - "Industry/niche"
        - "Company size"
        - "Problem type"
        - "Desired outcome"

      by_workshop_block:
        block_1: "Quick wins, numbers"
        block_2: "Personal transformation"
        block_3: "Framework validation"
        block_4: "Diverse case studies"
        block_5: "ROI justification"
        block_6: "Risk elimination"
        block_7: "Real-time success"

    case_study_structure: |
      1. Situacao inicial (numeros)
      2. Tentativas anteriores
      3. Ceticismo/objecoes
      4. Implementacao especifica
      5. Resultado mensuravel
      6. Tempo para resultado
      7. Efeito colateral positivo

    outputs:
      - "Proof library organized by segment"
      - "Case study scripts"
      - "Slide-ready proof materials"
      - "Real-time proof display system"

  content-producer:
    id: content-producer
    title: "Content & Framework Creator"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🎨"

    purpose: |
      Create the educational framework and all content assets for the
      workshop. Transform expertise into teachable, memorable content.

    framework_design:
      structure: |
        Parte 1: Problema Universal
        - Identificar dor #1 da audiencia
        - Amplificar consequencias
        - Mostrar tentativas falhas comuns

        Parte 2: Descoberta Unica
        - Momento de insight
        - Por que outros metodos falham
        - Principio contra-intuitivo

        Parte 3: Sistema Replicavel
        - 3-5 passos nomeados
        - Demonstracao de pelo menos 1 passo
        - Resultados esperados por passo

      requirements:
        - "Proprietary name for framework"
        - "3-5 core components"
        - "3 counter-intuitive insights"
        - "Memorable analogies"
        - "Practical demonstrations"

    slide_production:
      quantity: "100-1600 slides"
      pacing: "6-10 slides per minute"

      distribution:
        bloco_1_abertura: "Slides 1-150 (15-20 min)"
        bloco_2_problema: "Slides 151-350 (20-25 min)"
        bloco_3_solucao: "Slides 351-800 (45-60 min)"
        bloco_4_implementacao: "Slides 801-1000 (20-30 min)"
        bloco_5_oferta: "Slides 1001-1400 (30-40 min)"
        bloco_6_fechamento: "Slides 1401-1600 (15-20 min)"

      types:
        texto: "40% - Max 7 words, 72pt+ font"
        dados: "20% - Simplified graphs, highlighted numbers"
        imagem: "20% - Real screenshots, high quality photos"
        transicao: "10% - Section titles, provocative questions"
        mistos: "10% - Text over image, simple diagrams"

      specifications:
        aspect_ratio: "16:9 (1920x1080 minimum)"
        font: "Sans-serif bold (Impact/Bebas/Montserrat)"
        min_font_size: "32pt"
        colors: "Maximum 3 (black, white, 1 accent)"
        images: "High resolution, no watermarks"

    script_creation:
      scripts_required:
        - "Opening hook (first 60 seconds)"
        - "Block transitions (5 scripts)"
        - "Education to offer transition"
        - "Price reduction sequence"
        - "Guarantee presentation"
        - "Closing urgency"

      transition_scripts:
        "1_to_2": "Agora que voce viu o que e possivel, deixe-me mostrar o que esta impedindo 99% das pessoas..."
        "2_to_3": "Mas existe uma saida. E ela e mais simples do que voce imagina..."
        "3_to_4": "Conhecimento sem acao e apenas entretenimento. Veja como implementar..."
        "4_to_5": "Voce tem duas opcoes: fazer sozinho ou deixar que eu facilite o caminho..."
        "5_to_6": "A decisao e sua, mas o tempo nao espera..."

    outputs:
      - "Named proprietary framework"
      - "Complete slide deck"
      - "All transition scripts"
      - "Demonstration materials"
      - "Support materials (PDF/workbook)"

  traffic-driver:
    id: traffic-driver
    title: "Registration & Traffic Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🚀"

    purpose: |
      Drive registrations through paid ads and organic promotion.
      Maximize live attendance through strategic warmup and reminders.

    registration_campaigns:
      timeline:
        launch: "D-10 to D-4"
        optimization: "Daily bid adjustments"
        scale: "Based on cost per registration"

      channels:
        paid:
          - "Facebook/Instagram Ads"
          - "YouTube Ads"
          - "Google Search"
          - "LinkedIn (B2B)"
        organic:
          - "Email list"
          - "Social posts"
          - "Affiliate partners"

      landing_page_elements:
        - "Clear value proposition"
        - "Specific date/time"
        - "What they'll learn"
        - "Scarcity element"
        - "Social proof"
        - "Low-friction form"

    warmup_sequence:
      content_strategy:
        - "Email de confirmacao (immediately)"
        - "Email de aquecimento 1 (valor)"
        - "Email de aquecimento 2 (prova social)"
        - "Email de aquecimento 3 (o que esperar)"

      video_content:
        count: "3-5 warmup videos"
        purpose: "Deliver value, build anticipation, don't oversell"
        rule: "Each video provides standalone insight"

    reminder_system:
      automated:
        - timing: "24h before"
          content: "Full details + anticipation builder"
        - timing: "1h before"
          content: "Link reminder + urgency"

      sms_whatsapp:
        - timing: "24h before"
          content: "Quick reminder"
        - timing: "10 min before"
          content: "We're starting!"

      email_24h_template: |
        Assunto: Confirmado para amanha + surpresa

        [NOME],

        Amanha as [HORA] vou revelar [RESULTADO ESPECIFICO].
        Mas tem um detalhe que nao contei...
        Durante o workshop, vou fazer [DEMONSTRACAO IMPACTANTE]
        ao vivo com alguem da audiencia.
        Pode ser voce.

        Link da sala: [LINK]
        Hora: [HORA]
        O que trazer: [PREPARACAO]

        PS: Nos primeiros 10 minutos, entrego [BONUS RAPIDO].
        Nao atrase.

    conversion_targets:
      registration_to_live: ">25%"
      cost_per_registration: "Track and optimize daily"

    outputs:
      - "Ad campaigns running"
      - "Email sequences deployed"
      - "Reminder automations active"
      - "Registration reports"

  tech-director:
    id: tech-director
    title: "Technical Operations Director"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "⚙️"

    purpose: |
      Ensure flawless technical execution with redundancy for every
      critical system. No single point of failure allowed.

    tech_stack:
      streaming:
        primary: "OBS + YouTube/Facebook Live"
        backup: "Zoom as contingency"
        rule: "Backup stream always running in parallel"

      slides:
        tool: "Google Slides (shareable)"
        backup: "Downloaded PDF version"

      chat:
        tool: "ManyChat for automations"
        moderation: "Dedicated moderator team"

      payments:
        primary: "Hotmart/Stripe"
        backup: "Secondary gateway ready"
        test: "Full test 24h before"

      support:
        tool: "WhatsApp Business API"
        coverage: "Team on standby during event"

    go_live_checklist:
      60_min_before:
        - "Todos os links testados"
        - "Slides carregados"
        - "Equipe posicionada"
        - "Backup stream rodando"

      30_min_before:
        - "Camera e audio ok"
        - "Chat moderado ativo"
        - "Gateway funcionando"
        - "Warmup slides on"

      10_min_before:
        - "Musica de entrada"
        - "Contador regressivo"
        - "Mensagens automaticas"
        - "Respirar fundo 3x"

    contingency_protocols:
      streaming_failure:
        - "Immediate switch to Zoom backup"
        - "Email blast with new link"
        - "Chat team directs to backup"
        - "Continue from where stopped"

      payment_failure:
        - "Switch to backup gateway"
        - "Manual payment collection if needed"
        - "Team takes phone orders"

      audio_video_issues:
        - "Pre-recorded segment ready"
        - "Backup microphone tested"
        - "Secondary camera ready"

    monitoring_during_event:
      metrics:
        - "Stream health"
        - "Viewer count"
        - "Chat activity"
        - "Payment processing"
        - "Error rates"

    outputs:
      - "All systems tested and operational"
      - "Backup systems verified"
      - "Team briefed on contingencies"
      - "Monitoring dashboards live"

  conversion-closer:
    id: conversion-closer
    title: "Live Conversion Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "💰"

    purpose: |
      Execute the offer blocks (5-7) with maximum persuasive impact.
      Handle objections in real-time and close with urgency.

    scripts:
      opening_hook: |
        "Nos proximos [TEMPO], vou mostrar exatamente como [RESULTADO ESPECIFICO]
        sem [OBJECAO 1], sem [OBJECAO 2], mesmo que [LIMITACAO COMUM].

        E vou provar isso ao vivo, na sua frente, fazendo [DEMONSTRACAO].

        Se ao final voce nao tiver pelo menos [PEQUENO RESULTADO GARANTIDO],
        eu [PENALIDADE PARA VOCE]."

      education_to_offer: |
        "Voce viu como [RECAPITULAR INSIGHT PRINCIPAL].

        Agora voce tem duas opcoes:
        Opcao 1: Pegar tudo que mostrei e tentar implementar sozinho.
        Vai funcionar? Talvez. Em quanto tempo? Nao sei.

        Opcao 2: Deixar eu instalar isso para voce, junto com
        [BENEFICIO EXTRA NAO MENCIONADO ANTES].

        Deixe-me mostrar exatamente o que voce recebe..."

      price_reduction: |
        "O valor normal disso seria [ANCORA ALTA] porque [JUSTIFICATIVA].

        Mas nao vou cobrar [ANCORA].
        Nem mesmo [50% DA ANCORA].
        Nem [25% DA ANCORA].

        Hoje, apenas para quem esta ao vivo, o investimento e [PRECO FINAL].

        Mas tem um detalhe..."
        [REVELAR CONDICAO OU BONUS SURPRESA]

      guarantee_formula: |
        "Se em 90 dias voce nao tiver [RESULTADO],
        mesmo aplicando [CONDICAO MINIMA],
        eu [CONSEQUENCIA FAVORAVEL AO CLIENTE]"

    psychological_triggers:
      reciprocidade:
        timing: "Block 3-4"
        implementation: "Dar framework completo, resolver problema ao vivo, bonus surpresa"

      prova_social:
        timing: "Throughout"
        implementation: "Mostrar vendas tempo real, depoimentos, numero de participantes"

      autoridade:
        timing: "Block 1-2"
        implementation: "Credenciais no inicio, demonstracao de expertise"

      escassez:
        timing: "Block 5-6"
        implementation: "Unidades limitadas reais, bonus que expira, preco que aumenta"

      urgencia:
        timing: "Block 6-7"
        implementation: "Condicao especial ao vivo, fast action bonus, penalidade por esperar"

    objection_handling:
      prepared_objections:
        - objection: "Muito caro"
          response: "ROI demonstration + payment options"
        - objection: "Nao tenho tempo"
          response: "Implementation speed + support"
        - objection: "Preciso pensar"
          response: "What specifically? + Address concern"
        - objection: "Ja tentei algo similar"
          response: "What was different about that?"
        - objection: "Funciona no meu nicho?"
          response: "Case study from similar niche"

    closing_techniques:
      countdown:
        - "Timer de 3 minutos na tela"
        - "Recapitulacao de tudo"
        - "Ultima chance para bonus"

      live_proof:
        - "Show sales happening in real-time"
        - "Read buyer names/comments"
        - "Display spots remaining"

    outputs:
      - "High-impact offer delivery"
      - "Objections handled"
      - "Maximum urgency created"
      - "Conversions captured"

  performance-analyst:
    id: performance-analyst
    title: "Real-Time Performance Monitor"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "📈"

    purpose: |
      Monitor all KPIs during the workshop and provide real-time
      optimization recommendations to the commander.

    kpis_during_event:
      retention:
        1h:
          ruim: "<40%"
          ok: "40-60%"
          otimo: ">60%"
        2h:
          ruim: "<25%"
          ok: "25-40%"
          otimo: ">40%"

      peak_audience:
        ruim: "Inicio"
        ok: "Meio"
        otimo: "During offer"

      chat_engagement:
        ruim: "<10%"
        ok: "10-20%"
        otimo: ">20%"

      click_rate:
        ruim: "<5%"
        ok: "5-15%"
        otimo: ">15%"

    conversion_funnel:
      registrados_to_presentes: "Meta 25%+"
      presentes_to_clique: "Meta 30%+"
      clique_to_compra: "Meta 30%+"
      overall: "Meta 2.5%+ dos registrados"

    alert_triggers:
      immediate:
        - "Retention drops below 25% at any point"
        - "Technical issues detected"
        - "Payment failures spiking"

      warning:
        - "Retention 10% below benchmark"
        - "Chat engagement declining"
        - "Click rate below 5%"

    troubleshooting_guide:
      low_retention:
        causes:
          - "Hook muito fraco"
          - "Muito papo, pouca acao"
          - "Nao entregou valor cedo"
        actions:
          - "Signal to accelerate to value"
          - "Add demonstration"
          - "Increase visual variety"

      low_conversion:
        causes:
          - "Oferta desalinhada com conteudo"
          - "Preco sem justificativa"
          - "Falta de urgencia real"
        actions:
          - "Strengthen transition script"
          - "Add more price justification"
          - "Emphasize scarcity"

      high_objections:
        causes:
          - "Nao antecipou concerns"
          - "Falta de proof points"
          - "Transicao abrupta para venda"
        actions:
          - "Address top objections live"
          - "Add more case studies"
          - "Slow down transition"

    outputs:
      - "Real-time performance dashboard"
      - "Optimization recommendations"
      - "Post-event analysis report"
      - "Improvement recommendations"

  follow-up-specialist:
    id: follow-up-specialist
    title: "Post-Workshop Conversion Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🔄"

    purpose: |
      Maximize conversions after the live event through replay,
      urgency sequences, and downsell strategies.

    replay_strategy:
      delivery:
        timing: "Immediately after workshop"
        deadline: "24-48h expiration"

      messaging:
        - "Replay available"
        - "What you missed"
        - "Deadline reminder"
        - "Final chance"

    last_chance_sequence:
      timeline:
        day_1: "Replay + highlights"
        day_2: "Urgency + testimonials"
        day_3: "Final deadline"

      elements:
        - "Maintain real deadline"
        - "Show post-event buyers"
        - "Reinforce scarcity"

    downsell_strategy:
      timing: "After main offer deadline"
      options:
        - "Versao simplificada da oferta"
        - "Parcelamento alternativo"
        - "Trial ou teste"

      positioning: |
        Downsell should be DIFFERENT product, not discounted main.
        Preserve value of main offer.

    non_buyer_recovery:
      segmentation:
        - "Watched but didn't buy"
        - "Registered but didn't attend"
        - "Partial attendees"

      long_term:
        - "Add to content nurture"
        - "Future launch invitations"
        - "Different offer positioning"

    outputs:
      - "Replay sequence deployed"
      - "Additional conversions captured"
      - "Downsell results"
      - "Non-buyer segments for future"

# ===============================================================================
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ===============================================================================

executor_matrix:
  # Phase A: Pre-Workshop
  - task: "Define offer and pricing"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Anchor must be 10-20x final price"

  - task: "Create educational framework"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Must include 3 counter-intuitive insights"

  - task: "Collect and organize proof"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Minimum 10 case studies"

  - task: "Structure bonus stack"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Each bonus has standalone value"

  - task: "Produce slides"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "100+ slides minimum, 7 words max per slide"

  - task: "Record warmup content"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Each video provides standalone insight"

  - task: "Configure tech stack"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "No single point of failure"

  - task: "Launch traffic campaigns"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Track cost per registration daily"

  - task: "Execute email sequence"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Every email increases desire to attend"

  - task: "Complete rehearsal"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Record and review"

  # Phase B: Workshop Execution
  - task: "Pre-show setup"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Double-check every system"

  - task: "Block 1: Hook Impossivel"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Specific, measurable promise"

  - task: "Block 2: Origem e Conexao"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Start worse than audience"

  - task: "Block 3: Educacao Profunda"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "60%+ of time on education"

  - task: "Block 4: Casos em Cascata"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Minimum 3 diverse cases"

  - task: "Block 5: Stack de Valor"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Stack total 10x+ final price"

  - task: "Block 6: Inversao de Risco"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Guarantee must be specific and believable"

  - task: "Block 7: Demonstracao Final"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Don't end until sales velocity drops"

  - task: "Real-time monitoring"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Alert on threshold breaches"

  - task: "Chat moderation"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Collect objections for Q&A"

  - task: "Payment processing"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Backup gateway ready"

  # Phase C: Post-Workshop
  - task: "Send replay email"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Set clear expiration"

  - task: "Execute last chance sequence"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Deadline must be real"

  - task: "Follow up with non-buyers"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Don't devalue main offer"

  - task: "Post-event analysis"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Identify optimization opportunities"

# ===============================================================================
# QUALITY GATES
# ===============================================================================

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Registration Volume Gate"
    transition: "Traffic -> Event"
    condition: "registrations >= 1000"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Extend ads or postpone event"

  QG-002:
    name: "Live Attendance Gate"
    transition: "Registrations -> Live"
    condition: "live_attendance >= 25% of registrations"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Review reminder sequence"

  QG-003:

    transition: "Start -> Block 3"

  QG-004:

# ===============================================================================
```

# Validation Report: Squad Hormozi

**Squad:** hormozi | **Type Detected:** Expert (single mind, 10 specialists)
**Version:** 1.0.0 | **Date:** 2026-02-10
**Validator:** Squad Architect v3.2

---

## Executive Summary

| **Type** | Expert (single mind x multiple specialists) |

| **Critical Gap** | Missing AIOX standard sections (voice_dna, objection_algorithms, output_examples as YAML) |

```yaml
# Pricing Framework Squad Blueprint
# Pattern: HO-SB-002 (Hormozi Squad Blueprint Standard)
# Source: $100M Offers, $100M Price Raise Playbook - Alex Hormozi
# Version: 2.0.0
# Generated: 2026-02-10

squad:
  name: pricing-framework
  purpose: "Determine maximum price the market will pay while maximizing perceived value and profit"
  domain: pricing-strategy
  source_playbook: "$100M Offers, $100M Price Raise Playbook"

  core_equation: |
    VALUE = (Dream Outcome x Perceived Likelihood) / (Time Delay x Effort/Sacrifice)
    TARGET: Price < Perceived Value ALWAYS
    IMPACT: 2x price = 6x profit (at typical margins)

  guiding_principle: |
    "Profit is unnatural. You must force it into existence."
    - Alex Hormozi

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TIER STRUCTURE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tier_structure:
  orchestrator:
    - agent: pricing-coordinator
      role: "Orchestrate the 7-Step Pricing Process and optimize price-value ratio"
      decisions:
        - "Validate market readiness for premium pricing"
        - "Sequence pricing steps appropriately"
        - "Escalate edge cases requiring human judgment"
      kpis:
        - "Price-to-value ratio"
        - "Customer ROI threshold (>300%)"
        - "Churn rate post-increase"

  tier_0_diagnosis:
    - agent: market-validator
      role: "Score market on 4 Indicators (Dor Massiva, Poder de Compra, Fácil de Atingir, Crescendo)"
      inputs:
        - "Market research data"
        - "Competitor pricing analysis"
        - "Customer demographic data"
      outputs:
        - "Market Score (0-12, threshold ≥8)"
        - "Indicator breakdown report"
        - "Go/No-Go recommendation"

    - agent: value-equation-analyzer
      role: "Calculate and optimize the Value Equation variables"
      inputs:
        - "Product/service outcomes"
        - "Customer feedback data"
        - "Time-to-result metrics"
      outputs:
        - "Value Equation score"
        - "Optimization recommendations per variable"
        - "Perceived value estimate"

  tier_1_execution:
    - agent: niche-definer
      role: "Define ultra-specific niche using Dan Kennedy framework (Levels 0-3)"
      specialization: "Step 3: Niching"
      targets:
        minimum_niche_level: "Level 2 (5-10x multiplier)"
        commitment_period: "6 months minimum"
      techniques:
        - "Profissão → Subnicho → Ultra-específico progression"
        - "Multiplier calculation (1x → 100x)"
        - "Market size validation"

    - agent: price-tester
      role: "Execute price testing protocol on new customers"
      specialization: "Step 4: Testing"
      capabilities:
        - "Piloto phase execution (2-4 weeks)"
        - "Breakeven calculation"
        - "Conversion rate analysis"
        - "LTV projection"

    - agent: roi-validator
      role: "Validate price-value discrepancy meets threshold"
      specialization: "Step 5: ROI Validation"
      targets:
        minimum_roi: "300%"
        calculation: "ROI = (Expected Result - Price) / Price x 100%"
      techniques:
        - "Customer outcome documentation"
        - "ROI threshold verification"
        - "Case study compilation"

  tier_2_judgment:
    - agent: conviction-tester
      role: "Guide personal conviction assessment (Teste do Espelho)"
      inputs:
        - "Personal belief assessment"
        - "Documented results history"
        - "Family test scenario"
      outputs:
        - "Conviction score (Pass/Fail)"
        - "Belief gaps identified"
        - "Confidence-building recommendations"

    - agent: rollout-manager
      role: "Manage price increase rollout to existing customers"
      triggers:
        - "New price validated with new customers"
        - "Breakeven confirmed positive"
        - "Conviction test passed"
      techniques:
        - "RAISE letter preparation (5 sections)"
        - "Loyalty discount deployment (3-6 months)"
        - "3-type response handling"
        - "90-day churn monitoring"

    - agent: exception-handler
      role: "Handle price increase exceptions and escalations"
      responsibilities:
        - "Tipo 1 response: Accept without action"
        - "Tipo 2 response: Extend discount 3-6 months"
        - "Tipo 3 response: Accept churn as pulled forward"
        - "PS Statement deployment for edge cases"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AGENT DEFINITIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

agents:
  pricing-coordinator:
    id: pricing-coordinator
    title: "Premium Pricing Orchestrator"
    tier: orchestrator
    icon: "💰"

    purpose: |
      Coordinate the 7-Step Pricing Process to maximize price while maintaining
      value perception. Ensure ROI > 300% for customers.

    core_frameworks:
      - name: "7-Step Pricing Process"
        components: ["Market Validation", "Value Equation", "Niche Definition", "Price Testing", "ROI Validation", "Conviction Test", "Implementation"]
      - name: "Value Equation"
        equation: "(Dream Outcome x Perceived Likelihood) / (Time Delay x Effort/Sacrifice)"
      - name: "4 Market Indicators"
        origin: "$100M Offers Chapter 4"

    decision_authority:
      - "Go/No-Go on market readiness"
      - "Niche level selection"
      - "Price increase magnitude"
      - "Rollout timing and approach"

    inputs:
      - "Market validation scores"
      - "Value equation analysis"
      - "Test results from new customers"
      - "Conviction assessment"

    outputs:
      - "Final price recommendation"
      - "Rollout strategy"
      - "Exception protocols"
      - "Monitoring plan"

    success_metrics:
      primary:
        - name: "Customer ROI"
          target: ">300%"
          calculation: "(Result - Price) / Price x 100%"
        - name: "Price-Value Gap"
          target: "Price < Perceived Value"
      secondary:
        - "Churn rate post-increase <20% Month 1"
        - "Conversion rate drop <30%"
        - "Revenue increase >60% at 2x price"

  market-validator:
    id: market-validator
    title: "Market Indicator Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "🎯"

    purpose: |
      Score markets on the 4 Hormozi Indicators to validate premium pricing potential.
      Threshold: Score ≥8/12 to proceed.

    scoring_system:
      dor_massiva:
        definition: "Is the problem painful enough to pay premium?"
        score_range: "0-3"
        indicators:
          - "Customer urgency level"
          - "Emotional intensity of problem"
          - "Frequency of pain occurrence"
          - "Cost of NOT solving"

      poder_de_compra:
        definition: "Does the audience have money to pay premium?"
        score_range: "0-3"
        indicators:
          - "Average income/revenue"
          - "Budget allocation history"
          - "Price sensitivity data"
          - "Premium purchase history"

      facil_de_atingir:
        definition: "Can I find these people congregated?"
        score_range: "0-3"
        indicators:
          - "Known gathering places"
          - "Active communities"
          - "Accessible channels"
          - "Cost to reach"

      crescendo:
        definition: "Is the market expanding?"
        score_range: "0-3"
        indicators:
          - "Year-over-year growth rate"
          - "New entrants trending"
          - "Investment activity"
          - "Media attention"

    threshold: 8
    action_on_below_threshold: "Do not proceed with premium pricing strategy"

    outputs:
      - "Total Market Score (0-12)"
      - "Individual indicator scores"
      - "Gap analysis"
      - "Go/No-Go recommendation"

  value-equation-analyzer:
    id: value-equation-analyzer
    title: "Value Equation Optimization Specialist"
    tier: tier_0
    icon: "📊"

    purpose: |
      Calculate and optimize the Value Equation to maximize perceived value.
      Focus on increasing numerator, decreasing denominator.

    equation:
      formula: "VALUE = (Dream Outcome x Perceived Likelihood) / (Time Delay x Effort/Sacrifice)"

      variables:
        dream_outcome:
          direction: "INCREASE"
          optimization:
            - "Connect to status desires"
            - "Tap into deep emotional needs"
            - "Quantify outcome in dollars/time"
            - "Make outcome aspirational yet believable"

        perceived_likelihood:
          direction: "INCREASE"
          optimization:
            - "Stack social proof"
            - "Offer guarantees"
            - "Document track record"
            - "Show process transparency"

        time_delay:
          direction: "DECREASE"
          optimization:
            - "Create quick wins"
            - "Show immediate results"
            - "Reduce time-to-first-value"
            - "Milestone celebrations"

        effort_sacrifice:
          direction: "DECREASE"
          optimization:
            - "Done-for-you options"
            - "Simplify processes"
            - "Remove friction points"
            - "Handle objections proactively"

    delivery_vehicle_spectrum:
      low_value: "DIY (Do It Yourself)"
      medium_value: "DWY (Done With You)"
      high_value: "DFY (Done For You)"
      strategy: "Move up the spectrum to justify higher prices"

    outputs:
      - "Value Equation score"
      - "Variable-by-variable analysis"
      - "Optimization roadmap"
      - "Delivery vehicle recommendation"

  niche-definer:
    id: niche-definer
    title: "Niche Strategy Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🎪"

    purpose: |
      Define ultra-specific niche using Dan Kennedy framework to maximize
      price multiplier. Target Level 2-3 for premium pricing.

    niche_levels:
      level_0:
        type: "Genérico"
        multiplier: "1x"
        example: "Gestão de Tempo ($19)"
        recommendation: "Too broad for premium"

      level_1:
        type: "Por Profissão"
        multiplier: "2-5x"
        example: "Gestão de Tempo para Vendedores ($99)"
        recommendation: "Minimum for premium"

      level_2:
        type: "Por Subnicho"
        multiplier: "5-10x"
        example: "Gestão de Tempo para Vendedores B2B Outbound ($499)"
        recommendation: "Sweet spot"

      level_3:
        type: "Ultra-específico"
        multiplier: "10-100x"
        example: "Gestão de Tempo para Vendedores B2B de Ferramentas Elétricas ($2.000)"
        recommendation: "Maximum premium potential"

    commitment_rule: |
      "Commit for minimum 6 months before pivoting.
      Niche switching too early = missed opportunity."

    validation_criteria:
      - "Market size adequate for revenue goals"
      - "Can become known as THE expert"
      - "Language/problems deeply understood"
      - "Competition cannot easily follow"

    outputs:
      - "Recommended niche level"
      - "Target niche definition"
      - "Price multiplier estimate"
      - "6-month commitment plan"

  price-tester:
    id: price-tester
    title: "Price Testing Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "🧪"

    purpose: |
      Execute scientific price testing with new customers only.
      Calculate breakeven before rolling out to existing base.

    testing_protocol:
      piloto:
        duration: "2-4 weeks"
        target_audience: "NEW customers only"
        metric: "Conversion rate not dropping >30%"
        sample_size: "Minimum 30 new leads"

      analysis:
        duration: "1 week"
        metric: "LTV projection positive"
        calculation: "Compare new price LTV vs old price LTV"

      breakeven:
        formula: "Breakeven = (Old Revenue) / (New Price x (1 - Expected Churn Increase))"
        threshold: "Must be positive"

    decision_rules:
      dr_008: |
        "2x price + -20% conversion = FAZER (if +60% revenue)"
        Example:
        - $10 price → 5% conv → $500/100 clicks
        - $20 price → 4% conv → $800/100 clicks (+60%)

    key_insight: |
      "Pricing improvement by 1% is twice as efficient at increasing profit
      as improving retention, and 4x as efficient as acquisition."
      - Profitwell Study (512 companies)

    outputs:
      - "Test results (conversion rate change)"
      - "Revenue impact projection"
      - "Breakeven analysis"
      - "Go/No-Go for rollout"

  roi-validator:
    id: roi-validator
    title: "Customer ROI Validation Specialist"
    tier: tier_1
    icon: "✅"

    purpose: |
      Validate that customer ROI exceeds 300% threshold.
      Price must always be significantly less than value delivered.

    roi_formula:
      equation: "ROI_CLIENTE = (Expected_Result - Price) / Price x 100%"
      threshold: ">300%"
      interpretation: "Customer gains 3-10x what they pay"

    reference_case:
      name: "Gym Launch"
      investment: "$42,000"
      return: "$239,000/year"
      roi: "469%"
      status: "PASS"

    validation_checklist:
      - "Expected outcome quantified in dollars"
      - "Time to achieve outcome documented"
      - "Customer testimonials confirm results"
      - "ROI calculation exceeds 300%"

    warning_signs:
      - "ROI < 300% = price too high or value too low"
      - "Customers complaining about price = perception problem"
      - "High churn = delivery not matching promise"

    outputs:
      - "ROI calculation"
      - "Pass/Fail against threshold"
      - "Supporting evidence"
      - "Optimization recommendations"

  conviction-tester:
    id: conviction-tester
    title: "Personal Conviction Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🪞"

    purpose: |
      Guide the Mirror Test (Dan Kennedy) to ensure personal belief
      in the price. You cannot sell what you don't believe in.

    mirror_test:
      quote: |
        "Charge the highest price you can say out loud without laughing."
        - Dan Kennedy

    conviction_checklist:
      question_1:
        test: "Would you look in the mirror tonight and believe it's worth this price?"
        pass_criteria: "Genuine yes without hesitation"

      question_2:
        test: "Do you have documented results proving effectiveness?"
        pass_criteria: "3+ case studies with quantified results"

      question_3:
        test: "Would you be comfortable if a family member paid this price?"
        pass_criteria: "Genuine yes without guilt"

    failure_actions:
      - "Document more results before raising price"
      - "Improve product until belief is genuine"
      - "Start with smaller increase"
      - "Add more value to justify price"

    human_only: true
    rationale: "This is a judgment call only a human can make"

    outputs:
      - "Conviction score (Pass/Fail)"
      - "Belief gaps identified"
      - "Action plan for gaps"

  rollout-manager:
    id: rollout-manager
    title: "Price Increase Rollout Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "📈"

    purpose: |
      Manage price increase communication and rollout to existing customers.
      Minimize churn while maximizing revenue.

    raise_letter_template:
      name: "RAISE Framework"
      sections:
        R_remind:
          purpose: "Remind of value delivered"
          content: |
            "In the last [X] months, we've added value:
            • [Result 1 achieved]
            • [Feature/benefit used]
            • [Other value delivered]"

        A_address:
          purpose: "Address the increase directly"
          content: |
            "To continue investing in [PRODUCT] for you,
            we need to increase our prices."

        I_invest:
          purpose: "Explain future investments"
          content: |
            "With these resources, we will:
            • [Planned improvement 1]
            • [Planned improvement 2]
            • [Planned improvement 3]"

        S_soften:
          purpose: "Soften with loyalty discount"
          content: |
            "You've been loyal for [X] months.
            New customers pay full price, but you get
            [3-6 months] at current rate."

        E_explain:
          purpose: "Explain and offer support"
          content: |
            "Questions? Reply directly to me.
            PS - If this materially affects you, let me know."

    loyalty_discount:
      duration: "3-6 months"
      calculation: "New Price - Old Price = Credit"
      messaging: "Grandfathered rate as thank you"

    churn_pattern:
      month_1: "Increase (pulled forward churn)"
      month_2: "Decrease (below normal)"
      month_3: "Return to baseline"
      monitoring_period: "90 days minimum"

    outputs:
      - "RAISE letter draft"
      - "Loyalty discount terms"
      - "Rollout timeline"
      - "Churn monitoring dashboard"

  exception-handler:
    id: exception-handler
    title: "Price Exception Specialist"
    tier: tier_2
    icon: "🛡️"

    purpose: |
      Handle the 3 types of customer responses to price increases.
      Apply appropriate response protocol for each type.

    response_types:
      tipo_1:
        description: "See the value, don't like it, but accept"
        action: "None - proceed normally"
        frequency: "60-70%"

      tipo_2:
        description: "Really affected financially"
        action: "Extend discount 3-6 months"
        script: |
          "Don't worry, we got you. Why don't we extend your
          discount another 6 months, then reach out then.
          Is that fair?"
        frequency: "20-30%"

      tipo_3:
        description: "Were going to cancel anyway"
        action: "Accept churn as 'pulled forward'"
        rationale: "Would have left eventually"
        frequency: "10-15%"

    ps_statements:
      b2c: "If this materially affects your ability to buy groceries, let me know and we'll figure it out."
      b2b: "If this materially impacts your business, let me know and we'll figure it out."

    escalation_triggers:
      - condition: "Increase >50%"
        action: "Mandatory individual meetings"
      - condition: "Churn >20% in Month 1"
        action: "Pause rollout, analyze"
      - condition: "Massive negative feedback"
        action: "Implement stair-step increases"

    outputs:
      - "Response classification"
      - "Recommended action"
      - "Script for communication"
      - "Escalation flag if needed"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXECUTOR MATRIX
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

executor_matrix:
  # Step 1: Market Validation
  - task: "Collect market research data"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use verified data sources"

  - task: "Score Dor Massiva indicator"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates scoring"

  - task: "Score Poder de Compra indicator"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Verify with actual purchase data"

  - task: "Score Fácil de Atingir indicator"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Document congregation points"

  - task: "Score Crescendo indicator"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use recent trend data"

  - task: "Make Go/No-Go decision"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Score ≥8/12 required"

  # Step 2: Value Equation
  - task: "Document Dream Outcome"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Use customer language"

  - task: "Calculate Perceived Likelihood"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Based on proof available"

  - task: "Measure Time Delay"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Track actual time-to-result"

  - task: "Assess Effort/Sacrifice"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Survey customers"

  - task: "Recommend delivery vehicle (DIY/DWY/DFY)"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Strategic decision"

  # Step 3: Niche Definition
  - task: "Identify current niche level"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Use Dan Kennedy framework"

  - task: "Research potential sub-niches"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Document market size each"

  - task: "Select target niche level"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Strategic commitment"

  - task: "Define 6-month commitment plan"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "No pivoting before 6 months"

  # Step 4: Price Testing
  - task: "Set up A/B price test"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "New customers only"

  - task: "Run pilot phase (2-4 weeks)"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Minimum 30 leads"

  - task: "Calculate conversion rate change"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Threshold: <30% drop"

  - task: "Calculate breakeven point"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Use breakeven formula"

  - task: "Project LTV at new price"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Include churn projections"

  - task: "Make test Go/No-Go decision"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Revenue increase must be positive"

  # Step 5: ROI Validation
  - task: "Quantify expected customer outcome"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Use actual customer data"

  - task: "Calculate customer ROI"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Threshold: >300%"

  - task: "Document case studies"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Minimum 3 case studies"

  - task: "Validate ROI threshold met"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Pass/Fail decision"

  # Step 6: Conviction Test
  - task: "Conduct Mirror Test"
    executor: Human
    automation: NONE
    guardrails: "Human only - personal belief"

  - task: "Review documented results"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Evidence supports conviction"

  - task: "Family test scenario"
    executor: Human
    automation: NONE
    guardrails: "Human only - personal ethics"

  - task: "Make conviction Go/No-Go"
    executor: Human
    automation: NONE
    guardrails: "Must pass all 3 questions"

  # Step 7: Implementation
  - task: "Draft RAISE letter"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "All 5 sections required"

  - task: "Define loyalty discount"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "3-6 months standard"

  - task: "Prepare PS statement"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "B2B or B2C version"

  - task: "Send communications"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Batch send, track responses"

  - task: "Classify response types (1/2/3)"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Human validates classification"

  - task: "Handle Tipo 2 exceptions"
    executor: Human
    automation: LOW
    guardrails: "Extend discount per script"

  - task: "Monitor churn for 90 days"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Alert if >20% Month 1"

  - task: "Analyze churn pattern"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "Expect high→low→normal"

  # Ongoing Audit
  - task: "Schedule annual price review"
    executor: Worker
    automation: HIGH
    guardrails: "Calendar ≤12 months"

  - task: "Identify opportunistic review triggers"
    executor: Hybrid
    automation: MEDIUM
    guardrails: "New launches, inflation >5%"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUALITY GATES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

quality_gates:
  QG-001:
    name: "Market Validation Gate"
    transition: "Start → Niche Definition"
    condition: "market_score >= 8"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Do not proceed with premium pricing"

  QG-002:
    name: "Value Equation Gate"
    transition: "Analysis → Testing"
    condition: "value_equation_calculated AND optimization_plan_exists"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Complete value analysis before testing"

  QG-003:
    name: "Niche Commitment Gate"
    transition: "Niche → Testing"
    condition: "niche_level >= 2 AND commitment_6_months"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Recommend higher niche level"

  QG-004:
    name: "Price Test Gate"
    transition: "Testing → Validation"
    condition: "conversion_drop < 30% AND revenue_increase > 0"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Adjust price or add value"

  QG-005:
    name: "ROI Threshold Gate"
    transition: "Validation → Conviction"
    condition: "customer_roi > 300%"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Lower price or increase value delivered"

  QG-006:
    name: "Conviction Gate"
    transition: "Conviction → Implementation"
    condition: "mirror_test_passed AND documented_results AND family_test_passed"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Do not implement until genuine belief achieved"

  QG-007:
    name: "Communication Gate"
    transition: "Draft → Send"
    condition: "raise_letter_complete (5 sections) AND loyalty_discount_defined AND ps_statement_ready"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Complete all communication materials"

  QG-008:
    name: "Churn Monitoring Gate"
    transition: "Month 1 → Month 2"
    condition: "churn_rate < 20%"
    type: warning
    failure_action: "Pause rollout if exceeded, analyze root cause"

  QG-009:
    name: "Escalation Gate"
    transition: "Any → Escalation"
    condition: "increase_magnitude > 50%"
    type: blocking
    failure_action: "Require individual customer meetings"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WORKFLOWS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

workflows:
  new_pricing_workflow:
    trigger: "New product/service needs pricing"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: market-validator
        action: "Score market on 4 indicators"
        output: "Market Score (Go/No-Go)"
        gate: QG-001

      - step: 2
        agent: value-equation-analyzer
        action: "Calculate Value Equation"
        output: "Value optimization plan"
        gate: QG-002

      - step: 3
        agent: niche-definer
        action: "Define niche level (2-3)"
        output: "Niche definition + commitment plan"
        gate: QG-003

      - step: 4
        agent: price-tester
        action: "Execute price test on new customers"
        output: "Test results + breakeven"
        gate: QG-004

      - step: 5
        agent: roi-validator
        action: "Validate ROI > 300%"
        output: "ROI Pass/Fail"
        gate: QG-005

      - step: 6
        agent: conviction-tester
        action: "Conduct conviction assessment"
        output: "Conviction Pass/Fail"
        gate: QG-006

      - step: 7
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Set final price"
        output: "Validated price"

  price_increase_workflow:
    trigger: "Annual review OR opportunistic trigger"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Identify increase trigger"
        output: "Trigger classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: price-tester
        action: "Test new price on NEW customers only"
        output: "Test results"
        gate: QG-004

      - step: 3
        agent: roi-validator
        action: "Validate ROI at new price"
        output: "ROI validation"
        gate: QG-005

      - step: 4
        agent: conviction-tester
        action: "Re-confirm conviction at new price"
        output: "Conviction validation"
        gate: QG-006

      - step: 5
        agent: rollout-manager
        action: "Prepare RAISE letter and materials"
        output: "Communication package"
        gate: QG-007

      - step: 6
        agent: rollout-manager
        action: "Send to existing customer base"
        output: "Communications sent"

      - step: 7
        agent: exception-handler
        action: "Handle responses by type"
        output: "Exception resolutions"

      - step: 8
        agent: rollout-manager
        action: "Monitor churn for 90 days"
        output: "Churn analysis"
        gate: QG-008

  exception_handling_workflow:
    trigger: "Customer response to price increase"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: exception-handler
        action: "Classify response (Tipo 1/2/3)"
        output: "Classification"

      - step: 2
        agent: exception-handler
        action: "Execute response protocol"
        condition: "Based on type"
        outputs:
          tipo_1: "No action needed"
          tipo_2: "Extend discount 3-6 months"
          tipo_3: "Accept churn"

      - step: 3
        agent: exception-handler
        action: "Check for escalation triggers"
        condition: "If increase >50% or churn >20%"
        gate: QG-009

      - step: 4
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Document learnings"
        output: "Exception log"

  annual_audit_workflow:
    trigger: "Anniversary of last increase OR opportunistic trigger"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Check for audit triggers"
        triggers:
          - "Anniversary date reached"
          - "New product launch (within 90 days)"
          - "Significant value increase delivered"
          - "Inflation >5%"

      - step: 2
        agent: value-equation-analyzer
        action: "Re-analyze Value Equation"
        output: "Updated value assessment"

      - step: 3
        agent: roi-validator
        action: "Re-calculate customer ROI"
        output: "Current ROI"

      - step: 4
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Recommend increase magnitude"
        output: "Increase recommendation"

      - step: 5
        agent: pricing-coordinator
        action: "Initiate price_increase_workflow if recommended"
        output: "Workflow trigger"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DECISION RULES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

decision_rules:
  # Market Rules
  DR-001:
    name: "Dor Massiva → Premium Price"
    rule: "Price proportional to pain intensity"
    application: "Higher pain = higher willingness to pay"

  DR-002:
    name: "Poder de Compra Verification"
    rule: "Verify actual capacity to pay, not stated"
    application: "Check purchase history, not surveys"

  DR-003:
    name: "Congregation Requirement"
    rule: "Market must be easy to find congregated"
    application: "Known places, active communities"

  DR-004:
    name: "Market Growth"
    rule: "Prefer growing markets (wind at back)"
    application: "Avoid markets declining >25%/year"

  # Niche Rules
  DR-005:
    name: "6-Month Commitment"
    rule: "Minimum 6 months before pivoting niche"
    application: "No early pivots, even if challenging"

  # Value Rules
  DR-006:
    name: "ROI Threshold"
    rule: "Customer ROI must exceed 300%"
    application: "Customer gains 3-10x what they pay"

  DR-007:
    name: "Price < Perceived Value"
    rule: "Price must always be less than perceived value"
    application: "Create obvious value gap"

  # Testing Rules
  DR-008:
    name: "2x Price + -20% Conversion = Go"
    rule: "If 2x price with -20% conversion = +60% revenue, DO IT"
    application: "Revenue trumps conversion rate"

  DR-009:
    name: "Annual Review Mandatory"
    rule: "Review pricing minimum annually + opportunistic triggers"
    application: "Never go >12 months without review"

  # Response Rules
  DR-010:
    name: "3 Response Protocols"
    rule: "Apply specific protocol per response type"
    application: "Tipo 1: None, Tipo 2: Extend, Tipo 3: Accept"

  DR-011:
    name: "Testing Sequence"
    rule: "Test new → Breakeven → Rollout → Optimize"
    application: "Never test on existing customers first"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KPIs & SUCCESS METRICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

kpis:
  primary:
    customer_roi:
      formula: "(Expected Result - Price) / Price x 100%"
      target: ">300%"
      impact: "Ensures sustainable premium pricing"

    revenue_per_customer:
      formula: "Price x Conversion Rate"
      target: "Increase >60% when 2x price"
      benchmark:
        minimum: ">0% increase"
        target: ">60% increase"

  secondary:
    conversion_rate_change:
      formula: "(New Conv - Old Conv) / Old Conv"
      target: "<30% decrease"
      warning: ">30% decrease"

    churn_rate_month_1:
      formula: "Churned / Total Existing"
      target: "<20%"
      warning: ">20% = pause rollout"

    price_increase_frequency:
      formula: "Months since last increase"
      target: "≤12 months"
      reference: "See's Candies: 50+ years consistent"

  by_step:
    market_validation:
      - "Market Score (0-12)"
      - "Individual indicator scores"
      - "Go/No-Go rate"

    value_equation:
      - "Dream Outcome clarity score"
      - "Perceived Likelihood (proof count)"
      - "Time Delay (days to first result)"
      - "Effort/Sacrifice (complexity score)"

    niche_definition:
      - "Niche Level achieved (0-3)"
      - "Price multiplier realized"
      - "6-month commitment adherence"

    price_testing:
      - "Test conversion rate"
      - "Breakeven point"
      - "Revenue projection accuracy"

    implementation:
      - "RAISE letter completion"
      - "Response rate by type"
      - "90-day churn pattern"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

troubleshooting:
  - symptom: "Market Score <8"
    possible_causes:
      - "Wrong market selected"
      - "Pain not intense enough"
      - "Audience lacks purchasing power"
    diagnosis:
      - "Review each indicator score"
      - "Interview target customers"
      - "Research competitor success"
    solutions:
      - "Select different market"
      - "Find sub-segment with higher pain"
      - "Target higher-value customers"

  - symptom: "Conviction test fails"
    possible_causes:
      - "Insufficient proof of results"
      - "Price increase too aggressive"
      - "Product quality gaps"
    diagnosis:
      - "Count documented case studies"
      - "Compare to competitor pricing"
      - "Review customer feedback"
    solutions:
      - "Document more results before increasing"
      - "Start with smaller increase"
      - "Improve product before raising price"

  - symptom: "Conversion drops >30%"
    possible_causes:
      - "Price too high for value delivered"
      - "Communication not highlighting value"
      - "Wrong niche/audience"
    diagnosis:
      - "Calculate actual ROI"
      - "Review sales messaging"
      - "Analyze who is converting vs not"
    solutions:
      - "Add more value to offer"
      - "Improve value communication"
      - "Narrow niche further"

  - symptom: "Churn >20% Month 1"
    possible_causes:
      - "Increase too aggressive"
      - "Communication poorly received"
      - "Value not being perceived"
    diagnosis:
      - "Survey churned customers"
      - "Review RAISE letter feedback"
      - "Compare churn by customer tenure"
    solutions:
      - "Pause rollout"
      - "Extend loyalty discounts"
      - "Implement stair-step increases"

  - symptom: "Customers complaining but not churning"
    possible_causes:
      - "Tipo 1 responses (normal)"
      - "Value still exceeds price"
      - "No alternatives available"
    diagnosis:
      - "Track complaint-to-churn ratio"
      - "Survey customer satisfaction"
      - "Monitor competitor activity"
    solutions:
      - "Acknowledge - this is expected"
      - "Continue delivering value"
      - "Document for future reference"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TEMPLATES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

templates:
  raise_letter:
    name: "RAISE Price Increase Letter"
    format: |
      Dear [NAME],

      **R - REMIND (Value Delivered)**
      In the last [X] months, we've added significant value to [PRODUCT]:
      • [Result 1 you helped achieve]
      • [Feature/benefit they use]
      • [Other value delivered]

      **A - ADDRESS (The Increase)**
      To continue investing in [PRODUCT] for you and team [COMPANY],
      we need to increase our prices.

      **I - INVEST (Future Plans)**
      With these resources, we will:
      • [Planned improvement 1]
      • [Planned improvement 2]
      • [Planned improvement 3]

      **S - SOFTEN (Loyalty Reward)**
      You've been incredibly loyal, using our services for the last [X] months.
      Starting today, new customers pay the full price, but because you're
      special, we'll keep your current plan for the next [3-6 MONTHS].
      We're giving you a [$XXX] credit as a thank you
      (after which we'll adjust to the new price of $XXX).

      **E - EXPLAIN (Support)**
      Thank you for letting us be part of [COMPANY]'s mission.
      If you have any questions, let me know. All replies come directly to me.

      [YOUR NAME]

      PS - [B2C: If this materially affects your ability to buy groceries, let me know and we'll figure it out.]
      PS - [B2B: If this materially impacts your business, let me know and we'll figure it out.]

  tipo_2_response:
    name: "Extension Response Script"
    format: |
      "Don't worry, we got you. Why don't we extend your
      discount another 6 months, then reach out then.
      Is that fair?"

  breakeven_calculation:
    name: "Breakeven Formula"
    format: |
      Breakeven = (Old Revenue) / (New Price × (1 - Expected Churn Increase))

      Example:
      - Old Revenue: $50,000/month
      - New Price: 2x old price
      - Expected Churn Increase: 5%
      - Breakeven = $50,000 / (2 × 0.95) = $26,316
      - If you keep >$26,316 in revenue, you win

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 10 PRICING PLAYS (from $100M Price Raise Playbook)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pricing_plays:
  play_1:
    name: "28-Day Billing Cycles"
    description: "Change from monthly to 28-day billing"
    impact: "13 billing cycles per year instead of 12"
    source: "Playbook p.22-23"

  play_2:
    name: "Processing Fees"
    description: "Pass processing fees to customer"
    impact: "2-4% revenue increase"
    source: "Playbook p.24-26"

  play_3:
    name: "Sales Tax Separation"
    description: "Charge and display sales tax separately"
    impact: "Price appears lower, tax is expected"
    source: "Playbook p.27-29"

  play_4:
    name: "Annual Price Increases"
    description: "See's Candies model - consistent annual increases"
    impact: "50+ years, avg 10%/year, up to 17%"
    source: "Playbook p.30-32"

  play_5:
    name: "Annual Billing Option"
    description: "Offer discount for annual prepay"
    impact: "Improved cash flow, reduced churn"
    source: "Playbook p.33-35"

  play_6:
    name: "Round Up"
    description: "Round prices to nearest $5 or $10"
    impact: "Incremental revenue"
    source: "Playbook p.36-38"

  play_7:
    name: "Annual Renewal Fee"
    description: "Add annual fee on top of monthly"
    impact: "Additional revenue stream"
    source: "Playbook p.39-42"

  play_8:
    name: "Automatic Continuity"
    description: "Auto-renew subscriptions"
    impact: "Reduced friction, higher retention"
    source: "Playbook p.43-47"

  play_9:
    name: "Ultra High Ticket Anchor"
    description: "Show expensive option first"
    impact: "Makes standard price seem reasonable"
    source: "Playbook p.48-49"

  play_10:
    name: "Guarantee Upsells"
    description: "Sell extended warranties/guarantees"
    impact: "Additional revenue on existing sales"
    source: "Playbook p.50-53"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# THREE PRICING MODELS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pricing_models:
  cost_plus:
    name: "Cost Plus Pricing"
    description: "Whatever your costs are plus an arbitrarily added margin"
    limitation: "Doesn't account for customer willingness to pay"
    source: "Playbook p.12"

  competitor_based:
    name: "Competitor Based Pricing"
    description: "Whatever the average of what everyone else is charging"
    limitation: "Race to the bottom, commoditization"
    source: "Playbook p.12-13"

  value_based:
    name: "Value Based Pricing"
    description: "Based on what a customer is willing to pay (WTP)"
    advantage: "Captures maximum value"
    recommendation: "USE THIS MODEL"
    source: "Playbook p.13-14"
```
